        out = live.get_world().set_enabled(body.enabled)
    except live.Paused as e:
        raise Conflict(str(e)) from None
    T.audit(me, "simulation_" + ("resumed" if body.enabled else "paused"))
    return out

"""The team: accounts and roles, how leads are given out, performance, and the audit log (admins)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query, status

from app import db
from app.api.deps import Admin, Member
from app.core import security
from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.errors import NotFound
from app.schemas.crm import MemberRequest, MemberUpdate, PasswordRequest, TeamSettingsRequest
from app.services import team as T

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
router = APIRouter(tags=["CRM team"])
EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$")


def _member_or_404(member_id: int) -> dict:
    m = T.member(member_id)
    if not m:
        raise NotFound("No such team member.")
    return m


def _assign_after_release() -> None:
    try:
        T.auto_assign()
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - the every-minute run tries again
        log.warning("Giving out released leads failed; the every-minute run tries again", exc_info=True)


@router.get("/team", summary="Every account, the team settings and the roles")
def list_team(_: Admin):
    return {
        "members": [T.public(m) for m in T.members()],
        "settings": T.get_settings(),
        "roles": [{"key": r, "label": T.ROLE_LABEL[r]} for r in T.ROLES],
        "rules": list(T.RULES),
    }


@router.post("/team", summary="Add an account (they choose their own password at the first sign-in)")
def add_member(body: MemberRequest, me: Admin):
    name, email = (body.name or "").strip(), (body.email or "").strip().lower()
    if not name:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "Give a name (up to 80 characters).")
    if not EMAIL_RE.match(email):
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "Give a valid email address.")
    if body.role not in T.ROLES:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "Role must be admin, marketing or counsellor.")
    if email == get_settings().crm_owner_email.strip().lower() or T.member_by_email(email):
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT, "There is already an account with this email address.")
    problem = security.password_problem(body.password)
    if problem:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, problem)
    m = T.create_member(name, email, body.role, body.password)
    T.audit(me, "member_created", "member", m["id"], f"{name} ({T.ROLE_LABEL[body.role]})")
    return {
        "member": T.public(m),
        "message": f"{name} can now sign in; they choose their own password at the first sign-in.",
    }


@router.put("/team/{member_id}", summary="Change an account's name, role, status or lead intake")
def update_member(member_id: int, body: MemberUpdate, me: Admin):
    m = _member_or_404(member_id)
    changes, sets, params = [], [], []
    if body.name is not None:
        name = body.name.strip()
        if not name:
            raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "Give a name (up to 80 characters).")
        sets.append("name=?")
        params.append(name)
        changes.append(f"name: {name}")
    if body.role is not None and body.role != m["role"]:
        if body.role not in T.ROLES:
            raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "Role must be admin, marketing or counsellor.")
        if m["is_owner"]:
            raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "The owner account stays an admin.")
        sets.append("role=?")
        params.append(body.role)
        changes.append(f"role: {T.ROLE_LABEL[body.role]}")
    if body.active is not None and bool(body.active) != bool(m["active"]):
        if m["is_owner"] or m["id"] == me["id"]:
            raise HTTPException(
                status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "You cannot switch off the owner account or your own account."
            )
        sets.append("active=?")
        params.append(1 if body.active else 0)
        changes.append("switched on" if body.active else "switched off")
    if body.takes_new_leads is not None and bool(body.takes_new_leads) != bool(m["takes_new_leads"]):
        sets.append("takes_new_leads=?")
        params.append(1 if body.takes_new_leads else 0)
        changes.append("takes new leads" if body.takes_new_leads else "takes no new leads")
    if not sets:
        return {"member": T.public(m), "message": "Nothing changed."}
    db.execute(f"UPDATE team_members SET {', '.join(sets)} WHERE id=?", params + [member_id])
    released = 0
    if body.active is False:
        released = T.release_leads(member_id)  # their leads go back to the pool (and to the others)
        changes.append(f"{released} lead(s) unassigned")
    T.audit(me, "member_updated", "member", member_id, "; ".join(changes))
    if released:
        _assign_after_release()
    return {"member": T.public(T.member(member_id)), "message": "Saved: " + "; ".join(changes) + "."}


@router.post("/team/{member_id}/password", summary="Set a new password (they choose their own at the next sign-in)")
def reset_password(member_id: int, body: PasswordRequest, me: Admin):
    m = _member_or_404(member_id)
    if m["is_owner"] and get_settings().owner_password_from_env:
        raise HTTPException(
            status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "The owner account's password is CRM_OWNER_PASSWORD in backend/.env."
        )
    problem = security.password_problem(body.password)
    if problem:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, problem)
    T.set_password(member_id, body.password, must_change=True)
    T.clear_failures(m["email"])
    T.audit(me, "password_reset", "member", member_id, m["name"])
    return {"message": f"New password set for {m['name']}; they choose their own at the next sign-in."}


@router.delete("/team/{member_id}", summary="Delete an account (its leads become unassigned)")
def delete_member(member_id: int, me: Admin):
    """For an account made by mistake. Notes keep the name and the audit log keeps what it did; switching an account
    off keeps it in the list instead."""
    m = _member_or_404(member_id)
    if m["is_owner"] or m["id"] == me["id"]:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "You cannot delete the owner account or your own account.")
    released = T.release_leads(member_id)
    db.execute("DELETE FROM team_members WHERE id=?", (member_id,))
    T.clear_failures(m["email"])
    T.audit(me, "member_deleted", "member", member_id, f"{m['name']}; {released} lead(s) unassigned")
    if released:
        _assign_after_release()
    return {"message": f"{m['name']} deleted; {released} lead(s) unassigned."}


@router.put("/team-settings", summary="How leads are given out, service levels and task expiry")
def update_team_settings(body: TeamSettingsRequest, me: Admin):
    values = {k: v for k, v in body.model_dump().items() if v is not None}
    if "assignment_rule" in values and values["assignment_rule"] not in T.RULES:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "The rule must be round_robin or least_loaded.")
    for k in ("task_sla_hours", "callback_sla_hours"):
        if k in values and not 0.25 <= float(values[k]) <= 720:
            raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "Service levels must be between 0.25 and 720 hours.")
    if "task_expiry_days" in values and not 0 <= float(values["task_expiry_days"]) <= 90:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "Task expiry must be between 1 and 90 days (0 = never).")
    out = T.put_settings(values)
    T.audit(me, "team_settings", None, None, ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in values.items()))
    return {"settings": out}


@router.post("/team/assign-now", summary="Give out leads now (backlog=true: also older open leads)")
def assign_now(me: Admin, backlog: bool = False):
    made = []
    while True:  # in batches of 500
        batch = T.auto_assign(actor=me, backlog=backlog, force=True)
        made += batch
        if len(batch) < 500:
            break
    names = T.names()
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for _, mid in made:
        counts[names.get(mid, str(mid))] = counts.get(names.get(mid, str(mid)), 0) + 1
    if not T.eligible_counsellors():
        msg = "Nobody takes new leads yet: add a counsellor (Team page) or switch on 'takes new leads'."
    else:
        msg = f"{len(made)} lead(s) assigned" + (
            ": " + ", ".join(f"{n} to {k}" for k, n in counts.items()) if made else "."
        )
    return {"assigned": len(made), "by_member": counts, "message": msg}


@router.get("/team/performance", summary="One row per counsellor: leads, tasks, speed, purchases and revenue")
def performance(_: Member, days: int = Query(30, ge=1, le=365)):
    return T.performance(days)


@router.get("/audit", summary="Who changed what (people on the team; leads by number only)")
def audit_log(
    _: Admin,
    member_id: int | None = None,
    action: str | None = None,
    person: int | None = None,
    limit: int = Query(200, ge=1, le=2000),
):
    sql, params = "SELECT * FROM audit_log WHERE 1=1", []
    if member_id is not None:
        sql += " AND member_id=?"
        params.append(member_id)
    if action:
        sql += " AND action=?"
        params.append(action)
    if person is not None:
        sql += " AND target_type='person' AND target_id=?"
        params.append(person)
    rows = db.fetchall(sql + " ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", params + [limit])
    people = sorted({r["target_id"] for r in rows if r["target_type"] == "person" and r["target_id"]})
    lead_of = {}
    for i in range(0, len(people), 900):
        chunk = people[i : i + 900]
        for r in db.fetchall(
            f"""SELECT user_id, MAX(id) AS lead_id FROM leads
                                 WHERE user_id IN ({','.join('?' * len(chunk))}) GROUP BY user_id""",
            chunk,
        ):
            lead_of[r["user_id"]] = r["lead_id"]
    for r in rows:
        r["lead_id"] = lead_of.get(r["target_id"]) if r["target_type"] == "person" else None
    actions = [r["action"] for r in db.fetchall("SELECT DISTINCT action FROM audit_log ORDER BY action")]
    return {"entries": rows, "actions": actions}

"""The learner's own account: profile, contact preferences, their dashboard, and deleting everything."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re
import sqlite3

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, status

from app import db

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
router = APIRouter(tags=["Learner profile and privacy"])

PHONE_RE = re.compile(r"^\+?[0-9][0-9 -]{8,14}$")


@router.get("/profile/options", summary="The choices the profile form offers (the lead model's own vocabulary)")
def profile_options():
    from app.ml import features as F

    def known(values):
        return [v for v in values if v != "Unknown"]

    return {
        "occupations": known(F.OCCUPATIONS),
        "specializations": known(F.SPECIALIZATIONS),
        "age_brackets": known(F.AGE_BRACKETS),
        "how_heard": known(F.HOW_HEARD),
    }


@router.post("/profile/complete", summary="Save the profile (occupation, specialisation, city, phone)")
def complete_profile(body: ProfileRequest, user: Learner):
    if body.phone and not PHONE_RE.match(body.phone.strip()):
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "Please enter a valid phone number.")
    db.execute(
        """
        INSERT INTO user_profiles (user_id, current_occupation, specialization, age_bracket, city, country, phone,
                                   how_did_you_hear, profile_complete)
        VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,1)
        ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET
          current_occupation=excluded.current_occupation, specialization=excluded.specialization,
          age_bracket=excluded.age_bracket, city=excluded.city, country=excluded.country,
          phone=COALESCE(excluded.phone, user_profiles.phone), how_did_you_hear=excluded.how_did_you_hear,
          profile_complete=1, updated_at=datetime('now','localtime')""",
        (
            user["id"],
            body.current_occupation,
            body.specialization,
            body.age_bracket,
            body.city,
            body.country,
            (body.phone or "").strip() or None,
            body.how_did_you_hear,
        ),
    )
    return {"message": "Profile saved. Your course suggestions now use it."}


@router.put("/profile/preferences", summary="Contact preferences: email, calls, WhatsApp, phone number")
def update_preferences(body: PreferencesRequest, user: Learner):
    db.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO user_profiles (user_id) VALUES (?)", (user["id"],))
    if body.do_not_email is not None:
        db.execute(
            "UPDATE user_profiles SET do_not_email=? WHERE user_id=?",
            ("Yes" if body.do_not_email else "No", user["id"]),
        )
    if body.do_not_call is not None:
        db.execute(
            "UPDATE user_profiles SET do_not_call=? WHERE user_id=?", ("Yes" if body.do_not_call else "No", user["id"])
        )
    if body.whatsapp_opt_in is not None:
        db.execute(
            "UPDATE user_profiles SET whatsapp_opt_in=? WHERE user_id=?", (1 if body.whatsapp_opt_in else 0, user["id"])
        )
    if body.phone is not None:
        phone = body.phone.strip()
        if phone and not PHONE_RE.match(phone):
            raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "Please enter a valid phone number.")
        db.execute("UPDATE user_profiles SET phone=? WHERE user_id=?", (phone or None, user["id"]))
    return {"message": "Preferences saved.", "profile": db.get_profile(user["id"])}

@router.delete("/me", summary="Delete the account and every record linked to it (right to erasure)")
def delete_my_account(user: Learner):
    """Deletes the person and everything linked to them: contact records, events, emails, decisions, purchases,
    tasks, notes, WhatsApp log, questions to the CRM assistant about them. Cannot be undone. The audit log keeps
    only numbers, so it stays."""
    con = db.get_conn()
    removed = 0
    try:
        tables = [r[0] for r in con.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'")]
        for t in tables:
            cols = [r[1] for r in con.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({t})")]
            if "user_id" in cols and t != "users":
                removed += con.execute(f"DELETE FROM {t} WHERE user_id=?", (user["id"],)).rowcount
        con.execute("DELETE FROM otp_tokens WHERE email=?", (user["email"],))
        con.execute("DELETE FROM simulated_inbox WHERE email=?", (user["email"],))
        con.execute("DELETE FROM login_attempts WHERE email=?", ("learner:" + user["email"],))
        try:
            for v in {user["email"], (user.get("name") or "").strip()} - {""}:
                removed += con.execute(
                    """DELETE FROM copilot_log WHERE question LIKE ? OR answer LIKE ?
                                          OR tools_json LIKE ? OR drafts_json LIKE ?""",
                    (f"%{v}%",) * 4,
                ).rowcount
        except sqlite3.Error:
            pass
        con.execute("DELETE FROM users WHERE id=?", (user["id"],))
        con.commit()
    finally:
        con.close()
    from app.services import money

    money.reset_cache()  # they leave the pipeline's totals at once
    log.info("Deleted user %s and %d linked records at their request", user["id"], removed)
    return {"message": "Your account and all data linked to it have been deleted."}

from __future__ import annotations

TRACKED_EVENTS = {
    "page_view",
    "video_play",
    "brochure_dl",

    "pricing_view",
    "testimonial_view",
    "webinar_view",
    "webinar_register",
    "cart_add",

@router.post("/session/start", summary="Start a visit (a new tab, or after 30 minutes idle)")
def start_session(body: SessionStart, user: Learner):
    device = body.device_type if body.device_type in F.DEVICE_TYPES else "Desktop"
    source = body.lead_source if body.lead_source in F.LEAD_SOURCES else "Direct Traffic"
    sid = db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO user_sessions (user_id, device_type, lead_source) VALUES (?,?,?)", (user["id"], device, source)
    )
    return {"session_id": sid}


@router.post("/session/ping", summary="Still here (every 30 s while the page is in use)")
def session_ping(body: SessionPing, user: Learner):
    """Nothing is recorded as an event; only the visit's last-active time moves, so the CRM does not mistake a
    long read for a visit that has ended (its 'visit ended' follow-up waits until the learner has really left)."""
    db.execute(
        "UPDATE user_sessions SET last_active=datetime('now','localtime') WHERE id=? AND user_id=?",
        (body.session_id, user["id"]),
    )
    return {"ok": True}


@router.post("/track", summary="Record one event and re-score the learner")
def track_event(body: BehaviourEvent, user: Learner):
    if body.event_type not in TRACKED_EVENTS:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, f"Unknown event type '{body.event_type}'")
    # a visit id from another account (a stale browser tab) must not be counted
    sess = db.fetchone("SELECT id FROM user_sessions WHERE id=? AND user_id=?", (body.session_id, user["id"]))
    session_id = sess["id"] if sess else None
    seconds = max(0, min(int(body.time_spent_sec or 0), 1800))  # at most 30 minutes per page
    db.execute(
        """INSERT INTO behaviour_events (user_id, session_id, course_slug, event_type, time_spent_sec)
                  VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)""",
        (user["id"], session_id, body.course_slug, body.event_type, seconds),
    )
    if session_id:
        db.execute("UPDATE user_sessions SET last_active=datetime('now','localtime') WHERE id=?", (session_id,))
    # re-score live; a snapshot for the learning loop is kept at most every 30 minutes
    with perf.timer("event_to_score"):
        _, pred = rescore_latest_lead(user["id"], "activity", snapshot_gap_minutes=30)
    return {
        "tracked": True,
        "live_score": pred["lead_score"],
        "persona": pred["persona"],
        "tier": pred["recommended_action"],
    }


# Every marketing email's button opens <site>/courses/<slug>?ref=<token>: the course the person looked at, on our
# own website. The page reports the click here, signed in or not (the token identifies the email).
@router.post("/email/click", summary="An email's button was opened (reported by the course page)")
def email_click(body: EmailToken):
    token = (body.token or "").strip().lower()
    if not TOKEN_RE.match(token):
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "Invalid link.")
    send = db.get_email_send_by_token(token)
    if not send:
        return {"ok": False, "message": "Unknown email link."}
    first = not send.get("first_clicked_at")
    db.execute(
        """UPDATE email_sends SET click_count = click_count + 1, open_count = open_count + 1,
                  opened_at = COALESCE(opened_at, datetime('now','localtime')),
                  first_clicked_at = COALESCE(first_clicked_at, datetime('now','localtime'))
                  WHERE token=?""",
        (token,),
    )
    if send.get("user_id"):
        rescore_latest_lead(send["user_id"], "email_click")
    return {"ok": True, "first_click": first}


@router.post("/email/unsubscribe", summary="One-click unsubscribe from marketing emails")
def email_unsubscribe(body: EmailToken):
    token = (body.token or "").strip().lower()
    send = db.get_email_send_by_token(token) if TOKEN_RE.match(token) else None
    if not send or not send.get("user_id"):
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "This unsubscribe link is not valid any more.")
    db.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO user_profiles (user_id) VALUES (?)", (send["user_id"],))
    db.execute("UPDATE user_profiles SET do_not_email='Yes' WHERE user_id=?", (send["user_id"],))
    return {"ok": True, "message": "You have been unsubscribed from X Education marketing emails."}

"""Learner accounts: sign-up with an emailed code, sign-in, password reset, and deleting the account."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re
import sqlite3

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, status

from app import db
from app.api.deps import Learner
from app.core import rules, security
from app.schemas.learner import (
    ChangePasswordRequest,
    EmailOnly,
    LoginRequest,
    OtpVerifyRequest,
    ResetPasswordRequest,
    SignupRequest,
)
from app.services import learner_auth as otp
from app.services import team as T
from app.services.mailer import mailer_not_configured, send_otp_email
from app.services.scoring import save_lead, score_user

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
router = APIRouter(prefix="/auth", tags=["Learner accounts"])

EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$")
LOCK_NS = "learner:"


def _check_password(pw: str) -> None:
    problem = security.password_problem(pw, require_digit=False)
    if problem:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, problem)


def _start_session(user_id: int) -> int:
    return db.execute("INSERT INTO user_sessions (user_id, device_type) VALUES (?,?)", (user_id, "Desktop"))


def _send_code(email: str, code: str, name: str, purpose: str = "signup") -> dict | None:
    ok, msg = send_otp_email(email, code, name, purpose=purpose)
    if ok and not mailer_not_configured(msg):
        return None
    if ok or rules.DEMO_MODE:
        # a local or live demo must not stop because email is not set up or Gmail is unreachable: the code goes to
        # the backend log (only then; with email working, codes are never logged)
        log.warning("The %s code for %s is %s (%s)", purpose, email, code, msg)
        return {
            "message": "Email is not set up on this computer, so your code is shown in the backend window "
            "(and in backend/data/logs/app.log)."
            if ok
            else "We could not email your code just now. In demo mode it is shown in the backend window."
        }
    raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, f"Could not send the code: {msg}")


@router.post("/signup", summary="Create an account and email a verification code")
def signup(body: SignupRequest):
    email = (body.email or "").strip().lower()
    name = (body.name or "").strip()
    if not name:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "Please enter your name.")
    if not EMAIL_RE.match(email):
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "Please enter a valid email address.")
    _check_password(body.password)
    existing = db.get_user_by_email(email)
    if existing and existing["is_verified"]:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT, "This email address is already registered. Please sign in.")
    created = False
    if existing:
        # an unfinished sign-up: refresh the details and send a new code instead of leaving the address stuck
        db.execute(
            "UPDATE users SET name=?, password_hash=? WHERE id=?",
            (name, security.hash_password(body.password), existing["id"]),
        )
        user_id = existing["id"]
    else:
        try:
            user_id = db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO users (name, email, password_hash, is_verified) VALUES (?,?,?,0)",
                (name, email, security.hash_password(body.password)),
            )
            created = True
        except sqlite3.IntegrityError:
            raise HTTPException(
                status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                "A sign-up is already in progress for this address. Check your inbox for the code.",
            ) from None
    code = otp.generate_otp()
    otp.save_otp(email, code)
    try:
        demo = _send_code(email, code, name)
    except HTTPException:
        if created:
            db.execute("DELETE FROM users WHERE id=?", (user_id,))
        raise
    return demo or {"message": f"We sent a code to {email}. Enter it to finish signing up."}


@router.post("/verify-otp", summary="Verify the sign-up code and sign in")
def verify_otp(body: OtpVerifyRequest):
    email = (body.email or "").strip().lower()
    if not otp.verify_otp(email, body.otp):
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "That code is wrong or has expired. Please try again.")
    user = db.get_user_by_email(email)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "Account not found")
    db.execute("UPDATE users SET is_verified=1 WHERE email=?", (email,))
    db.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO user_profiles (user_id) VALUES (?)", (user["id"],))
    # every verified person becomes a contact in the CRM straight away
    if not db.get_user_lead(user["id"]):
        save_lead(user["id"], score_user(user["id"], source="signup", explain=True), {}, "signup")
    return {
        "token": security.create_learner_token(user["id"], user["email"], user["password_hash"]),
        "session_id": _start_session(user["id"]),
        "user": {"id": user["id"], "name": user["name"], "email": user["email"]},
        "profile_complete": bool((db.get_profile(user["id"]) or {}).get("profile_complete")),
        "message": "Email verified. Welcome to X Education.",
    }


@router.post("/login", summary="Sign in")
def login(body: LoginRequest):
    email = (body.email or "").strip().lower()
    wait = T.locked_seconds(email, ns=LOCK_NS)
    if wait:
        raise HTTPException(
            status.HTTP_429_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
            f"Too many wrong passwords. Try again in {max(1, round(wait / 60))} minute(s) or reset " "your password.",
        )
    user = db.get_user_by_email(email)
    if not user:
        security.waste_time(body.password)
    if not user or not security.verify_password(body.password, user["password_hash"]):
        T.record_failure(email, ns=LOCK_NS)
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, "Incorrect email address or password.")
    if not user["is_verified"]:
        raise HTTPException(
            status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "Please verify your email address first. Check your inbox " "for the code."
        )
    T.clear_failures(email, ns=LOCK_NS)
    profile = db.get_profile(user["id"])
    return {
        "token": security.create_learner_token(user["id"], user["email"], user["password_hash"]),
        "session_id": _start_session(user["id"]),
        "user": {"id": user["id"], "name": user["name"], "email": user["email"]},
        "profile_complete": bool(profile and profile.get("profile_complete")),
    }


@router.get("/me", summary="The signed-in learner and their profile")
def me(user: Learner):
    return {"user": db.public_user(user), "profile": db.get_profile(user["id"])}


@router.post("/resend-otp", summary="Send a new sign-up code")
def resend_otp(body: EmailOnly):
    email = (body.email or "").strip().lower()
    user = db.get_user_by_email(email)
    if not user or user["is_verified"]:
        return {"message": "If that account is waiting for verification, a new code has been sent."}
    age = otp.last_otp_age_seconds(email, "signup")
    if age is not None and age < otp.RESEND_SECONDS:
        raise HTTPException(
            status.HTTP_429_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
            f"Please wait {int(otp.RESEND_SECONDS - age)} seconds before asking for a new code.",
        )
    code = otp.generate_otp()
    otp.save_otp(email, code, "signup")
    demo = _send_code(email, code, user["name"])
    return demo or {"message": f"A new code has been sent to {email}."}


@router.post("/forgot-password", summary="Email a password reset code")
def forgot_password(body: EmailOnly):
    email = (body.email or "").strip().lower()
    generic = {"message": "If an account exists for that address, a reset code has been sent."}
    user = db.get_user_by_email(email)
    if not user or not user["is_verified"]:
        return generic  # do not reveal which addresses are registered
    age = otp.last_otp_age_seconds(email, "reset")
    if age is not None and age < otp.RESEND_SECONDS:
        raise HTTPException(
            status.HTTP_429_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
            f"Please wait {int(otp.RESEND_SECONDS - age)} seconds before asking for a new code.",
        )
    code = otp.generate_otp()
    otp.save_otp(email, code, "reset")
    send_otp_email(email, code, user["name"], purpose="reset")
    return generic


@router.post("/reset-password", summary="Set a new password with the reset code")
def reset_password(body: ResetPasswordRequest):
    email = (body.email or "").strip().lower()
    _check_password(body.new_password)
    if not otp.verify_otp(email, body.otp, "reset"):
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "That code is wrong or has expired.")
    db.execute("UPDATE users SET password_hash=? WHERE email=?", (security.hash_password(body.new_password), email))
    T.clear_failures(email, ns=LOCK_NS)
    return {"message": "Password updated. You can sign in now."}


@router.post("/change-password", summary="Change the password of the signed-in learner")
def change_password(body: ChangePasswordRequest, user: Learner):
    if not security.verify_password(body.current_password, user["password_hash"]):
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "Your current password is not right.")
    _check_password(body.new_password)
    new_hash = security.hash_password(body.new_password)
    db.execute("UPDATE users SET password_hash=? WHERE id=?", (new_hash, user["id"]))
    # every other session is signed out; this one goes on with a new token
    return {"message": "Password changed.", "token": security.create_learner_token(user["id"], user["email"], new_hash)}

"""Cart, wishlist, coupons, checkout and enquiries. Prices always come from the server's catalogue."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re

from fastapi import APIRouter, BackgroundTasks, HTTPException, status

from app import db
from app.api.deps import Learner
from app.ml import features as F
from app.schemas.learner import CartItem, CheckoutRequest, CouponCheck, EnquiryRequest, WishlistItem
from app.services import catalog, mailer, money
from app.services.mailer import ATTRIBUTION_LABELS, send_purchase_confirmation_email
from app.services.playbook import handle_trigger
from app.services.scoring import rescore_latest_lead

router = APIRouter(tags=["Cart and checkout"])
PHONE_RE = re.compile(r"^\+?[0-9][0-9 -]{8,14}$")


def _course_or_404(slug: str) -> dict:
    course = catalog.get_course(slug)
    if not course:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "Course not found.")
    return course


@router.get("/cart", summary="The learner's cart")
def get_cart(user: Learner):
    return {"cart": db.get_cart(user["id"])}


@router.post("/cart", summary="Add a course to the cart")
def add_to_cart(item: CartItem, user: Learner):
    course = _course_or_404(item.course_slug)
    if db.fetchone("SELECT id FROM purchases WHERE user_id=? AND course_slug=?", (user["id"], item.course_slug)):
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT, "You are already enrolled in this course.")
    db.execute(
        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO cart (user_id, course_slug, course_title, price) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
        (user["id"], course["slug"], course["title"], course["price"]),
    )
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO behaviour_events (user_id, course_slug, event_type) VALUES (?,?,?)",
        (user["id"], item.course_slug, "cart_add"),
    )
    return {"message": f"{course['title']} added to your cart."}


@router.delete("/cart/{course_slug}", summary="Remove a course from the cart")
def remove_from_cart(course_slug: str, user: Learner):
    db.execute("DELETE FROM cart WHERE user_id=? AND course_slug=?", (user["id"], course_slug))
    return {"message": "Removed from your cart."}


@router.get("/wishlist", summary="The learner's wishlist")

    db.execute(

    )
    db.execute(

        (user["id"], item.course_slug, "wishlist_add"),
    )
    return {"message": f"{course['title']} saved to your wishlist."}

def _cart_total(user_id: int) -> float:
    return sum(catalog.price_of(i["course_slug"]) or i["price"] for i in db.get_cart(user_id))


@router.post("/checkout/start", summary="The learner opened the checkout page")
def checkout_start(user: Learner):
    if not db.get_cart(user["id"]):
        return {"checkout_id": None, "cart_value": 0}  # nothing to abandon
    value = _cart_total(user["id"])
    return {"checkout_id": db.start_checkout_session(user["id"], value), "cart_value": value}


@router.post("/coupons/check", summary="Check a coupon before paying")
def check_coupon(body: CouponCheck, user: Learner):
    code = (body.code or "").strip().upper()
    coupon = db.validate_coupon(user["id"], code)
    if not coupon:
        raise HTTPException(
            status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "This code is not valid for your account, has expired or was already used."
        )
    total = _cart_total(user["id"])
    pct = coupon["discount_pct"]
    return {
        "code": code,
        "discount_pct": pct,
        "expires_at": coupon["expires_at"],
        "subtotal": total,
        "discount": round(total * pct / 100, 2),
        "total": round(total * (1 - pct / 100), 2),
    }


@router.post("/checkout", summary="Pay for the cart (simulated payment: nothing is charged)")
def checkout(body: CheckoutRequest, background: BackgroundTasks, user: Learner):
    cart = db.get_cart(user["id"])
    if not cart:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "Your cart is empty.")
    for item in cart:  # priced from the catalogue at the moment of purchase
        item["price"] = catalog.price_of(item["course_slug"]) or item["price"]
    code = (body.coupon_code or "").strip().upper()
    discount_pct, coupon_id = 0, None
    if code:
        coupon = db.validate_coupon(user["id"], code)
        if not coupon:
            raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "This coupon is not valid or has expired.")
        discount_pct, coupon_id = coupon["discount_pct"], coupon["id"]
    prior_lead = db.get_attribution_lead(user["id"])  # the last touch that reached the learner
    purchased, total_paid = [], 0.0
    with db.transaction() as con:  # all items, or none
        for item in cart:
            original = item["price"]
            paid = round(original * (1 - discount_pct / 100), 2)
            con.execute(
                """INSERT INTO purchases (user_id, course_slug, course_title, price_paid, coupon_used,
                           discount_amount) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)""",
                (user["id"], item["course_slug"], item["course_title"], paid, code or None, round(original - paid, 2)),
            )
            con.execute(
                "INSERT INTO behaviour_events (user_id, course_slug, event_type) VALUES (?,?,?)",
                (user["id"], item["course_slug"], "purchase"),
            )
            purchased.append(item["course_title"])
            total_paid += paid
        con.execute("DELETE FROM cart WHERE user_id=?", (user["id"],))
        if coupon_id:
            con.execute(
                "UPDATE coupons_issued SET used=1, used_at=datetime('now','localtime') WHERE id=?", (coupon_id,)
            )
        con.execute("UPDATE checkout_sessions SET completed=1 WHERE user_id=? AND completed=0", (user["id"],))
        # they bought: their open call / WhatsApp tasks leave the team's list
        con.execute(
            """UPDATE sales_tasks SET status='skipped', outcome='bought before the task was done',
                       done_at=datetime('now','localtime') WHERE user_id=? AND status='open'""",
            (user["id"],),
        )
    # the purchase is the outcome the learning loop learns from: re-score the lead now
    _, pred = rescore_latest_lead(user["id"], "purchase_conversion")
    money.reset_cache()  # a customer leaves the open pipeline's totals at once
    channel_label = ATTRIBUTION_LABELS.get(
        prior_lead["trigger_reason"] if prior_lead else None, ATTRIBUTION_LABELS[None]
    )
    background.add_task(
        send_purchase_confirmation_email,
        user["email"],
        user["name"],
        purchased,
        channel_label,
        total_paid,
        discount_pct,
    )  # after the reply: nobody waits for Gmail
    return {
        "message": "You are enrolled. This site takes no real payments: nothing was charged.",
        "courses_purchased": purchased,
        "discount_applied": f"{discount_pct}%" if discount_pct else "None",
        "attributed_to": channel_label,
        "updated_lead_score": pred["lead_score"],
        "demo_payment": True,  # the payment is simulated: nothing is charged and no card details are asked
        # a confirmation goes out only when email is set up (and never to a simulated learner's .test address)
        "confirmation_emailed": mailer.configured() and not mailer.is_simulated_address(user["email"]),
    }


@router.get("/purchases", summary="The learner's enrolments")
def get_purchases(user: Learner):
    return {"purchases": db.get_purchases(user["id"])}


@router.post("/enquiry", summary="Ask about a course (always confirmed by email)")
def submit_enquiry(body: EnquiryRequest, user: Learner):
    """An enquiry always gets a confirmation email; next-best-action decides whether it carries a coupon or
    whether a counsellor should call."""
    course = _course_or_404(body.course_slug)
    if body.phone:
        if not PHONE_RE.match(body.phone.strip()):
            raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "Please enter a valid phone number.")
        db.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO user_profiles (user_id) VALUES (?)", (user["id"],))
        db.execute(
            "UPDATE user_profiles SET phone=?, whatsapp_opt_in=? WHERE user_id=?",
            (body.phone.strip(), 1 if body.whatsapp_opt_in else 0, user["id"]),
        )
    if body.lead_source and body.lead_source != "Direct Traffic" and body.lead_source in F.LEAD_SOURCES:
        db.execute(
            "UPDATE user_sessions SET lead_source=? WHERE id=(SELECT MAX(id) FROM user_sessions WHERE user_id=?)",
            (body.lead_source, user["id"]),
        )
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO behaviour_events (user_id, course_slug, event_type) VALUES (?,?,?)",
        (user["id"], body.course_slug, "enquiry_submit"),
    )
    lead_id, prediction, _ = handle_trigger(
        user["id"],
        user["name"],
        user["email"],
        "enquiry",
        course["slug"],
        allowed=["email_info", "email_coupon_10", "email_coupon_20", "call"],
        always_email=True,
    )
    return {
        "lead_id": lead_id,
        "lead_score": prediction["lead_score"],
        "persona": prediction["persona"],
        "action": prediction["recommended_action"],
        "message": "Enquiry sent. Check your email for the next steps.",
    }

@router.get("/faq", summary="Answers to common questions (the same text the help assistant uses)")

    answers = catalog.faq()
    return {
        "faq": [{"key": k, "question": q, "answer": answers[k]} for k, q in FAQ_QUESTIONS.items() if answers.get(k)]
    }


@router.get("/courses/{slug}", summary="One course")
def course_detail(slug: str):
    c = catalog.get_course(slug)
    if not c:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "Course not found")
    return c


@router.get("/recommendations", summary="Courses for the signed-in learner")
def recommendations(user: Learner):
    profile = db.get_profile(user["id"]) or {}
    behaviour = db.get_behaviour_summary(user["id"])
    purchased = [p["course_slug"] for p in db.get_purchases(user["id"])]
    viewed = ([behaviour["top_course_slug"]] if behaviour.get("top_course_slug") else []) + [
        w["course_slug"] for w in db.get_wishlist(user["id"])
    ]
    co = {}  # what else did buyers of my courses buy?
    if purchased:
        q = ",".join("?" * len(purchased))
        for r in db.fetchall(
            f"""SELECT p2.course_slug, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.user_id) AS n
                                 FROM purchases p1 JOIN purchases p2 ON p1.user_id=p2.user_id
                                 WHERE p1.course_slug IN ({q}) AND p2.course_slug NOT IN ({q}) AND p1.user_id != ?
                                 GROUP BY p2.course_slug""",
            (*purchased, *purchased, user["id"]),
        ):
            co[r["course_slug"]] = r["n"]
    items = recommend(
        profile.get("current_occupation"),
        profile.get("specialization"),
        viewed,
        purchased,
        co_purchase=co,
        cart_slugs=[c["course_slug"] for c in db.get_cart(user["id"])],
    )
    return {"recommendations": [i["title"] for i in items], "items": items}


def _public_name(name: str | None) -> str:
    """'Riya Sharma' is shown as 'Riya S.' on public pages."""
    parts = (name or "").split()
    if not parts:
        return "A learner"
    return parts[0] + (f" {parts[-1][0]}." if len(parts) > 1 else "")


@router.get("/reviews/{course_slug}", summary="Reviews of a course (by enrolled learners only)")
def get_reviews(course_slug: str):
    return {
        "reviews": [
            {
                "id": r["id"],
                "rating": r["rating"],
                "review_text": r["review_text"],
                "created_at": r["created_at"],
                "name": _public_name(r.get("name")),
            }
            for r in db.get_reviews(course_slug)
        ]
    }


@router.post("/reviews", summary="Review a course you are enrolled in")
def add_review(body: ReviewRequest, user: Learner):
    if not 1 <= body.rating <= 5:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "Rating must be between 1 and 5.")
    if not db.fetchone("SELECT id FROM purchases WHERE user_id=? AND course_slug=?", (user["id"], body.course_slug)):
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "Only learners enrolled in this course can review it.")
    db.execute(
        """INSERT INTO reviews (user_id, course_slug, rating, review_text) VALUES (?,?,?,?)
                  ON CONFLICT(user_id, course_slug) DO UPDATE SET rating=excluded.rating,
                  review_text=excluded.review_text""",
        (user["id"], body.course_slug, body.rating, (body.review_text or "").strip()),
    )
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO behaviour_events (user_id, course_slug, event_type) VALUES (?,?,?)",
        (user["id"], body.course_slug, "review_submit"),
    )
    return {"message": "Review published. Thank you."}

@router.post("/qna", summary="Ask a question about a course")
def ask_question(body: QuestionRequest, user: Learner):
    question = (body.question or "").strip()
    if len(question) < 5:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "Please write a question (at least 5 characters).")
    if not catalog.get_course(body.course_slug):
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "Course not found")
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO qna (user_id, course_slug, question) VALUES (?,?,?)", (user["id"], body.course_slug, question)
    )
    return {"message": "Question sent. Our team will answer it here and by email."}

"""The website's help assistant and call-back requests."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import uuid

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, status

from app import db
from app.api.deps import Learner, OptionalLearner
from app.schemas.learner import CallbackRequest, ChatRequest
from app.services import assistant, catalog
from app.services.content import generate_content
from app.services.scoring import save_lead, score_user

router = APIRouter(tags=["Help and call-backs"])
PHONE_RE = re.compile(r"^\+?[0-9][0-9 -]{8,14}$")


@router.post("/chat", summary="Ask the website's help assistant")
def chat(body: ChatRequest, user: OptionalLearner):
    text = (body.message or "").strip()[:1000]
    if not text:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "Please type a message.")
    conversation = body.conversation_id or uuid.uuid4().hex
    profile = db.get_profile(user["id"]) if user else None
    purchased = [p["course_slug"] for p in db.get_purchases(user["id"])] if user else []
    res = assistant.answer(text, page_slug=body.course_slug, profile=profile, user=user, purchased_slugs=purchased)
    uid = user["id"] if user else None
    for role, said in (("user", text), ("assistant", res["reply"])):
        db.execute(
            """INSERT INTO chat_messages (user_id, conversation, role, text, intent, course_slug)
                      VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)""",
            (uid, conversation, role, said, res["intent"], res["course_slug"]),
        )
    return {"conversation_id": conversation, **res}


@router.post("/callback", summary="Ask a counsellor to call back")
def request_callback(body: CallbackRequest, user: Learner):
    phone = (body.phone or "").strip()
    if not PHONE_RE.match(phone):
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "Please enter a valid phone number.")
    slug = body.course_slug if body.course_slug and catalog.get_course(body.course_slug) else None
    db.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO user_profiles (user_id) VALUES (?)", (user["id"],))
    # asking for a call is consent to be called on this number
    db.execute(
        "UPDATE user_profiles SET phone=COALESCE(phone, ?), do_not_call='No' WHERE user_id=?", (phone, user["id"])
    )
    callback_id = db.execute(
        """INSERT INTO callback_requests (user_id, phone, course_slug, preferred_time, note)
                                VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)""",
        (user["id"], phone, slug, (body.preferred_time or "")[:60], (body.note or "")[:300]),
    )
    # an explicit, strong signal: recorded like an enquiry and scored at once
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO behaviour_events (user_id, course_slug, event_type) VALUES (?,?,?)",
        (user["id"], slug, "enquiry_submit"),
    )
    pred = score_user(user["id"], source="chat_callback", course=slug, explain=True)
    profile = db.get_profile(user["id"]) or {}
    content = generate_content(
        user["name"],
        profile.get("current_occupation"),
        profile.get("specialization"),
        catalog.title_of(slug, "our programmes"),
        pred["recommended_action"],
        trigger="chat_callback",
        lead_score=pred["lead_score"],
        course_slug=slug,
        offer_pct=0,
    )
    save_lead(user["id"], pred, content, "chat_callback", course_slug=slug)
    return {"callback_id": callback_id, "message": "Thanks. A counsellor will call you soon."}

"""
Application configuration, read once from the environment and ``backend/.env``.

Every setting that differs between machines (secrets, email account, URLs, file locations) lives
here. Business rules that the team may tune (tiers, costs, timings, the learning loop) are kept
separately in ``crm_settings.json`` and loaded by :mod:`app.core.rules`.

The ``.env`` file is loaded into the process environment at import time, so modules that read a
variable at call time (for example the Gemini client) see the same values as this object.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path

from dotenv import load_dotenv
from pydantic import AliasChoices, Field, field_validator
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict

BACKEND_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]  # .../backend
PROJECT_DIR = BACKEND_DIR.parent  # repository root
ENV_FILE = BACKEND_DIR / ".env"

load_dotenv(ENV_FILE, override=False)


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    """Typed view of the environment. Field names map to upper-case variables (``DEMO_MODE``...)."""

    # an empty value (KEY= in .env) means "use the default", so .env.example can be copied as it is
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_file=None, extra="ignore", case_sensitive=False, env_ignore_empty=True)

    app_name: str = "X Education CRM"
    environment: str = Field(default="development", description="development | production | test")
    demo_mode: bool = Field(default=True, description="Short automation timings for demonstrations")
    log_level: str = "INFO"

    # file locations (all inside backend/data by default; the folder is not tracked by git)
    data_dir: Path = BACKEND_DIR / "data"
    database_path: Path | None = Field(default=None, validation_alias=AliasChoices("DATABASE_PATH", "DB_PATH"))
    models_dir: Path | None = None
    simulation_db_path: Path | None = Field(
        default=None, validation_alias=AliasChoices("SIMULATION_DB_PATH", "SIM_WORLD_DB")
    )
    rules_path: Path = Field(
        default=PROJECT_DIR / "crm_settings.json", validation_alias=AliasChoices("RULES_PATH", "CRM_SETTINGS")
    )
    log_file: Path | None = None

    # security
    jwt_secret: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Empty: a random secret is kept in the database")
    learner_token_hours: int = 24 * 7
    crm_token_hours: int = 12
    otp_expiry_minutes: int = 10

    # the owner account of the CRM (an admin whose password stays in this file)
    crm_owner_email: str = Field(
        default="admin@xeducation.in", validation_alias=AliasChoices("CRM_OWNER_EMAIL", "MARKETING_EMAIL")
    )
    crm_owner_password: str | None = Field(
        default=None, validation_alias=AliasChoices("CRM_OWNER_PASSWORD", "MARKETING_PASSWORD")
    )
    crm_owner_name: str = Field(default="Admin", validation_alias=AliasChoices("CRM_OWNER_NAME", "MARKETING_NAME"))

    # outbound email (optional: without it, codes and emails are written to the log). Gmail by default; any mail
    # server works with SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT and SMTP_SECURITY (ssl, starttls, or none for a local relay)
    gmail_user: str = Field(default="", validation_alias=AliasChoices("GMAIL_USER", "SMTP_USER"))
    gmail_app_password: str = Field(default="", validation_alias=AliasChoices("GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD", "SMTP_PASSWORD"))
    smtp_host: str = ""
    smtp_port: int | None = None
    smtp_security: str = ""

    # Gemini (optional: without it, messages are written from templates)
    gemini_api_key: str = ""
    gemini_model: str = ""

    # URLs
    public_site_url: str = Field(
        default="http://localhost:5173", validation_alias=AliasChoices("PUBLIC_SITE_URL", "USER_FRONTEND_URL")
    )
    dashboard_url: str = "http://localhost:5174"
    api_url: str = Field(default="http://127.0.0.1:8000", validation_alias=AliasChoices("API_URL", "SIM_API_URL"))
    cors_origins: list[str] = Field(
        default_factory=lambda: [
            "http://localhost:5173",
            "http://127.0.0.1:5173",
            "http://localhost:5174",
            "http://127.0.0.1:5174",
        ]
    )

    # background work
    scheduler_enabled: bool = True
    simulation_enabled: bool | None = None  # None: crm_settings.json decides

    @field_validator("public_site_url", "dashboard_url", "api_url")
    @classmethod
    def _no_trailing_slash(cls, v: str) -> str:
        # on Windows "localhost" is tried as IPv6 first (about 2 s per connection) for server-to-server calls
        return v.rstrip("/")

    @property
    def db_path(self) -> Path:
        return Path(self.database_path) if self.database_path else self.data_dir / "xeducation.db"

    @property
    def model_dir(self) -> Path:
        return Path(self.models_dir) if self.models_dir else self.data_dir / "models"

    @property
    def simulation_db(self) -> Path:
        return Path(self.simulation_db_path) if self.simulation_db_path else self.data_dir / "simulation_world.db"

    @property
    def log_path(self) -> Path:
        return Path(self.log_file) if self.log_file else self.data_dir / "logs" / "app.log"

    @property
    def owner_password_from_env(self) -> bool:
        """True when CRM_OWNER_PASSWORD is set: the owner's password is managed in backend/.env. Otherwise a random
        password is made at the first start (see app.services.team.ensure_owner) and can be changed in the CRM."""
        return bool((self.crm_owner_password or "").strip())

    @property
    def initial_password_file(self) -> Path:
        return self.data_dir / "initial-admin-password.txt"


@lru_cache
def get_settings() -> Settings:
    s = Settings()
    s.data_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    s.model_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return s

"""
Domain errors. Services raise these instead of HTTP exceptions, so they stay usable outside a web request
(the scheduler, the history generator, tests); ``app.main`` turns each one into a JSON response with its status
code and ``{"detail": message}``, the same shape FastAPI uses for its own errors.
"""

from __future__ import annotations


class AppError(Exception):
    status_code = 400

    def __init__(self, message: str):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.message = message


class BadRequest(AppError):
    status_code = 400


class Forbidden(AppError):
    status_code = 403


class NotFound(AppError):
    status_code = 404


class Conflict(AppError):
    status_code = 409


class Unavailable(AppError):
    status_code = 503

FILE: c:\Users\krish\Desktop\xeducation-crm-v7.1.0\xeducation-crm\backend\app\core\logging.py
==========================================================================================

"""
Logging for the whole backend: one format, one place.

Console lines look like ``2026-10-16 22:41:05 INFO  app.ml.learning  Learning run 12: lead model kept``.
The same lines are also written to a rotating file (``LOG_FILE``, default ``backend/data/logs/app.log``; 5 files
of 5 MB), so a problem can be looked at after the window was closed.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import logging
import logging.handlers
import sys
from pathlib import Path

FORMAT = "%(asctime)s %(levelname)-7s %(name)s  %(message)s"
DATEFMT = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
_configured = {"done": False}


def setup_logging(level: str = "INFO", log_file: Path | None = None) -> None:
    """Configure the root logger once (safe to call again: later calls only change the level)."""
    root = logging.getLogger()
    root.setLevel(level.upper())
    if _configured["done"]:
        return
    formatter = logging.Formatter(FORMAT, DATEFMT)
    # a console that cannot show a character must not stop; and every line is written at once, also when the start
    # script sends the output to backend/data/logs/api.out (a file is block-buffered: a sign-up code shown there
    # minutes late is no use to the person waiting for it)
    with contextlib.suppress(AttributeError, ValueError):
        sys.stdout.reconfigure(errors="replace", line_buffering=True)
    console = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)
    console.setFormatter(formatter)
    root.handlers[:] = [console]
    if log_file is not None:
        log_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        file_handler = logging.handlers.RotatingFileHandler(
            log_file, maxBytes=5_000_000, backupCount=5, encoding="utf-8"
        )
        file_handler.setFormatter(formatter)
        root.addHandler(file_handler)
    # uvicorn keeps its own handlers; route its records through ours so every line has the same format
    for name in ("uvicorn", "uvicorn.error", "uvicorn.access"):
        lg = logging.getLogger(name)
        lg.handlers[:] = []
        lg.propagate = True
    logging.getLogger("uvicorn.access").setLevel(logging.WARNING)  # one line per request is noise
    for noisy in ("apscheduler", "httpx", "urllib3", "multipart", "alembic"):
        logging.getLogger(noisy).setLevel(logging.WARNING)
    _configured["done"] = True

"""
Response times of the real-time loop, kept in memory (last 1,000 per kind):
  event_to_score     a tracked website event → the lead is re-scored (POST /api/v1/track)
  trigger_to_action  a trigger (enquiry, abandoned cart ...) → the next-best-action decision is made and carried out
Shown on the dashboard's Learning loop page (median and 95th percentile).
"""

import threading
import time
from collections import deque

_lock = threading.Lock()
_data = {}


def record(kind, ms):
    with _lock:
        _data.setdefault(kind, deque(maxlen=1000)).append(float(ms))


class timer:
    """with perf.timer('event_to_score'): ..."""

    def __init__(self, kind):
        self.kind = kind

    def __enter__(self):
        self.t = time.perf_counter()
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *exc):
        record(self.kind, (time.perf_counter() - self.t) * 1000)
        return False


def _quantile(ordered: list[float], q: float) -> float:
    """The q-quantile of an already sorted list (nearest rank)."""
    return ordered[min(len(ordered) - 1, int(q * len(ordered)))]


def summary():
    out = {}
    with _lock:
        items = {k: list(v) for k, v in _data.items()}
    for k, v in items.items():
        if not v:
            continue
        s = sorted(v)
        out[k] = {
            "count": len(s),
            "median_ms": round(_quantile(s, 0.5), 1),
            "p95_ms": round(_quantile(s, 0.95), 1),
            "max_ms": round(s[-1], 1),
        }
    return out

# Simulated learners (the starting history and the live simulation) have addresses on this reserved
# domain: they are never emailed, and the dashboard tags them "simulated". Everything else treats them
# exactly like people who signed up themselves (only the learners are simulated; the team is real).
SIMULATED_DOMAIN = "demo.xeducation.test"


def is_simulated_email(email: str | None) -> bool:
    return (email or "").strip().lower().endswith("@" + SIMULATED_DOMAIN)


def _merge(base: dict, extra: dict | None) -> dict:
    out = copy.deepcopy(base)
    for k, v in (extra or {}).items():
        if k.startswith("_"):
            continue
        if isinstance(v, dict) and isinstance(out.get(k), dict):
            out[k] = _merge(out[k], v)
        else:
            out[k] = v
    return out


def load(path: str = PATH) -> dict:
    try:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            return _merge(DEFAULTS, json.load(f))
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return copy.deepcopy(DEFAULTS)
    except ValueError as e:
        log.error("%s is not valid JSON (%s); using the built-in defaults", path, e)
        return copy.deepcopy(DEFAULTS)


S = load()
DEMO_MODE = get_settings().demo_mode
MODE = "demo" if DEMO_MODE else "live"


def by_mode(section: str):
    """A value that differs between demo mode and live mode, e.g. ``by_mode('score_refresh_minutes')``."""
    v = S[section]
    return v[MODE] if isinstance(v, dict) and MODE in v else v


def tiers() -> list[tuple[float, str]]:
    """[(min_score, name), ...] from the highest tier down."""
    return sorted(((float(t["min_score"]), t["name"]) for t in S["tiers"]), reverse=True)


def tier_names() -> list[str]:
    return [name for _, name in tiers()]


def in_global_control(user_id) -> bool:
    """True for the fixed random share of people (global_control.share, default 5%) whom the CRM never
    contacts automatically: no next-best-action steps, campaigns or A/B emails. Comparing them with
    everyone else measures the CRM's total impact, and their outcomes are the learning loop's honest
    check (nobody's follow-ups shaped them). Decided by a hash of the person, so it never changes."""
    share = float((S.get("global_control") or {}).get("share", 0) or 0)
    if share <= 0 or user_id is None:
        return False
    h = hashlib.sha256(f"global-control:{user_id}".encode()).hexdigest()
    return int(h[:15], 16) / float(16**15) < share

"""
Passwords and sign-in tokens for both kinds of user: learners on the website and people on the CRM team.

Passwords are stored as salted PBKDF2-SHA256 hashes (600,000 iterations, the OWASP 2023 recommendation),
never in clear text; checking a password takes the same time whether the account exists or not.

Tokens are JWTs (HS256). Learner tokens and team tokens carry different audiences ("learner", "crm"),
so a learner's token can never open the CRM and the other way round. Every token also carries a short
fingerprint of the account's password hash ("pv"): changing or resetting a password changes it, so every
token issued before then stops working (all other sessions are signed out). The signing secret comes from
JWT_SECRET in backend/.env; without it a random secret is created once and kept in the database.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hashlib
import hmac
import secrets
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import jwt

from app.core.config import get_settings

ITERATIONS = 600_000
ALGORITHM = "HS256"
AUD_LEARNER = "learner"
AUD_CRM = "crm"
_secret: dict[str, str] = {}
_dummy: dict[str, str] = {}


# passwords
def hash_password(password: str) -> str:
    salt = secrets.token_bytes(16)
    dk = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", password.encode("utf-8"), salt, ITERATIONS)
    return f"pbkdf2_sha256${ITERATIONS}${base64.b64encode(salt).decode()}${base64.b64encode(dk).decode()}"


def verify_password(password: str | None, stored: str | None) -> bool:
    try:
        algo, iterations, salt, dk = (stored or "").split("$")
        if algo != "pbkdf2_sha256":
            return False
        calc = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", (password or "").encode("utf-8"), base64.b64decode(salt), int(iterations))
        return hmac.compare_digest(calc, base64.b64decode(dk))
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return False


def waste_time(password: str | None) -> None:
    """A wrong address costs as long as a wrong password, so nobody can find out which addresses exist."""
    if "hash" not in _dummy:
        _dummy["hash"] = hash_password(secrets.token_hex(8))
    verify_password(password, _dummy["hash"])


def password_problem(password: str | None, *, require_digit: bool = True) -> str | None:
    """None if the password is acceptable, else what is missing (NIST SP 800-63B: at least 8 characters)."""
    p = password or ""
    if len(p) < 8:
        return "Use at least 8 characters."
    if len(p) > 128:
        return "Use at most 128 characters."
    if require_digit and (not any(ch.isalpha() for ch in p) or not any(ch.isdigit() for ch in p)):
        return "Use letters and at least one digit."
    return None


def generate_password(length: int = 16) -> str:
    """A random password with letters and digits (no look-alike characters), for first sign-ins."""
    alphabet = "abcdefghjkmnpqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"
    while True:
        p = "".join(secrets.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(length))
        if any(c.isdigit() for c in p) and any(c.isalpha() for c in p):
            return p


def constant_time_equals(a: str | None, b: str | None) -> bool:
    return hmac.compare_digest((a or "").encode("utf-8"), (b or "").encode("utf-8"))


# tokens
def signing_secret() -> str:
    """JWT_SECRET from .env, else a random secret created once and kept in the database."""
    if "v" not in _secret:
        configured = get_settings().jwt_secret
        if configured:
            _secret["v"] = configured
        else:
            from app.db import app_setting, put_app_setting

            v = app_setting("jwt_secret")
            if not v:
                v = secrets.token_urlsafe(48)
                put_app_setting("jwt_secret", v)
            _secret["v"] = v
    return _secret["v"]


def reset_secret_cache() -> None:
    _secret.clear()


def create_token(subject: str, audience: str, hours: float, **claims) -> str:
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    payload = {"sub": str(subject), "aud": audience, "iat": now, "exp": now + timedelta(hours=hours), **claims}
    return jwt.encode(payload, signing_secret(), algorithm=ALGORITHM)


def decode_token(token: str, audience: str) -> dict | None:
    try:
        return jwt.decode(token, signing_secret(), algorithms=[ALGORITHM], audience=audience)
    except jwt.PyJWTError:
        return None


def password_version(password_hash: str | None) -> str:
    """A fingerprint of the stored password hash (not of the password): it changes with every new password."""
    return hashlib.sha256((password_hash or "").encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]


def token_is_current(claims: dict, password_hash: str | None) -> bool:
    """False for a token issued before the account's password was last changed or reset."""
    return constant_time_equals(str(claims.get("pv") or ""), password_version(password_hash))


def create_learner_token(user_id: int, email: str, password_hash: str | None) -> str:
    return create_token(
        str(user_id), AUD_LEARNER, get_settings().learner_token_hours, email=email, pv=password_version(password_hash)
    )


def create_member_token(member_id: int, role: str, password_hash: str | None) -> str:
    return create_token(
        f"member:{member_id}",
        AUD_CRM,
        get_settings().crm_token_hours,
        mid=member_id,
        role=role,
        pv=password_version(password_hash),
    )

"""
Database access for the whole backend: one SQLite file (``backend/data/xeducation.db``), opened per call
with WAL journaling and a 30-second busy timeout, plus the small repository helpers the services share.

The schema is created and upgraded by versioned Alembic migrations (``app/db/migrations``); ``init_db``
runs them, so a new database and an older one both end at the current version.

``DB_PATH`` is a module attribute on purpose: tests and the simulators point the whole backend at a
private copy by assigning it (``app.db.DB_PATH = path``).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import logging
import os
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

from app.core.config import get_settings

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

DB_PATH = os.getenv("DB_PATH_OVERRIDE") or str(get_settings().db_path)
MIGRATIONS_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "migrations"


def get_conn() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    # timeout/busy_timeout: wait up to 30 s for another writer instead of failing with "database is locked"
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH, check_same_thread=False, timeout=30)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=30000")
    conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
    return conn


def init_db(path: str | None = None) -> None:
    """Create or upgrade the database schema to the latest migration (idempotent)."""
    from alembic import command
    from alembic.config import Config

    target = str(path or DB_PATH)
    Path(target).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cfg = Config()
    cfg.set_main_option("script_location", str(MIGRATIONS_DIR))
    cfg.set_main_option("sqlalchemy.url", f"sqlite:///{target}")
    command.upgrade(cfg, "head")
    log.info("Database ready at %s", target)


def schema_version(path: str | None = None) -> str | None:
    con = sqlite3.connect(str(path or DB_PATH))
    try:
        row = con.execute("SELECT version_num FROM alembic_version").fetchone()
        return row[0] if row else None
    except sqlite3.Error:
        return None
    finally:
        con.close()


@contextlib.contextmanager
def transaction():
    """Several writes that must succeed or fail together: ``with db.transaction() as con: con.execute(...)``."""
    con = get_conn()
    try:
        con.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        yield con
        con.commit()
    except BaseException:
        con.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        con.close()


def claim(query: str, params=()) -> bool:
    """Run a guarded UPDATE and say whether it changed exactly one row (so a campaign or an A/B test can
    only be sent once, even if the timer and a button press collide)."""
    con = get_conn()
    try:
        cur = con.execute(query, params)
        con.commit()
        return cur.rowcount == 1
    finally:
        con.close()


# small key/value store (generated secrets, team settings, assignment state)
def app_setting(key: str) -> str | None:
    row = fetchone("SELECT value FROM app_settings WHERE key=?", (key,))
    return row["value"] if row else None


def put_app_setting(key: str, value: str) -> None:
    execute(
        """INSERT INTO app_settings (key, value, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, datetime('now','localtime'))
               ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value, updated_at=excluded.updated_at""",
        (key, value),
    )


# helpers
def fetchone(query: str, params=()) -> dict | None:
    conn = get_conn()
    try:
        row = conn.execute(query, params).fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row else None
    finally:
        conn.close()


def fetchall(query: str, params=()) -> list[dict]:
    conn = get_conn()
    try:
        return [dict(r) for r in conn.execute(query, params).fetchall()]
    finally:
        conn.close()


def execute(query: str, params=()) -> int | None:
    """Run one write and commit it; returns the new row id (for an INSERT)."""
    conn = get_conn()
    try:
        cur = conn.execute(query, params)
        conn.commit()
        return cur.lastrowid
    finally:
        conn.close()


def execute_rowcount(query: str, params=()) -> int:
    """Run one write and commit it; returns how many rows it changed."""
    conn = get_conn()
    try:
        cur = conn.execute(query, params)
        conn.commit()
        return cur.rowcount
    finally:
        conn.close()

# Behaviour summary → the model's auto-tracked features
def get_behaviour_summary(user_id):
    """
    Aggregates everything the website tracked for this user into the same
    quantities the model was trained on:
      total_visits          distinct sessions that produced at least one event
                            (a new session starts after 30 min of inactivity)
      total_time_on_website seconds summed from page_view events
      page_views_per_visit  page_view events / visits
      flags                 1 if the event ever happened
    """
    conn = get_conn()
    try:
        q = lambda sql, *a: conn.execute(sql, (user_id, *a)).fetchone()

        visits = (
            q(
                "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS c FROM behaviour_events "
                "WHERE user_id=? AND session_id IS NOT NULL"
            )["c"]
            or 0
        )
        visits = max(visits, 1)
        time_total = (
            q(
                "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(time_spent_sec),0) AS t FROM behaviour_events "
                "WHERE user_id=? AND event_type='page_view'"
            )["t"]
            or 0
        )
        pv = q("SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM behaviour_events " "WHERE user_id=? AND event_type='page_view'")["c"] or 0

        counts = {
            r["event_type"]: r["c"]
            for r in conn.execute(
                "SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS c FROM behaviour_events WHERE user_id=? GROUP BY event_type", (user_id,)
            ).fetchall()
        }
        has = lambda *types: int(any(counts.get(t, 0) > 0 for t in types))

        in_cart = q("SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM cart WHERE user_id=?")["c"]
        in_wishlist = q("SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM wishlist WHERE user_id=?")["c"]
        checkouts = q("SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM checkout_sessions WHERE user_id=?")["c"]
        enquiries = q("SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM leads WHERE user_id=? AND trigger_reason='enquiry'")["c"]

        # most-viewed course; ties go to the one seen most recently (the score refresh uses the same rule)
        row = q("""SELECT course_slug, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM behaviour_events
                   WHERE user_id=? AND course_slug IS NOT NULL
                   GROUP BY course_slug ORDER BY cnt DESC, MAX(id) DESC LIMIT 1""")
        last_session = q(
            "SELECT device_type FROM user_sessions WHERE user_id=? "
            "AND device_type IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1"
        )
        # acquisition source = first visit that came from somewhere specific
        first_source = q(
            "SELECT lead_source FROM user_sessions WHERE user_id=? "
            "AND lead_source IS NOT NULL AND lead_source != 'Direct Traffic' "
            "ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1"
        )

        return {
            "total_visits": visits,
            "sessions_count": visits,
            "total_time_on_website": int(min(time_total, 6000)),
            "page_views_per_visit": round(pv / visits, 1),
            "video_watched": has("video_play"),
            "brochure_downloaded": has("brochure_dl"),
            "chat_initiated": has("chat"),
            "pricing_page_visited": has("pricing_view"),
            "testimonial_visited": has("testimonial_view"),
            "webinar_attended": has("webinar_view", "webinar_register"),
            "added_to_wishlist": int(has("wishlist_add") or in_wishlist > 0),
            "added_to_cart": int(has("cart_add") or in_cart > 0),
            "checkout_started": int(has("checkout_start") or checkouts > 0),
            "enquiry_submitted": int(has("enquiry_submit") or enquiries > 0),
            "top_course_slug": row["course_slug"] if row else None,
            "device_type": last_session["device_type"] if last_session else None,
            "lead_source": first_source["lead_source"] if first_source else None,
        }
    finally:
        conn.close()


def add_score_snapshot(user_id, source, features, probability, lead_score, tier, model_version, min_gap_minutes=0):
    """Store what the model saw + what it predicted. Later labelled by purchases."""
    import json

    if min_gap_minutes:
        recent = fetchone(
            """SELECT id FROM score_snapshots WHERE user_id=? AND source=?
                             AND created_at >= datetime('now','localtime',?)""",
            (user_id, source, f"-{int(min_gap_minutes)} minutes"),
        )
        if recent:
            return None
    return execute(
        """INSERT INTO score_snapshots
        (user_id, source, features_json, probability, lead_score, tier, model_version)
        VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)""",
        (user_id, source, json.dumps(features), probability, lead_score, tier, model_version),
    )

        SELECT * FROM coupons_issued

OPEN_COUPON = "COALESCE(used, 0) = 0 AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > datetime('now','localtime'))"


def open_coupon(user_id):
    """The coupon this person can still use (not used, not expired; the biggest if there are several), or None. A
    person holds at most one open coupon from next-best-action or the team."""
    return fetchone(
        f"""SELECT * FROM coupons_issued WHERE user_id=? AND {OPEN_COUPON}
             ORDER BY discount_pct DESC, expires_at DESC LIMIT 1""",
        (user_id,),
    )


def recent_coupon(user_id, days):
    """The latest coupon this person was given in the last `days` days, used or not (None if none)."""
    return fetchone(
        """SELECT * FROM coupons_issued WHERE user_id=? AND created_at >= datetime('now','localtime',?)
             ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1""",
        (user_id, f"-{int(days)} days"),
    )


def recent_coupons(days) -> dict:
    """{user_id: their latest coupon of the last `days` days} for everyone given one (see recent_coupon)."""
    out: dict = {}
    for r in fetchall(
        "SELECT * FROM coupons_issued WHERE created_at >= datetime('now','localtime',?) ORDER BY created_at",
        (f"-{int(days)} days",),
    ):
        out[r["user_id"]] = r
    return out


def open_coupons() -> dict:
    """{user_id: their open coupon} for everyone who holds one (see open_coupon)."""
    out: dict = {}
    for r in fetchall(f"SELECT * FROM coupons_issued WHERE {OPEN_COUPON} ORDER BY discount_pct, expires_at"):
        out[r["user_id"]] = r  # the last row per person wins: the biggest discount, then the latest expiry
    return out

    """,

    )

def get_inactive_users(minutes=15, lookback_hours=48):
    """
    Visits that ended (no activity for `minutes`) and have not been handled by
    the inactivity job yet — one decision per visit. Only each user's latest
    visit counts, and only if it happened in the last `lookback_hours`.
    """
    return fetchall(
        """
        SELECT
            u.id AS user_id,
            u.email,
            u.name,
            s.id AS session_id,
            s.last_active AS last_seen
        FROM user_sessions s
        JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id
        WHERE u.is_verified = 1
          AND s.id = (SELECT MAX(s2.id) FROM user_sessions s2 WHERE s2.user_id = s.user_id)
          AND COALESCE(s.followed_up, 0) = 0
          AND s.last_active <= datetime('now','localtime', ?)
          AND s.last_active >= datetime('now','localtime', ?)
    """,
        (f"-{minutes} minutes", f"-{lookback_hours} hours"),
    )


def mark_visit_handled(user_id, session_id):
    execute("UPDATE user_sessions SET followed_up=1 WHERE user_id=? AND id<=?", (user_id, session_id))


def get_users_with_old_wishlist(minutes=30):
    """
    Users with a wishlisted course (not bought, not reminded yet) that was
    added more than `minutes` ago — one reminder per wishlist item.
    course_slug is the oldest such item (SQLite returns the row of MIN()).
    """
    return fetchall(
        """
        SELECT
            w.user_id,
            u.email,
            u.name,
            w.course_slug,
            MIN(w.added_at) as first_added
        FROM wishlist w
        JOIN users u ON u.id = w.user_id
        LEFT JOIN purchases p
            ON p.user_id = w.user_id
            AND p.course_slug = w.course_slug
        WHERE p.id IS NULL
          AND COALESCE(w.reminder_sent, 0) = 0
        GROUP BY w.user_id
        HAVING first_added <= datetime('now','localtime', ?)
    """,
        (f"-{minutes} minutes",),
    )


def mark_wishlist_reminded(user_id):

def recent_lead_exists(user_id, trigger, hours=6):
    """
    Prevent duplicate leads within cooldown window.
    trigger may be a single trigger, a list/tuple of triggers, or None (= any).
    """
    if trigger is None:
        triggers = None
    elif isinstance(trigger, list | tuple):
        triggers = list(trigger)
    else:
        triggers = [trigger]
    sql = "SELECT id FROM leads WHERE user_id=? AND created_at >= datetime('now','localtime', ?)"
    params = [user_id, f"-{hours} hours"]
    if triggers:
        sql += f" AND trigger_reason IN ({','.join('?' * len(triggers))})"
        params += triggers
    return fetchone(sql + " LIMIT 1", tuple(params)) is not None


def get_attribution_lead(user_id):
    """The latest lead that actually reached the user (email sent or enquiry)."""
    return fetchone(
        """SELECT * FROM leads WHERE user_id=? AND (email_sent=1 OR trigger_reason='enquiry')
                       ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1""",
        (user_id,),
    )
