"""
The email coach ("Improve email") for the team.

With GEMINI_API_KEY set, Gemini rewrites the draft (told to keep every fact
and invent none). Without it, a rule-based email coach checks the draft for
the problems that hurt deliverability and trust, applies the safe fixes
automatically and lists the rest as suggestions. (The old button just
pasted a canned template above the draft.)
"""

import json
import logging
import re

from app.services import catalog, gemini

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

UNVERIFIABLE = [
    (
        r"\b\d+\s?%\s?(salary|hike|increase|more|higher)",
        "Salary or pay-rise percentages cannot be backed up: remove them or cite a source.",
    ),
    (r"\b\d+\s?[-–]?\s?\d*\s?LPA\b", "Salary figures (LPA) are a claim you would have to prove: remove them."),
    (r"\bguarantee(d)?\b", "Avoid 'guaranteed': placement or results cannot be guaranteed."),
    (
        r"\bonly \d+ seats?\b|\bseats? (left|remaining)\b",
        "Seat-count urgency should only be used if it's literally true.",
    ),
    (
        r"\bexpires? in \d+ ?(hours?|hrs?|minutes?)\b",
        "Make sure any deadline matches the real coupon expiry (72 hours).",
    ),
    (
        r"\b(board|management) has (authori[sz]ed|approved)\b",
        "Invented authority ('the Board has approved') reads as manipulative.",
    ),
    (r"\b\d+ out of \d+\b", "Statistics like '3 out of 4' need a source: remove the claim or cite it."),
]
SPAMMY = r"\b(act now|100% free|winner|risk[- ]free|click here|urgent|limited time only|!!!+)\b"
CTA = r"\b(reply|enrol|enroll|book|view|join|reserve|start|apply|download|call|visit)\b"


def _first(name):
    return (name or "there").split()[0]


def rule_based(subject, body, name, tier, course_slug=None):
    suggestions, fixed_subject, fixed_body = [], (subject or "").strip(), (body or "").strip()
    first = _first(name)
    low = fixed_body.lower()

    if not re.match(rf"^(hi|hello|dear|hey)\b.*{re.escape(first.lower())}", low[:60]):
        fixed_body = f"Hi {first},\n\n" + re.sub(r"^(hi|hello|dear|hey)[^\n]*\n+", "", fixed_body, flags=re.I)
        suggestions.append("Added a personal greeting with the lead's first name.")
    if len(fixed_subject) > 60:
        suggestions.append(
            f"The subject has {len(fixed_subject)} characters; under 60 avoids it being cut off on phones."
        )
    if len(fixed_subject) < 15:
        suggestions.append("The subject is very short: say what the email is about (the course name helps).")
    if fixed_subject.isupper() or sum(1 for w in fixed_subject.split() if w.isupper() and len(w) > 3) >= 2:
        fixed_subject = fixed_subject.title()
        suggestions.append("Removed ALL-CAPS from the subject (a common spam-filter trigger).")
    if re.search(r"!{2,}", fixed_body + fixed_subject):
        fixed_body = re.sub(r"!{2,}", "!", fixed_body)
        fixed_subject = re.sub(r"!{2,}", "!", fixed_subject)
        suggestions.append("Replaced repeated exclamation marks.")
    if re.search(SPAMMY, low):
        suggestions.append(
            "Phrases that trigger spam filters were found (for example 'act now', 'click here', 'urgent'): "
            "rephrase them."
        )
    for pattern, advice in UNVERIFIABLE:
        if re.search(pattern, fixed_body, flags=re.I) or re.search(pattern, fixed_subject, flags=re.I):
            suggestions.append(advice)
    words = len(fixed_body.split())
    if words > 250:
        suggestions.append(f"The message has {words} words; 120 to 200 words get read on a phone.")
    if not re.search(CTA, low):
        fixed_body += "\n\nReply to this email if you have any questions: a person on our team reads every reply."
        suggestions.append("Added a clear call to action at the end.")
    f = catalog.facts(course_slug) if course_slug else None
    if f and f["duration"] and f["duration"].lower() not in low:
        fixed_body += (
            f"\n\nQuick facts: {f['title']} takes {f['duration']} ({f['level']} level). The fee is "
            f"₹{f['price']:,}, or EMI from ₹{f['emi']:,} a month."
        )
        suggestions.append("Added the course's real duration and fee from the catalogue.")
    if tier == "Low Priority" and re.search(r"\b(coupon|discount|% off)\b", low):
        suggestions.append("This lead is Low Priority: consider useful content instead of a discount.")
    if not suggestions:
        suggestions.append("Looks good: no issues found.")
    return fixed_subject, fixed_body, suggestions


def improve(subject, body, name, tier, course_slug=None, occupation=None):
    if gemini.enabled():
        try:
            f = catalog.facts(course_slug) if course_slug else None
            prompt = f"""Improve this marketing email for clarity, warmth and a clear call to action.
Recipient: {_first(name)}, {occupation or 'a learner'}; lead tier: {tier}.
Allowed course facts: {json.dumps(f, ensure_ascii=False) if f else 'none'}.
Rules: keep the sender's intent and any coupon code exactly; do NOT add statistics, salaries,
guarantees, seat counts or deadlines that aren't in the draft or the facts; under 180 words.
Draft subject: {subject}
Draft body:
{body}
Reply with ONLY JSON: {{"subject":"...","body":"...","notes":["what you changed", "..."]}}"""
            out = json.loads(gemini.generate(prompt, json_mode=True))
            _, _, checks = rule_based(out["subject"], out["body"], name, tier, course_slug)
            notes = list(out.get("notes") or []) + [c for c in checks if not c.startswith("Looks good")]
            return {
                "improved_subject": out["subject"],
                "improved_body": out["body"],
                "suggestions": notes or ["Rewritten by Gemini."],
                "engine": "gemini",
            }
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - any Gemini failure falls back to the rule-based coach
            log.warning("Gemini failed, using the rule-based coach: %s", e)
    s, b, sug = rule_based(subject, body, name, tier, course_slug)
    return {"improved_subject": s, "improved_body": b, "suggestions": sug, "engine": "rules"}

"""
Personalised email, WhatsApp and call-script text for a lead.

The text depends on:
  * the lead's tier (how ready they are) and why the CRM is writing now (cart, checkout, wishlist, enquiry, a visit
    that ended, a campaign)
  * true facts about the course from the catalogue (duration, level, modules, instructor, EMI): no invented salary
    figures, placement rates, scholarships or deadlines. Every claim in these messages can be checked on the course
    page.
  * the offer chosen for this lead (a discount or none). Next-best-action decides the offer; without a decision a
    tier default is used.

With GEMINI_API_KEY set in backend/.env, Gemini writes the copy from the same facts (and is told not to invent any);
on any error the templates below are used.

Who speaks: emails the CRM sends by itself are signed by the admissions team (no invented person). Call scripts and
WhatsApp messages are said by whoever on the team does the task: they contain the placeholder {my_name}, which the
dashboard fills with the name of the person signed in (Today's actions, the lead page, the WhatsApp link).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json as _json
import logging
import secrets

from app.services import catalog, gemini

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

COUPON_VALID_HOURS = 72

TRIGGER_CONTEXT = {
    "cart_abandon": "they added a course to their cart but did not complete checkout",
    "checkout_abandon": "they reached checkout and stopped one step short of paying",
    "wishlist": "they added a course to their wishlist",
    "session_end": "they browsed the website and then left",
    "enquiry": "they sent an enquiry form asking for more information",
    "email_click": "they clicked through a previous marketing email",
    "campaign": "they are part of a scheduled campaign",
    "manual_edit": "a member of the admissions team is drafting this email by hand",
    "chat_callback": "they asked for a call-back in the website's help assistant",
    "manual": "someone in the admissions team chose to follow up with them personally",
}

# Default offer per tier, used only when no next-best-action decision is passed in.
DEFAULT_OFFER_PCT = {
    "Target Immediately": 0,  # very likely to buy anyway: a discount mostly gives money away
    "Nurture via Email/WhatsApp": 15,
    "Marketing Campaign": 10,
    "Low Priority": 0,
}

# how an occupation reads in a sentence ("as a working professional")
OCCUPATION_PHRASE = {
    "Working Professional": "a working professional",
    "Student": "a student",
    "Businessman": "a business owner",
    "Unemployed": "someone looking for their next role",
    "Housewife": "someone returning to learning",
    "Other": "a learner",
}

MY_NAME = "{my_name}"  # filled in by the dashboard with the team member's own name
TEAM_SIGNATURE = "The X Education admissions team"


CODE_ALPHABET = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"  # no 0/O or 1/I, so a code can be read out on the phone


def coupon_code_for(pct, returning=False):
    """A personal code: a readable name for the discount level and five random characters (SMARTSTART20-K7Q2M), so
    every copy is unique to the one learner it is issued to in coupons_issued."""
    if not pct:
        return ""
    if returning:
        name = f"LOYAL{int(pct)}"
    else:
        name = {10: "EARLYBIRD10", 15: "FUTUREREADY15", 20: "SMARTSTART20", 25: "VIP25", 30: "LASTCHANCE30"}.get(
            int(pct), f"XEDU{int(pct)}"
        )
    return f"{name}-{personal_suffix()}"


def personal_suffix() -> str:
    """Five random characters that make a coupon code personal (about 33 million combinations)."""
    return "".join(secrets.choice(CODE_ALPHABET) for _ in range(5))


def _facts(course, course_slug):
    slug = course_slug or catalog.slug_for_title(course)
    f = catalog.facts(slug) if slug else None
    if f:
        return f
    return {
        "title": course or "our programme",
        "duration": None,
        "level": None,
        "price": None,
        "emi": None,
        "modules": None,
        "outcomes": [],
        "instructor": None,
        "instructor_role": None,
    }


def _course_block(f):
    lines = []
    if f["duration"]:
        lines.append(f"- Duration: {f['duration']}, level: {f['level']}")
    if f["modules"]:
        lines.append(f"- Modules include: {f['modules']}")
    if f["outcomes"]:
        lines.append(f"- What you will be able to do: {', '.join(f['outcomes'][:3])}")
    if f["instructor"]:
        lines.append(f"- Taught by {f['instructor']} ({f['instructor_role']})")
    if f["price"]:
        emi = f", or EMI from ₹{f['emi']:,} a month" if f["emi"] else ""
        lines.append(f"- Fee: ₹{f['price']:,}{emi}")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _offer_line(code, pct):
    if not code:
        return ""
    return (
        f"\n\nUse the code {code} at checkout for {pct}% off. It is linked to your account and valid for "
        f"{COUPON_VALID_HOURS} hours."
    )


def _trigger_line(trigger, title):
    return {
        "cart_abandon": f"You left {title} in your cart. It is still there whenever you are ready.",
        "checkout_abandon": (
            f"You were one step away from enrolling in {title}. If something went wrong at checkout, "
            f"reply to this email and we will help."
        ),
        "wishlist": f"You saved {title} to your wishlist, so here is a short summary to help you decide.",
        "enquiry": f"Thank you for your enquiry about {title}. Here are the key details.",
        "session_end": f"Thank you for looking at {title} on our website.",
        "chat_callback": f"Thank you for asking for a call about {title}. "
        "One of our counsellors will call you shortly.",
        "manual": f"I am following up personally about {title}, which you looked at on our website.",
    }.get(trigger, f"Here is a short overview of {title}.")


def _templates(first, occupation, specialization, f, action, trigger, code, pct, past_purchases):
    title = f["title"]
    block = _course_block(f)
    offer = _offer_line(code, pct)
    opener = _trigger_line(trigger, title)
    who = OCCUPATION_PHRASE.get(occupation, "a learner")
    field = f" with a background in {specialization}" if specialization else ""

    if past_purchases > 0:
        subject = f"{first}, a next step after your first course: {title}"
        body = (
            f"Hi {first},\n\nIt is good to have you learning with X Education. {opener}\n\n{block}"
            f"{offer}\n\nReply to this email if you would like help planning your next course.\n\n{TEAM_SIGNATURE}"
        )
        wa = (
            f"Hi {first}, thinking about {title} next? It is a {f['duration'] or 'short'} programme. "
            f"Reply YES for the details."
        )
        return subject, body, wa, ""

    if action == "Target Immediately":
        subject = f"{first}, your questions about {title}"
        body = (
            f"Hi {first},\n\n{opener}\n\nFor {who}{field}, this is what {title} covers:\n\n{block}{offer}\n\n"
            f"Would a 10-minute call help? Reply with a good time and one of our counsellors will call you.\n\n"
            f"{TEAM_SIGNATURE}"
        )
        wa = (
            f"Hi {first}, this is {MY_NAME} from X Education. {opener} I am happy to answer any questions about "
            f"{title}: reply here or tell me a good time to call."
        )
        script = (
            f"Hi {first}, this is {MY_NAME} from X Education. {opener} I would like to understand what you are "
            f"hoping to get from {title} and answer any questions about the curriculum, schedule or fees"
            + (f"; the programme runs for {f['duration']}" if f["duration"] else "")
            + ". "
            "What would make this the right time for you?"
        )
        return subject, body, wa, script

    if action == "Nurture via Email/WhatsApp":
        subject = f"{first}, is {title} right for you? A short guide"
        body = (
            f"Hi {first},\n\n{opener}\n\n{block}\n\nIt suits {who}{field} who wants hands-on, project-based "
            f"learning.{offer}\n\nQuestions? Reply to this email: a person on our team reads every one.\n\n"
            f"{TEAM_SIGNATURE}"
        )
        wa = (
            f"Hi {first}, {opener} {title} runs for {f['duration'] or 'a few months'}"
            + (f", and the code {code} gives {pct}% off for {COUPON_VALID_HOURS} hours" if code else "")
            + ". Reply for the syllabus."
        )
        return subject, body, wa, ""

    if action == "Marketing Campaign":
        subject = f"Free live session: getting started with {title}"
        body = (
            f"Hi {first},\n\n{opener}\n\nWe run a free live session every Saturday at 11 AM IST where instructors "
            f"walk through the {title} curriculum and answer questions, with no obligation.\n\n{block}{offer}\n\n"
            f"You can reserve a seat on the home page of our website.\n\n{TEAM_SIGNATURE}"
        )
        wa = (
            f"Hi {first}, there is a free live introduction to {title} this Saturday at 11 AM IST. "
            "Reply WEBINAR to join."
        )
        return subject, body, wa, ""

    subject = f"{title}: what you would learn, in two minutes"
    body = (
        f"Hi {first},\n\n{opener}\n\nHere is a short summary you can come back to later:\n\n{block}{offer}\n\n"
        f"When you are ready, the full curriculum is on the course page.\n\n{TEAM_SIGNATURE}"
    )
    wa = f"Hi {first}, here is a two-minute summary of {title} whenever you are ready. Reply INFO to get it."
    return subject, body, wa, ""


def speaker(text, name):
    """A call script or WhatsApp message as said by this person on the team ({my_name})."""
    if not text:
        return text
    return text.replace(MY_NAME, name or "the X Education team")


def generate_content(
    name: str,
    occupation: str | None,
    specialization: str | None,
    course: str,
    action: str,
    trigger: str = "session_end",
    past_purchases: int = 0,
    lead_score: float = 0,
    course_slug: str | None = None,
    offer_pct: int | None = None,
) -> dict:
    """{email_subject, email_body, whatsapp_message, coupon_code, offer_pct, call_script}.
    offer_pct: the discount next-best-action decided (None = tier default, 0 = no offer)."""
    first = (name or "there").split()[0]
    f = _facts(course, course_slug)
    pct = DEFAULT_OFFER_PCT.get(action, 0) if offer_pct is None else int(offer_pct)
    if past_purchases > 0 and offer_pct is None:
        pct = 20
    code = coupon_code_for(pct, returning=past_purchases > 0)

    if gemini.enabled():
        try:
            return generate_content_ai(
                first, occupation, specialization, f, action, trigger, lead_score, past_purchases, code, pct
            )
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - the templates always work
            log.warning("Gemini could not write the message (%s); using the template", e)

    subject, body, wa, script = _templates(
        first, occupation, specialization, f, action, trigger, code, pct, past_purchases
    )
    return {
        "email_subject": subject,
        "email_body": body,
        "whatsapp_message": wa,
        "coupon_code": code,
        "offer_pct": pct,
        "call_script": script,
    }


def generate_content_ai(
    first, occupation, specialization, f, action, trigger, lead_score, past_purchases, code, pct
) -> dict:
    """Gemini writes the copy from the catalogue facts only. Raises on any failure."""
    facts = _course_block(f) or f["title"]
    offer = (
        f"Include the coupon code {code} ({pct}% off, valid {COUPON_VALID_HOURS} hours) once."
        if code
        else "Do not offer any discount."
    )
    who = OCCUPATION_PHRASE.get(occupation or "", "a learner")
    prompt = f"""You write short, honest follow-up messages for X Education, an Indian online-education company.

Lead: {first}, {who}{f" in {specialization}" if specialization else ""}. Tier: {action}. Lead score: {lead_score}/100.
Why we are writing now: {TRIGGER_CONTEXT.get(trigger, 'they showed interest on the website')}.
{"Returning customer with " + str(past_purchases) + " past purchase(s)." if past_purchases else ""}
Course facts (the ONLY facts you may state):
{facts}

Rules:
- Do NOT invent statistics, salaries, placement guarantees, scholarships, seat limits or deadlines.
- Do NOT invent names of people. Sign the email "{TEAM_SIGNATURE}". In the WhatsApp message and the call script
  the counsellor introduces themselves as {MY_NAME} (write exactly {MY_NAME}; it is replaced by their name).
- {offer}
- Warm, specific, plain text, no emoji, under 160 words. Mention the course by name and why we are writing now.

Reply with ONLY JSON: {{"email_subject":"...","email_body":"...","whatsapp_message":"...","call_script":"..."}}"""
    content = _json.loads(gemini.generate(prompt, json_mode=True))
    for key in ("email_subject", "email_body", "whatsapp_message"):
        if not content.get(key):
            raise ValueError(f"Gemini response missing {key}")
    content.setdefault("call_script", "")
    content["coupon_code"] = code
    content["offer_pct"] = pct
    return content

"""
Ask the CRM: plain-English questions answered only from live data, and drafts that a person sends.

How it answers, without guessing:
  1. The question is matched to one of a fixed set of read-only data tools (who to call, hot leads, pipeline,
     learning loop, A/B tests, CRM impact, revenue, campaigns, one lead). Keyword rules do this; with GEMINI_API_KEY
     set, Gemini picks the tool when the rules are unsure.
  2. The tool reads the live database and returns its numbers plus where they came from.
  3. The answer is written from those numbers by a template. With Gemini, Gemini may re-phrase it, but if its text
     contains any number that is not in the tool's output, its text is thrown away and the template answer is used.
     So every number shown comes from the data.
  4. Drafts (an email to a lead, an A/B test plan) are only drafts: nothing is sent. A person opens them on the lead
     page or the A/B tests page and sends them.
Every question, the tools used and the answer are logged (copilot_log).
"""

def _num(x, d=0):
    return f"{x:,.{d}f}" if x is not None else "n/a"


def _pct(x, d=1):
    return f"{x * 100:.{d}f}%" if x is not None else "n/a"


def _mid(label: str) -> str:
    """A label inside a sentence: an ordinary first word in lower case, names and abbreviations as they are."""
    first = label.split(" ", 1)[0]
    return label if any(c.isupper() for c in first[1:]) else label[:1].lower() + label[1:]


def _money(x):
    return f"{CURRENCY}{x:,.0f}" if x is not None else "n/a"


def _chances(options_json, action) -> dict:
    """The chance of buying without a step and with this step, from a decision's receipt (empty when unknown)."""
    try:
        opts = {o["action"]: o for o in json.loads(options_json or "[]")}
        return {"p_without": float(opts["none"]["p_convert"]), "p_with": float(opts[action]["p_convert"])}
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
        return {}


class Copilot:
    # routing
    def route(self, q: str):
        text = q.lower()
        email = re.search(r"[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+(\.[\w-]+)+", q)
        if email and not re.search(r"\bdraft|write|compose", text):
            return "lead", {"query": email.group(0)}
        for intent, rx in RULES:
            if re.search(rx, text):
                args = {}
                if intent == "draft_email":
                    args["query"] = self._name_in(q)
                if intent == "counts":
                    args["days"] = self._period(text, default=7)
                if intent == "revenue":
                    m = re.search(r"(\d+)\s*(day|days|week|weeks|month|months)", text)
                    days = 30
                    if m:
                        n = int(m.group(1))
                        unit = m.group(2)
                        days = n * (7 if unit.startswith("week") else 30 if unit.startswith("month") else 1)
                    elif "week" in text:
                        days = 7
                    elif "today" in text:
                        days = 1
                    args["days"] = max(1, min(days, 365))
                if intent == "draft_ab_test":
                    args["text"] = text
                return intent, args
        name = self._name_in(q)
        if name:
            return "lead", {"query": name}
        return None, {}

    @staticmethod
    def _period(text: str, default: int = 30) -> int:
        """'last 3 weeks' -> 21, 'this month' -> 30, 'today' -> 1 (days)."""
        m = re.search(r"(\d+)\s*(day|days|week|weeks|month|months)", text)
        if m:
            n, unit = int(m.group(1)), m.group(2)
            days = n * (7 if unit.startswith("week") else 30 if unit.startswith("month") else 1)
        elif "today" in text:
            days = 1
        elif "week" in text:
            days = 7
        elif "month" in text:
            days = 30
        else:
            days = default
        return max(1, min(days, 365))

    def _name_in(self, q: str):
        """A learner's name mentioned in the question ('tell me about Riya Sharma')."""
        m = re.search(r"\b(?:about|for|to|on|is|lead)\s+([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)?)", q)
        if not m:
            return None
        cand = m.group(1).strip()
        return cand if db.fetchone("SELECT id FROM users WHERE name LIKE ? LIMIT 1", (f"%{cand}%",)) else None

    # tools
    def call_list(self, n: int = 5):
        rows = db.fetchall("""SELECT t.id, t.user_id, t.lead_id, t.expected_gain, u.name, u.email, l.lead_score,
                                     d.options_json
                              FROM sales_tasks t JOIN users u ON u.id = t.user_id LEFT JOIN leads l ON l.id = t.lead_id
                              LEFT JOIN nba_decisions d ON d.id = t.decision_id
                              WHERE t.status='open' AND t.task_type='call' ORDER BY t.expected_gain DESC""")
        cap = int(rules.S.get("daily_call_capacity", 20))
        top = rows[:n]
        facts = {
            "open_calls": len(rows),
            "daily_capacity": cap,
            "top": [
                {
                    "name": r["name"],
                    "lead_id": r["lead_id"],
                    "score": round(r["lead_score"] or 0),
                    **_chances(r["options_json"], "call"),
                    "simulated": (r["email"] or "").endswith(SIM_SUFFIX),
                }
                for r in top
            ],
        }
        if not rows:
            text = (
                "There are no open call tasks right now. Next-best-action creates a call only when it is expected "
                "to change the outcome by more than a call slot is worth today."
            )
        else:
            lines = [
                f"{i + 1}. {t['name']}: score {t['score']}"
                + (
                    f", a call raises the chance of buying from {t['p_without'] * 100:.0f}% to {t['p_with'] * 100:.0f}%"
                    if t.get("p_with") is not None
                    else ""
                )
                for i, t in enumerate(facts["top"])
            ]
            text = f"{len(rows)} open call tasks (up to {cap} new calls a day). Start with:\n" + "\n".join(lines)
        return (
            text,
            facts,
            "sales_tasks (open calls) and leads",
            [{"type": "lead", "lead_id": t["lead_id"], "label": t["name"]} for t in facts["top"] if t["lead_id"]],
        )

    def capacity(self):
        from app.ml import capacity

        s = capacity.current()
        facts = {
            k: s.get(k)
            for k in ("price", "policy", "capacity", "days_seen", "candidates", "per_day", "calls_today", "slots_left")
        }
        used = f"{s['calls_today']} of today's {s['capacity']} slots are used."
        if s["full"]:
            text = f"Today's {s['capacity']} call slots are all used: new calls wait for tomorrow."
        elif s["policy"] == "fcfs":
            text = (
                f"Call slots are not priced yet: {s['note']} Until then calls are given out first come, first "
                f"served, up to {s['capacity']} a day. {used}"
            )
        elif not s["price"]:
            text = (
                f"Call slots are not scarce right now: over the last {s['days_seen']} days about "
                f"{_num(s['per_day'], 1)} decisions a day could use a call profitably, fewer than the "
                f"{s['capacity']} slots, so a slot costs nothing and every call that adds value is made. {used}"
            )
        else:
            text = (
                f"A call slot is worth {_money(s['price'])} right now. Over the last {s['days_seen']} days about "
                f"{_num(s['per_day'], 1)} decisions a day could use a call profitably, for {s['capacity']} slots, "
                f"so a call is created only when it adds more than {_money(s['price'])} beyond the best step "
                f"without a call. {used}"
            )
        return (
            text,
            facts,
            "nba_decisions over the look-back window (capacity-aware next-best-action)",
            [{"type": "page", "to": "/actions", "label": "Open today's actions"}],
        )

    def hot_leads(self, n: int = 5):
        rows = db.fetchall(
            """SELECT l.id AS lead_id, l.user_id, l.lead_score, l.recommended_action, l.course_type,
                                     u.name, u.email
                              FROM leads l JOIN users u ON u.id = l.user_id
                              WHERE l.id IN (SELECT MAX(id) FROM leads GROUP BY user_id)
                                AND l.user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM purchases)
                              ORDER BY l.lead_score DESC LIMIT ?""",
            (n,),
        )
        facts = {
            "top": [
                {
                    "name": r["name"],
                    "lead_id": r["lead_id"],
                    "score": round(r["lead_score"] or 0, 1),
                    "tier": r["recommended_action"],
                    "course": r["course_type"],
                }
                for r in rows
            ]
        }
        if not rows:
            return "No open leads yet.", facts, "leads (latest per person)", []
        lines = [
            f"{i + 1}. {t['name']}: {t['score']:.0f}% chance to buy within {WINDOW_DAYS} days with no step "
            f"({t['tier']}), {t['course'] or 'no course yet'}"
            for i, t in enumerate(facts["top"])
        ]
        return (
            "Most likely to buy (not customers yet):\n" + "\n".join(lines),
            facts,
            "leads (latest score per person, customers excluded)",
            [{"type": "lead", "lead_id": t["lead_id"], "label": t["name"]} for t in facts["top"]],
        )

    def pipeline(self):
        from app.ml import journeys

        b = journeys.pipeline(limit=1)
        cols = {c["stage"]: c for c in b["columns"]}
        tot = b["totals"]
        facts = {s: {"people": c["count"], "anyway": c["anyway"], "add": c["add"]} for s, c in cols.items()}
        facts["totals"] = tot
        parts = ", ".join(f"{s} {cols[s]['count']:,}" for s in b["stages"])
        top = max((c for s, c in cols.items() if s not in ("Customer", "Lost")), key=lambda c: c["add"], default=None)
        text = (
            f"{parts}.\nIn the next {tot['window_days']} days about {_money(tot['anyway'])} comes in from the open "
            f"leads even if the team does nothing more, and the team can add about {_money(tot['add'])} with the "
            f"recommended step for {_num(tot['work'])} leads. {_num(tot['no_discount'])} leads are more likely "
            f"than not to buy anyway and a coupon would only give money away: they get no discount."
            + (f" The most money to add is in {top['stage']} ({_money(top['add'])})." if top and top["add"] > 0 else "")
        )
        return (
            text,
            facts,
            "pipeline board (each open lead's chance to buy with no step, and what the best step adds)",
            [{"type": "page", "to": "/pipeline", "label": "Open the pipeline"}],
        )

    def planner(self):
        from app.services import planner

        p = planner.overview()
        c, bud = p["counsellor"], p["budget"]
        facts = {
            "extra_adds_per_month": c["extra_adds_per_month"],
            "monthly_cost": c["monthly_cost"],
            "net_per_month": c["net_per_month"],
            "budget": bud.get("budget"),
            "budget_left": bud.get("left"),
        }
        if not c["enough_data"]:
            text = f"Not enough call decisions yet to price a counsellor's time: {c['note']}"
        elif c["extra_adds_per_month"] <= 0:
            text = (
                f"No: the team's {c['slots_now']} call slots a day are enough. Over the last week about "
                f"{_num(c['calls_worth_making_per_day'], 1)} decisions a day could use a call profitably."
            )
        else:
            verdict = "Yes" if c["net_per_month"] > 0 else "Not yet"
            text = (
                f"{verdict}: one more counsellor ({c['extra_slots']} more calls a day) would add about "
                f"{_money(c['extra_adds_per_month'])} a month, against {_money(c['monthly_cost'])} a month in cost "
                f"({_money(c['net_per_month'])} net). From the call decisions of the last week."
            )
        if bud.get("budget") is None:
            m = bud.get("month_without_limit") or {}
            text += "\nThere is no discount budget: a coupon goes out whenever it pays for itself" + (
                f" (about {_money(m.get('discount', 0))} of discount a month at the current pace)."
                if (bud.get("paying") or 0) >= (bud.get("min_decisions") or 30)
                else "."
            )
        else:
            text += f"\nDiscount budget: {_money(bud['budget'])} this month, {_money(max(bud['left'] or 0, 0))} left."
            if bud.get("extra"):
                text += (
                    f" {_money(bud['extra']['amount'])} more would add about "
                    f"{_money(bud['extra']['adds_per_month'])} of extra sales a month."
                )
        return (
            text,
            facts,
            "the CRM's own call and coupon decisions of the last week (planner)",
            [{"type": "page", "to": "/planner", "label": "Open the planner"}],
        )

    def learning(self):
        r = db.fetchone("SELECT * FROM learning_runs WHERE status='done' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1")
        if not r:
            return (
                "The learning loop has not run yet: it needs at least "
                f"{rules.S['learning']['min_new_outcomes']} new known outcomes.",
                {},
                "learning_runs",
                [],
            )
        lj = json.loads(r.get("learned_json") or "{}")
        ctl = lj.get("control") or {}
        pred = ctl.get("predicted") or {}
        actual = ctl.get("actual")
        facts = {
            "as_of": (r["as_of"] or "")[:10],
            "decision": r["lead_decision"],
            "control_people": ctl.get("people"),
            "actual": actual,
            "ours": pred.get("challenger"),
            "naive": pred.get("naive"),
            "naive_would_pick": bool(r.get("naive_would_pick")),
            "outcomes_known": r.get("outcomes_known"),
        }
        decision = {
            "swapped": "replaced the model",
            "kept": "kept the current model",
            "not_enough_data": "waited (not enough control-group data yet)",
        }.get(r["lead_decision"], r["lead_decision"])
        text = f"Latest run ({facts['as_of']}, {_num(r.get('outcomes_known'))} known outcomes): the loop {decision}."
        if actual and pred.get("naive") is not None and pred.get("challenger") is not None:
            over_n = pred["naive"] / actual - 1
            over_o = pred["challenger"] / actual - 1
            text += (
                f"\nOn the untouched control group ({ctl.get('people')} people), {_pct(actual)} actually bought. "
                f"Our retrain expected {_pct(pred['challenger'])}, a naive retrain {_pct(pred['naive'])} "
                f"(it overstates by {over_n * 100:+.0f}%, ours by {over_o * 100:+.0f}%)."
            )
            text += (
                " The usual check (fit on the CRM's own data) would have picked the naive model."
                if facts["naive_would_pick"]
                else " The usual check would not have picked the naive model this time."
            )
        return (
            text,
            facts,
            "learning_runs (latest), honest check on the control group",
            [{"type": "page", "to": "/learning", "label": "Open the learning loop"}],
        )

    def outreach(self):
        from app.services import analytics

        card = analytics.card("model_card.json") or {}
        steps = [e for e in (card.get("own_effects") or []) if e.get("input") in _STEP_INPUTS]
        link = [{"type": "page", "to": "/learning#own-steps", "label": "Open the learning loop"}]
        if not steps:
            return (
                "Not learned yet: the first model the learning loop adopts stores what each step adds.",
                {},
                "lead model card",
                link,
            )
        steps.sort(key=lambda e: -e["points"])
        facts = {e["input"]: round(e["points"], 1) for e in steps}
        text = (
            "What the team's work adds to the chance to buy within 14 days, by step, for a lead with a 30% chance on "
            "their own (the follow-ups after each step included): "
            + "; ".join(f"{_mid(e['label'])} {e['points']:+.1f} points" for e in steps)
            + ". Measured against leads the CRM never contacts and kept out of the lead score, so the score stays "
            "the chance to buy if the team does nothing. To compare the steps on their own, see the learning steps "
            "on the Next-best-action page."
        )
        return text, facts, "lead model in use (learning loop)", link

    def ab_tests(self):
        from app.services import abtests

        tests = abtests.listing()
        ad = abtests.adoption_rows()
        live = [t for t in tests if t.get("state") in ("running", "completed")]
        facts = {
            "tests": [
                {"name": t["name"], "state": t["state"], "verdict": (t.get("verdict") or {}).get("headline")}
                for t in live[:6]
            ],
            "adopted": [
                {"email": a["variant_label"], "audience": a["audience"], "status": a["status"]} for a in ad[:4]
            ],
        }
        if not live:
            text = "No A/B tests have been sent yet."
        else:
            lines = [f"- {t['name']}: {(t.get('verdict') or {}).get('headline', t['state'])}" for t in live[:6]]
            text = "A/B tests:\n" + "\n".join(lines)
        if ad:
            text += "\nAdopted winners: " + "; ".join(
                f"'{a['variant_label']}' for {a['audience']} ({a['status']}"
                + (f": {(a.get('check') or {}).get('why')}" if a.get("check") else "")
                + ")"
                for a in ad[:3]
            )
        return (
            text,
            facts,
            "ab_tests, experiment_assignments and adopted_emails",
            [{"type": "page", "to": "/ab-tests", "label": "Open A/B tests"}],
        )

    def impact(self):
        from app.services import analytics

        i = analytics.crm_impact()
        w, c = i["worked_on"], i["control"]
        facts = {
            "days": i["days"],
            "worked_on_rate": w["rate"],
            "worked_on_people": w["people"],
            "control_rate": c["rate"],
            "control_people": c["people"],
            "lift": i.get("lift"),
            "lift_ci": i.get("lift_ci"),
        }
        if not c["people"] or not w["people"]:
            return (
                "Not enough people yet: the comparison needs learners who signed up at least "
                f"{i['days']} days ago in both groups.",
                facts,
                "users, purchases and the control group",
                [],
            )
        lo, hi = i.get("lift_ci") or (None, None)
        text = (
            f"Of people the CRM worked on, {_pct(w['rate'])} bought within {i['days']} days of signing up "
            f"({w['people']:,} people); of the control group it never contacts, {_pct(c['rate'])} "
            f"({c['people']:,} people). Difference: {i['lift'] * 100:+.1f} points (95% interval "
            f"{lo * 100:+.1f} to {hi * 100:+.1f})."
        )
        text += (
            " The interval is above zero: the CRM is making a real difference."
            if lo is not None and lo > 0
            else " The interval still includes zero: not proven yet (the control group is small)."
        )
        return text, facts, "users and purchases, split by the fixed control group", []

    def revenue(self, days: int = 30):
        since = (datetime.now() - timedelta(days=days)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        rows = db.fetchall(
            """SELECT p.course_title, p.price_paid, p.discount_amount, u.email FROM purchases p
                              JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.purchased_at >= ?""",
            (since,),
        )
        n = len(rows)
        rev = sum(r["price_paid"] or 0 for r in rows)
        disc = sum(r["discount_amount"] or 0 for r in rows)
        sim = sum(1 for r in rows if (r["email"] or "").endswith(SIM_SUFFIX))
        by = {}
        for r in rows:
            by[r["course_title"]] = by.get(r["course_title"], 0) + 1
        top = sorted(by.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:3]
        facts = {
            "days": days,
            "purchases": n,
            "revenue": round(rev),
            "discounts": round(disc),
            "simulated": sim,
            "top_courses": top,
        }
        if not n:
            return f"No purchases in the last {days} days.", facts, "purchases", []
        text = f"Last {days} days: {n:,} purchases, {_money(rev)} revenue after {_money(disc)} of discounts."
        if top:
            text += " Top courses: " + ", ".join(f"{t} ({k})" for t, k in top) + "."
        if sim:
            text += f" {sim:,} of these are simulated learners."
        return text, facts, "purchases", []

    def counts(self, days: int = 7):
        """How many people the CRM has, split into real people and simulated learners."""
        now = datetime.now()
        since = (
            now.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0) if days == 1 else now - timedelta(days=days)
        ).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        people = db.fetchall(
            """SELECT u.email, u.created_at, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM purchases p WHERE p.user_id = u.id) AS bought
               FROM users u WHERE u.id IN (SELECT user_id FROM leads)"""
        )

        def split(rows):
            sim = sum(1 for r in rows if (r["email"] or "").endswith(SIM_SUFFIX))
            return {"all": len(rows), "real": len(rows) - sim, "simulated": sim}

        leads = split(people)
        new = split([r for r in people if (r["created_at"] or "") >= since])
        customers = split([r for r in people if r["bought"]])
        callbacks = db.fetchone("SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM callback_requests WHERE status='open'")["c"]
        tasks = db.fetchone("SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM sales_tasks WHERE status='open'")["c"]
        facts = {
            "days": days,
            "leads": leads,
            "new_leads": new,
            "customers": customers,
            "open_callbacks": callbacks,
            "open_tasks": tasks,
        }
        period = "today" if days == 1 else f"in the last {days} days"

        def both(x):
            if not x["simulated"]:
                return f"{x['all']:,}"
            who = "person" if x["real"] == 1 else "people"
            return f"{x['all']:,} ({x['real']:,} real {who}, {x['simulated']:,} simulated)"

        text = (
            f"Leads: {both(leads)}. New {period}: {both(new)}. Customers: {both(customers)}. "
            f"Open call-backs: {callbacks:,}; open call and WhatsApp tasks: {tasks:,}."
        )
        return (
            text,
            facts,
            "users, leads, purchases, call-backs and tasks",
            [{"type": "page", "to": "/leads", "label": "Open the leads"}],
        )

    def campaigns(self):
        from app.services import campaigns

        sent = [c for c in campaigns.report() if c.get("sent")][:4]
        facts = {
            "campaigns": [
                {
                    "name": c["name"],
                    "delivered": c.get("delivered"),
                    "conversions": c.get("conversions"),
                    "lift": (c.get("incremental") or {}).get("lift"),
                }
                for c in sent
            ]
        }
        if not sent:
            return "No campaigns have been sent yet.", facts, "campaign_schedules and email_sends", []
        lines = []
        for c in sent:
            inc = c.get("incremental")
            line = f"- {c['name']}: {c.get('delivered', 0):,} emails, " f"{c.get('conversions', 0):,} bought"
            if inc and inc.get("lift") is not None:
                lo, hi = inc["ci"]
                line += (
                    f"; against its hold-out {inc['lift'] * 100:+.1f} points (95% interval {lo * 100:+.1f} to "
                    f"{hi * 100:+.1f})"
                )
            lines.append(line)
        return (
            "Recent campaigns:\n" + "\n".join(lines),
            facts,
            "campaign_schedules, email_sends and hold-outs",
            [{"type": "page", "to": "/campaigns", "label": "Open campaigns"}],
        )

    def _find_lead(self, query):
        if not query:
            return None
        return db.fetchone(
            """SELECT l.*, u.name, u.email FROM leads l JOIN users u ON u.id = l.user_id
               WHERE (u.email = ? OR u.name LIKE ?) AND l.id IN (SELECT MAX(id) FROM leads GROUP BY user_id)
               ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 1""",
            (query, f"%{query}%"),
        )

    def lead(self, query):
        r = self._find_lead(query)
        if not r:
            return f"I could not find a lead matching '{query}'.", {}, "users and leads", []
        factors = json.loads(r.get("score_factors") or "[]")[:3]
        nba = json.loads(r.get("nba_json") or "null") or {}
        facts = {
            "name": r["name"],
            "score": round(r["lead_score"] or 0, 1),
            "tier": r["recommended_action"],
            "reasons": [f"{f['factor']} {f['impact']}" for f in factors],
            "next_step": nba.get("label"),
        }
        text = (
            f"{r['name']}: {facts['score']:.0f}% chance to buy within {WINDOW_DAYS} days with no step, "
            f"{r['recommended_action']}."
        )
        if factors:
            text += " Main reasons: " + "; ".join(f"{_mid(f['factor'])} ({f['impact']})" for f in factors) + "."
        if nba.get("label"):
            text += f" Last decision: {_mid(nba['label'])}" + (f". {nba['why']}" if nba.get("why") else ".")
        try:
            from app.ml import paths

            p = paths.plan(r["user_id"], depth=2)
            if p and p.get("summary"):
                text += f"\nWhat-if: {p['summary']}"
                facts["what_if"] = p["summary"]
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - the what-if part is optional here
            log.debug("What-if path unavailable for user %s", r["user_id"], exc_info=True)
        return (
            text,
            facts,
            "leads, nba_decisions and what-if paths",
            [{"type": "lead", "lead_id": r["id"], "label": f"Open {r['name']}"}],
        )

    def draft_email(self, query):
        from app.services.content import generate_content

        r = self._find_lead(query) if query else None
        if not r:
            return (
                "Tell me who the email is for, for example 'Draft an email to Riya Sharma'. I only write drafts; "
                "you send them from the lead page.",
                {},
                "users and leads",
                [],
            )
        slug = r.get("course_slug")
        title = catalog.title_of(slug, "our programmes") if slug else "our programmes"
        prof = db.get_profile(r["user_id"]) or {}
        content = generate_content(
            name=r["name"],
            occupation=prof.get("current_occupation"),
            specialization=prof.get("specialization"),
            course=title,
            action=r["recommended_action"],
            trigger="manual_edit",
            past_purchases=0,
            lead_score=r["lead_score"],
            course_slug=slug,
            offer_pct=0,
        )
        draft = {
            "type": "email",
            "lead_id": r["id"],
            "to": r["name"],
            "subject": content["email_subject"],
            "body": content["email_body"],
        }
        text = (
            f"Here is a draft for {r['name']} about {title}, written from the course facts. It offers no discount: "
            f"whether to offer one is next-best-action's decision. Nothing has been sent; open the lead to edit "
            f"and send it."
        )
        return text, {"lead": r["name"], "course": title}, "leads, user_profiles and the course catalogue", [draft]

    def draft_ab_test(self, text: str = ""):
        from app.services import abtests

        t = text or ""
        if re.search(r"subject|open|click", t):
            spec = (
                "Subject line: benefit vs urgency",
                "click",
                "An urgency subject line gets more people to click than a benefit-led one.",
                [
                    (
                        "Benefit-led subject",
                        "{first_name}, your next career step: {course}",
                        "Hi {first_name},\n\nSee how {course} fits your goals: curriculum, instructor and outcomes.",
                    ),
                    (
                        "Urgency subject",
                        "Last seats in the {course} batch",
                        "Hi {first_name},\n\nThe next {course} batch is filling up. Reserve your seat this week.",
                    ),
                ],
            )
        elif re.search(r"discount|coupon|offer|price", t):
            spec = (
                "EMI message vs refund guarantee",
                "purchase",
                "Removing a doubt (refund guarantee) converts more than talking about price (EMI).",
                [
                    (
                        "EMI from 2,200 a month",
                        "{course} from 2,200 a month",
                        "Hi {first_name},\n\nSpread the fee of {course} over easy monthly EMIs.",
                    ),
                    (
                        "7-day refund guarantee",
                        "Try {course} risk-free for 7 days",
                        "Hi {first_name},\n\nStart {course}; if it is not for you, get a full refund within 7 days.",
                    ),
                ],
            )
        elif re.search(r"mobile|short|long|length", t):
            spec = (
                "Short mobile email vs long email",
                "purchase",
                "A short email works better on phones.",
                [
                    (
                        "Long email",
                        "Everything about {course} in one email",
                        "Hi {first_name},\n\nModules, projects, instructor, fees, EMI and outcomes of "
                        "{course} in detail.",
                    ),
                    (
                        "Short mobile-first email",
                        "{course} in 30 seconds",
                        "Hi {first_name},\n\n{course}: 3 reasons, 1 link.",
                    ),
                ],
            )
        else:
            spec = (
                "Personalised course pick vs generic newsletter",
                "purchase",
                "A course picked for the learner's background converts better than a generic newsletter.",
                [
                    (
                        "Generic newsletter",
                        "This month at X Education",
                        "Hi {first_name},\n\nNews, new batches and learner stories from X Education.",
                    ),
                    (
                        "Personalised course pick",
                        "{first_name}, {course} fits your background",
                        "Hi {first_name},\n\nBased on what you looked at, {course} is the best next step for you.",
                    ),
                ],
            )
        name, metric, hyp, variants = spec
        ab = rules.S["ab_testing"]
        control = float(ab["control_share"]) if metric == "purchase" else 0.0
        mde = float(ab["min_detectable_effect"])
        p = abtests.plan("All leads", metric, len(variants), control, mde)
        draft = {
            "type": "ab_test",
            "name": name,
            "tier": "All leads",
            "metric": metric,
            "hypothesis": hyp,
            "control_share": control,
            "mde": mde,
            "variants": [{"label": lab, "subject": s, "body": b, "offer_pct": 0} for lab, s, b in variants],
        }
        facts = {
            "audience": p["audience"],
            "planned_per_arm": p["planned_per_arm"],
            "per_arm_available": p["per_arm_available"],
            "enough": p["enough"],
        }
        text = (
            f"Draft test: '{name}' ({'clicks' if metric == 'click' else 'purchases'} within {WINDOW_DAYS} days"
            + (f", {control * 100:.0f}% no-email control group" if control else "")
            + f"). Hypothesis: {hyp}\n"
            f"Plan: {p['planned_per_arm']:,} people per arm are needed to see a {mde * 100:.0f}-point lift; the "
            f"audience gives {p['per_arm_available']:,} per arm"
            + (
                ", which is enough."
                if p["enough"]
                else ", which is not enough, so only bigger effects could be " "detected."
            )
            + " Nothing is created yet: open it in A/B tests, review it, then create and send it."
        )
        return text, facts, "A/B planner (sample size) and the campaign audience", [draft]

    def help(self):
        text = (
            "I answer from the CRM's live data, and I only draft: a person sends. Try:\n"
            + "\n".join(f"- {s}" for s in SUGGESTIONS)
            + "\n- Tell me about <a learner's name or email>"
        )
        return text, {}, "none", []

    # answering
    def ask(self, question: str) -> dict:
        q = (question or "").strip()[:500]
        intent, args = self.route(q)
        used_gemini = False
        if intent is None and gemini.enabled():
            intent, args, used_gemini = self._gemini_route(q)
        if intent is None:
            intent, args = "help", {}
        fn = getattr(self, intent)
        try:
            text, facts, source, extras = fn(**args)
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - a tool failing must not break the page
            log.exception("Copilot tool %s failed", intent)
            text, facts, source, extras = (
                f"I could not read that data just now ({e.__class__.__name__}).",
                {},
                intent,
                [],
            )
        answer = text
        if gemini.enabled() and intent not in ("help", "draft_email", "draft_ab_test"):
            better = self._gemini_phrase(q, text)
            if better:
                answer, used_gemini = better, True
        drafts = [x for x in extras if x.get("type") in ("email", "ab_test")]
        links = [x for x in extras if x.get("type") in ("lead", "page")]
        out = {
            "question": q,
            "intent": intent,
            "answer": answer,
            "tools": [
                {
                    "name": intent,
                    "about": TOOLS.get(intent),
                    "source": source,
                    "read_at": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
                    "data": facts,
                }
            ],
            "drafts": drafts,
            "links": links,
            "used_gemini": used_gemini,
            "suggestions": SUGGESTIONS,
        }
        try:
            db.execute(
                """INSERT INTO copilot_log (question, intent, tools_json, answer, drafts_json, used_gemini)
                          VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)""",
                (
                    q,
                    intent,
                    json.dumps(out["tools"], default=str),
                    answer,
                    json.dumps(drafts, default=str),
                    int(bool(used_gemini)),
                ),
            )
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - logging must not fail the answer
            log.warning("Could not log the copilot question", exc_info=True)
        return out

    # optional Gemini (never the source of a number)
    def _gemini_route(self, q: str):
        try:
            prompt = (
                "You route a CRM user's question to ONE tool. Tools:\n"
                + "\n".join(f"- {k}: {v}" for k, v in TOOLS.items())
                + '\nReply with JSON only, e.g. {"tool": "hot_leads", "query": ""}. "query" is a learner name or '
                f"email for the lead and draft_email tools, else empty.\nQuestion: {q}"
            )
            raw = gemini.generate(prompt)
            m = re.search(r"\{.*\}", raw or "", re.S)
            d = json.loads(m.group(0)) if m else {}
            tool = d.get("tool")
            if tool not in TOOLS:
                return None, {}, True
            args = {"query": d.get("query") or None} if tool in ("lead", "draft_email") else {}
            if tool == "draft_ab_test":
                args = {"text": q.lower()}
            return tool, args, True
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            log.warning("Gemini routing failed: %s", e)
            return None, {}, False

    def _gemini_phrase(self, q: str, text: str):
        try:
            prompt = (
                "Rewrite this answer to the user's question so it reads naturally and briefly. Use ONLY the facts "
                "and numbers in the answer; do not add, round or change any number, and do not add advice.\n"
                f"Question: {q}\nAnswer: {text}"
            )
            out = (gemini.generate(prompt) or "").strip()

            def nums(s):
                return {n.replace(",", "") for n in re.findall(r"\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?", s)}

            if out and nums(out) <= nums(text):
                return out
            log.warning("Gemini's wording changed a number: using the template answer")
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            log.warning("Gemini phrasing failed: %s", e)
        return None


def ask(question: str) -> dict:
    return Copilot().ask(question)


def recent(limit: int = 10) -> list[dict]:
    return db.fetchall(
        "SELECT asked_at, question, intent, used_gemini FROM copilot_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,)
    )

"""
The one place that talks to Gemini (Google's ``google-genai`` SDK). Optional: without GEMINI_API_KEY nothing calls it,
and every caller falls back to its templates or rules when a call fails.

Three things keep it safe for a live demo:
  * Google retires model names every few months, so it tries GEMINI_MODEL from backend/.env first, then a few current
    names, and remembers the first one that answers.
  * Every call has a time limit (GEMINI_TIMEOUT seconds, default 12).
  * After a network failure Gemini is skipped for five minutes, so an offline demo does not wait on every email.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import os
import time

from app.core.config import get_settings

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

CANDIDATES = ["gemini-flash-latest", "gemini-2.5-flash", "gemini-2.0-flash"]
PAUSE_AFTER_NETWORK_ERROR = 300
_state: dict = {"model": None, "down_until": 0.0, "disabled": False, "client": None}


def _key() -> str:
    return (get_settings().gemini_api_key or "").strip()


def enabled() -> bool:
    return bool(_key()) and not _state["disabled"] and time.time() >= _state["down_until"]


def disable() -> None:
    """Templates only for the rest of this process (the history generator uses this)."""
    _state["disabled"] = True


def _names() -> list[str]:
    first = (get_settings().gemini_model or "").strip()
    return ([first] if first else []) + [m for m in CANDIDATES if m != first]


def _model_missing(e: Exception) -> bool:
    s = str(e).lower()
    return any(
        k in s for k in ("404", "not found", "not_found", "is not supported", "no longer available", "deprecated")
    )


def _client():
    if _state["client"] is None:
        from google import genai
        from google.genai import types

        timeout_ms = int(float(os.getenv("GEMINI_TIMEOUT", "12")) * 1000)
        _state["client"] = genai.Client(api_key=_key(), http_options=types.HttpOptions(timeout=timeout_ms))
    return _state["client"]


def generate(prompt: str, json_mode: bool = False) -> str:
    """Gemini's answer as text. Raises when it cannot answer (the caller then uses its fallback)."""
    if not _key() or _state["disabled"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Gemini is not configured")
    if time.time() < _state["down_until"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Gemini is paused after a network error")
    from google.genai import types

    config = types.GenerateContentConfig(response_mime_type="application/json") if json_mode else None
    names = [_state["model"]] if _state["model"] else _names()
    last: Exception | None = None
    for name in names:
        try:
            resp = _client().models.generate_content(model=name, contents=prompt, config=config)
            _state["model"] = name
            return resp.text or ""
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - every failure falls back to templates
            last = e
            if _model_missing(e):
                log.warning("Gemini model %s is not available; trying the next one", name)
                if _state["model"] == name:  # the remembered model was retired: try them all again
                    _state["model"] = None
                    return generate(prompt, json_mode)
                continue
            if any(
                k in str(e).lower()
                for k in ("connection", "timed out", "timeout", "proxy", "resolve", "unreachable", "network")
            ):
                _state["down_until"] = time.time() + PAUSE_AFTER_NETWORK_ERROR
                log.warning(
                    "Gemini is unreachable: using templates for the next %d minutes", PAUSE_AFTER_NETWORK_ERROR // 60
                )
            raise
    raise last or RuntimeError("No Gemini model is available")


def model_name() -> str | None:
    """The model that last answered (None before the first successful call)."""
    return _state["model"]
