import { useChartColors } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { signedPoints } from "../lib/learning";

export interface EffectItem {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  /** Points of buying chance for a typical lead (5.8 means 5.8 percentage points). */
  points: number;
  detail?: string;
}

/**
 * Learned effects as bars that grow left (lowers the chance to buy) or right (raises it) from a centre line, on one
 * scale, with the value written out in text so the colour never carries the meaning on its own.
 */
export function EffectBars({ items, label }: { items: EffectItem[]; label: string }) {
  const c = useChartColors();
  const max = Math.max(...items.map((i) => Math.abs(i.points)), 1);
  return (
    <ul aria-label={label} className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface">
      {items.map((i) => (
        <li
          key={i.key}
          className="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(4rem,7rem)_6.5rem] items-center gap-x-4 border-b border-line px-4 py-2.5 last:border-b-0"
        >
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <p className="truncate text-[13.5px] text-ink">{i.label}</p>
            {i.detail && <p className="truncate text-[12.5px] text-muted">{i.detail}</p>}
          </div>
          <div aria-hidden className="relative h-2">
            <span className="absolute inset-y-[-3px] left-1/2 w-px" style={{ background: c.axis }} />
            <span
              className="absolute inset-y-0 rounded-full"
              style={{
                background: i.points >= 0 ? c.series[0] : c.series[1],
                left: i.points >= 0 ? "50%" : `${50 - (50 * Math.abs(i.points)) / max}%`,
                width: `${(50 * Math.abs(i.points)) / max}%`,
              }}
            />
          </div>
          <p className="num text-right text-[13.5px] font-medium text-ink">{signedPoints(i.points)}</p>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

export interface Kpi {

  detail?: ReactNode;

/** Headline numbers in one band with hairline dividers (one row on a wide screen, wrapping on a narrow one). */
export function KpiStrip({ items, className }: { items: Kpi[]; className?: string }) {
  const cols =
    items.length >= 6
      ? "grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-6"
      : items.length === 5
        ? "grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-5"
        : items.length === 4
          ? "grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4"
          : "grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3";
  return (
    <dl className={cn("grid gap-px overflow-hidden rounded-md border border-line bg-line", cols, className)}>
      {items.map((k) => (
        <div key={k.label} className="bg-surface px-4 py-3.5">
          <dt className="text-[12.5px] text-muted">{k.label}</dt>
          <dd className="num mt-1 text-[22px] font-semibold leading-tight tracking-[-0.01em] text-ink">{k.value}</dd>
          {k.detail && <dd className="mt-0.5 text-[12.5px] text-muted">{k.detail}</dd>}
        </div>
      ))}
    </dl>
  );
}

// @vitest-environment jsdom
import { cleanup, render, screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { StepOption } from "../api/types";
import { DecisionReceipt } from "./receipt";

afterEach(cleanup);

function option(action: StepOption["action"], p: number, profit: number, blocked: string | null = null): StepOption {
  return {
    action,
    label: "",
    blocked,
    discount: 0,
    cost: 0,
    p_convert: p,
    uplift: 0,
    expected_profit: profit,
    incremental_profit: profit,
  };
}

const OPTIONS: StepOption[] = [
  option("none", 0.18, 0),
  option("email_info", 0.22, 1800),
  option("call", 0.34, 8251),
  option("whatsapp", 0, 0, "not opted in to WhatsApp"),
];

function rowOf(name: string): HTMLElement {
  const label = screen.getAllByText(name)[0];
  return label.closest('[role="row"]') as HTMLElement;
}

describe("DecisionReceipt", () => {
  it("shows each step's chance and how much it changes it, never rupees", () => {
    render(<DecisionReceipt options={OPTIONS} chosen="call" slotPrice={324} price={45000} policy="model" />);
    const call = rowOf("Counsellor phone call");
    expect(within(call).getByText("34%")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(within(call).getByText("+16.0 points")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(within(call).getByLabelText("Chosen")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText("Chance of buying with no step:", { exact: false })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByText(/₹8,251|₹7,927|profit/)).toBeNull();
  });

  it("says when today's call slots went to learners a call helps more", () => {
    render(<DecisionReceipt options={OPTIONS} chosen="email_info" slotPrice={9000} policy="model" />);
    expect(
      within(rowOf("Counsellor phone call")).getByText("Today's call slots are kept for learners a call helps more."),
    ).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it("says why a step was not possible", () => {
    render(<DecisionReceipt options={OPTIONS} chosen="call" />);
    const whatsapp = rowOf("WhatsApp message");
    expect(within(whatsapp).getByText("Not possible")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(within(whatsapp).getByText("Not opted in to WhatsApp.")).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it("names the model's own pick when a step was taken by hand", () => {
    render(<DecisionReceipt options={OPTIONS} chosen="email_info" modelBest="call" policy="manual" />);
    expect(screen.getByText(/The model would have picked: counsellor phone call\./)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(within(rowOf("Send an information email")).getByLabelText("Chosen")).toBeTruthy();
  });
});

import { cn, money, pct, points } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Check } from "lucide-react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import type { Policy, StepOption } from "../api/types";
import { actionLabel, POLICY_HELP, POLICY_LABEL } from "../lib/labels";

export interface DecisionReceiptProps {
  options: StepOption[];
  /** The step taken (or recommended). */
  chosen?: string | null;
  /** The model's own pick, when a different step was taken (a random step for learning, or by hand). */
  modelBest?: string | null;
  policy?: Policy | null;
  /** Price of a call slot when the decision was made (only used to say why a call was not taken). */
  slotPrice?: number | null;

  price?: number | null;
  title?: ReactNode;
  meta?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  compact?: boolean;
}

/**
 * The itemised receipt of one next-best-action decision: every step the CRM could take, the chance of buying after
 * it and how much that changes the chance against doing nothing, with the chosen step marked. The CRM also weighs
 * each step's cost, any discount and today's call slots; those stay inside the decision and are not shown here.
 */
export function DecisionReceipt({
  options,
  chosen,
  modelBest,
  policy,
  slotPrice,
  price,
  title = "Decision receipt",
  meta,
  className,
  compact,
}: DecisionReceiptProps) {
  const slot = slotPrice && slotPrice > 0 ? slotPrice : 0;
  const none = options.find((o) => o.action === "none");
  const change = (o: StepOption) => (none ? o.p_convert - none.p_convert : 0);
  const picked = options.find((o) => o.action === (chosen ?? "none"));
  const row = compact ? "py-1" : "py-1.5";
  return (
    <figure className={cn("rounded-md border border-line bg-surface", className)}>
      <figcaption
        className={cn(
          "flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-3 gap-y-1 border-b border-line",
          compact ? "px-3 py-2" : "px-4 py-3",
        )}
      >
        <span className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink">{title}</span>
        <span className="ml-auto text-[12.5px] text-muted">{meta}</span>
      </figcaption>
      <div className={compact ? "px-3 py-2" : "px-4 py-3"}>
        {(none || price) && (
          <p className="mb-2 text-[13px] text-muted">
            {none && (
              <>
                Chance of buying with no step: <span className="num text-ink">{pct(none.p_convert)}</span>.{" "}
              </>
            )}
            {price ? (
              <>
                Course fee <span className="num text-ink">{money(price)}</span>.
              </>
            ) : null}
          </p>
        )}
        <div role="table" aria-label="Steps compared" className="text-[13.5px]">
          <div role="row" className="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_3.5rem_6.5rem] gap-x-2 pb-1 text-[12px] text-muted">
            <span role="columnheader">Step</span>
            <span role="columnheader" className="text-right" title="Chance of buying within the outcome window">
              Chance
            </span>
            <span role="columnheader" className="text-right" title="Change in the chance of buying against no step">
              Change
            </span>
          </div>
          {options.map((o) => {
            const isChosen = picked?.action === o.action;
            return (
              <div key={o.action} role="row" className={cn("-mx-2 rounded-xs px-2", isChosen && "bg-brand-soft")}>
                <div className={cn("grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_3.5rem_6.5rem] items-baseline gap-x-2", row)}>
                  <span role="cell" className="flex min-w-0 items-baseline">
                    {isChosen ? (
                      <Check aria-label="Chosen" className="mr-1.5 size-3.5 shrink-0 self-center text-brand-ink" />
                    ) : (
                      <span aria-hidden className="mr-1.5 size-3.5 shrink-0" />
                    )}
                    <span
                      className={cn(
                        "truncate",
                        o.blocked ? "text-muted" : isChosen ? "font-medium text-ink" : "text-ink-2",
                      )}
                    >
                      {o.label || actionLabel(o.action)}
                    </span>
                    <span aria-hidden className="leader" />
                  </span>
                  <span role="cell" className="num text-right text-ink-2">
                    {o.blocked ? "" : pct(o.p_convert)}
                  </span>
                  <span
                    role="cell"
                    className={cn(
                      "num text-right",
                      o.blocked ? "text-muted" : isChosen ? "font-semibold text-ink" : "text-ink",
                    )}
                  >
                    {o.blocked ? "Not possible" : o.action === "none" ? "" : points(change(o))}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {o.blocked && <p className="-mt-0.5 pb-1 pl-5 text-[12.5px] text-muted">{capitalise(o.blocked)}</p>}
                {!o.blocked && o.action === "call" && slot > 0 && !isChosen && change(o) > 0 && (
                  <p className="-mt-0.5 pb-1 pl-5 text-[12.5px] text-muted">
                    Today&apos;s call slots are kept for learners a call helps more.
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        {picked && (
          <div className="mt-2 border-t-[3px] border-double border-line-strong pt-2">
            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-3 text-[14px]">
              <span className="font-semibold text-ink">{picked.label || actionLabel(picked.action)}</span>
              <span className="num ml-auto font-semibold text-ink">
                {picked.action === "none" ? pct(picked.p_convert) : points(change(picked))}
              </span>
            </div>
            <PolicyLine policy={policy} chosen={picked.action} modelBest={modelBest} />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </figure>
  );
}

function PolicyLine({
  policy,
  chosen,
  modelBest,
}: {
  policy?: Policy | null;
  chosen: string;
  modelBest?: string | null;
}) {
  if (!policy) return null;
  const differs = modelBest && modelBest !== chosen;
  return (
    <p className="mt-1 text-[12.5px] text-muted">
      {POLICY_LABEL[policy]}.{" "}
      {differs && (policy === "explore" || policy === "manual")
        ? `The model would have picked: ${actionLabel(modelBest).toLowerCase()}.`
        : POLICY_HELP[policy]}
    </p>
  );
}

function capitalise(s: string): string {
  return s ? s[0].toUpperCase() + s.slice(1) + (/[.!?]$/.test(s) ? "" : ".") : s;
}

import { ApiError } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { buttonClass } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { isRouteErrorResponse, Link, useRouteError } from "react-router";

/** Shown when a page cannot be opened: the page's code failed to load, or the page crashed while drawing. */
export function RouteError() {
  const error = useRouteError();
  const missing = isRouteErrorResponse(error) && error.status === 404;
  const chunk =
    error instanceof Error &&
    /dynamically imported module|Failed to fetch|Importing a module script failed/i.test(error.message);
  const title = missing
    ? "This page does not exist"
    : chunk
      ? "This page could not be loaded"
      : "This page stopped working";
  const detail = missing
    ? "Check the address, or go back to the start."
    : chunk
      ? "The CRM was probably updated while it was open. Reload to get the new version."
      : error instanceof ApiError
        ? error.message
        : "Reload the page. If it happens again, the error is in the browser console and the backend log.";
  return (
    <div className="mx-auto flex min-h-[60vh] max-w-lg flex-col justify-center px-6 py-16">
      <h1 className="text-[22px] font-semibold text-ink">{title}</h1>
      <p className="mt-2 text-[14px] text-muted">{detail}</p>
      <div className="mt-6 flex gap-2">
        <button type="button" className={buttonClass("primary")} onClick={() => window.location.reload()}>
          Reload
        </button>
        <Link to="/" className={buttonClass("secondary")}>
          Go to the start
        </Link>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function GlobalSearch() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const [params] = useSearchParams();
  // on the Leads page the box shows the search in use (and is cleared with it)
  const current = location.pathname === "/leads" ? (params.get("search") ?? "") : "";
  const [q, setQ] = useState(current);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(current);
  if (current !== shown) {
    setShown(current);
    setQ(current);
  }
  const submit = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const s = q.trim();
    navigate(s ? `/leads?search=${encodeURIComponent(s)}` : "/leads");
  };
  return (
    <form role="search" onSubmit={submit} className="relative w-full max-w-md">
      <Search
        aria-hidden
        className="pointer-events-none absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted"
      />
      <input
        type="search"
        value={q}
        onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
        placeholder="Find a lead by name, email or course"
        aria-label="Find a lead"
        className="h-9 w-full rounded-sm border border-line bg-sunken pl-8 pr-3 text-[13.5px] text-ink placeholder:text-muted focus:border-brand focus:bg-surface focus:outline-none"
      />
    </form>
  );
}

import type { UseQueryResult } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { errorText } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Button, Notice, Spinner } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

export function Loading({ label = "Loading", className }: { label?: string; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className={className ?? "flex min-h-40 items-center justify-center"}>
      <Spinner label={label} />
    </div>
  );
}

export function LoadError({ error, retry, what }: { error: unknown; retry?: () => void; what?: string }) {
  return (
    <Notice
      tone="bad"
      title={what ? `Could not load ${what}` : "Could not load this"}
      action={
        retry ? (
          <Button size="sm" onClick={retry}>
            Try again
          </Button>
        ) : undefined
      }
    >
      {errorText(error)}
    </Notice>
  );
}

/** Shows a spinner while the first answer is on its way, an error with a retry, or the content. */
export function QueryView<T>({
  query,
  children,
  what,
  loading,
}: {
  query: UseQueryResult<T>;
  children: (data: T) => ReactNode;
  what?: string;
  loading?: ReactNode;
}) {
  if (query.isPending) return <>{loading ?? <Loading label={what ? `Loading ${what}` : "Loading"} />}</>;
  if (query.isError) return <LoadError error={query.error} retry={() => void query.refetch()} what={what} />;
  return <>{children(query.data)}</>;
}

/// <reference types="vite/client" />
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import settingsText from "../../../../crm_settings.json?raw";
import { ACTION_LABEL, ACTION_ORDER, ACTION_SHORT, TIERS, actionLabel, tierLevel } from "./labels";

const settings = JSON.parse(settingsText) as {
  actions: Record<string, { label: string }>;
  tiers: { name: string; min_score: number }[];
};

describe("labels match crm_settings.json", () => {
  it("names every step the backend can take, in both lengths", () => {
    const keys = Object.keys(settings.actions).sort();
    expect([...ACTION_ORDER].sort()).toEqual(keys);
    for (const key of keys) {
      expect(ACTION_LABEL[key as keyof typeof ACTION_LABEL]).toBe(settings.actions[key].label);
      expect(ACTION_SHORT[key as keyof typeof ACTION_SHORT]).toBeTruthy();
    }
  });

  it("lists the tiers hottest first", () => {
    expect([...TIERS]).toEqual(settings.tiers.map((t) => t.name));
    expect(tierLevel("Target Immediately")).toBe(4);
    expect(tierLevel("Low Priority")).toBe(1);
    expect(tierLevel("Something else")).toBe(0);
  });

  it("falls back to the key for an unknown step", () => {
    expect(actionLabel("call")).toBe("Counsellor phone call");
    expect(actionLabel("call", true)).toBe("Phone call");
    expect(actionLabel(null)).toBe("No step");
    expect(actionLabel("fax")).toBe("fax");
  });
});

/** Words the CRM shows for the backend's keys. The backend sends most labels itself; these cover keys sent alone. */
import type { ActionKey, Policy } from "../api/types";

export const ACTION_LABEL: Record<ActionKey, string> = {
  none: "Do nothing for now",
  email_info: "Send an information email",
  email_coupon_10: "Send email with 10% coupon",
  email_coupon_20: "Send email with 20% coupon",
  call: "Counsellor phone call",
  whatsapp: "WhatsApp message",
};

/** Short names for table columns and chart axes. */
export const ACTION_SHORT: Record<ActionKey, string> = {
  none: "No step",
  email_info: "Information email",
  email_coupon_10: "10% coupon email",
  email_coupon_20: "20% coupon email",
  call: "Phone call",
  whatsapp: "WhatsApp",
};

export const ACTION_ORDER: ActionKey[] = [
  "none",
  "email_info",
  "email_coupon_10",
  "email_coupon_20",
  "call",
  "whatsapp",
];

export function actionLabel(key: string | null | undefined, short = false): string {
  if (!key) return "No step";
  const k = key as ActionKey;
  return (short ? ACTION_SHORT[k] : ACTION_LABEL[k]) ?? key;
}

/** Lead tiers, hottest first (crm_settings.json). */
export const TIERS = [
  "Target Immediately",
  "Nurture via Email/WhatsApp",
  "Marketing Campaign",
  "Low Priority",
] as const;

/** 4 for the hottest tier, 1 for the coolest; 0 when unknown. */
export function tierLevel(tier: string | null | undefined): number {
  const i = TIERS.indexOf((tier ?? "") as (typeof TIERS)[number]);
  return i < 0 ? 0 : TIERS.length - i;
}

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  fooledOverTime,
  latestChecked,
  overstatement,
  signedPoints,
  splitEffects,
  type RunWithControl,
} from "./learning";

function run(
  id: number,
  asOf: string,
  actual: number | null,
  naive?: number,
  ours?: number,
  people = 40,
): RunWithControl {
  return {
    id,
    as_of: asOf,
    learned: {
      control: { rows: 100, people, buyers: 5, actual, predicted: { champion: 0.2, challenger: ours, naive } },
    },
  };
}

describe("the learning loop's honesty check", () => {
  it("takes the newest run that was checked on the control group", () => {
    const runs = [run(3, "2026-10-19 18:00:00", 0.1, 0.3, 0.2, 0), run(2, "2026-09-19 00:00:00", 0.14, 0.32, 0.25)];
    expect(latestChecked(runs)?.id).toBe(2);
    expect(latestChecked([run(1, "2026-05-22 00:00:00", null)])).toBeNull();
  });

  it("keeps one point a day, the latest run of that day, oldest first", () => {
    const runs = [
      run(4, "2026-10-19 18:00:00", 0.15, 0.33, 0.26),
      run(3, "2026-10-19 09:00:00", 0.1, 0.3, 0.2),
      run(2, "2026-09-19 00:00:00", 0.14, 0.32, 0.25),
    ];
    expect(fooledOverTime(runs)).toEqual([
      { date: "2026-09-19", naive: 0.32, ours: 0.25, actual: 0.14 },
      { date: "2026-10-19", naive: 0.33, ours: 0.26, actual: 0.15 },
    ]);
  });

  it("measures over-statement against what the control group bought", () => {
    expect(overstatement(0.33, 0.25)).toBeCloseTo(0.32);
    expect(overstatement(0.2, 0.25)).toBeCloseTo(-0.2);
    expect(overstatement(0.2, 0)).toBeNull();
    expect(overstatement(null, 0.25)).toBeNull();
  });

  it("separates the CRM's own steps from the learned effects of time", () => {
    const { steps, time } = splitEffects([
      { input: "call", label: "Counsellor phone call", weight: 0.74, points: 17.3 },
      { input: "email_info", label: "Send an information email", weight: 0, points: 0.04 },
      { input: "away_14_30_days", label: "Last seen 14-30 days ago", weight: -1.48, points: -21.1 },
      { input: "age_7_14_days", label: "Signed up 7-14 days ago", weight: -1.29, points: -19.4 },
    ]);
    expect(steps.map((e) => e.input)).toEqual(["call"]);
    expect(time.map((e) => e.input)).toEqual(["away_14_30_days", "age_7_14_days"]);
    expect(splitEffects(null)).toEqual({ steps: [], time: [] });
  });

  it("writes points with a sign and a true minus", () => {
    expect(signedPoints(5.8)).toBe("+5.8 points");
    expect(signedPoints(-21.14)).toBe("−21.1 points");
    expect(signedPoints(-0.04)).toBe("0.0 points");
  });
});

/**
 * The numbers behind the Learning loop page's honesty check: what each model expected the untouched control group
 * to buy, against what it did, run by run. Kept apart from the page so they can be tested on their own.
 */

/** The control-group check stored with a learning run (learning_runs.learned_json -> control). */
export interface ControlCheck {
  rows: number;
  people: number;
  buyers: number;
  actual: number | null;
  /** The share each model expected to buy: the model in use, ours (told what the CRM did) and a naive retrain. */
  predicted: {
    champion?: number | null;
    challenger?: number | null;
    naive?: number | null;
  };
  naive_prob_better?: number | null;
}

export interface RunWithControl {
  id: number;
  as_of: string;
  learned: { control?: ControlCheck | null } | null;
}

/** An effect the lead model learned, in points of buying chance for a typical lead. */
export interface LearnedEffect {
  input: string;
  label: string;
  weight: number;
  points: number;
}

export interface FooledPoint {
  date: string;
  naive: number | null;
  ours: number | null;
  actual: number;
}

function checked(r: RunWithControl): ControlCheck | null {
  const c = r.learned?.control;
  return c && c.people > 0 && typeof c.actual === "number" ? c : null;
}

/** The latest run (runs arrive newest first) whose models were checked on people of the control group. */
export function latestChecked<R extends RunWithControl>(runs: readonly R[]): (R & { control: ControlCheck }) | null {
  for (const r of runs) {
    const c = checked(r);
    if (c) return { ...r, control: c };
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * One point per day, oldest first (the latest run of each day): the share of the control group a naive retrain and
 * ours expected to buy, and the share that bought.
 */
export function fooledOverTime(runs: readonly RunWithControl[]): FooledPoint[] {
  const byDay = new Map<string, FooledPoint>();
  for (const r of [...runs].sort((a, b) => a.as_of.localeCompare(b.as_of) || a.id - b.id)) {
    const c = checked(r);
    if (!c || c.actual === null) continue;
    const day = r.as_of.slice(0, 10);
    byDay.set(day, {
      date: day,
      naive: typeof c.predicted.naive === "number" ? c.predicted.naive : null,
      ours: typeof c.predicted.challenger === "number" ? c.predicted.challenger : null,
      actual: c.actual,
    });
  }
  return [...byDay.values()];
}

/** How much a model over-states (above 0) or under-states buying: 0.33 expected against 0.25 bought is +0.32. */
export function overstatement(expected: number | null | undefined, actual: number | null | undefined): number | null {
  if (typeof expected !== "number" || typeof actual !== "number" || actual <= 0) return null;
  return expected / actual - 1;
}

const TIME_INPUT = /^(away|age)_/;

/** The CRM's own steps (switched off when scoring "if we do nothing") apart from the learned effects of time. */
export function splitEffects(effects: readonly LearnedEffect[] | null | undefined): {
  steps: LearnedEffect[];
  time: LearnedEffect[];
} {
  const all = effects ?? [];
  return {
    steps: all.filter((e) => !TIME_INPUT.test(e.input) && Math.abs(e.points) >= 0.1),
    time: all.filter((e) => TIME_INPUT.test(e.input)),
  };
}

/** Points with a sign and a true minus: 5.8 -> "+5.8 points", -2.4 -> "−2.4 points". */
export function signedPoints(v: number, digits = 1): string {
  const n = Math.abs(v).toFixed(digits);
  if (Number(n) === 0) return `${n} points`;
  return v > 0 ? `+${n} points` : `−${n} points`;
}

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { byMoney, moneyLine } from "./money";

describe("the money line of a pipeline card", () => {
  it("names the step and what it adds when a step pays", () => {
    expect(moneyLine({ segment: "work", add: 8251, best: "call", p_anyway: 0.18, p_with_step: 0.34 })).toEqual({
      action: "call",
      add: 8251,
      pWithout: 0.18,
      pWith: 0.34,
      text: "with a phone call",
    });
  });

  it("offers no step when none pays, the lead is in the control group or cannot be contacted", () => {
    for (const segment of ["anyway", "wait", "control", "unreachable"] as const) {
      const line = moneyLine({ segment, add: 0, best: "none" });
      expect(line.action).toBeNull();
      expect(line.add).toBe(0);
      expect(line.text.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    }
    // a "work" card without a positive amount is not offered either
    expect(moneyLine({ segment: "work", add: 0, best: "call" }).action).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("working the board by money", () => {
  it("puts the most money to add first, then the score", () => {
    const cards = [
      { user_id: 1, add: 0, score: 90 },
      { user_id: 2, add: 500, score: 10 },
      { user_id: 3, add: 500, score: 40 },
      { user_id: 4, add: 1200, score: 5 },
    ];
    expect(byMoney(cards).map((c) => c.user_id)).toEqual([4, 3, 2, 1]);
  });
});

/**
 * The step line of a pipeline card: the best step now and how much it raises the chance of buying, or why nothing.
 * Kept apart from the page so it can be tested on its own.
 */
import type { ActionKey, MoneySegment, PipelineCard } from "../api/types";

export const SEGMENT_LABEL: Record<MoneySegment, string> = {
  work: "Work this",
  anyway: "Buys anyway",
  wait: "No step helps enough now",
  control: "Control group",
  unreachable: "Can't be contacted",
  lost: "Lost",
  customer: "Customer",
};

/** The step in a few words, after "with": "a phone call", "a 20% coupon email". */
export const STEP_WITH: Record<ActionKey, string> = {
  none: "no step",
  email_info: "an information email",
  email_coupon_10: "a 10% coupon email",
  email_coupon_20: "a 20% coupon email",
  call: "a phone call",
  whatsapp: "a WhatsApp message",
};

export interface MoneyLine {
  /** The step to take now, or null when there is nothing to do. */
  action: ActionKey | null;
  /** Extra profit of that step (rupees), 0 when there is no step: the order of work, never shown on a card. */
  add: number;
  /** Chance of buying with no step and with the step (0 to 1), when there is a step. */
  pWithout: number | null;
  pWith: number | null;
  text: string;
}

type CardMoney = Pick<PipelineCard, "segment" | "add" | "best"> &
  Partial<Pick<PipelineCard, "p_anyway" | "p_with_step">>;

export function moneyLine(card: CardMoney): MoneyLine {
  if (card.segment === "work" && card.best && card.best !== "none" && card.add > 0) {
    return {
      action: card.best,
      add: card.add,
      pWithout: card.p_anyway ?? null,
      pWith: card.p_with_step ?? null,
      text: `with ${STEP_WITH[card.best]}`,
    };
  }
  const text =
    card.segment === "anyway"
      ? "Likely to buy without help: no step needed"
      : card.segment === "control"
        ? "Never contacted: shows what happens without the CRM"
        : card.segment === "unreachable"
          ? "No allowed channel to contact them"
          : card.segment === "wait"
            ? "No step raises the chance enough now"
            : "";
  return { action: null, add: 0, pWithout: card.p_anyway ?? null, pWith: null, text };
}

/** Cards in the order the team should work them: where a step makes the most difference first, then the score. */
export function byMoney<T extends Pick<PipelineCard, "add" | "score" | "user_id">>(cards: readonly T[]): T[] {
  return [...cards].sort((a, b) => b.add - a.add || b.score - a.score || a.user_id - b.user_id);
}

  extra_slots: 8,

  enough_data: true,
  note: "",

  slots_now_add_per_month: 1120000,

  budget: null,
  spent: 0,

  left: null,

      "Only 3 decisions",
    );

    expect(budgetVerdict(budget).label).toBe("No budget");
    expect(budgetVerdict(budget).text).toContain("₹90,000");
    expect(budgetVerdict({ ...budget, paying: 0 }).text).toContain("has seen no coupon decisions that pay");
    // a handful of decisions is too few to say what a month costs
    const few = budgetVerdict({ ...budget, paying: 2, min_decisions: 30 }).text;
    expect(few).toContain("only 2 coupon decisions that pay");

      left: -1000,

    expect(usedUp.text).toContain("₹51,000 of this month's ₹50,000");
    expect(budgetVerdict({ ...budget, budget: 50000, left: 30000, price: 0 }).label).toBe("Enough");
    expect(budgetVerdict({ ...budget, budget: 50000, left: 30000, price: 0.8 }).label).toBe("Priced");
  });
});

/**
 * The owner's planner in words: whether one more counsellor pays, and what the discount budget is doing. Kept apart
 * from the page so the verdicts can be tested.
 */
import { money } from "@xedu/shared/lib";

export interface CounsellorView {
  slots_now: number;
  extra_slots: number;
  monthly_cost: number;
  enough_data: boolean;
  note: string;
  calls_worth_making_per_day: number;
  slots_now_add_per_month: number;
  extra_adds_per_month: number;
  net_per_month: number;
}

export interface BudgetView {
  budget: number | null;
  spent: number;
  committed: number;
  left: number | null;
  price: number | null;
  used_up: boolean;
  days_left: number;
  policy: string;
  note: string;
  /** Decisions of the look-back window where a coupon added profit. */
  paying: number;
  /** How many paying decisions are needed before a month's pace is stated. */
  min_decisions?: number;
  month_without_limit: { discount: number; profit_added: number };
  extra?: { amount: number; adds_per_month: number };
}

export interface Verdict {
  tone: "good" | "neutral" | "warn";
  label: string;
  text: string;
}

export function counsellorVerdict(c: CounsellorView): Verdict {
  if (!c.enough_data) return { tone: "neutral", label: "Not enough data", text: c.note };
  if (c.extra_adds_per_month <= 0)
    return {
      tone: "neutral",
      label: "Not needed",
      text: `The team's ${c.slots_now} call slots a day are enough: about ${c.calls_worth_making_per_day.toFixed(1)} decisions a day could use a call that pays.`,
    };
  const sentence = `One more counsellor (${c.extra_slots} more calls a day) would add about ${money(c.extra_adds_per_month)} a month against ${money(c.monthly_cost)} in cost.`;
  return c.net_per_month > 0
    ? { tone: "good", label: "Worth it", text: `${sentence} That is ${money(c.net_per_month)} a month more profit.` }
    : { tone: "warn", label: "Not yet", text: `${sentence} The extra calls would not pay for the salary yet.` };
}

export function budgetVerdict(b: BudgetView): Verdict {
  if (b.budget === null)
    return {
      tone: "neutral",
      label: "No budget",
      text:
        b.paying >= (b.min_decisions ?? 30)
          ? `A coupon goes out whenever it adds more profit than its discount costs. At the current pace that is about ${money(b.month_without_limit.discount)} of discount a month, for about ${money(b.month_without_limit.profit_added)} of extra profit.`
          : `A coupon goes out whenever it adds more profit than its discount costs. The CRM has seen ${b.paying === 0 ? "no" : `only ${b.paying}`} coupon ${b.paying === 1 ? "decision" : "decisions"} that pay in the last week; it needs ${b.min_decisions ?? 30} to say what a month of coupons costs.`,
    };
  if (b.used_up)
    return {
      tone: "warn",
      label: "Used up",
      text: `${money(b.spent + b.committed)} of this month's ${money(b.budget)} is already given or promised in open coupons: the CRM sends no more coupons until next month.`,
    };
  if (!b.price)
    return {
      tone: "good",
      label: "Enough",
      text:
        b.policy === "priced"
          ? "The budget covers every coupon that pays at the current pace, so no coupon is held back."
          : `Coupons go out first come, first served until the money is used. ${b.note}`,
    };
  return {
    tone: "good",
    label: "Priced",
    text: `Money is tight, so a coupon goes out only when it adds at least ${money(b.price * 100)} of profit for every ${money(100)} of discount it uses: the budget then lasts the month and goes to the coupons that add the most.`,
  };
}

describe("Start here", () => {

      expect(steps.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);

    const words = glossary(rules);
    expect(words.find((w) => w.term === "Control group")?.meaning).toContain("5%");
    expect(words.find((w) => w.term === "Learning steps")?.meaning).toContain("15%");
    expect(words.find((w) => w.term === "Price of a call slot")?.meaning).toContain("8 calls a day");
  });
});

export function markStartSeen(): void {

const DIMENSIONS = [
  { id: "tier", label: "Tier" },
  { id: "occupation", label: "Occupation" },
  { id: "device", label: "Device" },
  { id: "source", label: "Came from" },
] as const;

type Dim = (typeof DIMENSIONS)[number]["id"];

function armName(arm: string, test: AbTest): string {
  if (arm === "control") return "Control (no email)";
  const v = test.variants.find((x) => x.key === arm);
  return v ? `${arm}: ${v.label}` : arm;
}

function Segments({ r, test }: { r: AbResults; test: AbTest }) {
  const [dim, setDim] = useState<Dim>("tier");
  const rows = r.segments[dim] ?? [];
  const arms = r.arms.map((a) => a.arm);
  return (
    <>
      <Tabs<Dim>
        label="Split the results by"
        value={dim}
        onChange={setDim}
        tabs={DIMENSIONS.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, label: d.label }))}
        className="mb-3"
      />
      <Table label={`Results by ${dim}`}>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <Th>{DIMENSIONS.find((d) => d.id === dim)?.label}</Th>
            {arms.map((a) => (
              <Th key={a} className="text-right">
                {armName(a, test)}
              </Th>
            ))}
            <Th>Best</Th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.map((s) => (
            <tr key={s.value}>
              <Td className="text-ink">{s.value}</Td>
              {arms.map((a) => {
                const x = s.arms[a];
                return (
                  <Td key={a} className="num text-right">
                    {x ? pct(x.rate, 1, "None") : ""}
                    <span className="block text-[12px] text-muted">{x ? `${int(x.n)} people` : ""}</span>
                  </Td>
                );
              })}
              <Td className="text-ink-2">
                {s.best ? `Variant ${s.best}` : s.enough ? "No clear best" : "Too few people"}
              </Td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </Table>
      <p className="mt-2 text-[12.5px] text-muted">
        Exploratory: with many groups, some differences appear by chance. Use them to plan the next test, not to decide.
      </p>
    </>
  );
}

function Results({ r, test }: { r: AbResults; test: AbTest }) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { can } = useSession();
  const apply = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (variant: string) =>
      api.post<{ campaign_id: number; message: string }>(`/ab-tests/${test.id}/apply`, { variant }),
    onSuccess: (x) => {
      toast({ tone: "good", text: x.message });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["campaigns"] });
      navigate("/campaigns");
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
  const what = r.metric === "bought" ? "bought" : "clicked";
  const series = r.arms.map((a) => ({ key: a.arm, label: armName(a.arm, test) }));
  return (
    <>
      {r.srm_problem && (
        <Notice tone="bad" title="The random split looks broken" className="mb-6">
          The groups are not the sizes the random split should give (sample-ratio test p = {r.srm_p?.toFixed(4)}). Do
          not trust these results until the cause is found.
        </Notice>
      )}
      <Section
        title="Groups"
        description={`Share who ${what} within ${plural(r.window_days, "day")} of the email, with a 95% interval.`}
      >
        <Table label="Groups">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <Th>Group</Th>
              <Th className="text-right">People</Th>
              <Th className="text-right">{r.metric === "bought" ? "Bought" : "Clicked"}</Th>
              <Th className="text-right">Share</Th>
              <Th className="text-right">Revenue per person</Th>
              <Th className="text-right">Profit per person</Th>
              {can("marketing") && <Th aria-label="Actions" />}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {r.arms.map((a) => (
              <tr key={a.arm}>
                <Td className="text-ink">{armName(a.arm, test)}</Td>
                <Td className="num text-right">{int(a.n)}</Td>
                <Td className="num text-right">{int(r.metric === "bought" ? a.purchases : a.clicks)}</Td>
                <Td className="num text-right">
                  {pct(a.rate, 1, "None")}
                  {a.rate_ci[0] !== null && a.rate_ci[1] !== null && (
                    <span className="block text-[12px] text-muted">
                      {pct(a.rate_ci[0], 1)} to {pct(a.rate_ci[1], 1)}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </Td>
                <Td className="num text-right">{money(a.revenue_per_person, "")}</Td>
                <Td className="num text-right">{money(a.profit_per_person, "")}</Td>
                {can("marketing") && (
                  <Td className="text-right">
                    {a.arm !== "control" && (
                      <Button
                        size="sm"
                        variant="ghost"
                        loading={apply.isPending && apply.variables === a.arm}
                        onClick={() => apply.mutate(a.arm)}
                      >
                        Use as a campaign
                      </Button>
                    )}
                  </Td>
                )}
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </Table>
      </Section>

      {r.comparisons.length > 0 && (
        <Section
          title={`Difference against ${r.reference === "control" ? "sending nothing" : `variant ${r.reference}`}`}
          description={`In percentage points, with a 95% interval corrected for ${plural(r.bonferroni_comparisons, "comparison")}. An interval across zero is not a clear difference.`}
        >
          <div className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface px-4">
            <IntervalPlot
              label="Differences"
              format={(v) => points(v)}
              rows={r.comparisons.map((c) => ({
                label: armName(c.variant, test),
                note: `p = ${c.p_adjusted === null ? "not known" : c.p_adjusted.toFixed(4)} after the correction${c.significant ? ", clear" : ""}`,
                value: c.lift,
                low: c.lift_ci[0],
                high: c.lift_ci[1],
                emphasis: c.significant,
              }))}
            />
          </div>
        </Section>
      )}

      {r.curve.length > 1 && (
        <Section title="Day by day" description={`Share of each group who ${what} by each day after the email.`}>
          <TrendChart
            title={`Share who ${what}`}
            data={r.curve}
            x="day"
            xFormat={(d) => `Day ${d}`}
            series={series}
            format={(v) => `${v.toFixed(1)}%`}
            height={240}
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      <Section title="By group of people">
        <Segments r={r} test={test} />
      </Section>

      <p className="mt-6 text-[12.5px] text-muted">
        {r.final
          ? "Final: the outcome window has passed for everyone."
          : `Still counting: day ${r.days_since_start} of ${r.window_days}.`}{" "}
        Each group needed about {int(r.planned_per_arm)} people for a difference of {pointsPlain(test.mde ?? 0.05)}; the
        smallest has {int(r.smallest_arm)}
        {r.detectable_lift ? `, enough to notice ${pointsPlain(r.detectable_lift, 1)} or more` : ""}.
      </p>
    </>
  );
}

export default function AbTestDetail() {
  const { testId } = useParams();
  const id = Number(testId);
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { can } = useSession();
  const data = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["ab-tests", id],
    queryFn: () => api.get<ResultsResponse>(`/ab-tests/${id}/results`),
    refetchInterval: 30_000,
    enabled: Number.isFinite(id),
  });
  const send = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.post<{ message: string }>(`/ab-tests/${id}/send`),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      toast({ tone: "good", text: r.message });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["ab-tests"] });
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
  const remove = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.del(`/ab-tests/${id}`),
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast({ tone: "good", text: "Draft deleted." });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["ab-tests"] });
      navigate("/ab-tests");
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });

  if (data.isPending) return <Loading label="Loading the test" />;
  if (data.isError) {
    if (data.error instanceof ApiError && data.error.status === 404) {
      return (
        <EmptyState
          icon={FlaskConical}
          title="This test does not exist"
          action={
            <Link to="/ab-tests" className={buttonClass()}>
              Back to the tests
            </Link>
          }
        />
      );
    }
    return <LoadError error={data.error} what="the test" retry={() => void data.refetch()} />;
  }
  const { test, plan, results } = data.data;
  const verdict = results?.verdict ?? test.verdict;
  const tone =
    verdict?.status === "winner"
      ? "good"
      : verdict?.status === "broken" || verdict?.status === "loser"
        ? "bad"
        : "info";

  return (
    <>
      <Link to="/ab-tests" className="mb-3 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[13px] text-muted hover:text-ink">
        <ChevronLeft aria-hidden className="size-4" />
        A/B tests
      </Link>
      <header className="mb-6">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <h1 className="text-[22px] font-semibold leading-tight text-ink">{test.name}</h1>
          <VerdictBadge v={verdict} state={test.state} />
          {test.simulated && <SimulatedTag />}
        </div>
        <p className="mt-1 text-[13.5px] text-muted">
          {test.tier}. Measures {test.metric === "purchase" ? "buying a course" : "clicks"}.{" "}
          {test.started_at ? `Sent ${dateTime(test.started_at)}.` : "Not sent yet."}
        </p>
        {test.hypothesis && <p className="mt-2 max-w-[75ch] text-[14px] text-ink-2">{test.hypothesis}</p>}
      </header>

      {verdict && test.state !== "draft" && (
        <Notice tone={tone} title={verdict.headline} className="mb-8 max-w-3xl">
          {verdict.detail}
        </Notice>
      )}

      {test.state === "draft" && (
        <div className="mb-8 max-w-3xl">
          {plan && (
            <Notice
              tone={plan.enough ? "info" : "warn"}
              title={plan.enough ? "Ready to send" : "The audience is small for this test"}
            >
              About {int(plan.audience)} people would take part, {int(plan.per_arm_available)} per group. Each group
              needs about {int(plan.planned_per_arm)} to notice a difference of {pointsPlain(plan.mde)}.
            </Notice>
          )}
          {can("marketing") && (
            <div className="mt-4 flex gap-2">
              <Button variant="primary" loading={send.isPending} onClick={() => send.mutate()}>
                Send the test
              </Button>
              <Button variant="danger" loading={remove.isPending} onClick={() => remove.mutate()}>
                Delete the draft
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {results && <Results r={results} test={test} />}

      <Section title="The emails" className="mt-10">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
          {test.variants.map((v) => (
            <article key={v.key} className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface">
              <header className="border-b border-line px-4 py-2.5">
                <p className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink">
                  Variant {v.key}: {v.label}
                </p>
                {v.offer_pct > 0 && <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted">With a {v.offer_pct}% coupon</p>}
              </header>
              <div className="px-4 py-3">
                <p className="text-[14px] font-medium text-ink">{v.subject}</p>
                <p className="mt-2 whitespace-pre-line text-[13.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink-2">{v.body}</p>
              </div>
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      </Section>
    </>
  );
}

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { dateTime, errorText, int, pct, plural, pointsPlain } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import {
  Badge,
  Button,
  Dialog,
  EmptyState,
  Field,
  IconButton,

  Td,
  Textarea,
  Th,
  useToast,

import { FlaskConical, Plus, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Link, useNavigate } from "react-router";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import type { AbPlan, AbTest, AbTestsResponse, Adoption } from "../api/types";
import { VerdictBadge } from "../components/ab";
import { useSession } from "../app/session";
import { SimulatedTag } from "../components/lead-bits";
import { PageHeader, Section } from "../components/page";
import { Loading, LoadError, QueryView } from "../components/state";

interface DraftVariant {
  label: string;
  subject: string;
  body: string;
  offer_pct: number;
}

const KEYS = ["A", "B", "C"];

function NewTest({
  audiences,
  settings,
  onClose,
}: {
  audiences: string[];
  settings: AbTestsResponse["settings"];
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [tier, setTier] = useState(audiences[0] ?? "All leads");
  const [metric, setMetric] = useState<"purchase" | "click">("purchase");
  const [hypothesis, setHypothesis] = useState("");
  const [variants, setVariants] = useState<DraftVariant[]>([
    { label: "", subject: "", body: "Hi {first_name},\n\n", offer_pct: 0 },
    { label: "", subject: "", body: "Hi {first_name},\n\n", offer_pct: 0 },
  ]);
  const controlShare = metric === "purchase" ? settings.control_share : 0;
  const plan = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["ab-plan", tier, metric, variants.length],
    queryFn: () =>
      api.get<AbPlan>("/ab-tests/plan", { tier, metric, variants: variants.length, control_share: controlShare }),
  });
  const create = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      api.post<{ id: number; message: string; warning: string | null }>("/ab-tests", {
        name,
        tier,
        hypothesis,
        metric,
        control_share: controlShare,
        variants: variants.map((v, i) => ({ ...v, label: v.label || `Variant ${KEYS[i]}` })),
      }),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["ab-tests"] });
      navigate(`/ab-tests/${r.id}`);
    },
  });
  const update = (i: number, patch: Partial<DraftVariant>) =>
    setVariants((vs) => vs.map((v, j) => (j === i ? { ...v, ...patch } : v)));
  const ready = name.trim() && variants.every((v) => v.subject.trim() && v.body.trim());
  return (
    <Dialog
      open
      size="lg"
      onClose={onClose}
      title="New A/B test"
      description="Each person in the audience is given one variant at random. It is saved as a draft: you send it from its page."
      footer={
        <>
          <Button onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button variant="primary" loading={create.isPending} disabled={!ready} onClick={() => create.mutate()}>
            Save the draft
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <div className="grid gap-4">
        {create.isError && <Notice tone="bad">{errorText(create.error)}</Notice>}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Field label="Name">
            <Input value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} maxLength={200} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Audience">
            <Select
              value={tier}
              onChange={(e) => setTier(e.target.value)}
              options={audiences.map((a) => ({ value: a, label: a }))}
            />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="mb-1.5 text-[13px] font-medium text-ink">What counts as a success</p>
          <Segmented
            label="Success measure"
            value={metric}
            onChange={setMetric}
            options={[
              { value: "purchase", label: "Buying a course" },
              { value: "click", label: "Clicking the email" },
            ]}
          />
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-[12.5px] text-muted">
            {metric === "purchase"
              ? `${pct(controlShare)} of the audience get no email (the control group), so each variant is compared with sending nothing.`
              : "Everyone gets a variant; the variants are compared with each other."}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Field label="What you expect, and why" optional>
          <Textarea rows={2} value={hypothesis} onChange={(e) => setHypothesis(e.target.value)} maxLength={2000} />
        </Field>
        {variants.map((v, i) => (
          <fieldset key={i} className="rounded-md border border-line p-3">
            <legend className="px-1 text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink">Variant {KEYS[i]}</legend>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-[1fr_10rem]">
              <Field label="Short name" optional>
                <Input
                  value={v.label}
                  onChange={(e) => update(i, { label: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder={`Variant ${KEYS[i]}`}
                  maxLength={120}
                />
              </Field>
              <Field label="Coupon">
                <Select
                  value={String(v.offer_pct)}
                  onChange={(e) => update(i, { offer_pct: Number(e.target.value) })}
                  options={[0, 10, 15, 20].map((n) => ({ value: String(n), label: n ? `${n}% off` : "No coupon" }))}
                />
              </Field>
            </div>
            <Field label="Subject" className="mt-3">
              <Input value={v.subject} onChange={(e) => update(i, { subject: e.target.value })} maxLength={300} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Message" className="mt-3">
              <Textarea rows={4} value={v.body} onChange={(e) => update(i, { body: e.target.value })} />
            </Field>
            {variants.length > 2 && (
              <div className="mt-2 flex justify-end">
                <IconButton
                  label={`Remove variant ${KEYS[i]}`}
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => setVariants((vs) => vs.filter((_, j) => j !== i))}
                >
                  <X aria-hidden className="size-4" />
                </IconButton>
              </div>
            )}
          </fieldset>
        ))}
        {variants.length < Math.min(3, settings.max_variants) && (
          <div>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              icon={<Plus aria-hidden className="size-4" />}
              onClick={() =>
                setVariants((vs) => [...vs, { label: "", subject: "", body: "Hi {first_name},\n\n", offer_pct: 0 }])
              }
            >
              Add a variant
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
        {plan.data && (
          <Notice
            tone={plan.data.enough ? "info" : "warn"}
            title={plan.data.enough ? "The audience is big enough" : "The audience is small for this test"}
          >
            To notice a difference of {pointsPlain(plan.data.mde)}, each variant needs about{" "}
            {int(plan.data.planned_per_arm)} people; this audience gives about {int(plan.data.per_arm_available)} each.
            {!plan.data.enough && plan.data.detectable_lift
              ? ` With that many, only a difference of ${pointsPlain(plan.data.detectable_lift)} or more would show.`
              : ""}
          </Notice>
        )}
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function Adoptions() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  const { can } = useSession();
  const list = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["adoptions"],
    queryFn: () => api.get<{ adoptions: Adoption[]; auto_adopt: boolean; check_share: number }>("/adoptions"),
    refetchInterval: 60_000,
  });
  const revert = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: number) => api.post(`/adoptions/${id}/revert`),
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast({ tone: "good", text: "Switched back to the old standard email." });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["adoptions"] });
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
  return (
    <QueryView query={list} what="the adopted emails">
      {(d) =>
        d.adoptions.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-[13.5px] text-muted">
            None yet.{" "}
            {d.auto_adopt
              ? "When a content test ends with a clear winner, the CRM uses it as the standard email by itself."
              : ""}
          </p>
        ) : (
          <Table label="Adopted emails">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <Th>Email</Th>
                <Th>From the test</Th>
                <Th>Status</Th>
                <Th>Check</Th>
                {can("marketing") && <Th aria-label="Actions" />}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {d.adoptions.map((a) => (
                <tr key={a.id}>
                  <Td className="max-w-72">
                    <span className="font-medium text-ink">{a.variant_label}</span>
                    <p className="truncate text-[12.5px] text-muted">{a.subject}</p>
                  </Td>
                  <Td className="text-ink-2">
                    {a.test_name} {a.simulated && <SimulatedTag className="ml-1" />}
                  </Td>
                  <Td>
                    <Badge tone={a.status === "confirmed" ? "good" : a.status === "reverted" ? "neutral" : "info"}>
                      {a.status === "confirmed"
                        ? "Confirmed"
                        : a.status === "reverted"
                          ? "Switched back"
                          : "In use, being checked"}
                    </Badge>
                  </Td>
                  <Td className="max-w-80 text-[12.5px] text-muted">
                    {a.reason ??
                      `${pct(a.check_share)} of the audience still get the old email, to check the winner keeps winning.`}
                  </Td>
                  {can("marketing") && (
                    <Td>
                      {a.status === "active" && (
                        <Button
                          size="sm"
                          variant="ghost"
                          loading={revert.isPending && revert.variables === a.id}
                          onClick={() => revert.mutate(a.id)}
                        >
                          Switch back
                        </Button>
                      )}
                    </Td>
                  )}
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </Table>
        )
      }
    </QueryView>
  );
}

export default function AbTests() {
  const { can } = useSession();
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const tests = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["ab-tests"],
    queryFn: () => api.get<AbTestsResponse>("/ab-tests"),
    refetchInterval: 30_000,
  });
  const audiences = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["campaigns"],
    queryFn: () => api.get<{ audiences: string[] }>("/campaigns"),
    select: (d) => d.audiences,
  });
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="A/B tests"
        description="Compare two or three emails on a random split of an audience. Results come with a 95% interval and are corrected when several variants are compared."
        actions={
          can("marketing") ? (
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              icon={<Plus aria-hidden className="size-4" />}
              disabled={!tests.data || !audiences.data}
              onClick={() => setCreating(true)}
            >
              New A/B test
            </Button>
          ) : undefined
        }
      />
      {tests.isPending ? (
        <Loading label="Loading the tests" />
      ) : tests.isError ? (
        <LoadError error={tests.error} what="the tests" retry={() => void tests.refetch()} />
      ) : tests.data.ab_tests.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface px-4">
          <EmptyState icon={FlaskConical} title="No A/B tests yet">
            Test a new subject line, a coupon or a different message on part of an audience before sending it to
            everyone.
          </EmptyState>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <Table label="A/B tests">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <Th>Test</Th>
              <Th>Audience</Th>
              <Th>Measures</Th>
              <Th className="text-right">People</Th>
              <Th>Started</Th>
              <Th>Verdict</Th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {tests.data.ab_tests.map((t: AbTest) => (
              <tr key={t.id} className="hover:bg-sunken/60">
                <Td className="max-w-96">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <Link
                      to={`/ab-tests/${t.id}`}
                      className="font-medium text-ink hover:text-brand-ink hover:underline"
                    >
                      {t.name}
                    </Link>
                    {t.simulated && <SimulatedTag />}
                  </div>
                  <p className="truncate text-[12.5px] text-muted">
                    {t.variants.map((v) => v.label).join(" against ")}
                  </p>
                </Td>
                <Td className="text-ink-2">{t.tier}</Td>
                <Td className="text-ink-2">{t.metric === "purchase" ? "Buying" : "Clicks"}</Td>
                <Td className="num text-right">{t.state === "draft" ? "" : int(t.people)}</Td>
                <Td className="whitespace-nowrap text-muted">{t.started_at ? dateTime(t.started_at) : "Not sent"}</Td>
                <Td>
                  <VerdictBadge v={t.verdict} state={t.state} />
                </Td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </Table>
      )}
      <Section
        title="Winners in use"
        description={`A clear winner of a content test becomes the standard email. A small share of people keep getting the old one, so the CRM can switch back if the winner stops winning.`}
        className="mt-10"
      >
        <Adoptions />
      </Section>
      {tests.data && audiences.data && creating && (
        <NewTest audiences={audiences.data} settings={tests.data.settings} onClose={() => setCreating(false)} />
      )}
      {tests.data && (
        <p className="mt-6 text-[12.5px] text-muted">
          Purchases count for {plural(tests.data.window_days, "day")} after the email. Significance level{" "}
          {pct(tests.data.settings.alpha, 0)}, power {pct(tests.data.settings.power, 0)}.
        </p>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { dateTime, errorText } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Button, Field, Input, Notice, useToast } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router";
import { api, setToken } from "../api/client";
import { useMe } from "../app/session";
import { Facts, PageHeader, Panel, Section } from "../components/page";

function problem(pw: string): string | null {
  if (pw.length < 8) return "Use at least 8 characters.";
  if (!/[a-z]/i.test(pw) || !/\d/.test(pw)) return "Use letters and at least one digit.";
  return null;
}

export default function Account() {
  const me = useMe();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState("");
  const [next, setNext] = useState("");
  const [again, setAgain] = useState("");
  const [tried, setTried] = useState(false);

  const change = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      api.post<{ message: string; token: string }>("/me/password", { current_password: current, new_password: next }),
    onSuccess: async (r) => {
      // a new password signs out every other session; this one goes on with the new token
      setToken(r.token);
      setCurrent("");
      setNext("");
      setAgain("");
      setTried(false);
      toast({ tone: "good", text: "Password changed." });
      const first = me.must_change_password;
      await qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["me"] });
      if (first) navigate("/", { replace: true });
    },
  });

  const nextProblem = tried ? problem(next) : null;
  const againProblem = tried && again !== next ? "The two passwords are not the same." : null;

  const submit = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setTried(true);
    if (problem(next) || again !== next || !current) return;
    change.mutate();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title="Your account" description="Your details and your password." />
      {me.must_change_password && (
        <Notice tone="warn" title="Choose your own password to continue" className="mb-6 max-w-2xl">
          You signed in with a password someone else set. Choose a new one that only you know.
        </Notice>
      )}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 max-w-4xl gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_1.2fr]">
        <Section title="Details">
          <Facts
            items={[
              { label: "Name", value: me.name },
              { label: "Email address", value: me.email },
              { label: "Role", value: me.is_owner ? `${me.role_label} (owner)` : me.role_label },
              { label: "Gets new leads", value: me.takes_new_leads ? "Yes" : "No" },
              { label: "Last sign-in", value: dateTime(me.last_login_at, "Now") },
            ]}
          />
        </Section>
        <Section title="Change your password" description="At least 8 characters, with letters and a digit.">
          {me.env_password ? (
            <Notice tone="info">
              The owner account&apos;s password is set by CRM_OWNER_PASSWORD in backend/.env. Change it there and
              restart the backend.
            </Notice>
          ) : (
            <Panel>
              <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4" noValidate>
                {change.isError && <Notice tone="bad">{errorText(change.error)}</Notice>}
                <Field label="Current password">
                  <Input
                    type="password"
                    autoComplete="current-password"
                    value={current}
                    onChange={(e) => setCurrent(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </Field>
                <Field label="New password" error={nextProblem}>
                  <Input
                    type="password"
                    autoComplete="new-password"
                    value={next}
                    onChange={(e) => setNext(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </Field>
                <Field label="New password again" error={againProblem}>
                  <Input
                    type="password"
                    autoComplete="new-password"
                    value={again}
                    onChange={(e) => setAgain(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </Field>
                <div>
                  <Button
                    type="submit"
                    variant="primary"
                    loading={change.isPending}
                    disabled={!current || !next || !again}
                  >
                    Change password
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </form>
            </Panel>
          )}
        </Section>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
