import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { cn, dateTime, errorText, pct, plural, relative } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Badge, Button, Dialog, EmptyState, Field, Notice, Segmented, Textarea, useToast } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { ListChecks, MessageCircle, Phone } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Link, useSearchParams } from "react-router";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import { useCapacity } from "../api/queries";
import type { ActionRow, ActionsResponse } from "../api/types";
import { useMe } from "../app/session";
import { CapacityMeter } from "../components/capacity";
import { Person, Score } from "../components/lead-bits";
import { PageHeader } from "../components/page";
import { DecisionReceipt } from "../components/receipt";
import { Loading, LoadError } from "../components/state";
import { outcomeLabel } from "../lib/labels";

type Status = "open" | "closed";
type Owner = "me" | "unassigned" | "all";
type Segment = "all" | "real" | "simulated";

const REAL_OUTCOMES: Record<"call" | "whatsapp", { value: string; label: string }[]> = {
  call: [
    { value: "reached", label: "Spoke to them" },
    { value: "no_answer", label: "No answer" },
    { value: "not_interested", label: "Not interested" },
  ],
  whatsapp: [
    { value: "sent", label: "WhatsApp sent" },
    { value: "not_interested", label: "Not interested" },
  ],
};

function useInvalidate() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return () => {
    void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["actions"] });
    void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["stats"] });
    void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["capacity"] });
    void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["simulation"] });
  };
}

function RecordDialog({ task, onClose }: { task: ActionRow; onClose: () => void }) {
  const choices = REAL_OUTCOMES[task.task_type];
  const [outcome, setOutcome] = useState(choices[0].value);
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const toast = useToast();
  const invalidate = useInvalidate();
  const save = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      api.post<{ message: string; suggest_lost: boolean }>(`/actions/${task.id}/done`, { outcome, note: note || null }),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      toast({
        tone: "good",
        text: r.suggest_lost ? "Saved. If they will not buy, close the lead as lost on their page." : "Saved.",
      });
      invalidate();
      onClose();
    },
  });
  return (
    <Dialog
      open
      onClose={onClose}
      title={task.task_type === "call" ? `How did the call with ${task.name} go?` : `WhatsApp to ${task.name}`}
      description="The outcome goes on their timeline and teaches the model what this step does."
      footer={
        <>
          <Button onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button variant="primary" loading={save.isPending} onClick={() => save.mutate()}>
            Save outcome
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        {save.isError && <Notice tone="bad">{errorText(save.error)}</Notice>}
        <div>
          <p className="mb-1.5 text-[13px] font-medium text-ink">Outcome</p>
          <Segmented label="Outcome" value={outcome} onChange={setOutcome} options={choices} />
        </div>
        <Field label="Note" optional hint="Saved on the lead's page, for whoever talks to them next.">
          <Textarea rows={3} value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} />
        </Field>
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function TaskRow({ task }: { task: ActionRow }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [recording, setRecording] = useState(false);
  const toast = useToast();
  const invalidate = useInvalidate();
  const isCall = task.task_type === "call";
  const Icon = isCall ? Phone : MessageCircle;

  const simulate = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.post<{ message: string; outcome: string }>(`/actions/${task.id}/call`, {}),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      toast({ tone: r.outcome === "reached" || r.outcome === "sent" ? "good" : "info", text: r.message });
      invalidate();
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
  const skip = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.post(`/actions/${task.id}/done`, { outcome: "skipped" }),
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast({ tone: "info", text: "Skipped. Nothing was sent." });
      invalidate();
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
  const whatsapp = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.post<{ url: string }>("/whatsapp", { lead_id: task.lead_id, message: task.detail ?? "" }),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      window.open(r.url, "_blank", "noopener");
      setRecording(true);
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });

  const closed = task.status !== "open";
  return (
    <li className="border-b border-line last:border-b-0">
      <div className="flex gap-3 px-4 py-3.5">
        <span
          aria-hidden
          className={cn(
            "mt-0.5 flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full",
            closed ? "bg-sunken text-muted" : "bg-brand-soft text-brand-ink",
          )}
        >
          <Icon className="size-4" />
        </span>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-x-4 gap-y-1">
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-72">
              <p className="text-[14px] font-medium text-ink">{task.title}</p>
              <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-[12.5px] text-muted">
                <Person leadId={task.lead_id} name={task.name} simulated={task.simulated} />
                <Score score={task.lead_score} tier={task.recommended_action} />
                <span>{task.owner}</span>
                <span title={dateTime(task.created_at)}>Created {relative(task.created_at)}</span>
                {task.overdue && <Badge tone="warn">Overdue</Badge>}
                {task.policy === "explore" && (
                  <Badge variant="outline" title="A random step that helps the model learn">
                    Learning step
                  </Badge>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="sm:text-right">
              <p className="num text-[15px] font-semibold text-ink">{taskChance(task)}</p>
              <p className="text-[12px] text-muted">chance of buying, without → with this step</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {closed ? (
            <p className="mt-2 text-[13px] text-ink-2">
              <Badge tone={task.outcome === "reached" || task.outcome === "sent" ? "good" : "neutral"}>
                {outcomeLabel(task.outcome)}
              </Badge>
              <span className="ml-2 text-muted">
                {task.done_by ? `${task.done_by}, ` : ""}
                {dateTime(task.done_at)}
              </span>
            </p>
          ) : (
            <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              {task.simulated ? (
                <Button size="sm" variant="primary" loading={simulate.isPending} onClick={() => simulate.mutate()}>
                  {isCall ? "Call now" : "Send WhatsApp"}
                </Button>
              ) : isCall ? (
                <>
                  {task.phone && (
                    <a
                      href={`tel:${task.phone.replace(/\s+/g, "")}`}
                      className="num text-[13px] font-medium text-brand-ink hover:underline"
                    >
                      {task.phone}
                    </a>
                  )}
                  <Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => setRecording(true)}>
                    Record the call
                  </Button>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Button size="sm" variant="primary" loading={whatsapp.isPending} onClick={() => whatsapp.mutate()}>
                    Open WhatsApp
                  </Button>
                  <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setRecording(true)}>
                    Record outcome
                  </Button>
                </>
              )}
              <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" loading={skip.isPending} onClick={() => skip.mutate()}>
                Skip
              </Button>
              <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" aria-expanded={open} onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}>
                {open ? "Hide details" : "Script and receipt"}
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}

          {open && !closed && (
            <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_minmax(0,26rem)]">
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="mb-1.5 text-[12.5px] font-medium text-muted">{isCall ? "Call script" : "Message"}</p>
                <blockquote className="whitespace-pre-line rounded-md border border-line bg-sunken px-3.5 py-3 text-[13.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink">
                  {task.detail}
                </blockquote>
                {task.tips.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="mt-3">
                    <p className="mb-1.5 text-[12.5px] font-medium text-muted">What would raise their score</p>
                    <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-[13.5px]">
                      {task.tips.map((t) => (
                        <li key={t.title}>
                          <span className="text-ink">{t.title}</span>
                          <span className="text-muted"> ({t.detail})</span>
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              {task.options.length > 0 && (
                <DecisionReceipt
                  compact
                  options={task.options}
                  chosen={task.task_type}
                  modelBest={task.model_best}
                  policy={task.policy}
                  slotPrice={task.slot_price}
                  price={task.course_price}
                  meta={`Decided ${relative(task.created_at)}`}
                />
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      {recording && <RecordDialog task={task} onClose={() => setRecording(false)} />}
    </li>
  );
}

export default function Actions() {
  const me = useMe();
  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
  const status = (params.get("status") as Status) || "open";
  const owner = (params.get("owner") as Owner) || (me.role === "counsellor" ? "me" : "all");
  const segment = (params.get("segment") as Segment) || "all";
  const set = (k: string, v: string) =>
    setParams(
      (p) => {
        p.set(k, v);
        return p;
      },
      { replace: true },
    );

  const capacity = useCapacity(20_000);
  const list = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["actions", status, owner, segment],
    queryFn: () => api.get<ActionsResponse>("/actions", { status, owner, segment, limit: 300 }),
    refetchInterval: 20_000,
  });

  const rows = list.data?.actions ?? [];
  const open = rows.filter((r) => r.status === "open");
  const overdue = open.filter((r) => r.overdue).length;

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Today's actions"
        description="Calls and WhatsApp messages that next-best-action chose because they raise the chance of buying the most. The ones that help most come first."
      />
      {capacity.data && <CapacityMeter capacity={capacity.data} className="mb-6" />}
      {capacity.isError && (
        <LoadError error={capacity.error} what="the call slots" retry={() => void capacity.refetch()} />
      )}

      <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <Segmented
          label="Status"
          value={status}
          onChange={(v) => set("status", v)}
          options={[
            { value: "open", label: "To do" },
            { value: "closed", label: "Done" },
          ]}
        />
        <Segmented
          label="Whose leads"
          value={owner}
          onChange={(v) => set("owner", v)}
          options={[
            { value: "me", label: "Mine" },
            { value: "unassigned", label: "Unassigned" },
            { value: "all", label: "Everyone's" },
          ]}
        />
        <Segmented
          label="Learners"
          value={segment}
          onChange={(v) => set("segment", v)}
          options={[
            { value: "all", label: "All" },
            { value: "real", label: "Real people" },
            { value: "simulated", label: "Simulated" },
          ]}
        />
        {status === "open" && list.data && (
          <p className="ml-auto text-[13px] text-muted">
            {plural(open.length, "task")}
            {overdue > 0 && `, ${overdue} overdue`}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      {list.isPending ? (
        <Loading label="Loading the tasks" />
      ) : list.isError ? (
        <LoadError error={list.error} what="the tasks" retry={() => void list.refetch()} />
      ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface px-4">
          <EmptyState
            icon={ListChecks}
            title={status === "open" ? "Nothing to do right now" : "No finished tasks yet"}
            action={
              <Link to="/leads" className="text-[14px] font-medium text-brand-ink hover:underline">
                Look through the leads
              </Link>
            }
          >
            {status === "open"
              ? "Next-best-action adds a call or WhatsApp task when it is the most profitable step for a lead. New tasks appear here by themselves."
              : "Calls and messages the team has done appear here."}
            {list.data.other_segment_count > 0 &&
              ` ${plural(list.data.other_segment_count, "task")} in the other group of learners.`}
          </EmptyState>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ul className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface">
          {rows.map((t) => (
            <TaskRow key={t.id} task={t} />
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {list.data && list.data.expiry_days > 0 && status === "open" && rows.length > 0 && (
        <p className="mt-3 text-[12.5px] text-muted">
          A task is overdue after {plural(list.data.sla_hours, "hour")} and closes by itself after{" "}
          {plural(list.data.expiry_days, "day")}.
        </p>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

/** "8% → 14%": the chance of buying without a step and with this task's step, from its decision receipt. */
function taskChance(task: { task_type: string; options: { action: string; p_convert: number }[] }): string {
  const none = task.options.find((o) => o.action === "none");
  const step = task.options.find((o) => o.action === task.task_type);
  return none && step ? `${pct(none.p_convert)} → ${pct(step.p_convert)}` : "";
}

interface Draft {
  type: "email" | "ab_test";
  lead_id?: number;
  to?: string;
  subject?: string;
  body?: string;
  name?: string;
  tier?: string;
  metric?: "purchase" | "click";
  hypothesis?: string;
  control_share?: number;
  mde?: number;
  variants?: { label: string; subject: string; body: string; offer_pct: number }[];
}

interface Answer {
  question: string;
  intent: string;
  answer: string;
  tools: { name: string; about: string | null; source: string; read_at: string }[];
  drafts: Draft[];
  links: { type: "lead" | "page"; lead_id?: number; to?: string; label: string }[];
  used_gemini: boolean;
}

interface Info {
  suggestions: string[];
  tools: Record<string, string>;
  gemini: boolean;

}

function DraftCard({ d }: { d: Draft }) {
  const { can } = useSession();
  const toast = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const create = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      api.post<{ id: number }>("/ab-tests", {
        name: d.name,
        tier: d.tier,
        hypothesis: d.hypothesis,
        metric: d.metric,
        control_share: d.control_share,
        mde: d.mde,
        variants: d.variants,
      }),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["ab-tests"] });
      navigate(`/ab-tests/${r.id}`);
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
  if (d.type === "email") {
    return (
      <div className="mt-3 rounded-md border border-line bg-surface px-4 py-3">
        <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted">Draft email to {d.to}</p>
        <p className="mt-1 text-[14px] font-medium text-ink">{d.subject}</p>
        <p className="mt-1.5 whitespace-pre-line text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">{d.body}</p>
        {d.lead_id && (
          <Link to={`/leads/${d.lead_id}`} className={buttonClass("secondary", "sm", "mt-3")}>
            Open the lead to send it
          </Link>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="mt-3 rounded-md border border-line bg-surface px-4 py-3">
      <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted">Draft A/B test for {d.tier}</p>
      <p className="mt-1 text-[14px] font-medium text-ink">{d.name}</p>
      <ul className="mt-1.5 text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">
        {d.variants?.map((v, i) => (
          <li key={v.label}>
            {String.fromCharCode(65 + i)}: {v.label}, &ldquo;{v.subject}&rdquo;
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      {can("marketing") && (
        <Button size="sm" className="mt-3" loading={create.isPending} onClick={() => create.mutate()}>
          Save it as a draft test
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function Ask() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const [question, setQuestion] = useState("");
  const [thread, setThread] = useState<Answer[]>([]);
  const end = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const info = useQuery({ queryKey: ["copilot"], queryFn: () => api.get<Info>("/copilot") });
  const ask = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (q: string) => api.post<Answer>("/copilot", { question: q }),
    onSuccess: (a) => {
      setThread((t) => [...t, a]);
      setQuestion("");
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["copilot"] });
    },
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    end.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "end" });
  }, [thread.length]);

  const submit = (e?: FormEvent, q = question) => {
    e?.preventDefault();
    const s = q.trim();
    if (s && !ask.isPending) ask.mutate(s);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Ask the CRM"
        description={
          info.data?.gemini
            ? "Ask about the live data in plain words. Every number comes from the database; Gemini only phrases the answer."
            : "Ask about the live data in plain words. Answers are built from the database by fixed rules, so every number can be checked."
        }
      />
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_18rem]">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          {thread.length === 0 && info.data && (
            <div className="mb-6">
              <p className="mb-2 text-[13px] text-muted">Try one of these</p>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {info.data.suggestions.map((s) => (
                  <button
                    key={s}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => submit(undefined, s)}
                    className="rounded-full border border-line-strong bg-surface px-3 py-1.5 text-[13px] text-ink-2 hover:border-brand hover:text-ink"
                  >
                    {s}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          <ol className="flex flex-col gap-6" aria-live="polite">
            {thread.map((a, i) => (
              <li key={i}>
                <p className="ml-auto w-fit max-w-[85%] rounded-lg bg-brand-soft px-3.5 py-2 text-[14px] text-ink">
                  {a.question}
                </p>
                <div className="mt-3 max-w-[72ch]">
                  <p className="whitespace-pre-line text-[14px] leading-relaxed text-ink">{a.answer}</p>
                  {a.links.length > 0 && (

                          key={l.label}

                    Read from {a.tools.map((t) => t.source).join(", ")} at {time(a.tools[0]?.read_at)}
                    {a.used_gemini ? ". Phrased by Gemini." : "."}
                  </p>

function DoneDialog({ cb, onClose }: { cb: CallbackRow; onClose: () => void }) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const done = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.post(`/callbacks/${cb.id}/done`, { note: note || null }),
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast({ tone: "good", text: "Marked as done." });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["callbacks"] });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["stats"] });
      onClose();
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
  return (
    <Dialog
      open
      onClose={onClose}
      title={`Call-back to ${cb.name ?? "this learner"} done`}
      description="The note goes on their page for whoever talks to them next."
      footer={
        <>
          <Button onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button variant="primary" loading={done.isPending} onClick={() => done.mutate()}>
            Mark as done
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <Field label="What was said" optional>
        <Textarea rows={4} value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} />
      </Field>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

                <span className="text-[12.5px] text-muted" title={dateTime(cb.created_at)}>
                  Asked {relative(cb.created_at)}
                </span>
                {cb.status === "open" ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    {cb.overdue && <Badge tone="warn">Overdue</Badge>}
                    <Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => setClosing(cb)}>
                      Mark as done
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <Badge tone="good">Done{cb.done_by ? ` by ${cb.done_by}` : ""}</Badge>
                )}
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {closing && <DoneDialog cb={closing} onClose={() => setClosing(null)} />}
    </>
  );
}

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { dateTime, errorText, int, pct, plural, points } from "@xedu/shared/lib";

function localNow(minutesAhead = 0): string {
  const d = new Date(Date.now() + minutesAhead * 60_000);
  const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}T${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`;
}

function NewCampaign({ audiences, holdout, onClose }: { audiences: string[]; holdout: number; onClose: () => void }) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [tier, setTier] = useState(audiences[0] ?? "All leads");
  const [subject, setSubject] = useState("");
  const [body, setBody] = useState("Hi {first_name},\n\n");
  const [when, setWhen] = useState<"now" | "later">("later");
  const [at, setAt] = useState(() => localNow(60));
  const [share, setShare] = useState(String(holdout));
  const reach = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["ab-plan", tier, "reach"],
    queryFn: () => api.get<AbPlan>("/ab-tests/plan", { tier, variants: 1, metric: "purchase", control_share: 0 }),
  });
  const create = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      const r = await api.post<{ id: number; message: string }>("/campaigns", {
        name,
        tier,
        subject,
        body,
        scheduled_at: when === "now" ? localNow() : at,
        holdout_share: Number(share),
      });
      if (when === "now") return api.post<{ message: string }>(`/campaigns/${r.id}/send-now`);
      return r;
    },
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      toast({ tone: "good", text: r.message });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["campaigns"] });
      onClose();
    },
  });
  const ready = name.trim() && subject.trim() && body.trim() && (when === "now" || at);
  return (
    <Dialog
      open
      size="lg"
      onClose={onClose}
      title="New campaign"
      description="One email to everyone in an audience who accepts email. A random hold-out group gets nothing, so the campaign's real effect can be measured."
      footer={
        <>
          <Button onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button variant="primary" loading={create.isPending} disabled={!ready} onClick={() => create.mutate()}>
            {when === "now" ? "Send now" : "Schedule"}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <div className="grid gap-4">
        {create.isError && <Notice tone="bad">{errorText(create.error)}</Notice>}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Field label="Name" hint="Only the team sees it.">
            <Input value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} maxLength={200} />
          </Field>
          <Field
            label="Audience"
            hint={reach.data ? `${plural(reach.data.audience, "person", "people")} would get it now.` : " "}
          >
            <Select
              value={tier}
              onChange={(e) => setTier(e.target.value)}
              options={audiences.map((a) => ({ value: a, label: a }))}
            />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <Field label="Subject">
          <Input value={subject} onChange={(e) => setSubject(e.target.value)} maxLength={300} />
        </Field>
        <Field
          label="Message"
          hint="{first_name} and {course} are filled in for each person. An unsubscribe link is added."
        >
          <Textarea rows={8} value={body} onChange={(e) => setBody(e.target.value)} />
        </Field>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 items-end gap-4 sm:grid-cols-[auto_1fr_auto]">
          <div>
            <p className="mb-1.5 text-[13px] font-medium text-ink">When</p>
            <Segmented
              label="When"
              value={when}
              onChange={setWhen}
              options={[
                { value: "later", label: "Schedule" },
                { value: "now", label: "Send now" },
              ]}
            />
          </div>
          {when === "later" ? (
            <Field label="Date and time">
              <Input type="datetime-local" value={at} onChange={(e) => setAt(e.target.value)} />
            </Field>
          ) : (
            <span />
          )}
          <Field label="Hold-out group">
            <Select
              value={share}
              onChange={(e) => setShare(e.target.value)}
              options={[0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2].map((v) => ({
                value: String(v),
                label: v ? `${v * 100}% get nothing` : "No hold-out",
              }))}
            />
          </Field>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function Effect({ c }: { c: Campaign }) {
  if (!c.incremental) return <span className="text-muted">{c.sent ? "No hold-out" : ""}</span>;
  const { lift, ci, final } = c.incremental;
  return (
    <div className="text-right">
      <p className="num font-medium text-ink">{points(lift)}</p>
      <p className="num text-[12px] text-muted">
        {points(ci[0])} to {points(ci[1])}
        {final ? "" : ", still counting"}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

function Status({ c }: { c: Campaign }) {
  if (c.sent) return <Badge tone="good">Sent {dateTime(c.sent_at)}</Badge>;
  if (c.status === "failed")
    return (
      <Badge tone="bad" title={c.error ?? undefined}>
        Failed
      </Badge>
    );
  if (c.status === "draft" || !c.scheduled_at) return <Badge>Draft</Badge>;
  return <Badge tone="info">Scheduled {dateTime(c.scheduled_at)}</Badge>;
}

    onSuccess: (r) => {

      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["campaigns"] });
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
  const marketing = can("marketing");

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader

        actions={

              onClick={() => setCreating(true)}

            >
              New campaign

          ) : undefined
        }
      />
      {list.isPending ? (
        <Loading label="Loading the campaigns" />
      ) : list.isError ? (
        <LoadError error={list.error} what="the campaigns" retry={() => void list.refetch()} />
      ) : list.data.campaigns.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface px-4">
          <EmptyState icon={Send} title="No campaigns yet">
            Create a campaign to email an audience, such as everyone in the Nurture tier.
          </EmptyState>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <Table label="Campaigns">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <Th>Campaign</Th>
                <Th>Audience</Th>
                <Th>Status</Th>
                <Th className="text-right">Emails</Th>
                <Th className="text-right">Clicked</Th>
                <Th className="text-right">Bought</Th>
                <Th
                  className="text-right"
                  title="Share who bought among those emailed, minus the share among the hold-out group"
                >
                  Effect on buying
                </Th>
                {marketing && <Th aria-label="Actions" />}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {list.data.campaigns.map((c) => (
                <tr key={c.id}>
                  <Td className="max-w-80">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="font-medium text-ink">{c.name}</span>
                      {c.simulated && <SimulatedTag />}
                    </div>
                    <p className="truncate text-[12.5px] text-muted">{c.subject}</p>
                  </Td>
                  <Td className="text-ink-2">{c.tier}</Td>
                  <Td>
                    <Status c={c} />
                  </Td>
                  <Td className="num text-right">
                    {c.sent ? int(c.delivered) : c.audience_now !== null ? `${int(c.audience_now)} now` : ""}

                    {c.sent && c.failed > 0 ? (

                        {int(c.failed)} not sent

                    ) : null}

                  <Td className="num text-right">

import { keepPreviousData, useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { dateTime, errorText, int, parseTime, plural } from "@xedu/shared/lib";

  Badge,

} from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { Plus, TicketPercent } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import type { Coupon, LeadRow, LeadsResponse } from "../api/types";
import { useSession } from "../app/session";
import { PageHeader } from "../components/page";
import { Loading, LoadError } from "../components/state";

const LIMIT = 50;

/** One page of coupons, newest first; `total` counts the ones the filter shows, `all` and `used` every coupon. */
interface CouponList {
  coupons: Coupon[];
  total: number;
  all: number;
  used: number;
}

interface CouponCheck {
  verdict: "pays" | "costs" | "over_budget" | "control" | "customer" | "has_coupon";
  allowed: boolean;
  message: string;
  note?: string | null;
  expected_discount?: number;
  extra_profit?: number;
}

function NewCoupon({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  const [person, setPerson] = useState<LeadRow | null>(null);
  const [discount, setDiscount] = useState("10");
  const [hours, setHours] = useState("72");
  const found = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["leads", "coupon-search", q],
    queryFn: () => api.get<LeadsResponse>("/leads", { search: q, limit: 6 }),
    enabled: q.trim().length >= 2 && !person,
  });
  // the coupon guard: what this coupon would do for this person, before anyone gives it
  const guard = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["coupon-check", person?.user_id, discount],
    queryFn: () =>
      api.get<CouponCheck>("/coupons/check", { user_id: person?.user_id ?? 0, discount_pct: Number(discount) }),
    enabled: !!person,
  });
  const verdict = guard.data?.verdict;
  const override = verdict === "costs" || verdict === "over_budget";
  const create = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      api.post<{ coupon_code: string; message?: string }>("/coupons", {
        user_id: person?.user_id,
        tier: person?.recommended_action ?? "",
        discount_pct: Number(discount),
        expires_hours: Number(hours),
        override,
      }),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      toast({ tone: "good", text: `Coupon ${r.coupon_code} given to ${person?.name}.` });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["coupons"] });
      onClose();
    },
  });
  return (
    <Dialog
      open
      onClose={onClose}
      title="Give a personal coupon"
      description="The code works only for this person, until it expires. They see it in their account and at checkout."
      footer={
        <>
          <Button onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button
            variant={override ? "danger" : "primary"}
            loading={create.isPending}
            disabled={!person || verdict === "control" || verdict === "has_coupon" || guard.isPending}
            onClick={() => create.mutate()}
          >
            {override ? "Give it anyway" : "Give the coupon"}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <div className="grid gap-4">
        {create.isError && <Notice tone="bad">{errorText(create.error)}</Notice>}
        {person && guard.data && (
          <Notice
            tone={
              verdict === "pays" || verdict === "customer"
                ? "good"
                : verdict === "control" || verdict === "has_coupon"
                  ? "bad"
                  : "warn"
            }
            title={
              verdict === "pays"
                ? "This coupon pays for itself"
                : verdict === "costs"
                  ? "This coupon would mostly give money away"
                  : verdict === "over_budget"
                    ? "Over this month's discount budget"
                    : verdict === "control"
                      ? "Not for the control group"
                      : verdict === "has_coupon"
                        ? "Already has an open coupon"
                        : undefined
            }
          >
            {guard.data.message}
            {guard.data.note ? ` ${guard.data.note}` : ""}
          </Notice>
        )}
        {person ? (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-md border border-line bg-sunken px-3 py-2">
            <div>
              <p className="text-[14px] font-medium text-ink">{person.name}</p>
              <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted">{person.email}</p>
            </div>
            <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setPerson(null)}>
              Change
            </Button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <Field label="Who gets it" hint="Type at least two letters of their name or email.">
            <Input value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} autoFocus />
          </Field>
        )}
        {!person && found.data && (
          <ul className="rounded-md border border-line">
            {found.data.leads.length === 0 ? (
              <li className="px-3 py-2 text-[13px] text-muted">No one matches.</li>
            ) : (
              found.data.leads.map((l) => (
                <li key={l.id}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="flex w-full items-baseline gap-3 px-3 py-2 text-left hover:bg-sunken"
                    onClick={() => setPerson(l)}
                  >
                    <span className="text-[13.5px] text-ink">{l.name}</span>
                    <span className="truncate text-[12.5px] text-muted">{l.email}</span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))
            )}
          </ul>
        )}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Field label="Discount">
            <Select
              value={discount}
              onChange={(e) => setDiscount(e.target.value)}
              options={[5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30].map((n) => ({ value: String(n), label: `${n}% off` }))}
            />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Valid for">
            <Select
              value={hours}
              onChange={(e) => setHours(e.target.value)}
              options={[
                { value: "24", label: "1 day" },
                { value: "72", label: "3 days" },
                { value: "168", label: "7 days" },
                { value: "336", label: "14 days" },
              ]}
            />
          </Field>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function state(c: Coupon): { label: string; tone: "good" | "neutral" | "info" } {
  if (c.used) return { label: `Used ${dateTime(c.used_at)}`, tone: "good" };
  const exp = parseTime(c.expires_at);
  if (exp && exp.getTime() < Date.now()) return { label: "Expired", tone: "neutral" };
  return { label: `Valid until ${dateTime(c.expires_at)}`, tone: "info" };
}

export default function Coupons() {
  const { can } = useSession();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [show, setShow] = useState<"all" | "used" | "open">("all");
  const [offset, setOffset] = useState(0);
  const list = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["coupons", show, offset],
    queryFn: () => api.get<CouponList>("/coupons", { show, limit: LIMIT, offset }),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
    refetchInterval: 60_000,
  });
  const rows = list.data?.coupons ?? [];
  const total = list.data?.total ?? 0;
  const withdraw = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: number) => api.del<{ message: string }>(`/coupons/${id}`),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      toast({ tone: "good", text: r.message ?? "Coupon withdrawn." });
      // the last coupon on a later page was withdrawn: go back one page instead of showing an empty one
      if (offset > 0 && rows.length === 1) setOffset(Math.max(0, offset - LIMIT));
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["coupons"] });
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Coupons"
        description="Every personal coupon the CRM or the team gave out, and whether it was used."
        actions={
          can("marketing") ? (
            <Button variant="primary" icon={<Plus aria-hidden className="size-4" />} onClick={() => setCreating(true)}>
              Give a coupon
            </Button>
          ) : undefined
        }
      />
      <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <Segmented
          label="Show"
          value={show}
          onChange={(v) => {
            setShow(v);
            setOffset(0);
          }}
          options={[
            { value: "all", label: "All" },
            { value: "open", label: "Not used" },
            { value: "used", label: "Used" },
          ]}
        />
        {list.data && (
          <p className="ml-auto text-[13px] text-muted">
            {plural(list.data.all, "coupon")}, {int(list.data.used)} used
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
      {list.isPending ? (
        <Loading label="Loading the coupons" />
      ) : list.isError ? (
        <LoadError error={list.error} what="the coupons" retry={() => void list.refetch()} />
      ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface px-4">
          {total > 0 ? (
            <EmptyState icon={TicketPercent} title="Nothing on this page any more">
              Coupons were withdrawn while it was open.{" "}
              <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setOffset(0)}>
                Go to the first page
              </Button>
            </EmptyState>
          ) : (
            <EmptyState icon={TicketPercent} title="No coupons here">
              Next-best-action gives a coupon when a discount adds more profit than it costs.
            </EmptyState>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <Table label="Coupons">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <Th>Code</Th>
                <Th>Person</Th>
                <Th className="text-right">Discount</Th>
                <Th>Status</Th>
                <Th>Given</Th>
                {can("marketing") && <Th aria-label="Actions" />}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {rows.map((c) => {
                const s = state(c);
                return (
                  <tr key={c.id}>
                    <Td className="num font-medium text-ink">{c.coupon_code}</Td>
                    <Td>
                      <span className="text-ink">{c.name}</span>
                      <span className="block text-[12.5px] text-muted">{c.email}</span>
                    </Td>
                    <Td className="num text-right">{c.discount_pct}%</Td>
                    <Td>
                      <Badge tone={s.tone}>{s.label}</Badge>
                    </Td>
                    <Td className="whitespace-nowrap text-muted">{dateTime(c.created_at)}</Td>
                    {can("marketing") && (
                      <Td className="text-right">
                        {!c.used && (
                          <Button
                            size="sm"
                            variant="ghost"
                            loading={withdraw.isPending && withdraw.variables === c.id}
                            onClick={() => withdraw.mutate(c.id)}
                          >
                            Withdraw
                          </Button>
                        )}
                      </Td>
                    )}
                  </tr>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </Table>
          <div className="mt-3">
            <Pager offset={offset} limit={LIMIT} total={total} onChange={setOffset} />
          </div>
        </>
      )}
      <p className="mt-4 text-[12.5px] text-muted">
        Coupons from A/B tests carry the test&apos;s code. See{" "}
        <Link to="/ab-tests" className="text-brand-ink hover:underline">
          A/B tests
        </Link>{" "}
        for whether a discount paid for itself.
      </p>
      {creating && <NewCoupon onClose={() => setCreating(false)} />}
    </>
  );
}

import { keepPreviousData, useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { int, pct, points, useChartColors } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Segmented, Select, Table, Td, Th } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { useState } from "react";
import { ResponsiveContainer, Sankey, Tooltip, type TooltipContentProps } from "recharts";
import type { LinkProps, NodeProps } from "recharts/types/chart/Sankey";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import { PageHeader, Panel, Section } from "../components/page";
import { QueryView } from "../components/state";
import { STAGE_LABEL, TIERS } from "../lib/labels";

interface MapNode {
  name: string;
  layer: "stage" | "group" | "reaction" | "outcome";
}

interface MapLink {
  source: number;
  target: number;
  value: number;
  conversion: number;
}

interface JourneyData {
  days: number;
  decisions: number;
  with_outcome: number;
  sankey: { nodes: MapNode[]; links: MapLink[] };
  funnel: { stages: { stage: string; people: number }[]; signed_up: number };
  dropoffs: { from: string; to: string; lost: number; lost_share: number }[];
  top_paths: {
    stage: string;
    action: string;
    action_label: string;
    reaction: string;
    reaction_label: string;
    n: number;
    conversion: number;
    conversion_weighted: number;
  }[];
  action_effects: {
    stage: string;
    action: string;
    label: string;
    n: number;
    rate: number;
    nothing_rate: number;
    lift: number;
  }[];
}

function Funnel({ f }: { f: JourneyData["funnel"] }) {
  const c = useChartColors();
  const max = Math.max(...f.stages.map((s) => s.people), 1);
  return (
    <Panel>
      <ol className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        {f.stages.map((s, i) => {
          const prev = i > 0 ? f.stages[i - 1].people : null;
          return (
            <li
              key={s.stage}
              className="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,10rem)_minmax(0,1fr)_7rem] items-center gap-4 text-[13.5px]"
            >
              <span className="text-ink">{STAGE_LABEL[s.stage] ?? s.stage}</span>
              <span aria-hidden className="h-5 overflow-hidden rounded-xs" style={{ background: c.grid }}>
                <span
                  className="block h-full rounded-xs"
                  style={{ width: `${(100 * s.people) / max}%`, background: c.series[0] }}
                />
              </span>
              <span className="text-right">
                <span className="num font-medium text-ink">{int(s.people)}</span>
                <span className="num block text-[12px] text-muted">
                  {i === 0
                    ? s.people
                      ? "everyone who signed up"
                      : ""
                    : prev
                      ? `${pct(s.people / prev)} of the stage before`
                      : ""}
                </span>
              </span>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
    </Panel>
  );
}

const LAYERS: { layer: MapNode["layer"]; label: string }[] = [
  { layer: "stage", label: "Stage" },
  { layer: "group", label: "Step the CRM took" },
  { layer: "reaction", label: "Reaction within 3 days" },
  { layer: "outcome", label: "In the end" },
];

const STEP_GROUP_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  Nothing: "No step",
  Email: "Email",
  Coupon: "Coupon email",
  Call: "Call",
  WhatsApp: "WhatsApp",
};

function nodeLabel(n: MapNode): string {
  if (n.layer === "stage") return STAGE_LABEL[n.name] ?? n.name;
  if (n.layer === "group") return STEP_GROUP_LABEL[n.name] ?? n.name;
  if (n.layer === "outcome") return n.name === "Bought" ? "Bought" : "Not bought yet";
  return n.name === "Bought" ? "Bought within 3 days" : n.name;
}

/** The journey map: stage, the step the CRM took, the reaction and the outcome, with a table of the same flows. */
function JourneyMap({ map }: { map: JourneyData["sankey"] }) {
  const c = useChartColors();
  const [view, setView] = useState<"map" | "table">("map");
  const lastLayer = map.nodes.reduce(
    (m, n) =>
      Math.max(
        m,
        LAYERS.findIndex((l) => l.layer === n.layer),
      ),
    0,
  );
  const flows = map.links.map((l) => ({ ...l, from: map.nodes[l.source], to: map.nodes[l.target] }));
  const MapNodeShape = ({ x, y, width, height, payload }: NodeProps) => {
    const node = payload as unknown as MapNode & { value: number; depth: number };
    const end = node.depth >= lastLayer;
    const tx = end ? x - 8 : x + width + 8;
    return (
      <g>
        <rect x={x} y={y} width={width} height={Math.max(height, 1)} rx={2} fill={c.brand} />
        {/* a halo in the surface colour keeps the label readable where it crosses the bands */}
        <text
          x={tx}
          y={y + height / 2}
          dy="0.35em"
          textAnchor={end ? "end" : "start"}
          fontSize={12}
          fill={c.ink}
          stroke={c.surface}
          strokeWidth={4}
          strokeLinejoin="round"
          paintOrder="stroke"
        >
          {nodeLabel(node)}
          <tspan fill={c.text}> {int(node.value)}</tspan>
        </text>
      </g>
    );
  };
  const MapLinkShape = (p: LinkProps) => {
    const conv = (p.payload as unknown as { conversion?: number }).conversion ?? 0;
    return (
      <path
        d={`M${p.sourceX},${p.sourceY}C${p.sourceControlX},${p.sourceY} ${p.targetControlX},${p.targetY} ${p.targetX},${p.targetY}`}
        fill="none"
        stroke={c.series[0]}
        strokeOpacity={0.14 + 0.62 * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, conv))}
        strokeWidth={Math.max(1, p.linkWidth)}
      />
    );
  };
  const tip = ({ active, payload }: Partial<TooltipContentProps<number, string>>) => {
    const item = payload?.[0]?.payload as
      { source?: MapNode & { value: number }; target?: MapNode; value?: number; payload?: unknown } | undefined;
    if (!active || !item) return null;
    const link = (item.payload ?? item) as { source?: MapNode; target?: MapNode; value?: number; conversion?: number };
    return (
      <div className="min-w-48 rounded-sm border border-line bg-raised px-3 py-2 text-[12.5px] shadow-overlay">
        {link.source && link.target ? (
          <>
            <p className="font-medium text-ink">
              {nodeLabel(link.source)} to {nodeLabel(link.target)}
            </p>
            <p className="mt-0.5 flex text-ink-2">
              Decisions<span className="num ml-auto pl-4 font-medium text-ink">{int(link.value)}</span>
            </p>
            <p className="flex text-ink-2">
              Bought in the end<span className="num ml-auto pl-4 font-medium text-ink">{pct(link.conversion, 1)}</span>
            </p>
          </>
        ) : (
          <p className="font-medium text-ink">
            {nodeLabel(item as unknown as MapNode)}: {int((item as { value?: number }).value)}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  };
  return (
    <figure className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface">
      <figcaption className="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-3 px-4 pt-3">
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <p className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink">Journey map</p>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-[12.5px] text-muted">
            The width of a band is how many decisions took that path; the darker it is, the more of them bought in the
            end.
          </p>
        </div>
        <Segmented
          size="sm"
          label="Journey map: show as"
          value={view}
          onChange={setView}
          options={[
            { value: "map", label: "Map" },
            { value: "table", label: "Table" },
          ]}
        />
      </figcaption>
      {view === "map" ? (
        <div className="overflow-x-auto px-2 pb-3 pt-3">
          <div className="min-w-[680px]">
            {/* column names over the node columns, which sit at equal steps across the drawing */}
            <div className="relative mx-2 h-5 text-[12px] font-medium text-muted">
              {LAYERS.slice(0, lastLayer + 1).map((l, i) => (
                <span
                  key={l.layer}
                  className="absolute top-0 whitespace-nowrap"
                  style={
                    i === lastLayer && lastLayer > 0
                      ? { right: 0 }
                      : { left: lastLayer > 0 ? `${(100 * i) / lastLayer}%` : 0 }
                  }
                >
                  {l.label}
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div style={{ height: 420 }}>
              <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                <Sankey
                  data={map}
                  node={MapNodeShape}
                  link={MapLinkShape}
                  nodeWidth={10}
                  nodePadding={22}
                  margin={{ top: 10, right: 8, bottom: 10, left: 8 }}
                  iterations={64}
                >
                  <Tooltip content={(p) => tip(p as Partial<TooltipContentProps<number, string>>)} />
                </Sankey>
              </ResponsiveContainer>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="max-h-96 overflow-auto px-4 pb-3 pt-2">
          <table className="w-full border-collapse text-[13px]" aria-label="Journey map as a table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                {["From", "To", "Decisions", "Bought in the end"].map((h, i) => (
                  <th
                    key={h}
                    scope="col"
                    className={`sticky top-0 border-b border-line bg-surface py-1.5 font-medium text-muted ${i > 1 ? "pl-3 text-right" : "pr-3 text-left"}`}
                  >
                    {h}
                  </th>
                ))}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {flows.map((f, i) => (
                <tr key={i}>
                  <td className="border-b border-line py-1.5 pr-3 text-ink-2">{nodeLabel(f.from)}</td>
                  <td className="border-b border-line py-1.5 pr-3 text-ink">{nodeLabel(f.to)}</td>
                  <td className="num border-b border-line py-1.5 pl-3 text-right text-ink">{int(f.value)}</td>
                  <td className="num border-b border-line py-1.5 pl-3 text-right text-ink">{pct(f.conversion, 1)}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}
    </figure>
  );
}

import { Badge, Button, buttonClass, EmptyState, Tabs, useToast } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { ChevronLeft, UserX } from "lucide-react";
import { Link, useParams, useSearchParams } from "react-router";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import type { LeadPage, PathsResponse } from "../api/types";
import { Score, SimulatedTag } from "../components/lead-bits";
import { Loading, LoadError } from "../components/state";
import { Activity } from "./lead/Activity";
import { Decisions } from "./lead/Decisions";
import { Messages } from "./lead/Messages";
import { NextStep } from "./lead/NextStep";
import { Notes } from "./lead/Notes";
import { SidePanel } from "./lead/SidePanel";

type Tab = "next" | "activity" | "decisions" | "messages" | "notes";
const TABS: Tab[] = ["next", "activity", "decisions", "messages", "notes"];

export default function LeadDetail() {
  const { leadId } = useParams();
  const id = Number(leadId);
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  // the open section is part of the address (?tab=decisions), so it can be linked to and survives a reload
  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
  const asked = params.get("tab") as Tab | null;
  const tab: Tab = asked && TABS.includes(asked) ? asked : "next";
  const setTab = (t: Tab) => setParams(t === "next" ? {} : { tab: t }, { replace: true });
  const lead = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["lead", id],
    queryFn: () => api.get<LeadPage>(`/leads/${id}`),
    refetchInterval: 15_000,
    enabled: Number.isFinite(id),
  });
  // the stage comes with the what-if paths (cached, shared with the Next step tab)
  const paths = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["lead", id, "paths"],
    queryFn: () => api.get<PathsResponse>(`/leads/${id}/paths`),
    enabled: Number.isFinite(id) && Boolean(lead.data && !lead.data.customer),
    refetchInterval: 60_000,
  });
  const rescore = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.post<{ lead_score: number; tier: string }>(`/leads/${id}/rescore`),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      toast({ tone: "good", text: `Scored again: ${Math.round(r.lead_score)}, ${r.tier}.` });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["lead", id] });
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });

  if (lead.isPending) return <Loading label="Loading the lead" />;
  if (lead.isError) {
    if (lead.error instanceof ApiError && lead.error.status === 404) {
      return (
        <EmptyState
          icon={UserX}
          title="This lead does not exist"
          action={
            <Link to="/leads" className={buttonClass("secondary")}>
              Back to the leads
            </Link>
          }
        >
          It may have been deleted when the person deleted their account.
        </EmptyState>
      );
    }
    return <LoadError error={lead.error} what="the lead" retry={() => void lead.refetch()} />;
  }
  const l = lead.data;
  const stage = l.customer ? "Customer" : l.status.lost ? "Lost" : paths.data?.lead.stage_label;

  return (
    <>
      <Link to="/leads" className="mb-3 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[13px] text-muted hover:text-ink">
        <ChevronLeft aria-hidden className="size-4" />
        Leads
      </Link>
      <header className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-start gap-x-8 gap-y-4">
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-96">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <h1 className="text-[22px] font-semibold leading-tight text-ink">{l.name}</h1>
            {l.customer && <Badge tone="good">Customer</Badge>}
            {l.status.lost && <Badge>Lost</Badge>}
            {l.global_control && <Badge tone="info">Control group</Badge>}
            {l.simulated && <SimulatedTag />}
          </div>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[13.5px] text-muted">
            {l.email}
            {l.phone ? `, ${l.phone}` : ""}
            {l.course_type && l.course_type !== "Unknown" ? `. Interested in ${l.course_type}` : ""}
            {stage ? `. ${stage}` : ""}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-6">
          <div>
            <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted">Lead score</p>
            <Score score={l.lead_score} tier={l.customer ? null : l.recommended_action} large />
          </div>
          {!l.customer && (
            <div>
              <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted">Chance of buying</p>
              <p className="num text-[20px] font-semibold text-ink">{pct(l.conversion_probability)}</p>
            </div>
          )}
          <Button size="sm" loading={rescore.isPending} onClick={() => rescore.mutate()}>
            Score again
          </Button>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_20rem]">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <Tabs<Tab>
            label="Lead sections"
            value={tab}
            onChange={setTab}
            className="mb-5"
            tabs={[
              { id: "next", label: "Next step" },
              { id: "activity", label: "Activity" },
              { id: "decisions", label: "Decisions", count: l.decisions.length },
              { id: "messages", label: "Messages" },
              { id: "notes", label: "Notes", count: l.notes.length },
            ]}
          />
          <div role="tabpanel" aria-label={tab}>
            {tab === "next" && <NextStep lead={l} />}
            {tab === "activity" && <Activity lead={l} />}
            {tab === "decisions" && <Decisions decisions={l.decisions} />}
            {tab === "messages" && <Messages lead={l} />}
            {tab === "notes" && <Notes lead={l} />}
          </div>
        </div>
        <SidePanel lead={l} stage={stage} />
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

import { keepPreviousData, useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { errorText, int, money, plural, relative } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Button, EmptyState, Pager, Segmented, Select, Table, Td, Th, useToast } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { Download, Users, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import type { LeadsResponse } from "../api/types";
import { useMe, useSession } from "../app/session";
import { Person, Score } from "../components/lead-bits";
import { PageHeader } from "../components/page";
import { Loading, LoadError } from "../components/state";
import { actionLabel, TIERS } from "../lib/labels";

const LIMIT = 50;

export default function Leads() {
  const me = useMe();
  const { can } = useSession();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
  const search = params.get("search") ?? "";
  const tier = params.get("tier") ?? "";
  const segment = params.get("segment") ?? "all";
  const owner = params.get("owner") ?? "all";
  const sort = params.get("sort") ?? "";
  const offset = Number(params.get("offset") ?? 0) || 0;
  const [exporting, setExporting] = useState(false);

  const set = (changes: Record<string, string | null>) =>
    setParams(
      (p) => {
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(changes)) {
          if (v === null || v === "") p.delete(k);
          else p.set(k, v);
        }
        if (!("offset" in changes)) p.delete("offset");
        return p;
      },
      { replace: true },
    );

  const leads = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["leads", { search, tier, segment, owner, sort, offset }],
    queryFn: () => api.get<LeadsResponse>("/leads", { search, tier, segment, owner, sort, offset, limit: LIMIT }),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
    refetchInterval: 30_000,
  });

  const exportCsv = async () => {
    setExporting(true);
    try {
      await api.download("/leads/export.csv", "leads.csv");
    } catch (e) {
      toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) });
    } finally {
      setExporting(false);
    }
  };

  const counts = leads.data?.counts;
  const ownerOptions = [
    { value: "all", label: "Everyone's leads" },
    { value: "me", label: `Mine${counts ? ` (${int(counts.mine)})` : ""}` },
    { value: "unassigned", label: `Unassigned${counts ? ` (${int(counts.unassigned)})` : ""}` },
    ...me.team.filter((m) => m.id !== me.id && m.active).map((m) => ({ value: String(m.id), label: m.name })),
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Leads"
        description="Everyone who signed up, one row per person, with their current score and the step the CRM would take next."
        actions={
          can("marketing") ? (
            <Button
              icon={<Download aria-hidden className="size-4" />}
              loading={exporting}
              onClick={() => void exportCsv()}
            >
              Export CSV
            </Button>
          ) : undefined
        }
      />

      <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
        <Segmented
          label="Learners"
          value={segment}
          onChange={(v) => set({ segment: v === "all" ? null : v })}
          options={[
            { value: "all", label: "All", count: counts?.all },
            { value: "real", label: "Real people", count: counts?.real },
            { value: "simulated", label: "Simulated", count: counts?.simulated },
          ]}
        />
        <Select
          aria-label="Tier"
          value={tier}
          onChange={(e) => set({ tier: e.target.value })}
          className="w-56"
          options={[
            { value: "", label: "Every tier" },
            ...TIERS.map((t) => ({ value: t, label: t })),
            { value: "Customers", label: "Customers" },
          ]}
        />
        <Select
          aria-label="Whose leads"
          value={owner}
          onChange={(e) => set({ owner: e.target.value === "all" ? null : e.target.value })}
          className="w-52"
          options={ownerOptions}
        />
        <Select
          aria-label="Sort by"
          value={sort}
          onChange={(e) => set({ sort: e.target.value })}
          className="w-52"
          options={[
            { value: "", label: "Latest visit first" },
            { value: "added", label: "Latest contact record first" },
            { value: "score", label: "Highest score first" },
            { value: "name", label: "Name, A to Z" },
          ]}
        />
        {search && (
          <span className="inline-flex h-8 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-sm bg-brand-soft pl-2.5 pr-1 text-[13px] text-brand-ink">
            Matching &ldquo;{search}&rdquo;
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label="Clear the search"
              className="rounded-xs p-1 hover:bg-surface/60"
              onClick={() => set({ search: null })}
            >
              <X aria-hidden className="size-3.5" />
            </button>
          </span>
        )}
        {leads.data && (
          <p className="ml-auto text-[13px] text-muted">{plural(leads.data.matching, "person", "people")}</p>
        )}
      </div>

      {leads.isPending ? (
        <Loading label="Loading the leads" />
      ) : leads.isError ? (
        <LoadError error={leads.error} what="the leads" retry={() => void leads.refetch()} />
      ) : leads.data.leads.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface px-4">
          <EmptyState
            icon={Users}
            title={search || tier || owner !== "all" ? "No one matches these filters" : "No leads yet"}
          >
            {search || tier || owner !== "all"
              ? "Change the filters or clear the search."
              : "A lead appears here as soon as someone signs up on the website."}
          </EmptyState>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <Table label="Leads">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <Th>Person</Th>
                <Th>Course</Th>
                <Th>Score</Th>
                <Th>Next step</Th>
                <Th>Owner</Th>
                <Th className="text-right">Last visit</Th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {leads.data.leads.map((l) => (
                <tr key={l.id} className="hover:bg-sunken/60">
                  <Td className="max-w-72">
                    <Person
                      leadId={l.id}
                      name={l.name}
                      email={l.email}
                      simulated={l.simulated}
                      customer={l.customer}
                      lost={l.lost}
                    />
                  </Td>
                  <Td className="max-w-52">
                    <span className="block truncate text-ink-2">{l.course_type ?? "Not chosen"}</span>
                    {l.customer && <span className="block text-[12.5px] text-muted">Spent {money(l.spent)}</span>}
                  </Td>
                  <Td>
                    <Score score={l.lead_score} tier={l.customer ? null : l.recommended_action} />
                  </Td>
                  <Td className="text-ink-2">{l.customer || l.lost ? "" : actionLabel(l.nba_action, true)}</Td>
                  <Td className="text-ink-2">{l.owner}</Td>
                  <Td
                    className="whitespace-nowrap text-right text-muted"
                    title="The last time this person was on the website"
                  >
                    {relative(l.last_active_at ?? l.created_at)}
                  </Td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </Table>
          <div className="mt-3">
            <Pager
              offset={offset}
              limit={LIMIT}
              total={leads.data.matching}
              onChange={(o) => set({ offset: o ? String(o) : null })}
            />
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { date, dateTime, errorText, int, money, pct, plural, relative, shortDate } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Badge, Button, Notice, Table, Td, Th, useToast } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { useState } from "react";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import { useSession } from "../app/session";
import { TrendChart } from "../components/charts";
import { EffectBars } from "../components/effect-bars";
import { SimulatedTag } from "../components/lead-bits";
import { KpiStrip, PageHeader, Panel, Section } from "../components/page";
import { QueryView } from "../components/state";
import { eventLabel } from "../lib/labels";
import {
  fooledOverTime,
  latestChecked,
  overstatement,
  splitEffects,
  type ControlCheck,
  type LearnedEffect,
} from "../lib/learning";

interface SignalPoint {
  signal: string;
  label: string;
  weight: number;
  points: number;
}

interface Run {
  id: number;
  as_of: string;
  reason: string;
  status: string;
  outcomes_known: number;
  new_outcomes: number;
  lead_decision: "kept" | "swapped" | "not_enough_data" | string;
  lead_prob_better: number | null;
  nba_decision: string;
  note: string | null;
  simulated: number;
  learned: {
    points: SignalPoint[];
    outcomes_used: number;
    control: ControlCheck | null;
  } | null;
  nba_detail: {
    champion: string;
    champion_profit_per_lead: number | null;
    challenger_profit_per_lead: Record<string, number>;
    note: string;
  } | null;
}

interface Latency {
  count: number;
  median_ms: number;
  p95_ms: number;
  max_ms: number;
}

interface Overview {
  counts: { control_group: number };
  runs: Run[];
  status: {
    outcomes_known: number;
    new_outcomes: number;
    min_new_outcomes: number;
    latency: Record<string, Latency>;
  };
  lead_model: {
    learned_signals?: SignalPoint[];
    own_effects?: LearnedEffect[];
    live?: { outcomes_used?: number; learned_as_of?: string } | null;
  } | null;
  feed: { kind: string; what: string; name: string; at: string; simulated: boolean }[];
  settings: {
    swap_confidence: number;
    min_new_outcomes: number;
    window_days: number;
    control_share: number;
  };
}

const LATENCY_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  event_to_score: "A website event to a new score",
  trigger_to_action: "A trigger to the step being taken",
  pipeline_board: "Drawing the pipeline board",
};

const DECISION_TEXT: Record<string, string> = {
  kept: "Kept",
  swapped: "Replaced",
  not_enough_data: "Not enough data yet",
};

const LEAD_DECISION: Record<string, string> = {
  kept: "kept the score in use",
  swapped: "replaced the score in use with the new one",
  not_enough_data: "waited for more outcomes",
};

/** How far an expectation is from what happened, in plain words: "on target", "3 points high". */
function accuracyText(expected: number | null | undefined, actual: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (typeof expected !== "number" || typeof actual !== "number") return "Not checked yet";
  const gap = Math.round((expected - actual) * 100);
  if (gap === 0) return "On target";
  return `${Math.abs(gap)} ${Math.abs(gap) === 1 ? "point" : "points"} ${gap > 0 ? "high" : "low"}`;
}

function effectItems(effects: readonly LearnedEffect[]) {
  return effects.map((e) => ({ key: e.input, label: e.label, points: e.points }));
}

function RunDetail({ run }: { run: Run }) {
  const c = run.learned?.control;
  const n = run.nba_detail;
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 bg-sunken/50 px-4 py-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
      <div className="text-[13px]">
        <p className="mb-1 font-semibold text-ink">Lead score</p>
        {c && c.people > 0 ? (
          <p className="text-ink-2">
            Checked on {plural(c.people, "person", "people")} the team never contacted: {pct(c.actual)} bought; the
            score in use expected {pct(c.predicted.champion)}, the new one {pct(c.predicted.challenger)}.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <p className="text-muted">Not enough never-contacted people with a known outcome yet.</p>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="text-[13px]">
        <p className="mb-1 font-semibold text-ink">Next-best-action</p>
        {n ? (
          <>
            <p className="text-ink-2">
              In use: {money(n.champion_profit_per_lead, "none yet")} extra profit per lead on held-out decisions
              {Object.entries(n.challenger_profit_per_lead).length > 0 &&
                `; new: ${Object.values(n.challenger_profit_per_lead)
                  .map((v) => money(v))
                  .join(", ")}`}
              .
            </p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-muted">{n.note}</p>
          </>
        ) : (
          <p className="text-muted">No comparison in this update.</p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Runs({ runs }: { runs: Run[] }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<number | null>(null);
  return (
    <Table label="Updates">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <Th>Date</Th>
          <Th className="text-right">Outcomes</Th>
          <Th>Lead score</Th>
          <Th>Next-best-action</Th>
          <Th aria-label="Details" />
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        {runs.map((r) => (
          <RunRow key={r.id} run={r} open={open === r.id} toggle={() => setOpen(open === r.id ? null : r.id)} />
        ))}
      </tbody>
    </Table>
  );
}

function RunRow({ run: r, open, toggle }: { run: Run; open: boolean; toggle: () => void }) {
  return (
    <>
      <tr>
        <Td>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-ink">{dateTime(r.as_of)}</span>
            {r.simulated ? <SimulatedTag /> : null}
          </div>
          <span className="block text-[12.5px] text-muted">
            {r.reason === "history" ? "During the history" : r.reason === "manual" ? "Run by hand" : "Automatic"}
          </span>
        </Td>
        <Td className="num text-right">
          {int(r.outcomes_known)}
          <span className="block text-[12px] text-muted">{int(r.new_outcomes)} new</span>
        </Td>
        <Td>
          <Badge tone={r.lead_decision === "swapped" ? "good" : "neutral"}>
            {DECISION_TEXT[r.lead_decision] ?? r.lead_decision}
          </Badge>
        </Td>
        <Td>
          <Badge tone={r.nba_decision === "swapped" ? "good" : "neutral"}>
            {DECISION_TEXT[r.nba_decision] ?? r.nba_decision}
          </Badge>
        </Td>
        <Td className="text-right">
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" aria-expanded={open} onClick={toggle}>
            {open ? "Hide" : "Details"}
          </Button>
        </Td>
      </tr>
      {open && (
        <tr>
          <td colSpan={5} className="border-b border-line p-0">
            <RunDetail run={r} />
            {r.note && <p className="bg-sunken/50 px-4 pb-4 text-[12.5px] text-muted">{r.note}</p>}
          </td>
        </tr>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

export default function Learning() {
  const { can } = useSession();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  const data = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["learning"],
    queryFn: () => api.get<Overview>("/learning/overview"),
    refetchInterval: 30_000,
  });
  const run = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      api.post<{ message?: string; status?: string; lead_decision?: string; nba_decision?: string }>("/learning/run"),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      const lead = DECISION_TEXT[r.lead_decision ?? ""]?.toLowerCase();
      const nba = DECISION_TEXT[r.nba_decision ?? ""]?.toLowerCase();
      toast({
        tone: r.status === "busy" ? "info" : "good",
        text:
          r.message ?? `Update finished. Lead score: ${lead ?? "no change"}. Next-best-action: ${nba ?? "no change"}.`,
      });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["learning"] });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["model"] });
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Learning loop"
        description="The lead score and next-best-action learn from every outcome. A new version replaces the one in use only when it predicts better for the leads the team never contacts, so the team's own follow-ups cannot fool it."
        actions={
          can("marketing") ? (
            <Button variant="primary" loading={run.isPending} onClick={() => run.mutate()}>
              Update now
            </Button>
          ) : undefined
        }
      />
      <QueryView query={data} what="the learning loop">
        {(d) => {
          const checked = latestChecked(d.runs);
          const c = checked?.control;
          const trend = fooledOverTime(d.runs);
          const effects = splitEffects(d.lead_model?.own_effects);
          const signals = [...(d.lead_model?.learned_signals ?? [])]
            .filter((s) => Math.abs(s.points) >= 0.1)
            .sort((a, b) => b.points - a.points);
          const last = d.runs[0];
          return (
            <>
              <KpiStrip
                items={[
                  {
                    label: "Learned from",
                    value: `${int(d.lead_model?.live?.outcomes_used ?? d.status.outcomes_known)} outcomes`,
                    detail: last ? `Last update ${relative(last.as_of)}` : "No update yet",
                  },
                  {
                    label: "Accuracy on never-contacted leads",
                    value: accuracyText(c?.predicted.challenger, c?.actual),
                    detail: c
                      ? `Expected ${pct(c.predicted.challenger)}, bought ${pct(c.actual)}`
                      : "Needs people of the control group with a known outcome",
                  },
                  {
                    label: "Next update",
                    value: `${int(d.status.new_outcomes)} of ${int(d.status.min_new_outcomes)}`,
                    detail: "new outcomes; then it starts by itself",
                  },
                  {
                    label: "Control group",
                    value: int(d.counts.control_group),
                    detail: `${pct(d.settings.control_share)} of learners, never contacted`,
                  },
                ]}
              />

              <Section
                id="accuracy"
                title="Is the score accurate?"

                          {(overstatement(c.predicted.naive, c.actual) ?? 0) >= 0 ? "too high" : "too low"}): it counts

                        </p>
                      )}
                    </Panel>

                        title="Expected and actual buying, update by update"
                        data={trend}
                        x="date"

                          { key: "ours", label: "The score expected", dashed: true },

                        dots

                      <Notice tone="info">The chart appears after the second update.</Notice>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <Notice tone="info">
                    Not checked yet: the check needs people of the control group whose outcome is known.
                  </Notice>
                )}

                  title="What the team's work adds, by step"
                  description="Points of buying chance within 14 days for a lead with a 30% chance on their own: leads the CRM worked on after each step, the follow-ups after it included, against similar leads it never contacts. This is kept out of the lead score, so a score never includes the team's own work. To compare the steps on their own, see the learning steps on the Next-best-action page."
                >
                  {effects.steps.length ? (
                    <EffectBars label="What the team's work adds, by step" items={effectItems(effects.steps)} />

                    <p className="text-[13.5px] text-muted">
                      Not learned yet: the first score the loop adopts stores them.
                    </p>
                  )}

                  description="Learned from outcomes instead of a hand-set decay rule. Points of buying chance for a typical lead."
                >
                  {effects.time.length ? (
                    <EffectBars label="Learned effects of time" items={effectItems(effects.time)} />
                  ) : (
                    <p className="text-[13.5px] text-muted">
                      Not learned yet: the first score the loop adopts stores them.
                    </p>
                  )}
                </Section>

              {signals.length > 0 && (

                  id="learned"
