                >
                  <div className="max-w-3xl">
                    <EffectBars
                      label="Learned corrections"
                      items={signals.map((s) => ({ key: s.signal, label: s.label, points: s.points }))}
                    />
                  </div>
                </Section>
              )}

              <Section
                id="runs"
                title="Updates"
                description={`An update starts when ${int(d.settings.min_new_outcomes)} new outcomes are known. The score in use is replaced only with ${pct(d.settings.swap_confidence)} confidence that the new one is better.`}
              >
                {d.runs.length ? <Runs runs={d.runs} /> : <Notice tone="info">No update yet.</Notice>}
              </Section>

              <div className="mt-9 grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-6 gap-y-9 lg:grid-cols-2 [&>section]:mt-0">

                        ))}

                    </Table>
                  )}
                </Section>

import { errorText } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Button, Field, Input, Notice, ThemeToggle } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Navigate, useLocation, useNavigate } from "react-router";
import { useSession } from "../app/session";

export default function Login() {
  const { me, signIn } = useSession();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const from = (location.state as { from?: string } | null)?.from ?? "/";
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  if (me) return <Navigate to={me.must_change_password ? "/account" : from} replace />;

  const submit = async (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const m = await signIn(email.trim(), password);
      navigate(m.must_change_password ? "/account" : from, { replace: true });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(errorText(err));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col">
      <div className="flex justify-end p-4">
        <ThemeToggle />
      </div>
      <main className="flex flex-1 items-start justify-center px-4 pb-24 pt-[8vh]">
        <div className="w-full max-w-[400px]">
          <div className="mb-8 flex items-center gap-3">
            <svg aria-hidden viewBox="0 0 32 32" className="size-9">
              <rect width="32" height="32" rx="7" fill="var(--xe-brand)" />
              <path d="M9 9l14 14M23 9L9 23" stroke="#fff" strokeWidth="3.2" strokeLinecap="round" />
            </svg>
            <div className="leading-tight">
              <p className="text-[16px] font-semibold text-ink">X Education</p>
              <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">Admissions CRM</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-[22px] font-semibold text-ink">Sign in</h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[14px] text-muted">Use the work account an admin created for you.</p>
          <form onSubmit={submit} className="mt-6 flex flex-col gap-4" noValidate>
            {error && <Notice tone="bad">{error}</Notice>}
            <Field label="Email address">
              <Input
                type="email"
                autoComplete="username"
                value={email}
                onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                required
                autoFocus
              />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Password">
              <Input
                type="password"
                autoComplete="current-password"
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                required
              />
            </Field>
            <Button type="submit" variant="primary" size="lg" loading={busy} disabled={!email || !password}>
              Sign in
            </Button>
          </form>
          <div className="mt-8 border-t border-line pt-5 text-[13px] text-muted">
            <p>Forgotten your password? An admin can set a new one for you on the Team page.</p>
            <p className="mt-2">
              First start: the start window shows the owner account&apos;s address and first password (also in
              backend/data/initial-admin-password.txt). You choose your own after signing in.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { int, pct } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Table, Td, Th } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import type { ModelHealth as Health } from "../api/types";
import { TrendChart } from "../components/charts";
import { KpiStrip, PageHeader, Section } from "../components/page";
import { QueryView } from "../components/state";
import { TIERS } from "../lib/labels";

interface Card {
  version?: string;
  model_type?: string;
  trained_at?: string;
  metrics?: Record<string, number>;
  base_rate?: number;
  trained_on?: Record<string, number>;
}

export default function ModelHealth() {
  const health = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["model", "health"],
    queryFn: () => api.get<Health & { retrain_hint?: string }>("/model/health"),
    refetchInterval: 60_000,
  });
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Model health"
        description="Is the lead score still right? Scores from the last weeks are compared with what the people then did."
      />
      <QueryView query={health} what="the model check">
        {(h) => {
          const card = (h.model ?? {}) as Card;
          const m = card.metrics ?? {};
          const calibration = h.calibration.map((b) => ({
            bin: `${(b.bin - 1) * 10} to ${b.bin * 10}`,
            predicted: b.predicted,
            actual: b.actual,
            n: b.n,
          }));
          return (
            <>
              <KpiStrip
                items={[
                  {
                    label: "Ranking (AUC)",
                    value: m.roc_auc?.toFixed(3) ?? "None",
                    detail: "1.0 ranks every buyer first",
                  },
                  {
                    label: "Chance error (log-loss)",
                    value: m.log_loss?.toFixed(3) ?? "None",
                    detail: "Lower is better",
                  },
                  {
                    label: "Calibration error",
                    value: m.ece?.toFixed(3) ?? "None",
                    detail: "Gap between score and reality",
                  },
                  {
                    label: "Buyers in the top 10%",
                    value: pct(m.precision_top10, 0, "None"),
                    detail: "Buyers among the highest scores",
                  },
                  {
                    label: "Scores checked",
                    value: int(h.snapshots_labelled),
                    detail: `of ${int(h.snapshots_total)} in ${h.window_days} days`,
                  },
                ]}
              />
              <p className="mt-2 text-[12.5px] text-muted">
                Model {card.version ?? "not loaded"} ({(card.model_type ?? "").replace(/_/g, " ")}). The first four
                numbers are from held-out training data.
              </p>

              <Section
                title="Calibration"
                description="For each tenth of the scores: the chance of buying the score said, against the share who really bought."
              >
                {calibration.length ? (
                  <TrendChart
                    title="Predicted and actual share who bought"
                    description="By score band"
                    data={calibration}
                    x="bin"
                    series={[
                      { key: "predicted", label: "Predicted" },
                      { key: "actual", label: "Actual" },
                    ]}
                    format={(v) => pct(v, 0)}
                    height={260}
                    footer="When the two lines are close, the score can be read as a chance of buying."
                  />
                ) : (
                  <p className="text-[13.5px] text-muted">Not enough known outcomes yet.</p>
                )}
              </Section>

              <Section title="By tier">
                {h.by_tier.length === 0 ? (
                  <p className="text-[13.5px] text-muted">
                    Not enough known outcomes yet: a score is checked {h.window_days} days after it was given.
                  </p>
                ) : (
                  <Table label="By tier">
                    <thead>
                      <tr>
                        <Th>Tier</Th>
                        <Th className="text-right">Scores</Th>
                        <Th className="text-right">Predicted</Th>
                        <Th className="text-right">Actual</Th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {[...h.by_tier]
                        .sort(
                          (a, b) =>
                            TIERS.indexOf(a.tier as (typeof TIERS)[number]) -
                            TIERS.indexOf(b.tier as (typeof TIERS)[number]),
                        )
                        .map((t) => (
                          <tr key={t.tier}>
                            <Td className="text-ink">{t.tier}</Td>
                            <Td className="num text-right">{int(t.snapshots)}</Td>
                            <Td className="num text-right">{pct(t.predicted_rate, 1)}</Td>
                            <Td className="num text-right">{pct(t.actual_rate, 1)}</Td>
                          </tr>
                        ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </Table>
                )}
                {h.retrain_hint && <p className="mt-3 max-w-[80ch] text-[13px] text-muted">{h.retrain_hint}</p>}
                <p className="mt-2 max-w-[80ch] text-[12.5px] text-muted">
                  People the team worked on buy more than their score said, because the follow-ups work. The learning
                  loop checks new models on the untouched control group for that reason.
                </p>
              </Section>
            </>
          );
        }}
      </QueryView>
    </>
  );
}

                </tbody>

            )}
          </QueryView>
        </Section>
      </div>

        title="What the emails led to"
        description="Purchases within the outcome window after a click. A click before buying is not proof the email caused it: the A/B tests and hold-out groups measure that."
      >
        <QueryView query={influence} what="the email numbers">
          {(r) => (

                  <Th className="text-right">Click rate</Th>
                  <Th className="text-right">Bought after a click</Th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {Object.entries(r.campaign_influence).map(([k, v]) => (
                  <tr key={k}>
                    <Td className="text-ink">{EMAIL_KIND[k] ?? k}</Td>
                    <Td className="num text-right">{int(v.emails_sent)}</Td>
                    <Td className="num text-right">{int(v.clicks)}</Td>
                    <Td className="num text-right">
                      {pct(v.emails_sent ? v.clicks / v.emails_sent : null, 0, "None")}
                    </Td>
                    <Td className="num text-right">{int(v.influenced_conversions)}</Td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </QueryView>
      </Section>
    </>
  );
}

import { keepPreviousData, useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { compactMoney, errorText, int, pct, relative } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import {
  Badge,
  Button,
  Dialog,
  Field,
  IconButton,
  Menu,
  Segmented,
  Select,
  Switch,
  Textarea,
  useToast,
} from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { MoreHorizontal } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";

import { api } from "../api/client";

const MOVABLE = ["Lead", "Engaged", "MQL", "SQL", "Lost"];

function useMove() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({
      card,
      stage,
      reason,
      note,
    }: {
      card: PipelineCard;
      stage: string | null;
      reason?: string;
      note?: string;
    }) =>
      stage === null
        ? api.del(`/pipeline/${card.user_id}`)
        : api.put(`/pipeline/${card.user_id}`, { stage, reason, note }),
    onSuccess: (_r, v) => {
      toast({
        tone: "good",
        text:
          v.stage === null
            ? `${v.card.name} follows their behaviour again.`
            : `${v.card.name} moved to ${STAGE_LABEL[v.stage] ?? v.stage}.`,
      });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["pipeline"] });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["lead"] });
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
}

/** Take the card's best step now (logged like an automatic decision, as "Take this step" on the lead page). */
function useAct() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ card, action }: { card: PipelineCard; action: ActionKey }) =>
      api.post<{ message: string }>(`/leads/${card.lead_id}/act`, { action }),
    onSuccess: (r, v) => {
      toast({ tone: "good", text: `${v.card.name}: ${r.message}` });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["pipeline"] });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["lead"] });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["actions"] });
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
}

function LostDialog({ card, reasons, onClose }: { card: PipelineCard; reasons: string[]; onClose: () => void }) {
  const move = useMove();
  const [reason, setReason] = useState(reasons[0] ?? "");
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  return (
    <Dialog
      open
      onClose={onClose}
      title={`Move ${card.name} to Lost`}
      description="The CRM stops every automatic step for them until someone re-opens the lead."
      footer={
        <>
          <Button onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button
            variant="danger"
            loading={move.isPending}
            onClick={() => move.mutate({ card, stage: "Lost", reason, note }, { onSuccess: onClose })}
          >
            Move to Lost
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        <Field label="Reason">
          <Select
            value={reason}
            onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
            options={reasons.map((r) => ({ value: r, label: r }))}
          />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Note" optional>
          <Textarea rows={3} value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} maxLength={200} />
        </Field>
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function Card({ card, reasons }: { card: PipelineCard; reasons: string[] }) {
  const move = useMove();
  const act = useAct();
  const [losing, setLosing] = useState(false);
  const isCustomer = card.stage === "Customer";
  const isOpen = !isCustomer && card.stage !== "Lost";
  const line = moneyLine(card);
  const items = isCustomer
    ? []
    : [
        ...MOVABLE.filter((s) => s !== card.stage).map((s) => ({
          label: `Move to ${STAGE_LABEL[s] ?? s}`,
          onSelect: () => (s === "Lost" ? setLosing(true) : move.mutate({ card, stage: s })),
        })),
        ...(card.moved_by_hand
          ? [
              {
                label: "Back to automatic",
                hint: `Stage from their behaviour: ${STAGE_LABEL[card.auto_stage] ?? card.auto_stage}`,
                onSelect: () => move.mutate({ card, stage: null }),
              },
            ]
          : []),
      ];
  return (
    <li className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface p-3">
      <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <Link
            to={`/leads/${card.lead_id}`}
            className="block truncate text-[13.5px] font-medium text-ink hover:text-brand-ink hover:underline"
          >
            {card.name}
          </Link>
          <p className="truncate text-[12.5px] text-muted">{card.course ?? "No course chosen"}</p>
        </div>
        {items.length > 0 && (
          <Menu
            label={`Move ${card.name}`}
            items={items}
            trigger={(p) => (
              <IconButton {...p} label={`Move ${card.name}`} size="sm" className="-mr-1.5 -mt-1">
                <MoreHorizontal aria-hidden className="size-4" />
              </IconButton>
            )}
          />
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-3 text-[12.5px]">
        <Score score={card.score} tier={isCustomer ? null : card.tier} />
        {isOpen && card.p_anyway !== null && (
          <span className="num ml-auto text-ink-2" title="Chance of buying within 14 days if the team does nothing">
            {pct(card.p_anyway)} chance
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
      {isOpen && line.action && (
        <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md bg-good-soft px-2.5 py-1.5">
          <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-[12.5px] text-ink">
            {line.pWithout !== null && line.pWith !== null && (
              <>
                <span className="num font-semibold">
                  {pct(line.pWithout)} → {pct(line.pWith)}
                </span>{" "}
              </>
            )}
            <span className="text-ink-2">{line.text}</span>
          </p>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="primary"
            loading={act.isPending}
            onClick={() => line.action && act.mutate({ card, action: line.action })}
            aria-label={`Take the step for ${card.name}`}
          >
            Do it
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
      {isOpen && !line.action && line.text && <p className="mt-2 text-[12px] text-muted">{line.text}</p>}
      <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[12px] text-muted">
        <span className="mr-auto">{card.owner}</span>
        {card.last_seen && <span>Seen {relative(card.last_seen)}</span>}
      </div>
      {(card.simulated || card.moved_by_hand || card.control_group || card.lost_reason || card.no_discount) && (
        <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
          {isOpen && card.no_discount && (
            <Badge
              tone="info"
              title="More likely than not to buy without help, and a coupon would hardly change that: no discount is given"
            >
              No discount needed
            </Badge>
          )}
          {card.moved_by_hand && (
            <Badge tone="info" title={card.moved_by ? `Moved by ${card.moved_by}` : undefined}>
              Moved by hand
            </Badge>
          )}
          {card.lost_reason && <Badge>{card.lost_reason}</Badge>}
          {card.control_group && <Badge variant="outline">Control group</Badge>}
          {card.simulated && <SimulatedTag />}
        </div>
      )}
      {losing && <LostDialog card={card} reasons={reasons} onClose={() => setLosing(false)} />}
    </li>
  );
}

export default function Pipeline() {
  const me = useMe();
  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
  const owner = params.get("owner") ?? (me.role === "counsellor" ? "me" : "all");
  const simulated = params.get("simulated") !== "no";
  const sort = params.get("sort") === "score" ? "score" : "money";
  const set = (k: string, v: string | null) =>
    setParams(
      (p) => {
        if (v === null) p.delete(k);
        else p.set(k, v);
        return p;
      },
      { replace: true },
    );
  const board = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["pipeline", owner, simulated, sort],
    queryFn: () => api.get<PipelineBoard>("/pipeline", { owner, include_simulated: simulated, limit: 40, sort }),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
    refetchInterval: 30_000,
  });

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Pipeline"
        description="Every open lead in its stage, in rupees: what will come in anyway if the team does nothing, and what the team can still add with the best step now. Stages follow what people do on the website; move a lead by hand when you know better."
      />
      {board.data && (
        <KpiStrip
          className="mb-5"
          items={[
            {
              label: "Comes in anyway",
              value: compactMoney(board.data.totals.anyway),
              detail: `next ${board.data.totals.window_days} days, if the team does nothing`,
            },
            {
              label: "The team can add",
              value: compactMoney(board.data.totals.add),
              detail: `with the best step for ${int(board.data.totals.work)} leads`,
            },
            {
              label: "No discount needed",
              value: int(board.data.totals.no_discount),
              detail: "likely buyers who need no discount",
            },
            {
              label: "Open leads",
              value: int(board.data.totals.open_leads),
              detail: owner === "me" ? "yours" : owner === "unassigned" ? "nobody's yet" : "everyone's",
            },
          ]}
        />
      )}
      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
        <Segmented
          label="Whose leads"
          value={owner}
          onChange={(v) => set("owner", v)}
          options={[
            { value: "me", label: "Mine" },
            { value: "unassigned", label: "Unassigned" },
            { value: "all", label: "Everyone's" },
          ]}
        />
        <Segmented
          label="Order"
          value={sort}
          onChange={(v) => set("sort", v === "money" ? null : v)}
          options={[
            { value: "money", label: "Work first" },
            { value: "score", label: "Highest score" },
          ]}
        />
        <div className="w-64">
          <Switch
            checked={simulated}
            onChange={(v) => set("simulated", v ? null : "no")}
            label="Include simulated learners"
          />
        </div>
      </div>
      {board.isPending ? (
        <Loading label="Loading the board" />
      ) : board.isError ? (
        <LoadError error={board.error} what="the pipeline" retry={() => void board.refetch()} />
      ) : (
        <div className="-mx-4 overflow-x-auto px-4 pb-2 sm:-mx-6 sm:px-6">
          <div className="flex min-w-max gap-4">
            {board.data.columns.map((col) => (
              <section key={col.stage} aria-label={STAGE_LABEL[col.stage] ?? col.stage} className="w-[272px] shrink-0">
                <header className="mb-2.5 border-b-2 border-line-strong pb-2">

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { compactMoney, errorText, int, money, pct, plural } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Badge, Button, Field, Input, Notice, useToast } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { useState } from "react";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import type { MoneyTotals } from "../api/types";
import { useSession } from "../app/session";
import { KpiStrip, PageHeader, Panel, Section } from "../components/page";
import { QueryView } from "../components/state";
import { budgetVerdict, counsellorVerdict, type BudgetView, type CounsellorView } from "../lib/planner";

interface PlannerData {
  as_of: string;
  month: {
    label: string;
    days_in_month: number;
    day: number;
    revenue: number;
    purchases: number;
    discount_given: number;
  };
  pipeline: MoneyTotals & { by_step: Record<string, { label: string; leads: number; add: number }> };
  team: {
    days: number;
    worked_on: { people: number; bought: number; rate: number | null };
    control: { people: number; bought: number; rate: number | null };
    lift?: number;
    lift_ci?: [number, number];
    revenue?: number;
    revenue_ci?: [number, number];
    share_of_buyers?: number;
  };
  counsellor: CounsellorView;
  budget: BudgetView & { days_in_month: number };
  coupons_kept: {
    days: number;
    decisions: number;
    usual: { coupons: number; to_buyers_anyway: number };
    ours: { coupons: number; to_buyers_anyway: number };
    kept: number;
    discount_given: number;
    purchases_with_discount: number;
  };
  average_fee_paid: number;
}

const TONE = { good: "good", neutral: "neutral", warn: "warn" } as const;

/** The owner's two numbers: saving one keeps the other as it is. */
function useSaveSettings() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (body: { monthly_discount_budget: number | null; counsellor_monthly_cost: number }) =>
      api.put<PlannerData>("/planner/settings", body),
    onSuccess: (d) => {
      qc.setQueryData(["planner"], d);
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["pipeline"] });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["money"] });
      toast({ tone: "good", text: "Saved. The CRM uses it from its next decision." });
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
}

function amount(text: string): number | null {
  const v = text.replace(/[,\s₹]/g, "");
  if (v === "") return null;
  const n = Number(v);
  return Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0 ? n : NaN;
}

function BudgetForm({ data }: { data: PlannerData }) {
  const save = useSaveSettings();
  const [value, setValue] = useState(data.budget.budget === null ? "" : String(Math.round(data.budget.budget)));
  const n = amount(value);
  return (
    <form
      className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!Number.isNaN(n))
          save.mutate({ monthly_discount_budget: n, counsellor_monthly_cost: data.counsellor.monthly_cost });
      }}
    >
      <Field label="Monthly discount budget (₹)" hint="Empty: no budget" className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-48">
        <Input inputMode="numeric" value={value} onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)} placeholder="No budget" />
      </Field>
      <Button type="submit" loading={save.isPending} disabled={Number.isNaN(n)}>
        Save
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}

function CostForm({ data }: { data: PlannerData }) {
  const save = useSaveSettings();
  const [value, setValue] = useState(String(Math.round(data.counsellor.monthly_cost)));
  const n = amount(value);
  return (
    <form
      className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (n !== null && !Number.isNaN(n))
          save.mutate({ monthly_discount_budget: data.budget.budget, counsellor_monthly_cost: n });
      }}
    >
      <Field label="What a counsellor costs a month (₹)" className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-48">
        <Input inputMode="numeric" value={value} onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)} />
      </Field>
      <Button type="submit" loading={save.isPending} disabled={n === null || Number.isNaN(n)}>
        Save
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { dateTime, errorText, relative } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Button, EmptyState, Field, Textarea, useToast } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { MessageCircleQuestion } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import { useCourses } from "../api/queries";
import { PageHeader } from "../components/page";
import { Loading, LoadError } from "../components/state";

interface Question {
  id: number;
  user_id: number;
  course_slug: string;
  question: string;
  user_name: string;
  created_at: string;
}

function Answer({ q }: { q: Question }) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const send = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.post<{ message: string }>("/qna/answer", { qna_id: q.id, answer: text }),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      toast({ tone: "good", text: r.message });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["qna"] });
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
  return (
    <form
      className="mt-3"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (text.trim()) send.mutate();
      }}
    >
      <Field label="Answer" hint="Published on the course page for everyone, and emailed to the person who asked.">
        <Textarea rows={3} value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} maxLength={4000} />
      </Field>
      <Button
        type="submit"
        variant="primary"
        size="sm"
        className="mt-2"
        loading={send.isPending}
        disabled={!text.trim()}
      >
        Publish the answer
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}

export default function Questions() {
  const courses = useCourses();
  const list = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["qna"],
    queryFn: () => api.get<{ questions: Question[] }>("/qna"),
    refetchInterval: 30_000,
  });
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Course questions"
        description="Questions people asked on course pages that are not answered yet. An answer appears on the course page for everyone."
      />
      {list.isPending ? (
        <Loading label="Loading the questions" />
      ) : list.isError ? (
        <LoadError error={list.error} what="the questions" retry={() => void list.refetch()} />
      ) : list.data.questions.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface px-4">
          <EmptyState icon={MessageCircleQuestion} title="Every question has an answer">
            New questions from course pages appear here.
          </EmptyState>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ul className="flex max-w-3xl flex-col gap-4">
          {list.data.questions.map((q) => (
            <li key={q.id} className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface px-4 py-3.5">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-3 text-[12.5px] text-muted">
                <span className="font-medium text-ink-2">{courses.title(q.course_slug)}</span>
                <span>{q.user_name}</span>
                <span className="ml-auto" title={dateTime(q.created_at)}>
                  {relative(q.created_at)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="mt-1.5 text-[14.5px] text-ink">{q.question}</p>
              <Answer q={q} />
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

const KIND_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  visit: "Visit",
  signup: "Sign-up",
  purchase: "Purchase",
  click: "Email click",
  team: "Team",
  info: "Note",
  error: "Problem",
};

export default function Simulation() {
  const { can } = useSession();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  const sim = useSimulation(10_000);
  const refresh = () => {
    void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["simulation"] });
    void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["stats"] });
  };
  const switchIt = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (enabled: boolean) => api.post<{ message?: string }>("/simulation/enabled", { enabled }),
    onSuccess: (r, enabled) => {
      toast({
        tone: "good",
        text: r.message ?? (enabled ? "Simulated learners resumed." : "Simulated learners paused."),
      });
      refresh();
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
  const visit = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (kind: "returning" | "signup") => api.post<{ message: string }>("/simulation/visit", { kind }),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      toast({ tone: "good", text: r.message });
      refresh();
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
  const admin = can("marketing");

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Simulated learners"
        description="Only the learners are simulated. They use the website through the same public API as real people, and the CRM treats them exactly the same; everything the team does is real."
      />
      <QueryView query={sim} what="the simulation">
        {(s) => (
          <>
            {s.last_error && (
              <Notice tone="bad" title="The last step failed" className="mb-6">
                {s.last_error}
              </Notice>
            )}
            <div className="mb-6 grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,22rem)]">
              <KpiStrip
                items={[
                  { label: "Learners", value: int(s.learners.total), detail: `${int(s.learners.customers)} customers` },
                  {
                    label: "On the website now",
                    value: int(s.learners.on_site_now),
                    detail: `${int(s.learners.still_deciding)} still deciding`,
                  },
                  {
                    label: "Visits, last 24 hours",
                    value: int(s.last_24h.visits),
                    detail: `about ${s.expected_per_day.visits} a day expected`,
                  },
                  {
                    label: "Purchases, last 24 hours",
                    value: int(s.last_24h.purchases),
                    detail: `about ${s.expected_per_day.purchases} a day expected`,
                  },
                ]}
              />
              <Panel>
                <Switch
                  checked={s.enabled}
                  disabled={!admin || switchIt.isPending || Boolean(s.switched_off_by_settings)}
                  onChange={(v) => switchIt.mutate(v)}
                  label={s.switched_off_by_settings ? "Switched off" : s.enabled ? "Running" : "Paused"}

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { int, money } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Badge, Segmented, type Tone } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { ArrowRight, CheckCircle2, Circle, Compass } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import { useSimulation } from "../api/queries";
import type { Role } from "../api/types";
import { useMe, useSession } from "../app/session";
import { PageHeader, Panel, Section } from "../components/page";
import { QueryView } from "../components/state";
import { doesByItself, FIRST_STEPS, glossary, JOBS, markStartSeen, type StartInfo } from "../lib/start";

interface Check {
  label: string;
  tone: Tone;
  state: string;
  text: string;
  to?: string;
  link?: string;
}

function checks(s: StartInfo, simulationOn: boolean | undefined, owner: boolean): Check[] {
  const out: Check[] = [
    s.email_sending
      ? { label: "Email", tone: "good", state: "Sending", text: "Emails and sign-up codes go out through Gmail." }
      : {
          label: "Email",
          tone: "warn",
          state: "Not set up",
          text: "Emails and sign-up codes are only recorded in the API's log, not sent. Add a Gmail address and app password to backend/.env and restart to send them.",
        },
    s.gemini
      ? {
          label: "Writing help",
          tone: "good",
          state: "On",
          text: "Gemini writes the message drafts; the facts come from the course catalogue.",
        }
      : {
          label: "Writing help",
          tone: "neutral",
          state: "Off",
          text: "Templates write the messages. A Gemini key in backend/.env turns on drafts in your own words; everything works without it.",
        },
    s.team_members > 1
      ? {
          label: "Team",
          tone: "good",
          state: `${int(s.team_members)} people`,
          text: "New leads are shared among the counsellors who take them.",
        }
      : {
          label: "Team",
          tone: "warn",
          state: "Only you",
          text: "Add your counsellors and marketers so calls and leads can be shared.",
          ...(owner ? { to: "/team", link: "Add people" } : {}),
        },
    {
      label: "Learners",
      tone: "neutral",
      state: `${int(s.learners.real)} real, ${int(s.learners.simulated)} simulated`,
      text:
        simulationOn === false
          ? "The simulated learners are paused. Everyone who signs up on the website is a real lead."
          : "Simulated learners use the website like real people so the CRM has something to do. Everyone who signs up on the website is a real lead.",
      to: "/simulation",
      link: "Simulated learners",
    },
    s.discount_budget === null
      ? {
          label: "Discount budget",
          tone: "neutral",
          state: "None",
          text: "A coupon goes out whenever it pays for itself. The owner can set a monthly limit in the planner.",
          to: "/planner",
          link: "Open the planner",
        }
      : {
          label: "Discount budget",
          tone: "good",
          state: `${money(s.discount_budget)} a month`,
          text: "The CRM spends it on the coupons that add the most for each rupee, so it lasts the month.",
          to: "/planner",
          link: "Open the planner",
        },
  ];
  return out;
}

                  <li key={step.title}>

                      <span
                        aria-hidden
                        className="num flex size-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-brand-soft text-[13px] font-semibold text-brand-ink"
                      >
                        {i + 1}
                      </span>

                        <p className="text-[14px] font-medium text-ink">{step.title}</p>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">{step.text}</p>
                        <Link
                          to={step.to}
                          className="mt-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[13.5px] font-medium text-brand-ink hover:underline"
                        >
                          {step.link}
                          <ArrowRight aria-hidden className="size-3.5" />
                        </Link>
                      </div>
                    </Panel>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ol>
            </Section>

            <Section id="setup" title="Is everything set up?" description="Read from this CRM right now.">
              <Panel padded={false}>
                <ul className="divide-y divide-line">
                  {checks(s, sim.data?.enabled, can("team")).map((c) => (
                    <li key={c.label} className="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-x-4 gap-y-1.5 px-4 py-3">
                      <span className="flex w-40 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 text-[14px] font-medium text-ink">
                        <Circle aria-hidden className="size-2.5 fill-current text-muted" />
                        {c.label}
                      </span>
                      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-64 text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">
                        <Badge tone={c.tone}>{c.state}</Badge> <span className="ml-1">{c.text}</span>
                        {c.to && c.link && (
                          <Link to={c.to} className="ml-2 font-medium text-brand-ink hover:underline">
                            {c.link}
                          </Link>
                        )}
                      </span>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </Panel>
            </Section>

            <Section id="words" title="Words you will see">
              <Panel>
                <dl className="grid gap-x-8 gap-y-3 md:grid-cols-2">
                  {glossary(s.rules).map((w) => (
                    <div key={w.term}>
                      <dt className="text-[14px] font-medium text-ink">{w.term}</dt>
                      <dd className="mt-0.5 text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">{w.meaning}</dd>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </dl>
              </Panel>
            </Section>

            <p className="mt-8 flex items-center gap-2 text-[13px] text-muted">
              <Compass aria-hidden className="size-4" />
              This guide stays in the menu under Start here. Ask the CRM answers questions about your data in plain
              words.
            </p>
          </>
        )}
      </QueryView>
    </>
  );
}

interface TeamSettings {

  callback_sla_hours: number;

const RULE_LABEL: Record<string, string> = { round_robin: "In turn", least_loaded: "Fewest open tasks first" };

function suggestPassword(): string {
  const alphabet = "abcdefghjkmnpqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789";
  const bytes = new Uint32Array(14);
  crypto.getRandomValues(bytes);
  const p = Array.from(bytes, (b) => alphabet[b % alphabet.length]).join("");
  return /\d/.test(p) ? p : `${p.slice(0, -1)}7`;
}

function useTeamMutation<T>(fn: (v: T) => Promise<{ message?: string }>, done?: string, onDone?: () => void) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: fn,
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      toast({ tone: "good", text: r?.message ?? done ?? "Saved." });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["team"] });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["me"] });
      onDone?.();
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
}

function AddMember({ roles, onClose }: { roles: TeamResponse["roles"]; onClose: () => void }) {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [role, setRole] = useState<Role>("counsellor");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState(suggestPassword);
  const add = useTeamMutation(() => api.post("/team", { name, email, role, password }), "Account added.", onClose);
  return (
    <Dialog
      open
      onClose={onClose}
      title="Add an account"
      description="Give them the email address and this first password. They choose their own password when they first sign in."
      footer={
        <>
          <Button onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            loading={add.isPending}
            disabled={!name.trim() || !email.trim() || password.length < 8}
            onClick={() => add.mutate(undefined)}
          >
            Add the account
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <div className="grid gap-4">
        <Field label="Name">
          <Input value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} maxLength={80} autoFocus />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Work email address">
          <Input type="email" value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} maxLength={120} />
        </Field>
        <Field
          label="Role"
          hint="Counsellors work their own leads. Marketing also runs campaigns and tests. Admins also manage the team."
        >
          <Select
            value={role}
            onChange={(e) => setRole(e.target.value as Role)}
            options={roles.map((r) => ({ value: r.key, label: r.label }))}
          />
        </Field>
        <Field
          label="First password"
          hint="Letters and at least one digit, 8 characters or more."
          trailing={<Button onClick={() => setPassword(suggestPassword())}>New</Button>}
        >
          <Input value={password} onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)} className="num" />
        </Field>
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function EditMember({ m, roles, onClose }: { m: Member; roles: TeamResponse["roles"]; onClose: () => void }) {
  const [name, setName] = useState(m.name);
  const [role, setRole] = useState<Role>(m.role);
  const [takes, setTakes] = useState(m.takes_new_leads);
  const save = useTeamMutation(
    () => api.put(`/team/${m.id}`, { name, role, takes_new_leads: takes }),
    undefined,
    onClose,
  );
  return (
    <Dialog
      open
      onClose={onClose}
      title={`Change ${m.name}'s account`}
      footer={
        <>
          <Button onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button variant="primary" loading={save.isPending} onClick={() => save.mutate(undefined)}>
            Save
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <div className="grid gap-4">
        <Field label="Name">
          <Input value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} maxLength={80} />
        </Field>

          onChange={setTakes}
          label="Gets new leads"

    </Dialog>
  );
}

function ResetPassword({ m, onClose }: { m: Member; onClose: () => void }) {
  const [password, setPassword] = useState(suggestPassword);
  const reset = useTeamMutation(() => api.post(`/team/${m.id}/password`, { password }), undefined, onClose);
  return (
    <Dialog

      onClose={onClose}
      title={`Set a new password for ${m.name}`}

        <>
          <Button onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>

      <Field label="New password" trailing={<Button onClick={() => setPassword(suggestPassword())}>New</Button>}>
        <Input value={password} onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)} className="num" />
      </Field>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function SettingsForm({ s }: { s: TeamSettings }) {

import { date, money, parseTime, time } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Badge, EmptyState } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import {
  Activity as ActivityIcon,
  CircleDollarSign,
  Gauge,
  Mail,
  MessageCircle,
  MousePointerClick,
  Phone,
  PhoneIncoming,
} from "lucide-react";
import type { LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { useCourses } from "../../api/queries";
import type { LeadPage } from "../../api/types";
import { eventLabel, outcomeLabel, SCORE_REASON_LABEL } from "../../lib/labels";

interface Item {
  at: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  text: ReactNode;
  detail?: ReactNode;
  key: string;
}

function minutes(sec: number | null): string | null {
  if (!sec) return null;
  return sec < 60 ? `${sec} s` : `${Math.round(sec / 60)} min`;
}

function items(lead: LeadPage, title: (slug: string | null) => string): Item[] {
  const out: Item[] = [];
  for (const e of lead.behaviour_events) {
    if (e.event_type === "purchase") continue;
    out.push({
      key: `e${e.id}`,
      at: e.created_at,
      icon: MousePointerClick,
      text: eventLabel(e.event_type),
      detail: [title(e.course_slug), minutes(e.time_spent_sec)].filter(Boolean).join(", ") || undefined,
    });
  }
  for (const m of lead.emails) {
    out.push({
      key: `m${m.id}`,
      at: m.sent_at,
      icon: Mail,
      text: m.error ? <>Email not sent: {m.subject}</> : <>Email sent: {m.subject}</>,
      detail: m.error ? (
        <>The mail server did not take it: {m.error}</>
      ) : (
        <>
          {m.campaign_name
            ? `Campaign ${m.campaign_name}. `
            : m.ab_test_id
              ? `A/B test, variant ${m.variant ?? ""}. `
              : ""}
          {m.first_clicked_at
            ? `Clicked ${m.click_count} time${m.click_count === 1 ? "" : "s"}, first at ${time(m.first_clicked_at)}.`
            : "Not clicked."}
        </>
      ),
    });
  }
  for (const p of lead.purchases) {
    out.push({
      key: `p${p.id}`,
      at: p.purchased_at,
      icon: CircleDollarSign,
      text: (
        <>
          Bought {p.course_title} for <span className="num">{money(p.price_paid)}</span>
        </>
      ),
      detail: p.coupon_used ? `Coupon ${p.coupon_used}, ${money(p.discount_amount ?? 0)} off` : undefined,
    });
  }
  for (const t of lead.tasks) {
    out.push({
      key: `t${t.id}`,
      at: t.done_at ?? t.created_at,
      icon: t.task_type === "call" ? Phone : MessageCircle,
      text: t.title,
      detail:
        t.status === "open" ? (
          <Badge tone="warn">Open</Badge>
        ) : (
          <>
            {outcomeLabel(t.outcome)}
            {t.done_by ? `, by ${t.done_by}` : ""}
          </>
        ),
    });
  }
  for (const c of lead.callbacks) {
    out.push({
      key: `c${c.id}`,
      at: c.created_at,
      icon: PhoneIncoming,
      text: "Asked for a call-back",
      detail: [
        c.preferred_time && `Best time: ${c.preferred_time}`,
        c.note,
        c.status === "done" ? `Done by ${c.done_by ?? "the team"}` : "Open",
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(". "),
    });
  }
  for (const s of lead.score_history) {
    if (Math.round(s.old_score) === Math.round(s.new_score)) continue;
    out.push({
      key: `s${s.id}`,
      at: s.created_at,
      icon: Gauge,
      text: (
        <>
          Score <span className="num">{Math.round(s.old_score)}</span> to{" "}
          <span className="num">{Math.round(s.new_score)}</span>
        </>
      ),
      detail: `${SCORE_REASON_LABEL[s.reason] ?? s.reason}${s.old_tier !== s.new_tier ? `. Now ${s.new_tier}` : ""}`,
    });
  }
  for (const [i, m] of lead.chat.entries()) {
    if (m.role !== "user") continue;
    out.push({
      key: `q${i}`,
      at: m.created_at,
      icon: MessageCircle,
      text: "Asked the help assistant",
      detail: `"${m.text}"`,
    });
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => (parseTime(b.at)?.getTime() ?? 0) - (parseTime(a.at)?.getTime() ?? 0));
}

function dayLabel(at: string): string {
  const d = parseTime(at);
  if (!d) return "";
  const today = new Date();
  const y = new Date(today);
  y.setDate(today.getDate() - 1);
  if (d.toDateString() === today.toDateString()) return "Today";
  if (d.toDateString() === y.toDateString()) return "Yesterday";
  return date(at);
}

/** Everything the person did and everything the CRM did for them, newest first, grouped by day. */
export function Activity({ lead }: { lead: LeadPage }) {
  const courses = useCourses();
  const all = items(lead, courses.title);
  if (!all.length) {
    return (
      <EmptyState icon={ActivityIcon} title="No activity yet">
        Visits, emails, calls and purchases appear here as they happen.
      </EmptyState>
    );
  }
  const groups: { day: string; items: Item[] }[] = [];
  for (const it of all) {
    const day = dayLabel(it.at);
    const last = groups[groups.length - 1];
    if (last && last.day === day) last.items.push(it);
    else groups.push({ day, items: [it] });
  }
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      {groups.map((g) => (
        <section key={g.day}>
          <h3 className="mb-2 text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink">{g.day}</h3>
          <ol className="relative ml-3 border-l border-line">
            {g.items.map((it) => {
              const Icon = it.icon;
              return (
                <li key={it.key} className="relative pb-3.5 pl-6 last:pb-0">
                  <span className="absolute -left-[13px] top-0 flex size-[26px] items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-line bg-surface text-muted">
                    <Icon aria-hidden className="size-3.5" />
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-3">
                    <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-[13.5px] text-ink">{it.text}</p>
                    <time className="num text-[12.5px] text-muted" dateTime={it.at.replace(" ", "T")}>
                      {time(it.at)}
                    </time>
                  </div>
                  {it.detail && <div className="mt-0.5 text-[12.5px] text-muted">{it.detail}</div>}
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ol>
        </section>
      ))}
      <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted">Showing the latest 30 website events, 20 emails and 10 tasks.</p>
    </div>
  );
}

import { dateTime, money, relative } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Badge, Button, EmptyState } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { Scale } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import type { DecisionItem } from "../../api/types";
import { DecisionReceipt } from "../../components/receipt";
import { actionLabel, outcomeLabel, POLICY_LABEL, triggerLabel } from "../../lib/labels";

function Outcome({ d }: { d: DecisionItem }) {
  if (d.outcome === "bought" && d.bought) {
    return (
      <Badge tone="good">
        Bought {d.bought.course} for {money(d.bought.paid)}
      </Badge>
    );
  }
  if (d.outcome === "did_not_buy") return <Badge>Did not buy within the window</Badge>;
  return <Badge tone="info">Waiting{typeof d.days_left === "number" ? `, ${d.days_left} days left` : ""}</Badge>;
}

function Row({ d }: { d: DecisionItem }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const title =
    d.kind === "campaign"
      ? `Campaign: ${d.name ?? ""}`
      : d.kind === "ab"
        ? `A/B test: ${d.name ?? ""}`
        : `${d.label ?? actionLabel(d.action)}`;
  return (
    <li className="border-b border-line px-4 py-3 last:border-b-0">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-x-4 gap-y-1.5">
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-72">
          <p className="text-[14px] font-medium text-ink">{title}</p>
          <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-[12.5px] text-muted">
            <span title={dateTime(d.at)}>{relative(d.at)}</span>
            {d.kind === "decision" && d.trigger && <span>After: {triggerLabel(d.trigger).toLowerCase()}</span>}
            {d.kind === "decision" && d.policy && <span>{POLICY_LABEL[d.policy]}</span>}
            {d.kind !== "decision" && d.arm && (
              <span>
                {d.arm === "holdout" || d.arm === "control"
                  ? "Held out at random: no email"
                  : d.kind === "campaign"
                    ? "Sent the campaign email"
                    : `Sent variant ${d.arm}`}
              </span>
            )}
            {d.email && (
              <span>{d.email.clicked_at ? `Email clicked ${relative(d.email.clicked_at)}` : "Email not clicked"}</span>
            )}
            {d.task && (
              <span>
                {d.task.status === "open" ? "Task open" : `Task: ${outcomeLabel(d.task.outcome).toLowerCase()}`}
              </span>
            )}
            {d.next_visit && <span>Came back {relative(d.next_visit)}</span>}
            {d.adopted_email && <span>Standard email from the test {d.adopted_email.test}</span>}
          </div>
        </div>
        <Outcome d={d} />
      </div>
      {d.kind === "decision" && d.options && d.options.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mt-2">
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" aria-expanded={open} onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}>
            {open ? "Hide the receipt" : "Show the receipt"}
          </Button>
          {open && (
            <DecisionReceipt
              className="mt-2 max-w-xl"
              compact
              options={d.options}
              chosen={d.action}
              modelBest={d.model_best}
              policy={d.policy}
              slotPrice={d.slot_price}
              price={d.price}
              meta={d.model_version ? `Model ${d.model_version}` : undefined}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}

/** Every step the CRM took, or chose not to take, for this person, and what happened after it. */
export function Decisions({ decisions }: { decisions: DecisionItem[] }) {
  if (!decisions.length) {
    return (
      <EmptyState icon={Scale} title="No decisions yet">
        The CRM decides a step after each visit, enquiry, wishlist, cart or checkout. Each decision is listed here with
        its receipt and its outcome.
      </EmptyState>
    );
  }
  return (
    <>
      <ul className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface">
        {decisions.map((d, i) => (
          <Row key={`${d.kind}-${d.id ?? i}`} d={d} />
        ))}
      </ul>
      <p className="mt-3 text-[12.5px] text-muted">
        An outcome counts a purchase within the outcome window after the decision. The latest 20 decisions are shown.
      </p>
    </>
  );
}

import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { errorText } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Button, Field, Input, Notice, Textarea, useToast } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { useState } from "react";
import { api } from "../../api/client";
import type { ImproveResponse, LeadPage } from "../../api/types";
import { Panel, Section } from "../../components/page";

function EmailComposer({ lead }: { lead: LeadPage }) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [subject, setSubject] = useState(lead.email_subject ?? "");
  const [body, setBody] = useState(lead.email_body ?? "");
  const [review, setReview] = useState<ImproveResponse | null>(null);
  const noEmail = lead.do_not_email === "Yes";

  const check = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      api.post<ImproveResponse>("/emails/improve", {
        draft: body,
        subject,
        tier: lead.recommended_action,
        course: lead.course_type ?? "",
        course_slug: lead.course_slug,
        occupation: lead.current_occupation ?? "",
        name: lead.name,
      }),
    onSuccess: setReview,
  });
  const send = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      api.post<{ success: boolean; message: string }>("/emails", { lead_id: lead.latest_lead_id, subject, body }),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      toast({ tone: r.success ? "good" : "bad", text: r.message });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["lead", lead.id] });
    },
  });

  return (
    <Panel>
      {noEmail && (
        <Notice tone="warn" className="mb-4">
          This person does not want emails. Only they can change that, in their settings on the website.
        </Notice>
      )}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        <Field label="Subject">
          <Input value={subject} onChange={(e) => setSubject(e.target.value)} maxLength={300} />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Message" hint="{first_name} and {course} are filled in when it is sent.">
          <Textarea rows={9} value={body} onChange={(e) => setBody(e.target.value)} />
        </Field>
        {(send.isError || check.isError) && <Notice tone="bad">{errorText(send.error ?? check.error)}</Notice>}
        {review && (
          <div className="rounded-md border border-line bg-sunken px-4 py-3">
            <p className="text-[13px] font-medium text-ink">Review of the draft</p>
            <ul className="mt-1.5 list-disc pl-5 text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">
              {review.suggestions.map((s) => (
                <li key={s}>{s}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
            <p className="mt-2 text-[12.5px] text-muted">{review.note}</p>
            {(review.improved_body !== body || review.improved_subject !== subject) && (
              <Button
                size="sm"
                className="mt-3"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSubject(review.improved_subject);
                  setBody(review.improved_body);
                  setReview(null);
                }}
              >
                Use the reviewed version
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            loading={send.isPending}
            disabled={noEmail || !subject.trim() || !body.trim() || !lead.can_change}
            onClick={() => send.mutate()}
          >
            Send email
          </Button>
          <Button loading={check.isPending} disabled={!body.trim()} onClick={() => check.mutate()}>
            Check the draft
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Panel>
  );
}

function WhatsAppComposer({ lead }: { lead: LeadPage }) {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [text, setText] = useState(lead.whatsapp_message ?? "");
  const allowed = Boolean(lead.whatsapp_opt_in) && Boolean(lead.phone);
  const open = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      api.post<{ url: string; message: string }>("/whatsapp", { lead_id: lead.latest_lead_id, message: text }),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      window.open(r.url, "_blank", "noopener");
      toast({ tone: "info", text: r.message });
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
  return (
    <Panel>
      {!allowed && (
        <Notice tone="info" className="mb-4">
          {lead.phone
            ? "This person has not opted in to WhatsApp messages."
            : "There is no phone number on this person's profile."}
        </Notice>
      )}
      <Field label="Message" hint="Opens WhatsApp with this text; you press send there.">
        <Textarea rows={5} value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} />
      </Field>
      <Button
        className="mt-4"
        variant="primary"
        disabled={!allowed || !text.trim() || !lead.can_change}
        loading={open.isPending}
        onClick={() => open.mutate()}
      >
        Open WhatsApp
      </Button>
    </Panel>
  );
}

export function Messages({ lead }: { lead: LeadPage }) {
  return (
    <div>
      {!lead.can_change && lead.can_change_why && (
        <Notice tone="info" className="mb-5">
          {lead.can_change_why}
        </Notice>
      )}
      <Section
        title="Email"
        description="Drafted for this person from their course and tier. Edit it, check it, and send it."
      >
        <EmailComposer lead={lead} />
      </Section>
      <Section title="WhatsApp" className="mt-8">
        <WhatsAppComposer lead={lead} />
      </Section>
      {lead.call_script && (
        <Section title="Call script" description="What to say when you call. It uses your name." className="mt-8">
          <blockquote className="whitespace-pre-line rounded-md border border-line bg-surface px-4 py-3 text-[13.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink">
            {lead.call_script}
          </blockquote>
        </Section>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { cn, errorText, pct, relative, useChartColors } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Button, Menu, Notice, Select, useToast } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { ChevronDown } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { api } from "../../api/client";
import type { ActResponse, LeadPage, NowRecommendation, PathsResponse } from "../../api/types";
import { Section } from "../../components/page";
import { DecisionReceipt } from "../../components/receipt";
import { Loading, LoadError } from "../../components/state";

function Factors({ factors }: { factors: NonNullable<NowRecommendation["factors"]> }) {
  const c = useChartColors();
  if (!factors.length)
    return <p className="text-[13.5px] text-muted">No signals yet: the person has not done anything on the website.</p>;
  const max = Math.max(...factors.map((f) => Math.abs(f.points)), 1);
  return (
    <ul className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface">
      {factors.map((f) => (
        <li
          key={f.factor}
          className="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_7rem_4.5rem] items-center gap-x-4 border-b border-line px-4 py-2.5 last:border-b-0"
        >
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <p className="truncate text-[13.5px] text-ink">{f.factor}</p>
            <p className="truncate text-[12.5px] text-muted">{f.detail}</p>
          </div>
          <div aria-hidden className="relative h-2">
            <span className="absolute inset-y-0 left-1/2 w-px" style={{ background: c.axis }} />
            <span
              className="absolute inset-y-0 rounded-full"
              style={{
                background: f.points >= 0 ? c.series[0] : c.series[1],
                left: f.points >= 0 ? "50%" : `${50 - (50 * Math.abs(f.points)) / max}%`,
                width: `${(50 * Math.abs(f.points)) / max}%`,
              }}
            />
          </div>
          <p className="num text-right text-[13.5px] font-medium text-ink">
            {f.points > 0 ? "+" : f.points < 0 ? "−" : ""}
            {Math.abs(Math.round(f.points))} points
          </p>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

function Paths({ leadId }: { leadId: number }) {
  const c = useChartColors();
  const paths = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["lead", leadId, "paths"],
    queryFn: () => api.get<PathsResponse>(`/leads/${leadId}/paths`),
    refetchInterval: 60_000,
  });
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<string | null>(null);
  if (paths.isPending) return <Loading label="Working out the likely paths" />;
  if (paths.isError)
    return <LoadError error={paths.error} what="the what-if paths" retry={() => void paths.refetch()} />;
  const d = paths.data;
  if (!d.steps.length)
    return <p className="text-[13.5px] text-muted">{d.summary || "No what-if paths for this person."}</p>;
  const step = d.steps.find((s) => s.action === (chosen ?? d.best)) ?? d.steps[0];
  return (
    <div className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 border-b border-line px-4 py-3">
        <label className="text-[13px] text-muted" htmlFor="path-step">
          If the CRM takes
        </label>
        <Select
          id="path-step"
          value={step.action}
          onChange={(e) => setChosen(e.target.value)}
          className="w-64"
          options={d.steps.map((s) => ({
            value: s.action,
            label: s.action === d.best ? `${s.label} (recommended)` : s.label,
          }))}
        />
        <p className="ml-auto text-[13px] text-muted">
          Chance of buying with this step <span className="num text-ink">{pct(step.p_buy_step)}</span>
        </p>
      </div>
      <ul>
        {step.reactions.map((r) => (
          <li
            key={r.reaction}
            className="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,12rem)_minmax(0,1fr)] items-center gap-x-4 border-b border-line px-4 py-2.5 last:border-b-0 sm:grid-cols-[minmax(0,12rem)_10rem_minmax(0,1fr)]"
          >
            <p className="text-[13.5px] text-ink">{r.label}</p>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span aria-hidden className="h-1.5 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full" style={{ background: c.grid }}>
                <span
                  className="block h-full rounded-full"
                  style={{ width: `${Math.round(r.prob * 100)}%`, background: c.series[0] }}
                />
              </span>
              <span className="num w-10 text-right text-[13px] text-ink">{pct(r.prob)}</span>
            </div>
            <p className="col-span-2 text-[13px] text-muted sm:col-span-1">
              {r.reaction === "bought"
                ? "Done: they bought."
                : r.best_next
                  ? `Then: ${r.best_next.label.toLowerCase()} (chance of buying ${pct(r.best_next.p_buy)})${r.next ? `, score about ${Math.round(r.next.score)}` : ""}`
                  : "Then: nothing more to do."}
            </p>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <p className="border-t border-line px-4 py-2.5 text-[12.5px] text-muted">
        Based on {step.evidence.decisions.toLocaleString("en-IN")} earlier decisions:{" "}
        {step.evidence.basis.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + step.evidence.basis.slice(1)}. {d.note}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

export function NextStep({ lead }: { lead: LeadPage }) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  const now = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["lead", lead.id, "now"],
    queryFn: () => api.get<NowRecommendation>(`/leads/${lead.id}/now`),
    refetchInterval: 20_000,
  });
  const act = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (action: string) => api.post<ActResponse>(`/leads/${lead.id}/act`, { action }),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      toast({ tone: "good", text: r.message });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["lead", lead.id] });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["actions"] });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["capacity"] });
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });

  if (now.isPending) return <Loading label="Working out the next step" />;
  if (now.isError) return <LoadError error={now.error} what="the next step" retry={() => void now.refetch()} />;
  const n = now.data;

  if (!n.recommendation) {
    return (
      <Notice tone="good" title="Customer">
        {n.message}
      </Notice>
    );
  }
  const rec = n.recommendation;
  const recent = n.recent ?? {};
  const others = (n.options ?? []).filter(
    (o) => !o.blocked && o.action !== "none" && o.action !== rec.action && !recent[o.action],
  );
  const recentNotes = Object.values(recent).filter(Boolean);
  const recValue = (n.options ?? []).find((o) => o.action === rec.action);
  const noneValue = (n.options ?? []).find((o) => o.action === "none");
  const blockedWhy = !lead.can_change
    ? lead.can_change_why
    : n.control_group
      ? "This person is in the control group."
      : null;

  return (
    <div>
      {n.control_group && (
        <Notice tone="info" title="Control group" className="mb-5">
          The CRM never contacts this person, so their outcome shows what happens without it. The receipt shows what it
          would have done.
        </Notice>
      )}
      <div className="rounded-md border border-brand/30 bg-brand-soft/50 px-4 py-4">
        <p className="text-[12.5px] font-medium text-brand-ink">Recommended now</p>
        <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-4 gap-y-1">
          <p className="text-[18px] font-semibold text-ink">{rec.label}</p>
          <p className="num ml-auto text-[18px] font-semibold text-ink">
            {rec.action === "none" || !recValue || !noneValue
              ? pct(n.probability)
              : `${pct(noneValue.p_convert)} → ${pct(recValue.p_convert)}`}
          </p>
        </div>
        <p className="mt-1 max-w-[70ch] text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">{rec.why}</p>
        <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {rec.action !== "none" && (
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              loading={act.isPending && act.variables === rec.action}
              disabled={Boolean(blockedWhy) || act.isPending || Boolean(recent[rec.action])}
              onClick={() => act.mutate(rec.action)}
            >
              {rec.action === "call" || rec.action === "whatsapp" ? "Add to today's actions" : "Send it now"}
            </Button>
          )}
          {others.length > 0 && (
            <Menu
              label="Take another step"
              align="start"
              items={others.map((o) => ({
                label: o.label,
                hint: noneValue ? `${pct(noneValue.p_convert)} → ${pct(o.p_convert)}` : pct(o.p_convert),
                onSelect: () => act.mutate(o.action),
              }))}
              trigger={(p) => (
                <Button {...p} disabled={Boolean(blockedWhy) || act.isPending}>
                  Take another step
                  <ChevronDown aria-hidden className="size-4" />
                </Button>
              )}
            />
          )}
          {blockedWhy && <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">{blockedWhy}</p>}
        </div>
        {!blockedWhy &&
          recentNotes.map((note) => (
            <p key={note} className="mt-2 text-[13px] text-muted">
              {note}
            </p>
          ))}
      </div>

      {n.options && n.options.length > 0 && (
        <Section
          title="Decision receipt"
          description="What each step is expected to add for this person right now."
          className="mt-8"
        >
          <DecisionReceipt
            title="Every step compared"
            options={n.options}
            chosen={rec.action}
            policy="model"
            slotPrice={n.slot_price}
            price={n.course?.price}
            meta={`${n.course?.title ?? ""}${n.nba_model ? `, model ${n.nba_model}` : ""}`}
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      <Section
        title="What could happen next"
        description="The likely reactions to a step, and the best follow-up after each."
        className="mt-8"
      >
        <Paths leadId={lead.id} />
      </Section>

      <Section
        title="Why this score"
        description={`What each signal adds to or takes from the score of ${Math.round(n.score ?? lead.lead_score)}.`}
        className="mt-8"
      >
        <Factors factors={n.factors ?? []} />
      </Section>

      {n.tips && n.tips.length > 0 && (
        <Section
          title="What would raise their score"
          description="Small steps the person could take next, and the score they would give."
          className="mt-8"
        >
          <ul className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface">
            {n.tips.map((t) => (
              <li
                key={t.title}
                className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-4 border-b border-line px-4 py-2.5 last:border-b-0"
              >
                <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-[13.5px] text-ink">{t.title}</p>
                <p className={cn("num text-[13px] text-muted")}>{t.detail}</p>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </Section>
      )}
      <p className="mt-6 text-[12.5px] text-muted">
        Lead model {n.lead_model ?? "not loaded"}, scored {relative(lead.created_at)}. Away for{" "}
        {n.away_days === null ? "an unknown time" : `${n.away_days.toFixed(1)} days`}.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { dateTime, errorText, relative } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Button, EmptyState, Field, Notice, Select, Textarea, useToast } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { NotebookPen } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { api } from "../../api/client";
import type { LeadPage, Note } from "../../api/types";
import { useMe } from "../../app/session";

const KINDS = [
  { value: "note", label: "Note" },
  { value: "call", label: "Call" },
  { value: "whatsapp", label: "WhatsApp" },
  { value: "meeting", label: "Meeting" },
];

const KIND_LABEL: Record<string, string> = Object.fromEntries(KINDS.map((k) => [k.value, k.label]));

export function Notes({ lead }: { lead: LeadPage }) {
  const me = useMe();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const [kind, setKind] = useState("note");
  const refresh = () => void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["lead", lead.id] });

  const add = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.post<{ note: Note }>(`/leads/${lead.id}/notes`, { text, kind }),
    onSuccess: () => {
      setText("");
      toast({ tone: "good", text: "Note added." });
      refresh();
    },
  });
  const remove = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: number) => api.del(`/notes/${id}`),
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast({ tone: "info", text: "Note deleted." });
      refresh();
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6">
      {lead.can_change ? (
        <form
          className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface p-4"
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (text.trim()) add.mutate();
          }}
        >
          {add.isError && (
            <Notice tone="bad" className="mb-3">
              {errorText(add.error)}
            </Notice>
          )}
          <Field label="Add a note" hint="Everyone on the team sees notes. Do not write card numbers or passwords.">
            <Textarea rows={3} value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} maxLength={4000} />
          </Field>
          <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <Select
              aria-label="Kind of note"
              value={kind}
              onChange={(e) => setKind(e.target.value)}
              options={KINDS}
              className="w-40"
            />
            <Button type="submit" variant="primary" loading={add.isPending} disabled={!text.trim()}>
              Add note
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      ) : (
        lead.can_change_why && <Notice tone="info">{lead.can_change_why}</Notice>
      )}
      {lead.notes.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState icon={NotebookPen} title="No notes yet">
          Notes from calls and meetings help whoever talks to this person next.
        </EmptyState>
      ) : (
        <ul className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface">
          {lead.notes.map((n) => (
            <li key={n.id} className="border-b border-line px-4 py-3 last:border-b-0">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-3 text-[12.5px] text-muted">
                <span className="font-medium text-ink">{n.author ?? "The CRM"}</span>
                <span>{KIND_LABEL[n.kind] ?? n.kind}</span>
                <span title={dateTime(n.created_at)}>{relative(n.created_at)}</span>
                {(n.member_id === me.id || me.role === "admin") && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="ml-auto text-[12.5px] text-muted hover:text-bad"
                    onClick={() => remove.mutate(n.id)}
                    disabled={remove.isPending}
                  >
                    Delete
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="mt-1 whitespace-pre-line text-[13.5px] text-ink">{n.text}</p>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
