import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { date, dateTime, errorText, money, relative } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Badge, Button, Dialog, Field, Menu, Notice, Select, Textarea, useToast } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { ChevronDown } from "lucide-react";
import { useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { api } from "../../api/client";
import type { LeadPage } from "../../api/types";
import { useMe } from "../../app/session";

function Block({ title, children, action }: { title: string; children: ReactNode; action?: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section className="border-b border-line px-4 py-4 last:border-b-0">
      <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
        <h2 className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink">{title}</h2>
        <div className="ml-auto">{action}</div>
      </div>
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

function Row({ label, value }: { label: string; value: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-3 py-0.5 text-[13px]">
      <dt className="w-28 shrink-0 text-muted">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="min-w-0 flex-1 break-words text-ink">{value}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}

function useLeadMutation<T>(lead: LeadPage, fn: (body: T) => Promise<{ message?: string }>, done?: string) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: fn,
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      toast({ tone: "good", text: r?.message ?? done ?? "Saved." });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["lead", lead.id] });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["leads"] });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["pipeline"] });
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
}

function Owner({ lead }: { lead: LeadPage }) {
  const me = useMe();
  const change = useLeadMutation<number | null>(lead, (member_id) => api.put(`/leads/${lead.id}/owner`, { member_id }));
  if (me.role === "admin") {
    return (
      <Select
        aria-label="Owner"
        value={lead.owner.id === null ? "" : String(lead.owner.id)}
        disabled={change.isPending}
        onChange={(e) => change.mutate(e.target.value ? Number(e.target.value) : null)}
        options={[
          { value: "", label: "Unassigned" },
          ...lead.team.map((m) => ({ value: String(m.id), label: m.name })),
        ]}
      />
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[13.5px]">
      <span className="text-ink">{lead.owner.name}</span>
      {lead.owner.id === null && (
        <Button size="sm" loading={change.isPending} onClick={() => change.mutate(me.id)}>
          Take this lead
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function LostDialog({ lead, onClose }: { lead: LeadPage; onClose: () => void }) {
  const [reason, setReason] = useState(lead.lost_reasons[0] ?? "");
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const close = useLeadMutation(
    lead,
    () => api.post(`/leads/${lead.id}/status`, { status: "lost", reason, note: note || null }),
    "Closed as lost.",
  );
  return (
    <Dialog
      open
      onClose={onClose}
      title={`Close ${lead.name} as lost`}
      description="The CRM stops every automatic step for them until someone re-opens the lead."
      footer={
        <>
          <Button onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button
            variant="danger"
            loading={close.isPending}
            onClick={() => close.mutate(undefined, { onSuccess: onClose })}
          >
            Close as lost
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        <Field label="Reason">
          <Select
            value={reason}
            onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
            options={lead.lost_reasons.map((r) => ({ value: r, label: r }))}
          />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Note" optional>
          <Textarea rows={3} value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} maxLength={200} />
        </Field>
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

const CHANNELS = [
  { key: "email", label: "Emails", off: (l: LeadPage) => l.do_not_email === "Yes" },
  { key: "call", label: "Calls", off: (l: LeadPage) => l.do_not_call === "Yes" },
  { key: "whatsapp", label: "WhatsApp", off: (l: LeadPage) => !l.whatsapp_opt_in },
] as const;

export function SidePanel({ lead, stage }: { lead: LeadPage; stage?: string }) {

  const reopen = useLeadMutation(lead, () => api.post(`/leads/${lead.id}/status`, { status: "open" }), "Re-opened.");

  const allowed = CHANNELS.filter((c) => !c.off(lead));
  return (
    <aside className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface">
      <Block title="Owner">
        <Owner lead={lead} />

        )}

          <Row
            label="Course"

          <Row label="Phone" value={lead.phone ?? "Not given"} />
          <Row label="Touches" value={`${lead.touches.length} contact records`} />
        </dl>
      </Block>

      <Block
        title="Contact preferences"

/// <reference types="vite/client" />
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import tokens from "../styles/tokens.css?raw";
import { CHART_COLORS } from "./chart";

/** The value of a custom property inside one block of tokens.css (":root" or ".dark"). */
function token(block: string, name: string): string | undefined {
  const start = tokens.indexOf(`${block} {`);
  const body = tokens.slice(start, tokens.indexOf("}", start));
  return body.match(new RegExp(`--xe-${name}:\\s*([^;]+);`))?.[1].trim();
}

describe("chart colours", () => {
  const cases = [
    ["light", ":root"],
    ["dark", ".dark"],
  ] as const;

  it.each(cases)("repeat the %s design tokens exactly", (theme, block) => {
    const c = CHART_COLORS[theme];
    c.series.forEach((hex, i) => expect(token(block, `series-${i + 1}`)).toBe(hex));
    expect(token(block, "series-muted")).toBe(c.seriesMuted);
    expect(token(block, "grid")).toBe(c.grid);
    expect(token(block, "axis")).toBe(c.axis);
    expect(token(block, "muted")).toBe(c.text);
    expect(token(block, "ink")).toBe(c.ink);
    expect(token(block, "surface")).toBe(c.surface);
    expect(token(block, "brand")).toBe(c.brand);
  });

  it("keeps four distinct series hues per theme", () => {
    for (const theme of ["light", "dark"] as const) {
      expect(new Set(CHART_COLORS[theme].series).size).toBe(4);
    }
  });
});

import { useTheme } from "./theme";

/**
 * Chart colours for each theme. They repeat the --xe-series-* and chart tokens of styles/tokens.css (a unit test
 * checks that both stay the same), because SVG attributes need real colour values, not CSS variables.
 *
 * The four series hues were checked with the data-visualisation palette validator on both surfaces: adjacent pairs
 * stay apart for the common colour-vision deficiencies. On the light surface series 3 and 4 have low contrast, so
 * every chart with more than one series has a legend and a table view, and values are never printed in a series
 * colour.
 */
export const CHART_COLORS = {
  light: {
    series: ["#2a78d6", "#eb6834", "#1baf7a", "#eda100"],
    seriesMuted: "#b8bdc8",
    grid: "#e8eaee",
    axis: "#c9cdd5",
    text: "#5f6577",
    ink: "#1e2230",
    surface: "#ffffff",
    brand: "#5b2c83",
  },
  dark: {
    series: ["#3987e5", "#d95926", "#199e70", "#c98500"],
    seriesMuted: "#4a4e5a",
    grid: "#262934",
    axis: "#3a3e4a",
    text: "#8e93a0",
    ink: "#e7e8ec",
    surface: "#191b22",
    brand: "#7a4ab3",
  },
} as const;

export type ChartColors = (typeof CHART_COLORS)[keyof typeof CHART_COLORS];

/** The chart colours of the theme in use. */
export function useChartColors(): ChartColors {
  return CHART_COLORS[useTheme().resolved];
}

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  compact,
  compactMoney,
  date,
  initials,
  money,
  parseTime,
  pct,
  plural,
  points,
  relative,
  signedMoney,
} from "./format";

describe("money", () => {
  it("writes rupees with Indian digit grouping", () => {
    expect(money(45000)).toBe("₹45,000");
    expect(money(1250000)).toBe("₹12,50,000");
    expect(money(null)).toBe("Not known");
    expect(money(Number.NaN, "")).toBe("");
  });

  it("signs a change with a real minus sign", () => {
    expect(signedMoney(4100)).toBe("+₹4,100");
    expect(signedMoney(-600)).toBe("−₹600");
    expect(signedMoney(0)).toBe("₹0");
  });

  it("compacts only from one lakh, so a thousand is never written as T", () => {
    expect(compactMoney(15200)).toBe("₹15,200");
    expect(compactMoney(2450000)).toBe("₹24.5L");
    expect(compactMoney(12000000)).toBe("₹1.2Cr");
    expect(compact(12345)).toBe("12,345");
    expect(compact(150000)).toBe("1.5L");
  });
});

describe("rates", () => {
  it("writes shares and point changes", () => {
    expect(pct(0.4123)).toBe("41%");
    expect(pct(0.4123, 1)).toBe("41.2%");
    expect(points(0.052)).toBe("+5.2 points");
    expect(points(-0.008)).toBe("−0.8 points");
    expect(points(0)).toBe("0.0 points");
  });
});

describe("times from the backend", () => {
  it("reads the backend's local time format", () => {
    const d = parseTime("2026-10-17 16:52:03");
    expect(d?.getFullYear()).toBe(2026);
    expect(d?.getHours()).toBe(16);
    expect(parseTime("not a time")).toBeNull();
    expect(date("2026-10-17")).toBe("17 Oct 2026");
  });

  it("says how long ago", () => {
    const now = new Date("2026-10-17T12:00:00");
    expect(relative("2026-10-17 11:59:40", now)).toBe("just now");
    expect(relative("2026-10-17 11:57:00", now)).toBe("3 minutes ago");
    expect(relative("2026-10-16 12:00:00", now)).toBe("yesterday");
    expect(relative(null, now, "never")).toBe("never");
  });
});

describe("words", () => {
  it("makes initials and plurals", () => {
    expect(initials("Riya Sharma")).toBe("RS");
    expect(initials("  Asha  ")).toBe("A");
    expect(initials("")).toBe("?");
    expect(plural(1, "lead")).toBe("1 lead");
    expect(plural(1200, "lead")).toBe("1,200 leads");
    expect(plural(2, "person", "people")).toBe("2 people");
  });
});

/** Number, money and date formatting in Indian English (lakh and crore grouping, 24-hour times). */

const LOCALE = "en-IN";

const moneyFmt = new Intl.NumberFormat(LOCALE, { style: "currency", currency: "INR", maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
const compactMoneyFmt = new Intl.NumberFormat(LOCALE, {
  style: "currency",
  currency: "INR",
  notation: "compact",
  maximumFractionDigits: 1,
});
const intFmt = new Intl.NumberFormat(LOCALE, { maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
const compactFmt = new Intl.NumberFormat(LOCALE, { notation: "compact", maximumFractionDigits: 1 });

type Num = number | null | undefined;

const isNum = (v: Num): v is number => typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v);

/** 45000 -> "₹45,000"; null -> the fallback. */
export function money(v: Num, fallback = "Not known"): string {
  return isNum(v) ? moneyFmt.format(v) : fallback;
}

/** A signed amount: +₹4,100 or -₹600 (a real minus sign). */
export function signedMoney(v: Num, fallback = "Not known"): string {
  if (!isNum(v)) return fallback;
  const s = moneyFmt.format(Math.abs(v));
  return v > 0 ? `+${s}` : v < 0 ? `−${s}` : s;
}

/**
 * 2450000 -> "₹24.5L" (lakh), 12000000 -> "₹1.2Cr". Below one lakh the full amount is shown (₹15,200): Indian
 * English writes a compact thousand as "T", which reads like a trillion.
 */
export function compactMoney(v: Num, fallback = "Not known"): string {
  if (!isNum(v)) return fallback;
  return Math.abs(v) < 100_000 ? moneyFmt.format(v) : compactMoneyFmt.format(v);
}

export function int(v: Num, fallback = "0"): string {
  return isNum(v) ? intFmt.format(v) : fallback;
}

/** 12345 -> "12,345"; 2450000 -> "24.5L" (counts are compacted only from one lakh). */
export function compact(v: Num, fallback = "0"): string {
  if (!isNum(v)) return fallback;
  return Math.abs(v) < 100_000 ? intFmt.format(v) : compactFmt.format(v);
}

/** 0.4123 -> "41%" (digits: decimals). */
export function pct(v: Num, digits = 0, fallback = "Not known"): string {
  return isNum(v) ? `${(v * 100).toFixed(digits)}%` : fallback;
}

/** A change in probability, in percentage points: 0.052 -> "+5.2 points". */
export function points(v: Num, digits = 1, fallback = "Not known"): string {
  if (!isNum(v)) return fallback;
  const n = (v * 100).toFixed(digits);
  return v > 0 ? `+${n} points` : v < 0 ? `−${n.replace("-", "")} points` : `${n} points`;
}

/** A size of a difference in percentage points, without a sign: 0.05 -> "5 points". */
export function pointsPlain(v: Num, digits = 0, fallback = "Not known"): string {
  return isNum(v) ? `${Math.abs(v * 100).toFixed(digits)} points` : fallback;
}

/** The backend sends local times as "2026-10-17 16:52:03". */
export function parseTime(s: string | null | undefined): Date | null {
  if (!s) return null;
  const d = new Date(s.length > 10 ? s.replace(" ", "T") : `${s}T00:00:00`);
  return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
}

const dateFmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(LOCALE, { day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric" });
const dateTimeFmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(LOCALE, {
  day: "numeric",
  month: "short",
  hour: "2-digit",
  minute: "2-digit",
  hour12: false,
});
const timeFmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(LOCALE, { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: false });
const dayFmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(LOCALE, { day: "numeric", month: "short" });

export function date(s: string | null | undefined, fallback = ""): string {
  const d = parseTime(s);
  return d ? dateFmt.format(d) : fallback;
}

export function dateTime(s: string | null | undefined, fallback = ""): string {
  const d = parseTime(s);
  return d ? dateTimeFmt.format(d) : fallback;
}

/** "18 Sep": for chart axes and short lists. */
export function shortDate(s: string | null | undefined, fallback = ""): string {
  const d = parseTime(s);
  return d ? dayFmt.format(d) : fallback;
}

export function time(s: string | null | undefined, fallback = ""): string {
  const d = parseTime(s);
  return d ? timeFmt.format(d) : fallback;
}

const rtf = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat(LOCALE, { numeric: "auto" });

/** "3 minutes ago", "yesterday", "in 2 days". */
export function relative(s: string | null | undefined, now: Date = new Date(), fallback = ""): string {
  const d = parseTime(s);
  if (!d) return fallback;
  const sec = (d.getTime() - now.getTime()) / 1000;
  const abs = Math.abs(sec);
  if (abs < 45) return "just now";
  const steps: [Intl.RelativeTimeFormatUnit, number][] = [
    ["minute", 60],
    ["hour", 3600],
    ["day", 86400],
    ["week", 604800],
    ["month", 2629800],
    ["year", 31557600],
  ];
  let unit: Intl.RelativeTimeFormatUnit = "minute";
  let size = 60;
  for (const [u, s2] of steps) {
    if (abs >= s2) {
      unit = u;
      size = s2;
    }
  }
  return rtf.format(Math.round(sec / size), unit);
}

/** "Riya Sharma" -> "RS". */
export function initials(name: string | null | undefined): string {
  const parts = (name ?? "").trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  return ((parts[0]?.[0] ?? "") + (parts.length > 1 ? parts[parts.length - 1][0] : "")).toUpperCase() || "?";
}

/** "1 lead", "3 leads". */
export function plural(n: number, one: string, many = `${one}s`): string {
  return `${int(n)} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`;
}

/**
 * A small JSON client for the backend API. Both apps call relative URLs (/api/v1/...); in development Vite proxies
 * them to the backend on port 8000, so the browser never needs cross-origin requests.
 */

export class ApiError extends Error {
  readonly status: number;
  readonly detail: unknown;

  constructor(status: number, message: string, detail?: unknown) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ApiError";
    this.status = status;
    this.detail = detail;
  }
}

export type Query = Record<string, string | number | boolean | null | undefined>;

export interface HttpClientOptions {
  base: string;
  /** Returns the bearer token to send, if any. */
  token?: () => string | null;
  /** Called on 401: the session has ended (the app signs the person out). */
  onUnauthorized?: () => void;
}

function withQuery(path: string, query?: Query): string {
  if (!query) return path;
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(query)) {
    if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "") p.set(k, String(v));
  }
  const s = p.toString();
  return s ? `${path}${path.includes("?") ? "&" : "?"}${s}` : path;
}

function messageOf(status: number, body: unknown): string {
  if (body && typeof body === "object" && "detail" in body) {
    const d = (body as { detail: unknown }).detail;
    if (typeof d === "string") return d;
  }
  if (status === 0) return "The server cannot be reached. Check that the backend is running.";
  if (status >= 500) return "Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a moment.";
  return `The request failed (${status}).`;
}

export function createHttpClient(opts: HttpClientOptions) {
  async function request<T>(method: string, path: string, body?: unknown, query?: Query): Promise<T> {
    const headers: Record<string, string> = { Accept: "application/json" };
    const token = opts.token?.();
    if (token) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
    if (body !== undefined) headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json";
    let res: Response;
    try {
      res = await fetch(opts.base + withQuery(path, query), {
        method,
        headers,
        body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
      });
    } catch {
      throw new ApiError(0, messageOf(0, null));
    }
    const type = res.headers.get("content-type") ?? "";
    const data: unknown = type.includes("application/json") ? await res.json().catch(() => null) : await res.text();
    if (!res.ok) {
      if (res.status === 401 && token) opts.onUnauthorized?.();
      throw new ApiError(res.status, messageOf(res.status, data), data);
    }
    return data as T;
  }

  return {
    get: <T>(path: string, query?: Query) => request<T>("GET", path, undefined, query),
    post: <T>(path: string, body?: unknown, query?: Query) => request<T>("POST", path, body ?? {}, query),
    put: <T>(path: string, body?: unknown) => request<T>("PUT", path, body ?? {}),
    del: <T>(path: string) => request<T>("DELETE", path),
    /** Download a file response (for example a CSV export) and save it in the browser. */
    async download(path: string, fallbackName: string): Promise<void> {
      const token = opts.token?.();
      const res = await fetch(opts.base + path, { headers: token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {} });
      if (!res.ok) throw new ApiError(res.status, messageOf(res.status, await res.json().catch(() => null)));
      const blob = await res.blob();
      const cd = res.headers.get("content-disposition") ?? "";
      const name = /filename=([^;]+)/.exec(cd)?.[1]?.replace(/"/g, "") ?? fallbackName;
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = name;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    },
  };
}

export type HttpClient = ReturnType<typeof createHttpClient>;

/** A readable message for any error thrown by a request. */
export function errorText(e: unknown): string {
  if (e instanceof ApiError) return e.message;
  if (e instanceof Error) return e.message;
  return "Something went wrong.";
}

export const THEME_KEY = "xe-theme";

  choice: ThemeChoice;
  resolved: "light" | "dark";
  setChoice: (c: ThemeChoice) => void;
  toggle: () => void;
}

export function useTheme(): ThemeState {
  const ctx = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("useTheme must be used inside ThemeProvider");

}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { THEME_KEY, ThemeContext, type ThemeChoice } from "./theme";

function stored(): ThemeChoice {
  try {
    const v = localStorage.getItem(THEME_KEY);
    return v === "light" || v === "dark" || v === "system" ? v : "system";
  } catch {
    return "system";
  }
}

function systemDark(): boolean {
  return typeof window !== "undefined" && window.matchMedia?.("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
}

/** Light, dark or the computer's setting; the class on <html> switches every token. */
export function ThemeProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [choice, setChoiceState] = useState<ThemeChoice>(stored);
  const [osDark, setOsDark] = useState<boolean>(systemDark);

  useEffect(() => {
    const mq = window.matchMedia?.("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)");
    if (!mq) return;
    const on = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => setOsDark(e.matches);
    mq.addEventListener("change", on);
    return () => mq.removeEventListener("change", on);
  }, []);

  const resolved: "light" | "dark" = choice === "system" ? (osDark ? "dark" : "light") : choice;

  useEffect(() => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.classList.toggle("dark", resolved === "dark");
    root.style.colorScheme = resolved;
  }, [resolved]);

  const setChoice = useCallback((c: ThemeChoice) => {
    setChoiceState(c);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, c);
    } catch {
      /* private browsing: the choice lasts for this visit */
    }
  }, []);

  const toggle = useCallback(() => setChoice(resolved === "dark" ? "light" : "dark"), [resolved, setChoice]);

  const value = useMemo(() => ({ choice, resolved, setChoice, toggle }), [choice, resolved, setChoice, toggle]);
  return <ThemeContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</ThemeContext.Provider>;
}

import { cn } from "../lib";

export type ButtonVariant = "primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "danger";
export type ButtonSize = "sm" | "md" | "lg";

const base =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap select-none " +
  "transition-colors disabled:opacity-55 disabled:pointer-events-none";

const variants: Record<ButtonVariant, string> = {
  primary: "bg-brand text-on-brand hover:bg-brand-strong",
  secondary: "bg-surface text-ink border border-line-strong hover:bg-sunken",
  ghost: "text-ink-2 hover:bg-sunken hover:text-ink",
  danger: "bg-surface text-bad border border-line-strong hover:bg-bad-soft hover:border-bad",
};

const sizes: Record<ButtonSize, string> = {
  sm: "h-8 px-2.5 text-[13px]",
  md: "h-9 px-3.5 text-[14px]",
  lg: "h-11 px-5 text-[15px]",
};

/** The classes of a button, for links that look like one. */
export function buttonClass(variant: ButtonVariant = "secondary", size: ButtonSize = "md", extra?: string): string {
  return cn(base, variants[variant], sizes[size], extra);
}

import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { forwardRef, type ButtonHTMLAttributes, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib";
import { buttonClass, type ButtonSize, type ButtonVariant } from "./button-class";

export interface ButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  loading?: boolean;
  icon?: ReactNode;
}

export const Button = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(function Button(
  {
    variant = "secondary",
    size = "md",
    loading = false,
    icon,
    className,
    children,
    disabled,
    type = "button",
    ...rest
  },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <button
      ref={ref}
      type={type}
      className={buttonClass(variant, size, className)}
      disabled={disabled || loading}
      aria-busy={loading || undefined}
      {...rest}
    >
      {loading ? <Loader2 aria-hidden className="size-4 animate-spin" /> : icon}
      {children}
    </button>
  );
});

export interface IconButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  label: string;
  size?: "sm" | "md";
}

/** A button with only an icon; label is read out by screen readers and shown as the tooltip. */
export const IconButton = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, IconButtonProps>(function IconButton(
  { label, size = "md", className, children, type = "button", ...rest },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <button
      ref={ref}
      type={type}
      aria-label={label}
      title={label}
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-sm text-ink-2 hover:bg-sunken hover:text-ink transition-colors",
        size === "sm" ? "size-8" : "size-9",
        className,
      )}
      {...rest}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
});

}

/** A small set of mutually exclusive filters, side by side. */
export function Segmented<T extends string>({
  options,
  value,
  onChange,
  label,
  size = "md",
}: {
  options: SegmentOption<T>[];
  value: T;
  onChange: (v: T) => void;
  label: string;
  size?: "sm" | "md";
}) {
  return (
    <div role="group" aria-label={label} className="inline-flex rounded-sm border border-line-strong bg-surface p-0.5">
      {options.map((o) => (
        <button
          key={o.value}
          type="button"
          aria-pressed={value === o.value}
          onClick={() => onChange(o.value)}
          className={cn(
            "rounded-[4px] px-2.5 font-medium transition-colors",
            size === "sm" ? "h-7 text-[12.5px]" : "h-8 text-[13px]",
            value === o.value ? "bg-brand-soft text-brand-ink" : "text-ink-2 hover:text-ink",
          )}
        >
          {o.label}
          {o.count !== undefined && <span className="num ml-1.5 text-muted">{int(o.count)}</span>}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export interface TabItem<T extends string> {
  id: T;
  label: string;
  count?: number;
}

/** Tabs (the panel is rendered by the page); arrow keys move between tabs. */
export function Tabs<T extends string>({
  tabs,
  value,
  onChange,
  label,
  className,
}: {
  tabs: TabItem<T>[];
  value: T;
  onChange: (v: T) => void;
  label: string;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (e.key !== "ArrowRight" && e.key !== "ArrowLeft") return;
    const i = tabs.findIndex((t) => t.id === value);
    const next = tabs[(i + (e.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : tabs.length - 1)) % tabs.length];
    onChange(next.id);
    ref.current?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(`[data-tab="${next.id}"]`)?.focus();
  };
  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      role="tablist"
      aria-label={label}
      onKeyDown={onKey}
      className={cn("flex gap-5 border-b border-line", className)}
    >
      {tabs.map((t) => (
        <button
          key={t.id}
          data-tab={t.id}
          type="button"
          role="tab"
          aria-selected={value === t.id}
          tabIndex={value === t.id ? 0 : -1}
          onClick={() => onChange(t.id)}
          className={cn(
            "-mb-px border-b-2 pb-2.5 pt-1 text-[14px] font-medium transition-colors",
            value === t.id ? "border-brand text-ink" : "border-transparent text-muted hover:text-ink",
          )}
        >
          {t.label}
          {t.count !== undefined && <span className="num ml-1.5 text-[12.5px] text-muted">{int(t.count)}</span>}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/** "1 to 50 of 1,234" with previous and next. */
export function Pager({
  offset,
  limit,
  total,
  onChange,
}: {
  offset: number;
  limit: number;
  total: number;
  onChange: (offset: number) => void;
}) {
  if (total <= limit) return null;
  const end = Math.min(offset + limit, total);
  return (
    <nav aria-label="Pages" className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 text-[13px] text-muted">
      <span className="num">
        {int(offset + 1)} to {int(end)} of {int(total)}
      </span>
      <button
        type="button"
        aria-label="Previous page"
        disabled={offset === 0}
        onClick={() => onChange(Math.max(0, offset - limit))}
        className="inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-sm border border-line-strong bg-surface text-ink-2 hover:bg-sunken disabled:opacity-40"
      >
        <ChevronLeft aria-hidden className="size-4" />
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        aria-label="Next page"
        disabled={end >= total}
        onClick={() => onChange(offset + limit)}
        className="inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-sm border border-line-strong bg-surface text-ink-2 hover:bg-sunken disabled:opacity-40"
      >
        <ChevronRight aria-hidden className="size-4" />
      </button>
    </nav>
  );
}

export type Tone = "neutral" | "brand" | "good" | "bad" | "warn" | "info";

const soft: Record<Tone, string> = {
  neutral: "bg-sunken text-ink-2",
  brand: "bg-brand-soft text-brand-ink",
  good: "bg-good-soft text-good",
  bad: "bg-bad-soft text-bad",
  warn: "bg-warn-soft text-warn",
  info: "bg-info-soft text-info",
};

  neutral: "border border-line-strong text-ink-2",
  brand: "border border-brand/40 text-brand-ink",
  good: "border border-good/40 text-good",

const noticeIcon: Record<"info" | "good" | "warn" | "bad", LucideIcon> = {
  info: Info,
  good: CheckCircle2,
  warn: TriangleAlert,
  bad: XCircle,
};

export interface NoticeProps {
  tone?: "info" | "good" | "warn" | "bad";
  title?: ReactNode;
  children?: ReactNode;
  action?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

/** An inline message inside a page: an error to fix, a result, a caveat. */
export function Notice({ tone = "info", title, children, action, className }: NoticeProps) {
  const Icon = noticeIcon[tone];
  return (
    <div
      role={tone === "bad" ? "alert" : "status"}
      className={cn("flex gap-3 rounded-md border px-3.5 py-3 text-[14px]", soft[tone], "border-current/15", className)}
    >
      <Icon aria-hidden className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" />
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-ink">
        {title && <p className="font-medium">{title}</p>}

    </div>

/** Short confirmations ("Saved", "Email sent"); errors that need attention stay in the page as a Notice. */
export function ToastProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<ToastItem[]>([]);
  const next = useRef(1);
  const show = useCallback((t: Omit<ToastItem, "id">) => {
    const id = next.current++;
    setItems((xs) => [...xs.slice(-3), { ...t, id }]);
    window.setTimeout(() => setItems((xs) => xs.filter((x) => x.id !== id)), t.tone === "bad" ? 7000 : 4000);
  }, []);
  const value = useMemo(() => show, [show]);
  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
      <div
        aria-live="polite"
        className="pointer-events-none fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50 flex w-[min(380px,calc(100vw-2rem))] flex-col gap-2"
      >
        {items.map((t) => {
          const Icon = t.tone === "good" ? CheckCircle2 : t.tone === "bad" ? XCircle : Info;
          return (
            <div
              key={t.id}
              className="pointer-events-auto flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-md border border-line bg-raised px-3.5 py-3 text-[14px] text-ink shadow-overlay"
            >
              <Icon
                aria-hidden
                className={cn(
                  "mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0",
                  t.tone === "good" ? "text-good" : t.tone === "bad" ? "text-bad" : "text-info",
                )}
              />
              <p className="flex-1">{t.text}</p>
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label="Dismiss"
                className="text-muted hover:text-ink"
                onClick={() => setItems((xs) => xs.filter((x) => x.id !== t.id))}
              >
                <X aria-hidden className="size-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
}

import { cleanup, render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";

afterEach(cleanup);

describe("Field", () => {

      <Field label="Coupon code" error="This coupon is not valid or has expired." trailing={<button>Apply</button>}>

    render(
      <Field label="City" hint="Where you live">
        <Input />
      </Field>,

    expect(screen.getByLabelText("City").tagName).toBe("INPUT");

import { ChevronDown } from "lucide-react";
import {
  cloneElement,
  forwardRef,
  isValidElement,
  useId,
  type InputHTMLAttributes,
  type ReactElement,
  type ReactNode,
  type SelectHTMLAttributes,
  type TextareaHTMLAttributes,
} from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib";

const control =
  "w-full rounded-sm border border-line-strong bg-surface text-ink placeholder:text-muted " +
  "transition-colors hover:border-ink-2/40 focus:border-brand focus:outline-none focus-visible:outline-2 " +
  "focus-visible:outline-offset-0 focus-visible:outline-focus disabled:opacity-60 aria-[invalid=true]:border-bad";

export interface FieldProps {
  label: ReactNode;
  hint?: ReactNode;
  error?: string | null;
  optional?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  /** A button beside the control (Apply, New...). The label stays on the control, so pass the control as the child. */
  trailing?: ReactNode;
  children: ReactElement<{ id?: string; "aria-describedby"?: string; "aria-invalid"?: boolean }>;
}

/** A label, the control, and a hint or an error under it (linked for screen readers). */
export function Field({ label, hint, error, optional, className, trailing, children }: FieldProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const controlId = children.props.id ?? `${id}-c`;
  const hintId = hint || error ? `${id}-h` : undefined;
  const child = isValidElement(children)
    ? cloneElement(children, { id: controlId, "aria-describedby": hintId, "aria-invalid": error ? true : undefined })
    : children;
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex flex-col gap-1.5", className)}>
      <label htmlFor={controlId} className="text-[13px] font-medium text-ink">
        {label}
        {optional && <span className="ml-1 font-normal text-muted">(optional)</span>}
      </label>
      {trailing ? (
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">{child}</div>
          {trailing}
        </div>
      ) : (
        child
      )}
      {(error || hint) && (
        <p id={hintId} className={cn("text-[12.5px]", error ? "text-bad" : "text-muted")}>
          {error || hint}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export const Input = forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>>(function Input(
  { className, ...rest },
  ref,
) {
  return <input ref={ref} className={cn(control, "h-9 px-3 text-[14px]", className)} {...rest} />;
});

export const Textarea = forwardRef<HTMLTextAreaElement, TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement>>(function Textarea(
  { className, rows = 4, ...rest },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <textarea
      ref={ref}
      rows={rows}
      className={cn(control, "px-3 py-2 text-[14px] leading-relaxed", className)}
      {...rest}
    />
  );
});

export interface SelectProps extends SelectHTMLAttributes<HTMLSelectElement> {
  options?: { value: string; label: string }[];
}

export const Select = forwardRef<HTMLSelectElement, SelectProps>(function Select(
  { className, options, children, ...rest },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("relative", className)}>
      <select ref={ref} className={cn(control, "h-9 appearance-none pl-3 pr-8 text-[14px]")} {...rest}>
        {options?.map((o) => (
          <option key={o.value} value={o.value}>
            {o.label}
          </option>
        ))}
        {children}
      </select>
      <ChevronDown
        aria-hidden
        className="pointer-events-none absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted"
      />
    </div>
  );
});

export function Checkbox({ label, description, className, ...rest }: CheckboxProps) {

export interface SwitchProps {

          )}
        />
      </button>

  );
}

import { X } from "lucide-react";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib";

export interface DialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  title: ReactNode;
  description?: ReactNode;
  children?: ReactNode;
  footer?: ReactNode;
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
}

/** A modal dialog on the native <dialog> element: focus moves into it, Esc and the backdrop close it. */
export function Dialog({ open, onClose, title, description, children, footer, size = "md" }: DialogProps) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  const titleId = useId();
  useEffect(() => {
    const d = ref.current;
    if (!d) return;
    if (open && !d.open) d.showModal();
    if (!open && d.open) d.close();
  }, [open]);
  return (
    <dialog
      ref={ref}
      aria-labelledby={titleId}
      onClose={onClose}
      onCancel={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        onClose();
      }}
      onMouseDown={(e) => {
        if (e.target === ref.current) onClose();
      }}
      className={cn(
        "m-auto max-h-[calc(100vh-3rem)] w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-line bg-raised p-0 text-ink shadow-overlay",
        size === "sm" ? "max-w-md" : size === "lg" ? "max-w-3xl" : "max-w-xl",
      )}
    >
      {open && (
        <div className="flex max-h-[calc(100vh-3rem)] flex-col">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3 border-b border-line px-5 py-4">
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <h2 id={titleId} className="text-[16px] font-semibold">
                {title}
              </h2>
              {description && <p className="mt-1 text-[13.5px] text-muted">{description}</p>}
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label="Close"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="-mr-1 rounded-sm p-1 text-muted hover:bg-sunken hover:text-ink"
            >
              <X aria-hidden className="size-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="overflow-y-auto px-5 py-4">{children}</div>
          {footer && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2 border-t border-line bg-surface px-5 py-3">{footer}</div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </dialog>
  );
}

export interface MenuItem {
  label: string;
  onSelect: () => void;
  danger?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  hint?: string;
}

export interface MenuProps {
  trigger: (props: { onClick: () => void; "aria-expanded": boolean; "aria-haspopup": "menu"; id: string }) => ReactNode;
  items: MenuItem[];
  align?: "start" | "end";
  label?: string;
}

/** A small menu of actions, opened by a button; arrow keys move, Enter chooses, Esc closes. */
export function Menu({ trigger, items, align = "end", label }: MenuProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const id = useId();
  const wrap = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const list = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const close = useCallback(() => setOpen(false), []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onDown = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (wrap.current && !wrap.current.contains(e.target as Node)) close();
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", onDown);
    list.current?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("button:not(:disabled)")?.focus();
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", onDown);
  }, [open, close]);

  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const buttons = Array.from(list.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>("button:not(:disabled)") ?? []);
    const i = buttons.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLButtonElement);
    if (e.key === "Escape") {
      close();
      document.getElementById(id)?.focus();
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
      e.preventDefault();
      buttons[(i + 1) % buttons.length]?.focus();
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault();
      buttons[(i - 1 + buttons.length) % buttons.length]?.focus();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div ref={wrap} className="relative inline-block">
      {trigger({ onClick: () => setOpen((o) => !o), "aria-expanded": open, "aria-haspopup": "menu", id })}
      {open && (
        <div
          ref={list}
          role="menu"
          aria-label={label}
          aria-labelledby={label ? undefined : id}
          onKeyDown={onKey}
          className={cn(
            "absolute z-40 mt-1 min-w-48 rounded-md border border-line bg-raised p-1 shadow-overlay",
            align === "end" ? "right-0" : "left-0",
          )}
        >
          {items.map((it) => (
            <button
              key={it.label}
              type="button"
              role="menuitem"
              disabled={it.disabled}
              onClick={() => {
                close();
                it.onSelect();
              }}
              className={cn(
                "flex w-full flex-col items-start rounded-sm px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[13.5px] hover:bg-sunken focus:bg-sunken focus:outline-none disabled:opacity-50",
                it.danger ? "text-bad" : "text-ink",
              )}
            >
              {it.label}
              {it.hint && <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">{it.hint}</span>}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { Moon, Sun } from "lucide-react";
import { useTheme } from "../lib";
import { IconButton } from "./button";

/** Switches between light and dark (the first choice follows the computer's setting). */
export function ThemeToggle({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  const { resolved, toggle } = useTheme();
  const toDark = resolved === "light";
  return (
    <IconButton
      label={toDark ? "Switch to dark theme" : "Switch to light theme"}
      onClick={toggle}
      className={className}
    >
      {toDark ? <Moon aria-hidden className="size-[18px]" /> : <Sun aria-hidden className="size-[18px]" />}
    </IconButton>
  );
}

import { createContext, useContext } from "react";

export interface ToastItem {
  id: number;
  tone: "good" | "bad" | "info";
  text: string;
}

export const ToastContext = createContext<((t: Omit<ToastItem, "id">) => void) | null>(null);

/** Shows a short confirmation ("Saved", "Email sent"). Errors that need attention belong in the page as a Notice. */
export function useToast() {
  const show = useContext(ToastContext);
  if (!show) throw new Error("useToast must be used inside ToastProvider");
  return show;
}

import { createHttpClient } from "@xedu/shared/lib";

const TOKEN_KEY = "xe-learner-token";

export function getToken(): string | null {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function setToken(token: string | null): void {
  try {
    if (token) localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, token);
    else localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY);
  } catch {
    /* storage blocked: the session lasts until the tab closes */
  }
}

let onSignedOut: () => void = () => {};

/** The app registers what happens when the server says the session has ended. */
export function setSignedOutHandler(fn: () => void): void {
  onSignedOut = fn;
}

/** The learner API: every path is relative to /api/v1. */
export const api = createHttpClient({
  base: "/api/v1",
  token: getToken,
  onUnauthorized: () => {
    setToken(null);
    onSignedOut();
  },
});

/** Queries used on more than one page. */
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useSession } from "../app/session";
import { api } from "./client";
import type { CartItem, Course, WishlistItem } from "./types";

export function useCourses() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["courses"],
    queryFn: () => api.get<{ courses: Course[] }>("/courses"),
    staleTime: 10 * 60_000,
    select: (d) => d.courses,
  });
}

export function useCart() {
  const { me } = useSession();
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["cart"],
    queryFn: () => api.get<{ cart: CartItem[] }>("/cart"),
    enabled: Boolean(me),
    select: (d) => d.cart,
  });
}

export function useWishlist() {
  const { me } = useSession();
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["wishlist"],
    queryFn: () => api.get<{ wishlist: WishlistItem[] }>("/wishlist"),
    enabled: Boolean(me),
    select: (d) => d.wishlist,
  });
}

import { Spinner } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { Navigate, Outlet, useLocation } from "react-router";
import { useSession } from "./session";

/** Pages for signed-in learners: the sign-in page first, then back here. */
export function RequireLearner() {
  const { me, checking } = useSession();
  const location = useLocation();
  if (checking) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-[50vh] items-center justify-center">
        <Spinner label="Opening your account" />
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (!me) return <Navigate to="/login" replace state={{ from: location.pathname + location.search }} />;
  return <Outlet />;
}

import { useToast } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from "react-router";
import type { Profile, SignInResponse, User } from "../api/types";

export interface Me {
  user: User;
  profile: Profile | null;
}

export interface SessionState {
  me: Me | null;
  /** True while a saved session is being checked. */
  checking: boolean;
  signIn: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<SignInResponse>;
  /** Keeps the token of a sign-in that happened elsewhere (verifying the sign-up code). */
  adopt: (r: SignInResponse) => Promise<void>;
  signOut: () => void;
}

export const SessionContext = createContext<SessionState | null>(null);

export function useSession(): SessionState {
  const ctx = useContext(SessionContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("useSession must be used inside SessionProvider");
  return ctx;
}

/** The signed-in learner (only on pages behind RequireLearner). */
export function useMe(): Me {
  const { me } = useSession();
  if (!me) throw new Error("Not signed in");
  return me;
}

/** The history state of the page a deliberate sign-out opens: the session ends once that page is on screen. */
export interface SignOutState {
  signOut: true;
  /** A confirmation to show there. */
  message?: string;
}

/**
 * Sign out on purpose (the account menu, or after deleting the account): open the home page first and end the
 * session once it is on screen (useEndSessionOnArrival, in the Layout), so the signed-in page being left never sees
 * the session end and sends the learner to the sign-in page instead.
 */
export function useSignOutHome(): (message?: string) => void {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  return useCallback(
    (message?: string) => {
      const state: SignOutState = message ? { signOut: true, message } : { signOut: true };
      void navigate("/", { replace: true, state });
    },
    [navigate],
  );
}

/** Ends the session once the page a deliberate sign-out opened is on screen, and shows its confirmation. */
export function useEndSessionOnArrival(): void {
  const { signOut } = useSession();
  const location = useLocation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();
  const state = location.state as SignOutState | null;
  const leaving = state?.signOut === true;
  const message = leaving ? state?.message : undefined;
  // each history entry is handled once, even if the effect runs again before the entry is replaced
  const handled = useRef<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!leaving || handled.current === location.key) return;
    handled.current = location.key;
    signOut();
    if (message) toast({ tone: "good", text: message });
    // the history entry forgets the sign-out, so going back and forward does not repeat it
    void navigate({ pathname: location.pathname, search: location.search, hash: location.hash }, { replace: true });
  }, [leaving, message, signOut, toast, navigate, location.key, location.pathname, location.search, location.hash]);
}

==========================================================================================

import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { api, getToken, setSignedOutHandler, setToken } from "../api/client";
import type { SignInResponse } from "../api/types";
import { adoptVisit, forgetVisit } from "../lib/tracker";
import { SessionContext, type Me, type SessionState } from "./session";

/** The signed-in learner: the token in this browser, and who it belongs to (GET /auth/me). */
export function SessionProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const [hasToken, setHasToken] = useState(() => Boolean(getToken()));
  const me = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["me"],
    queryFn: () => api.get<Me>("/auth/me"),
    enabled: hasToken,
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });

  const signOut = useCallback(() => {
    setToken(null);
    forgetVisit();
    setHasToken(false);
    qc.clear();
  }, [qc]);

  useEffect(() => setSignedOutHandler(signOut), [signOut]);

  const adopt = useCallback(
    async (r: SignInResponse) => {
      setToken(r.token);
      adoptVisit(r.session_id);
      setHasToken(true);
      await qc.invalidateQueries();
    },
    [qc],
  );

  const signIn = useCallback(
    async (email: string, password: string) => {
      const r = await api.post<SignInResponse>("/auth/login", { email, password });
      await adopt(r);
      return r;
    },
    [adopt],
  );

  const value = useMemo<SessionState>(
    () => ({
      me: hasToken ? (me.data ?? null) : null,
      checking: hasToken && me.isPending,
      signIn,
      adopt,
      signOut,
    }),
    [hasToken, me.data, me.isPending, signIn, adopt, signOut],
  );
  return <SessionContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</SessionContext.Provider>;
}

// @vitest-environment jsdom
import { cleanup, fireEvent, render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { ToastProvider } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { useMemo, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { createMemoryRouter, Outlet, RouterProvider } from "react-router";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { RequireLearner } from "./guards";
import {
  SessionContext,
  useEndSessionOnArrival,
  useSession,
  useSignOutHome,
  type Me,
  type SessionState,
} from "./session";

afterEach(cleanup);

const ME = { user: { id: 7, name: "Asha Rao", email: "asha@example.com" }, profile: null } as unknown as Me;

/** A signed-in learner whose session ends when signOut is called, as in SessionProvider. */
function TestSession({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [me, setMe] = useState<Me | null>(ME);
  const value = useMemo<SessionState>(
    () => ({
      me,
      checking: false,
      signIn: () => Promise.reject(new Error("not used")),
      adopt: () => Promise.resolve(),
      signOut: () => setMe(null),
    }),
    [me],
  );
  return <SessionContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</SessionContext.Provider>;
}

function Root() {
  useEndSessionOnArrival();
  return <Outlet />;
}

function Home() {
  const { me } = useSession();
  return <p>Home page, {me ? "signed in" : "signed out"}</p>;
}

/** A page behind RequireLearner with both ways a session ends. */
function Cart() {
  const signOutHome = useSignOutHome();
  const { signOut } = useSession();
  return (
    <>
      <button onClick={() => signOutHome("Your account is deleted.")}>Sign out</button>
      <button onClick={signOut}>Session ends</button>
    </>
  );
}

function open(path: string) {
  const router = createMemoryRouter(
    [
      {
        element: <Root />,
        children: [
          { index: true, element: <Home /> },
          { path: "login", element: <p>Sign-in page</p> },
          { element: <RequireLearner />, children: [{ path: "cart", element: <Cart /> }] },
        ],
      },
    ],
    { initialEntries: [path] },
  );
  render(
    <ToastProvider>
      <TestSession>
        <RouterProvider router={router} />
      </TestSession>
    </ToastProvider>,
  );
  return router;
}

describe("signing out", () => {
  it("on purpose, from a signed-in page, opens the home page and ends the session there", async () => {
    const router = open("/cart");
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Sign out" }));
    expect(await screen.findByText("Home page, signed out")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByText("Sign-in page")).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByText("Your account is deleted.")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(router.state.location.pathname).toBe("/");
    // the history entry no longer carries the sign-out, so going back and forward does not repeat it
    expect(router.state.location.state).toBeFalsy();
  });

  it("when the session ends by itself, asks to sign in again and remembers the page", async () => {
    const router = open("/cart");
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Session ends" }));
    expect(await screen.findByText("Sign-in page")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(router.state.location.state).toEqual({ from: "/cart" });
  });
});

import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { cn, errorText } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Button, IconButton } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { ArrowUp, MessageCircle, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Link, useLocation } from "react-router";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import type { ChatReply } from "../api/types";
import { useSession } from "../app/session";
import { onOpenAssistant } from "../lib/assistant-bus";
import { track } from "../lib/tracker";
import { CallbackForm } from "./CallbackForm";

interface Line {
  from: "you" | "assistant";
  text: string;
  reply?: ChatReply;
}

const STARTERS = [
  "How much does it cost?",
  "Which course suits me?",
  "Can I study while working?",
  "Talk to a counsellor",
];

/** The help assistant: answers from the course catalogue and the written policies only, and books a call. */
export function Assistant() {
  const { me } = useSession();
  const location = useLocation();
  const slug = /^\/courses\/([^/]+)$/.exec(location.pathname)?.[1] ?? null;
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const [lines, setLines] = useState<Line[]>([]);
  const [conversation, setConversation] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [tracked, setTracked] = useState(false);
  const end = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const input = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  const ask = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (message: string) =>
      api.post<ChatReply>("/chat", { message, conversation_id: conversation, course_slug: slug }),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      setConversation(r.conversation_id);
      setLines((ls) => [...ls, { from: "assistant", text: r.reply, reply: r }]);
    },
    onError: (e) => setLines((ls) => [...ls, { from: "assistant", text: errorText(e) }]),
  });

  const send = (message: string) => {
    const m = message.trim();
    if (!m || ask.isPending) return;
    setLines((ls) => [...ls, { from: "you", text: m }]);
    setText("");
    ask.mutate(m);
    if (me && !tracked) {
      setTracked(true);
      void track("chat", slug);
    }
  };

  // other parts of the site open the assistant (with a first question) through the bus
  const sendLatest = useRef(send);
  useEffect(() => {
    sendLatest.current = send;
  });
  useEffect(
    () =>
      onOpenAssistant((q) => {
        setOpen(true);
        if (q) sendLatest.current(q);
      }),
    [],
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) input.current?.focus();
  }, [open]);
  useEffect(() => {
    end.current?.scrollIntoView({ block: "end" });
  }, [lines.length, ask.isPending]);

  const submit = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    send(text);
  };

  return (
    <>
      {!open && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
          className="fixed bottom-5 right-5 z-30 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-brand px-4 py-3 text-[14px] font-medium text-on-brand shadow-overlay hover:bg-brand-strong"
        >
          <MessageCircle aria-hidden className="size-[18px]" />
          Ask a question
        </button>
      )}
      {open && (
        <section
          aria-label="Course help"
          className="fixed inset-0 z-40 flex flex-col bg-surface sm:inset-auto sm:bottom-5 sm:right-5 sm:h-[min(600px,calc(100vh-2.5rem))] sm:w-[380px] sm:rounded-lg sm:border sm:border-line sm:shadow-overlay"
        >
          <header className="flex items-start gap-3 border-b border-line px-4 py-3">
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <h2 className="text-[15px] font-semibold text-ink">Course help</h2>
              <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted">
                An automated assistant. It answers from the course pages and can book a counsellor.
              </p>
            </div>
            <IconButton label="Close course help" size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
              <X aria-hidden className="size-4" />
            </IconButton>
          </header>
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-3" aria-live="polite">
            {lines.length === 0 && (
              <div>
                <p className="text-[14px] text-ink-2">
                  Ask about fees, duration, the syllabus or which course fits you.
                </p>
                <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {STARTERS.map((s) => (
                    <button
                      key={s}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => send(s)}
                      className="rounded-full border border-line-strong px-3 py-1.5 text-[13px] text-ink-2 hover:border-brand hover:text-ink"
                    >
                      {s}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
            <ol className="flex flex-col gap-3">
              {lines.map((l, i) => (
                <li key={i} className={cn("max-w-[88%] text-[14px]", l.from === "you" ? "ml-auto" : "")}>
                  <p
                    className={cn(
                      "whitespace-pre-line rounded-lg px-3 py-2",
                      l.from === "you" ? "bg-brand text-on-brand" : "bg-sunken text-ink",
                    )}
                  >
                    {l.text}
                  </p>
                  {l.reply && l.reply.links.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                      {l.reply.links.map((k) => (
                        <Link
                          key={k.to + k.label}
                          to={k.to}
                          onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
                          className="rounded-sm border border-line-strong px-2 py-1 text-[12.5px] font-medium text-brand-ink hover:bg-brand-soft"
                        >
                          {k.label}
                        </Link>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {l.reply?.action?.type === "callback_form" && (
                    <div className="mt-2 rounded-md border border-line p-3">
                      <CallbackForm
                        courseSlug={l.reply.course_slug}
                        compact
                        onDone={(m) => setLines((ls) => [...ls, { from: "assistant", text: m }])}
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </li>
              ))}
              {ask.isPending && (
                <li
                  className="w-fit rounded-lg bg-sunken px-3 py-2 text-[14px] text-muted"
                  aria-label="The assistant is answering"
                >
                  Writing an answer
                </li>
              )}
            </ol>
            <div ref={end} />
          </div>
          <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex items-end gap-2 border-t border-line p-3">
            <label htmlFor="assistant-input" className="sr-only">
              Your question
            </label>
            <textarea
              id="assistant-input"
              ref={input}
              rows={1}
              value={text}
              maxLength={1000}
              onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) submit(e);
              }}
              placeholder="Type your question"
              className="max-h-32 min-h-9 flex-1 resize-none rounded-sm border border-line-strong bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-[14px] text-ink placeholder:text-muted focus:border-brand focus:outline-none"
            />
            <Button
              type="submit"
              variant="primary"
              aria-label="Send"
              disabled={!text.trim() || ask.isPending}
              className="size-9 px-0"
            >
              <ArrowUp aria-hidden className="size-4" />
            </Button>
          </form>
        </section>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { errorText } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Button, Dialog, Field, Input, Notice, Select } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Link, useLocation } from "react-router";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import { useSession } from "../app/session";

const TIMES = ["Any time", "Morning (9 to 12)", "Afternoon (12 to 5)", "Evening (5 to 8)"];

/** Phone number and a good time; a counsellor calls back. Asking for a call is consent to be called on that number. */
export function CallbackForm({
  courseSlug,
  onDone,
  compact,
}: {
  courseSlug?: string | null;
  onDone?: (message: string) => void;
  compact?: boolean;
}) {
  const { me } = useSession();
  const location = useLocation();
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState(me?.profile?.phone ?? "");
  const [time, setTime] = useState(TIMES[0]);
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const send = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      api.post<{ message: string }>("/callback", {
        phone,
        preferred_time: time,
        note,
        course_slug: courseSlug ?? null,
      }),
    onSuccess: (r) => onDone?.(r.message),
  });
  if (!me) {
    return (
      <p className="text-[14px] text-ink-2">
        <Link to="/login" state={{ from: location.pathname }} className="font-medium text-brand-ink hover:underline">
          Sign in
        </Link>{" "}
        or{" "}
        <Link to="/signup" className="font-medium text-brand-ink hover:underline">
          create a free account
        </Link>{" "}
        and a counsellor can call you.
      </p>
    );
  }
  if (send.isSuccess) return <Notice tone="good">{send.data.message}</Notice>;
  return (
    <form
      className="flex flex-col gap-3"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (phone.trim()) send.mutate();
      }}
    >
      {send.isError && <Notice tone="bad">{errorText(send.error)}</Notice>}
      <Field label="Phone number">
        <Input
          type="tel"
          autoComplete="tel"
          value={phone}
          onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="+91 98765 43210"
          required
        />
      </Field>
      <Field label="A good time">
        <Select
          value={time}
          onChange={(e) => setTime(e.target.value)}
          options={TIMES.map((t) => ({ value: t, label: t }))}
        />
      </Field>
      {!compact && (
        <Field label="What would you like to talk about?" optional>
          <Input value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} maxLength={300} />
        </Field>
      )}
      <Button type="submit" variant="primary" loading={send.isPending} disabled={!phone.trim()}>
        Ask for a call
      </Button>
      <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted">We use this number only to call you about courses.</p>
    </form>
  );
}

export function CallbackDialog({
  courseSlug,
  courseTitle,
  onClose,
}: {
  courseSlug?: string | null;
  courseTitle?: string;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const [done, setDone] = useState<string | null>(null);
  return (
    <Dialog
      open
      size="sm"
      onClose={onClose}
      title="Talk to a counsellor"
      description={
        courseTitle
          ? `About ${courseTitle}: fees, schedule, whether it fits you.`
          : "About fees, schedules and which course fits you."
      }
      footer={done ? <Button onClick={onClose}>Close</Button> : undefined}
    >
      {done ? <Notice tone="good">{done}</Notice> : <CallbackForm courseSlug={courseSlug} onDone={setDone} />}
    </Dialog>
  );
}

/** Every page: header, content, footer, the help assistant, and the visit tracking for signed-in learners. */
export function Layout() {
  const { me } = useSession();
  const location = useLocation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const userId = me?.user.id;

  useEffect(() => (userId ? keepVisitAlive() : undefined), [userId]);
  // a deliberate sign-out (useSignOutHome) ends the session here, once the page it opened is on screen
  useEndSessionOnArrival();

  // an email's button: /courses/<slug>?ref=<token>. The click is reported once and the token taken out of the address.
  useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    const ref = params.get("ref");
    if (!ref) return;
    void reportEmailClick(ref);
    params.delete("ref");
    const rest = params.toString();
    navigate({ pathname: location.pathname, search: rest ? `?${rest}` : "", hash: location.hash }, { replace: true });
  }, [location.search, location.pathname, location.hash, navigate]);

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col">
      <a
        href="#main"
        className="sr-only focus:not-sr-only focus:fixed focus:left-4 focus:top-3 focus:z-50 focus:rounded-sm focus:bg-surface focus:px-3 focus:py-2"
      >
        Skip to the content
      </a>
      <SiteHeader />
      <main id="main" className="flex-1">
        <Outlet />
      </main>
      <SiteFooter />
      <div className="print:hidden">
        <Assistant />
      </div>
      <ScrollRestoration />
    </div>
  );
}

import { buttonClass } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { isRouteErrorResponse, Link, useRouteError } from "react-router";

/** A page that could not be opened: its code failed to load (usually after an update), or it crashed. */
export function RouteError() {
  const error = useRouteError();
  const missing = isRouteErrorResponse(error) && error.status === 404;
  const chunk =
    error instanceof Error &&
    /dynamically imported module|Failed to fetch|Importing a module script failed/i.test(error.message);
  return (
    <div className="mx-auto flex min-h-[60vh] max-w-lg flex-col justify-center px-6 py-16">
      <h1 className="text-[28px] font-semibold text-ink">
        {missing
          ? "This page does not exist"
          : chunk
            ? "This page could not be loaded"
            : "Something went wrong on this page"}
      </h1>
      <p className="mt-2 text-[15px] text-muted">
        {missing
          ? "The address may be mistyped, or the page has moved."
          : chunk
            ? "The site was probably updated while you had it open. Reload to get the new version."
            : "Reload the page. If it happens again, please tell us through the help assistant."}
      </p>
      <div className="mt-6 flex gap-2">
        <button type="button" className={buttonClass("primary")} onClick={() => window.location.reload()}>
          Reload
        </button>
        <Link to="/" className={buttonClass("secondary")}>
          Go to the home page
        </Link>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Lets any button on the site open the help assistant (optionally with a first question). */
type Listener = (question?: string) => void;

const listeners = new Set<Listener>();

export function openAssistant(question?: string): void {
  listeners.forEach((l) => l(question));
}

export function onOpenAssistant(l: Listener): () => void {
  listeners.add(l);
  return () => {
    listeners.delete(l);
  };
}

import type { Course } from "../api/types";

/** "6 Months" -> 6. */
export function months(c: Pick<Course, "duration">): number {
  const n = parseInt(c.duration, 10);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
}

/** "6 Months" -> "6 months". */
export function durationText(c: Pick<Course, "duration">): string {
  return c.duration.toLowerCase();
}

export const DOMAIN_SHORT: Record<string, string> = {
  "Data Science & Analytics": "Data and AI",
  "Digital Marketing": "Marketing",
  MBA: "Management (MBA)",
  "Finance & Banking": "Finance",
  "HR Management": "HR",
  "Operations Management": "Operations",
  "Supply Chain Management": "Supply chain",
  "E-Commerce": "E-commerce",
};

export const DOMAIN_ORDER = Object.keys(DOMAIN_SHORT);

export function byDomain(courses: Course[]): { domain: string; courses: Course[] }[] {
  return DOMAIN_ORDER.map((domain) => ({ domain, courses: courses.filter((c) => c.domain === domain) })).filter(
    (g) => g.courses.length,
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, type RefObject } from "react";
import { useSession } from "../app/session";
import { ensureVisit, track } from "./tracker";

/**
 * Records a page view when the learner leaves the page (or hides the tab), with the time spent on it. Only for
 * signed-in learners.
 */
export function usePageView(courseSlug?: string | null, enabled = true): void {
  const { me } = useSession();
  const userId = me?.user.id;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!userId || !enabled) return;
    let start = Date.now();
    let sent = false;
    void ensureVisit();
    const send = (keepalive: boolean) => {
      if (sent) return;
      sent = true;
      void track("page_view", courseSlug, Math.max(1, (Date.now() - start) / 1000), keepalive);
    };
    const onVisibility = () => {
      if (document.visibilityState === "hidden") send(true);
      else {
        start = Date.now();
        sent = false;
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
    const mounted = Date.now();
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
      // React mounts twice while it checks the code in development: a page "seen" for no time at all is not a view
      if (Date.now() - mounted >= 250) send(false);
    };
  }, [userId, courseSlug, enabled]);
}

/** Records an event once when an element has been at least half visible for a second (fees, reviews). */
export function useSeen(ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, eventType: string, courseSlug?: string | null): void {
  const { me } = useSession();
  const userId = me?.user.id;
  const done = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    done.current = false;
  }, [courseSlug]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el || !userId || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return;
    let timer: number | undefined;
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting && !done.current) {
          timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
            done.current = true;
            void track(eventType, courseSlug, 1);
          }, 1000);
        } else if (timer) {
          window.clearTimeout(timer);
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.5 },
    );
    io.observe(el);
    return () => {
      io.disconnect();
      if (timer) window.clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [ref, eventType, courseSlug, userId]);
}

/** At least 8 characters (the backend checks the same rule for learners; no forced mix of character types). */
export function passwordProblem(pw: string): string | null {
  if (pw.length < 8) return "Use at least 8 characters.";
  if (pw.length > 128) return "Use at most 128 characters.";
  return null;
}

export const EMAIL_RE = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

/**
 * What a signed-in learner does on the website goes to the backend, which re-scores them at once (the CRM's
 * real-time loop). A visit ("session") starts when a tab opens or after 30 minutes without activity; while the page
 * is in use the visit is kept alive every 30 seconds, so the CRM's "visit ended" follow-up waits until the learner
 * has really left. Nothing is recorded for visitors who are not signed in.
 */
import { getToken } from "../api/client";

const VISIT_KEY = "xe-visit";
const SOURCE_KEY = "xe-source";
const IDLE_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000;

interface Visit {
  id: number;
  last: number;
}

function readVisit(): Visit | null {
  try {
    const v = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(VISIT_KEY) ?? "null") as Visit | null;
    return v && Date.now() - v.last < IDLE_MS ? v : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function writeVisit(v: Visit | null): void {
  try {
    if (v) sessionStorage.setItem(VISIT_KEY, JSON.stringify(v));
    else sessionStorage.removeItem(VISIT_KEY);
  } catch {
    /* storage blocked: a new visit starts with every page */
  }
}

export function adoptVisit(id: number | null | undefined): void {
  if (id) writeVisit({ id, last: Date.now() });
}

export function forgetVisit(): void {
  writeVisit(null);
}

export function deviceType(): "Mobile" | "Tablet" | "Desktop" {
  const w = window.screen?.width || window.innerWidth;
  if (/iPad|Tablet/i.test(navigator.userAgent) || (w >= 600 && w < 1024 && "ontouchstart" in window)) return "Tablet";
  if (/Mobi|Android|iPhone/i.test(navigator.userAgent) || w < 600) return "Mobile";
  return "Desktop";
}

/** Where this visit came from (kept for the browser tab): an email, an ad, a search engine, or typed in. */
export function leadSource(): string {
  try {
    const kept = sessionStorage.getItem(SOURCE_KEY);
    if (kept) return kept;
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
  const p = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const utm = (p.get("utm_source") ?? "").toLowerCase();
  const ref = document.referrer.toLowerCase();
  let source = "Direct Traffic";
  if (p.get("ref")) source = "Email Campaign";
  else if (utm.includes("linkedin") || ref.includes("linkedin.")) source = "LinkedIn";
  else if (utm.includes("youtube") || ref.includes("youtube.")) source = "YouTube";
  else if (/facebook|instagram|twitter|x\.com/.test(utm + ref)) source = "Social Media";
  else if (utm.includes("google")) source = "Google";
  else if (/google\.|bing\.|duckduckgo\./.test(ref)) source = "Organic Search";
  else if (utm.includes("webinar")) source = "Webinar";
  else if (utm) source = "Reference";
  try {
    sessionStorage.setItem(SOURCE_KEY, source);
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
  return source;
}

async function post(path: string, body: unknown, keepalive = false): Promise<Response | null> {
  const token = getToken();
  if (!token) return null;
  try {
    return await fetch(`/api/v1${path}`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
      keepalive,
    });
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

let starting: Promise<number | null> | null = null;

/** The current visit's id, starting a new visit when needed. */
export async function ensureVisit(): Promise<number | null> {
  if (!getToken()) return null;
  const v = readVisit();
  if (v) {
    writeVisit({ id: v.id, last: Date.now() });
    return v.id;
  }
  starting ??= (async () => {
    const res = await post("/session/start", { device_type: deviceType(), lead_source: leadSource() });
    const data = res?.ok ? ((await res.json()) as { session_id: number }) : null;
    adoptVisit(data?.session_id);
    starting = null;
    return data?.session_id ?? null;
  })();
  return starting;
}

/** Records one event. Failures are ignored: tracking must never get in the learner's way. */
export async function track(
  eventType: string,
  courseSlug?: string | null,
  seconds = 0,
  keepalive = false,
): Promise<void> {
  const id = keepalive ? (readVisit()?.id ?? null) : await ensureVisit();
  if (!id) return;
  await post(
    "/track",
    { session_id: id, event_type: eventType, course_slug: courseSlug ?? null, time_spent_sec: Math.round(seconds) },
    keepalive,
  );
}

/** Keeps the visit alive every 30 seconds while the page is visible. Returns a function that stops it. */
export function keepVisitAlive(): () => void {
  const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
    const v = readVisit();
    if (!v || document.visibilityState !== "visible") return;
    writeVisit({ id: v.id, last: Date.now() });
    void post("/session/ping", { session_id: v.id });
  }, 30_000);
  return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
}

const reportedClicks = new Set<string>();

/** An email's button brought the learner here (?ref=<token>): the click is recorded, signed in or not. Once per page
 * load: React runs effects twice while it checks the code in development, and one click must count once. */
export async function reportEmailClick(token: string): Promise<void> {
  if (reportedClicks.has(token)) return;
  reportedClicks.add(token);
  try {
    await fetch("/api/v1/email/click", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ token }),
    });
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { errorText, money } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Button, buttonClass, Spinner, useToast } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { ShoppingBag } from "lucide-react";
import { Link } from "react-router";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import { useCart, useCourses } from "../api/queries";
import { CourseTile } from "../components/course";
import { usePageView } from "../lib/hooks";

export default function Cart() {
  usePageView();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  const cart = useCart();
  const courses = useCourses();
  const bySlug = new Map((courses.data ?? []).map((c) => [c.slug, c]));
  const remove = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (slug: string) => api.del<{ message: string }>(`/cart/${slug}`),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      toast({ tone: "info", text: r.message });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["cart"] });
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
  const items = cart.data ?? [];
  const total = items.reduce((s, i) => s + (bySlug.get(i.course_slug)?.price ?? i.price), 0);

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-[900px] px-5 pb-10 pt-12 sm:px-8">
      <h1 className="text-[34px] font-semibold leading-tight text-ink">Your cart</h1>
      {cart.isPending ? (
        <Spinner className="mt-8" />
      ) : items.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="mt-8 rounded-md border border-dashed border-line-strong px-5 py-10 text-center">
          <ShoppingBag aria-hidden className="mx-auto size-6 text-muted" />
          <p className="mt-2 text-[16px] text-ink">Your cart is empty.</p>
          <Link to="/courses" className={buttonClass("primary", "md", "mt-4")}>
            Find a course
          </Link>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <ul className="mt-8 divide-y divide-line border-y border-line">
            {items.map((i) => {
              const c = bySlug.get(i.course_slug);

                        {c.duration.toLowerCase()}, {c.level}
                      </p>
                    )}

                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    variant="ghost"
                    loading={remove.isPending && remove.variables === i.course_slug}
                    onClick={() => remove.mutate(i.course_slug)}
                  >
                    Remove
                  </Button>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>

            <Link to="/courses" className="text-[14px] font-medium text-brand-ink hover:underline">
