                Check out
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-3 text-right text-[13px] text-muted">A coupon can be added at checkout.</p>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { errorText, money } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Button, buttonClass, Field, Input, Notice, Spinner } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { Lock } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Link, useNavigate } from "react-router";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import { useCart, useCourses } from "../api/queries";
import type { CheckoutResult, Coupon, CouponCheck } from "../api/types";
import { usePageView } from "../lib/hooks";
import { track } from "../lib/tracker";

export default function Checkout() {
  usePageView();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const cart = useCart();
  const courses = useCourses();
  const coupons = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["coupons"],
    queryFn: () => api.get<{ coupons: Coupon[] }>("/coupons"),
    select: (d) => d.coupons.filter((c) => !c.used),
  });
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [applied, setApplied] = useState<CouponCheck | null>(null);
  const started = useRef(false);
  const items = cart.data ?? [];

  // opening the checkout is recorded once: the CRM follows up if the learner leaves without paying
  useEffect(() => {
    if (started.current || !items.length) return;
    started.current = true;
    void api.post("/checkout/start");
    void track("checkout_start");
  }, [items.length]);

  const check = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (c: string) => api.post<CouponCheck>("/coupons/check", { code: c }),
    onSuccess: setApplied,
  });
  const pay = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.post<CheckoutResult>("/checkout", { coupon_code: applied?.code ?? "" }),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      void qc.invalidateQueries();
      navigate("/thank-you", { replace: true, state: r });
    },
  });

  if (cart.isPending) return <Spinner className="m-12" />;
  if (!items.length) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[640px] px-5 py-16 sm:px-8">
        <h1 className="text-[30px] font-semibold text-ink">Nothing to pay for</h1>
        <p className="mt-2 text-[15px] text-ink-2">Your cart is empty.</p>
        <Link to="/courses" className={buttonClass("primary", "md", "mt-5")}>
          Find a course
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const price = (slug: string, fallback: number) => courses.data?.find((c) => c.slug === slug)?.price ?? fallback;
  const subtotal = items.reduce((s, i) => s + price(i.course_slug, i.price), 0);
  const discount = applied?.discount ?? 0;
  const total = subtotal - discount;

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-[900px] px-5 pb-10 pt-12 sm:px-8">
      <h1 className="text-[34px] font-semibold leading-tight text-ink">Checkout</h1>
      <div className="mt-8 grid grid-cols-1 gap-10 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_20rem]">
        <section aria-labelledby="order-title">
          <h2 id="order-title" className="text-[18px] font-semibold text-ink">
            Your order
          </h2>
          <dl className="mt-3 text-[15px]">
            {items.map((i) => (
              <div key={i.course_slug} className="flex items-baseline gap-4 border-b border-line py-2.5">
                <dt className="text-ink">{i.course_title}</dt>
                <dd className="num ml-auto text-ink">{money(price(i.course_slug, i.price))}</dd>
              </div>
            ))}
            {applied && (
              <div className="flex items-baseline gap-4 border-b border-line py-2.5">
                <dt className="text-ink-2">
                  Coupon {applied.code} ({applied.discount_pct}% off)
                </dt>
                <dd className="num ml-auto text-ink">−{money(discount)}</dd>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-4 border-t-[3px] border-double border-line-strong pt-3">
              <dt className="font-semibold text-ink">To pay</dt>
              <dd className="num ml-auto text-[20px] font-semibold text-ink">{money(total)}</dd>
            </div>
          </dl>

          <form
            className="mt-8 max-w-sm"
            onSubmit={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              if (code.trim()) check.mutate(code.trim());
            }}
          >
            <Field
              label="Coupon code"
              error={check.isError ? errorText(check.error) : null}
              trailing={
                <Button type="submit" loading={check.isPending} disabled={!code.trim()}>
                  Apply
                </Button>
              }
            >
              <Input
                value={code}
                onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
                className="num uppercase"
                maxLength={40}
              />
            </Field>
            {coupons.data && coupons.data.length > 0 && !applied && (
              <p className="mt-2 text-[13px] text-muted">
                You have {coupons.data.length === 1 ? "a coupon" : "coupons"}:{" "}
                {coupons.data.map((c, k) => (
                  <span key={c.id}>
                    {k > 0 && ", "}
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="num font-medium text-brand-ink hover:underline"
                      onClick={() => (setCode(c.coupon_code), check.mutate(c.coupon_code))}
                    >
                      {c.coupon_code}
                    </button>
                  </span>
                ))}
              </p>
            )}
          </form>
        </section>

        <aside className="rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface p-5">
          <h2 className="text-[16px] font-semibold text-ink">Payment</h2>
          <Notice tone="info" className="mt-3">
            This is a demonstration site: the payment is simulated, nothing is charged and no card details are asked
            for.
          </Notice>
          {pay.isError && (
            <Notice tone="bad" className="mt-3">
              {errorText(pay.error)}
            </Notice>
          )}
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            size="lg"
            className="mt-4 w-full"
            icon={<Lock aria-hidden className="size-4" />}
            loading={pay.isPending}
            onClick={() => pay.mutate()}
          >
            Pay {money(total)}
          </Button>
          <p className="mt-3 text-[13px] text-muted">
            Full refund within 7 days of enrolling. A receipt is emailed to you.
          </p>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { ApiError, cn, date, errorText, money } from "@xedu/shared/lib";

  buttonClass,

  Field,
  Notice,

const SLIDE_MS = 7000;

/** A 35-second overview of the programme in five slides (counts as watching the overview). */
function Overview({ course, onClose }: { course: Course; onClose: () => void }) {
  const [i, setI] = useState(0);
  const started = useRef(0);
  const slides = [
    { title: course.title, body: <p className="text-[18px] text-ink-2">{course.tagline}.</p> },
    {
      title: "What you will be able to do",
      body: (
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2 text-[17px] text-ink">
          {course.outcomes.map((o) => (
            <li key={o} className="flex gap-2.5">
              <Check aria-hidden className="mt-1 size-4 shrink-0 text-brand-ink" />
              {o}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ),
    },
    {
      title: `${course.curriculum.length} modules`,
      body: (
        <ol className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-6 gap-y-1.5 text-[15.5px] text-ink sm:grid-cols-2">
          {course.curriculum.map((m) => (
            <li key={m.module}>{m.title}</li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      ),
    },
    {
      title: "Who teaches it",
      body: (
        <p className="text-[17px] text-ink-2">
          {course.instructor.name}, {course.instructor.role.toLowerCase()}, with {course.instructor.exp} of experience.
          Live sessions every week, and the modules in between at your own pace.
        </p>
      ),
    },
    {
      title: `${course.duration.toLowerCase()}, ${money(course.price)}`,
      body: (
        <p className="text-[17px] text-ink-2">
          {course.emi ? `Or ${money(course.emi)} a month. ` : ""}A full refund if you change your mind within 7 days of
          enrolling.
        </p>
      ),
    },
  ];
  useEffect(() => {
    started.current = Date.now();
    return () => {
      const seconds = (Date.now() - started.current) / 1000;
      // React mounts twice while it checks the code in development: an overview "watched" for no time is not one
      if (seconds >= 0.25) void track("video_play", course.slug, seconds);
    };
  }, [course.slug]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (i >= slides.length - 1) return;
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setI((x) => x + 1), SLIDE_MS);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [i, slides.length]);
  const s = slides[i];
  return (
    <Dialog
      open
      onClose={onClose}
      size="lg"
      title={`${course.title}: the overview`}
      description="Five slides, about 35 seconds."
    >
      <div className="flex gap-1" aria-hidden>
        {slides.map((_, k) => (
          <span key={k} className="h-1 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-sunken">
            <span
              className={cn(
                "block h-full bg-brand",
                k < i ? "w-full" : k === i ? "w-full origin-left animate-[grow_7s_linear]" : "w-0",
              )}
              style={k === i ? { animationDuration: `${SLIDE_MS}ms` } : undefined}
            />
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="flex min-h-64 flex-col justify-center py-8" aria-live="polite">
        <h3 className="text-[26px] font-semibold text-ink">{s.title}</h3>
        <div className="mt-4">{s.body}</div>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={i === 0} onClick={() => setI(i - 1)}>
          Previous
        </Button>
        <span className="num text-[13px] text-muted">
          {i + 1} of {slides.length}
        </span>
        {i < slides.length - 1 ? (
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setI(i + 1)}>
            Next
          </Button>
        ) : (
          <Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={onClose}>
            Done
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function Stars({ rating }: { rating: number }) {
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5" role="img" aria-label={`${rating} out of 5`}>
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => (
        <svg
          key={n}
          viewBox="0 0 20 20"
          className={cn("size-4", n <= rating ? "text-brand" : "text-line-strong")}
          aria-hidden
        >
          <path fill="currentColor" d="M10 1.5l2.6 5.3 5.9.9-4.3 4.1 1 5.8L10 14.9l-5.2 2.7 1-5.8L1.5 7.7l5.9-.9z" />
        </svg>
      ))}
    </span>
  );
}

function Reviews({ slug, enrolled }: { slug: string; enrolled: boolean }) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  const ref = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  useSeen(ref, "testimonial_view", slug);
  const reviews = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["reviews", slug],
    queryFn: () => api.get<{ reviews: Review[] }>(`/reviews/${slug}`),
  });
  const [rating, setRating] = useState("5");
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const write = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      api.post<{ message: string }>("/reviews", { course_slug: slug, rating: Number(rating), review_text: text }),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      toast({ tone: "good", text: r.message });
      setText("");
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["reviews", slug] });
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
  const list = reviews.data?.reviews ?? [];
  const avg = list.length ? list.reduce((s, r) => s + r.rating, 0) / list.length : null;
  return (
    <section ref={ref} aria-labelledby="reviews-title" className="scroll-mt-24">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-4">
        <h2 id="reviews-title" className="text-[24px] font-semibold text-ink">
          Reviews
        </h2>
        {avg !== null && (
          <p className="text-[14px] text-muted">
            {avg.toFixed(1)} out of 5 from {list.length} {list.length === 1 ? "learner" : "learners"} who enrolled
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
      {reviews.isPending ? (
        <Spinner className="mt-4" />
      ) : list.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="mt-3 text-[15px] text-muted">No reviews yet. Only people who enrolled can review a course.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="mt-4 flex flex-col divide-y divide-line border-y border-line">
          {list.slice(0, 8).map((r) => (
            <li key={r.id} className="py-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <Stars rating={r.rating} />
                <span className="text-[14px] font-medium text-ink">{r.name}</span>
                <span className="text-[13px] text-muted">{date(r.created_at)}</span>
              </div>
              {r.review_text && <p className="mt-1.5 max-w-[70ch] text-[15px] text-ink-2">{r.review_text}</p>}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {enrolled && (
        <form
          className="mt-5 max-w-xl rounded-md border border-line bg-surface p-4"
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            write.mutate();
          }}
        >
          <p className="text-[14px] font-medium text-ink">Review this course</p>
          <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-[9rem_1fr]">
            <Field label="Rating">
              <Select
                value={rating}
                onChange={(e) => setRating(e.target.value)}
                options={[5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map((n) => ({ value: String(n), label: `${n} out of 5` }))}
              />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Your review" optional>
              <Textarea rows={3} value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} maxLength={2000} />
            </Field>
          </div>
          <Button type="submit" size="sm" variant="primary" className="mt-3" loading={write.isPending}>
            Publish the review
          </Button>
        </form>
      )}

}

function Questions({ slug }: { slug: string }) {

export default function CourseDetail() {
  const { slug = "" } = useParams();
  const { me } = useSession();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();

    enabled: Boolean(me),
    select: (d) => d.purchases,
  });
  const course = useQuery({ queryKey: ["course", slug], queryFn: () => api.get<Course>(`/courses/${slug}`) });
  const fees = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const [overview, setOverview] = useState(false);
  const [calling, setCalling] = useState(false);
  usePageView(slug, course.isSuccess);
  useSeen(fees, "pricing_view", slug);

  const inCart = Boolean(cart.data?.some((c) => c.course_slug === slug));
  const saved = Boolean(wishlist.data?.some((w) => w.course_slug === slug));
  const enrolled = Boolean(purchases.data?.some((p) => p.course_slug === slug));

  const signInFirst = () => navigate("/login", { state: { from: location.pathname } });
  const addToCart = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.post<{ message: string }>("/cart", { course_slug: slug }),
    onSuccess: () => {
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["cart"] });
      navigate("/cart");
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
  const save = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      saved
        ? api.del<{ message: string }>(`/wishlist/${slug}`)
        : api.post<{ message: string }>("/wishlist", { course_slug: slug }),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      toast({ tone: "good", text: r.message });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["wishlist"] });
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });

  if (course.isPending) return <Spinner className="m-12" label="Loading the course" />;
  if (course.isError) {
    const missing = course.error instanceof ApiError && course.error.status === 404;
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1200px] px-5 py-16 sm:px-8">
        <EmptyState
          icon={BookOpen}
          title={missing ? "This course does not exist" : "This course could not be loaded"}
          action={
            <Link to="/courses" className={buttonClass("primary")}>
              See all courses
            </Link>
          }
        >
          {missing ? "It may have been renamed. Every course is on the courses page." : errorText(course.error)}
        </EmptyState>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const c = course.data;

  const enrol = enrolled ? (
    <Link to="/my-learning" className={buttonClass("primary", "lg", "w-full")}>
      Go to my learning
    </Link>
  ) : inCart ? (
    <Link to="/cart" className={buttonClass("primary", "lg", "w-full")}>
      In your cart: check out
    </Link>
  ) : (
    <Button
      variant="primary"
      size="lg"
      className="w-full"
      loading={addToCart.isPending}
      onClick={() => (me ? addToCart.mutate() : signInFirst())}
    >
      Enrol now
    </Button>
  );

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1200px] px-5 pb-10 pt-8 sm:px-8">
      <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb" className="text-[13.5px] text-muted">
        <Link to="/courses" className="hover:text-ink">
          Courses
        </Link>
        <span aria-hidden className="mx-2">
          /
        </span>
        <Link to={`/courses#${c.domain.replace(/\W+/g, "-").toLowerCase()}`} className="hover:text-ink">
          {DOMAIN_SHORT[c.domain] ?? c.domain}
        </Link>

import { Input, Spinner } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { Search } from "lucide-react";

import { CourseRow } from "../components/course";
import { byDomain, DOMAIN_SHORT } from "../lib/course";
import { usePageView } from "../lib/hooks";

export default function Courses() {
  usePageView();
  const courses = useCourses();
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  const needle = q.trim().toLowerCase();
  const shown = (courses.data ?? []).filter(
    (c) =>
      !needle ||
      [c.title, c.tagline, c.domain, ...c.outcomes, ...c.curriculum.map((m) => m.title)]
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(needle),
  );
  const groups = byDomain(shown);

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1200px] px-5 pb-10 pt-12 sm:px-8">
      <h1 className="text-[34px] font-semibold leading-tight text-ink sm:text-[40px]">All courses</h1>
      <p className="mt-3 max-w-[62ch] text-[16px] text-ink-2">
        24 programmes in eight areas. Every one is online, with weekly live sessions and a capstone project.
      </p>
      <div className="mt-8 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-4">
        <div className="relative w-full max-w-sm">
          <Search
            aria-hidden
            className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted"
          />
          <Input
            type="search"
            aria-label="Search the courses"
            placeholder="Search: SQL, branding, Excel, hiring"
            value={q}
            onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
            className="h-10 pl-9"
          />
        </div>
        <nav aria-label="Areas" className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-[14px]">
          {groups.map((g) => (
            <a
              key={g.domain}

              className="text-ink-2 hover:text-brand-ink"
            >
              {DOMAIN_SHORT[g.domain] ?? g.domain}
            </a>
          ))}
        </nav>
      </div>
      {courses.isPending ? (
        <Spinner className="mt-10" label="Loading the courses" />
      ) : groups.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="mt-10 text-[15px] text-muted">
          No course mentions &ldquo;{q}&rdquo;. Try a broader word, or ask the help assistant.
        </p>
      ) : (

import { useMutation, useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { errorText } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Button, buttonClass, Checkbox, Field, Input, Notice, Spinner } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Link, useParams } from "react-router";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import type { Course } from "../api/types";
import { useMe } from "../app/session";
import { AuthFrame } from "../components/AuthFrame";
import { leadSource } from "../lib/tracker";

/** An enquiry about one course: always answered by email; a counsellor may call if they left a number. */
export default function Enquiry() {
  const { slug = "" } = useParams();
  const me = useMe();
  const course = useQuery({ queryKey: ["course", slug], queryFn: () => api.get<Course>(`/courses/${slug}`) });
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState(me.profile?.phone ?? "");
  const [whatsapp, setWhatsapp] = useState(Boolean(me.profile?.whatsapp_opt_in));
  const send = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      api.post<{ message: string }>("/enquiry", {
        course_slug: slug,
        course_type: course.data?.title,
        phone: phone.trim() || null,
        whatsapp_opt_in: whatsapp ? 1 : 0,
        lead_source: leadSource(),
      }),
  });
  if (course.isPending) return <Spinner className="m-12" />;
  if (course.isError) return <p className="m-12 text-muted">This course could not be found.</p>;
  const submit = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    send.mutate();
  };
  if (send.isSuccess) {
    return (
      <AuthFrame title="Enquiry sent" description={send.data.message}>
        <Link to={`/courses/${slug}`} className={buttonClass("primary", "lg")}>
          Back to {course.data.title}
        </Link>
      </AuthFrame>
    );
  }
  return (
    <AuthFrame
      title={`Ask about ${course.data.title}`}
      description="We email you the details: dates, fees and the next steps. Add a number if you would like a call."
    >
      <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4" noValidate>
        {send.isError && <Notice tone="bad">{errorText(send.error)}</Notice>}
        <Field label="Phone" optional>
          <Input
            type="tel"
            autoComplete="tel"
            value={phone}
            onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="+91 98765 43210"
            maxLength={20}
          />
        </Field>
        <Checkbox
          checked={whatsapp}
          onChange={(e) => setWhatsapp(e.target.checked)}
          label="WhatsApp me about this course"
          description="You can switch this off at any time in your settings."
          disabled={!phone.trim()}
        />
        <Button type="submit" variant="primary" size="lg" loading={send.isPending}>
          Send the enquiry
        </Button>
      </form>
    </AuthFrame>
  );
}

import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { errorText } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Button, Field, Input, Notice } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Link, useNavigate } from "react-router";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import { AuthFrame } from "../components/AuthFrame";
import { EMAIL_RE } from "../lib/password";

export default function ForgotPassword() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const send = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.post<{ message: string }>("/auth/forgot-password", { email: email.trim() }),
    onSuccess: (r) =>
      navigate(`/reset-password?email=${encodeURIComponent(email.trim().toLowerCase())}`, {
        state: { message: r.message },
      }),
  });
  const submit = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (EMAIL_RE.test(email.trim())) send.mutate();
  };
  return (
    <AuthFrame
      title="Reset your password"
      description="Enter the email address of your account. We send a code to set a new password."
      footer={
        <Link to="/login" className="font-medium text-brand-ink hover:underline">
          Back to sign in
        </Link>
      }
    >
      <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4" noValidate>
        {send.isError && <Notice tone="bad">{errorText(send.error)}</Notice>}
        <Field label="Email address">
          <Input type="email" autoComplete="email" value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} autoFocus />
        </Field>
        <Button
          type="submit"
          variant="primary"
          size="lg"
          loading={send.isPending}
          disabled={!EMAIL_RE.test(email.trim())}
        >
          Send the code
        </Button>
      </form>
    </AuthFrame>
  );
}

import { useMutation, useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";

type Who = "student" | "working" | "seeking" | "business";
type Time = "short" | "medium" | "long";

const WHO: { value: Who; label: string }[] = [
  { value: "student", label: "a student" },
  { value: "working", label: "working" },
  { value: "seeking", label: "looking for work" },
  { value: "business", label: "running a business" },
];

const TIME: { value: Time; label: string; max: number; min: number }[] = [
  { value: "short", label: "up to 3 months", min: 0, max: 3 },
  { value: "medium", label: "4 to 6 months", min: 4, max: 6 },
  { value: "long", label: "longer than 6 months", min: 7, max: 99 },
];

/** How well a course fits the answers: the area and the time first, then the level that suits the person. */
function fit(c: Course, who: Who | null, areas: string[], time: Time | null): { score: number; why: string[] } {
  const why: string[] = [];
  let score = 0;
  if (areas.length) {
    if (!areas.includes(c.domain)) return { score: -1, why };
    score += 3;
  }
  if (time) {
    const t = TIME.find((x) => x.value === time)!;
    const m = months(c);
    if (m < t.min || m > t.max) return { score: -1, why };
    score += 2;
    why.push(c.duration.toLowerCase());
  }
  const level = c.level.toLowerCase();
  if (who === "student" || who === "seeking") {
    if (level.startsWith("advanced")) return { score: -1, why };
    if (level.startsWith("beginner")) {
      score += 2;
      why.push("no experience needed");
    }
  } else if (who === "working") {
    if (!level.startsWith("beginner")) score += 1;
    if (c.slug === "executive-mba") score += 2;
  } else if (who === "business") {
    if (["MBA", "E-Commerce", "Digital Marketing", "Finance & Banking"].includes(c.domain)) score += 2;
    if (c.slug === "mba-entrepreneurship" || c.slug === "d2c-brand-building") score += 2;
  }
  return { score, why };
}

function Chip({ selected, onClick, children }: { selected: boolean; onClick: () => void; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-pressed={selected}
      onClick={onClick}
      className={cn(
        "rounded-full border px-3.5 py-1.5 text-[14px] transition-colors",
        selected
          ? "border-brand bg-brand text-on-brand"
          : "border-line-strong bg-surface text-ink-2 hover:border-brand hover:text-ink",
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

              .map((c) => {

                    )}
                  >

function nextSaturday(): Date {
  const d = new Date();
  const add = (6 - d.getDay() + 7) % 7 || (d.getHours() >= 12 ? 7 : 0);
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + add);
  d.setHours(11, 0, 0, 0);
  return d;
}

        <div className="flex size-24 flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-line-strong bg-canvas text-center">

function Faq() {
  const faq = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["faq"],
    queryFn: () => api.get<{ faq: { key: string; question: string; answer: string }[] }>("/faq"),
    staleTime: Infinity,
  });
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<string | null>("schedule");
  if (!faq.data) return null;
  return (
    <ul className="divide-y divide-line border-y border-line">
      {faq.data.faq.map((f) => {
        const isOpen = open === f.key;
        return (
          <li key={f.key}>
            <h3 className="font-sans">
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-expanded={isOpen}
                onClick={() => setOpen(isOpen ? null : f.key)}
                className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-4 py-4 text-left text-[16px] font-medium text-ink"
              >
                {f.question}
                <ChevronDown
                  aria-hidden
                  className={cn("size-4 shrink-0 text-muted transition-transform", isOpen && "rotate-180")}
                />
              </button>
            </h3>
            {isOpen && <p className="max-w-[70ch] pb-5 text-[15px] text-ink-2">{f.answer}</p>}
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}

export default function Home() {
  usePageView();
  const location = useLocation();
  const courses = useCourses();
  const [who, setWho] = useState<Who | null>(null);
  const [areas, setAreas] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [time, setTime] = useState<Time | null>(null);
  const [calling, setCalling] = useState(false);
  const active = who !== null || areas.length > 0 || time !== null;

  const ranked = useMemo(() => {
    const all = courses.data ?? [];
    return all
      .map((c) => ({ c, ...fit(c, who, areas, time) }))
      .filter((x) => x.score >= 0)
      .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.c.price - b.c.price);
  }, [courses.data, who, areas, time]);
  const match = active ? new Set(ranked.map((r) => r.c.slug)) : null;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (location.hash) document.getElementById(location.hash.slice(1))?.scrollIntoView();
  }, [location.hash, courses.data]);

  const toggleArea = (d: string) => setAreas((a) => (a.includes(d) ? a.filter((x) => x !== d) : [...a, d]));

  return (
    <>
      <section className="mx-auto max-w-[1200px] px-5 pb-16 pt-12 sm:px-8 sm:pt-16">
        <h1 className="max-w-[18ch] text-[36px] font-semibold leading-[1.08] tracking-[-0.02em] text-ink sm:text-[48px]">
          Find the course that fits where you are now.
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-4 max-w-[62ch] text-[16.5px] text-ink-2">
          24 online programmes in data, marketing, management, finance, HR, operations and e-commerce. Live sessions
          every week, a project you can show, and a counsellor when you want one.
        </p>

        <div className="mt-10" aria-label="Course finder">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3.5">
            <div
              role="group"
              aria-labelledby="finder-who"
              className="grid grid-cols-1 items-baseline gap-2.5 sm:grid-cols-[9.5rem_1fr]"
            >
              <span id="finder-who" className="text-[14.5px] font-medium text-ink">
                I am
              </span>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {WHO.map((w) => (
                  <Chip
                    key={w.value}
                    selected={who === w.value}
                    onClick={() => setWho(who === w.value ? null : w.value)}
                  >
                    {w.label}
                  </Chip>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div
              role="group"
              aria-labelledby="finder-area"
              className="grid grid-cols-1 items-baseline gap-2.5 sm:grid-cols-[9.5rem_1fr]"
            >
              <span id="finder-area" className="text-[14.5px] font-medium text-ink">
                I want to grow in
              </span>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {DOMAIN_ORDER.map((d) => (
                  <Chip key={d} selected={areas.includes(d)} onClick={() => toggleArea(d)}>
                    {DOMAIN_SHORT[d]}
                  </Chip>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div
              role="group"
              aria-labelledby="finder-time"
              className="grid grid-cols-1 items-baseline gap-2.5 sm:grid-cols-[9.5rem_1fr]"
            >

              </span>

                    key={t.value}
                    selected={time === t.value}
                    onClick={() => setTime(time === t.value ? null : t.value)}
                  >
                    {t.label}
                  </Chip>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[14px] text-muted sm:pl-[10.1rem]" aria-live="polite">
              {!active
                ? "Choose what applies; the matching courses light up."
                : ranked.length === 0
                  ? "Nothing fits all three. Try a longer time or another area."
                  : `${ranked.length} ${ranked.length === 1 ? "course fits" : "courses fit"}.`}

                  type="button"
                  className="ml-2 font-medium text-brand-ink hover:underline"

            <ul className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-6 gap-y-1 md:grid-cols-2">
              {ranked.slice(0, 6).map((r) => (
                <li key={r.c.slug}>
                  <CourseRow course={r.c} />
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
            {ranked.length > 6 && (
              <Link to="/courses" className="mt-3 inline-block text-[14px] font-medium text-brand-ink hover:underline">
                See all {ranked.length} that fit, and every other course
              </Link>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </section>

      <LiveSession />

      <section className="mx-auto grid grid-cols-1 max-w-[1200px] gap-12 px-5 py-16 sm:px-8 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,20rem)_minmax(0,1fr)]">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-[26px] font-semibold text-ink">Questions people ask first</h2>
          <p className="mt-2 text-[15px] text-ink-2">

          </p>

              Talk to a counsellor

import { ApiError, errorText } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Button, Field, Input, Notice } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Link, Navigate, useLocation, useNavigate } from "react-router";
import { useSession } from "../app/session";
import { AuthFrame } from "../components/AuthFrame";

export default function Login() {
  const { me, signIn } = useSession();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const from = (location.state as { from?: string } | null)?.from;
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<unknown>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  if (me) return <Navigate to={from ?? "/my-learning"} replace />;

  const submit = async (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const r = await signIn(email.trim(), password);
      navigate(r.profile_complete ? (from ?? "/my-learning") : "/welcome", { replace: true, state: { from } });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const unverified = error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 403;

  return (
    <AuthFrame
      title="Sign in"
      footer={
        <>
          New here?{" "}
          <Link to="/signup" state={{ from }} className="font-medium text-brand-ink hover:underline">
            Create a free account
          </Link>
        </>
      }
    >
      <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4" noValidate>
        {Boolean(error) && (
          <Notice tone="bad">
            {errorText(error)}{" "}
            {unverified && (
              <Link to={`/verify?email=${encodeURIComponent(email.trim())}`} className="font-medium underline">
                Enter the code
              </Link>
            )}
          </Notice>
        )}
        <Field label="Email address">
          <Input
            type="email"
            autoComplete="username"
            value={email}
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            autoFocus
          />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Password">
          <Input
            type="password"
            autoComplete="current-password"
            value={password}
            onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
          />
        </Field>
        <Button type="submit" variant="primary" size="lg" loading={busy} disabled={!email || !password}>
          Sign in
        </Button>
        <Link to="/forgot-password" className="text-[14px] font-medium text-brand-ink hover:underline">
          Forgotten your password?
        </Link>
      </form>
    </AuthFrame>
  );
}

import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { errorText } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Button, Field, Input, Notice, useToast } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Link, useLocation, useNavigate, useSearchParams } from "react-router";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import { AuthFrame } from "../components/AuthFrame";
import { passwordProblem } from "../lib/password";

export default function ResetPassword() {
  const [params] = useSearchParams();
  const location = useLocation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();
  const message = (location.state as { message?: string } | null)?.message;
  const [email, setEmail] = useState(params.get("email") ?? "");
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [tried, setTried] = useState(false);
  const reset = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      api.post<{ message: string }>("/auth/reset-password", {
        email: email.trim(),
        otp: code.trim(),
        new_password: password,
      }),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      toast({ tone: "good", text: r.message });
      navigate("/login", { replace: true });
    },
  });
  const pwError = tried ? passwordProblem(password) : null;
  const submit = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setTried(true);
    if (email && code.length === 6 && !passwordProblem(password)) reset.mutate();
  };
  return (
    <AuthFrame
      title="Choose a new password"
      description="Enter the 6-digit code from the email and a new password."
      footer={
        <Link to="/forgot-password" className="font-medium text-brand-ink hover:underline">
          Send a new code
        </Link>
      }
    >
      <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4" noValidate>
        {message && !reset.isError && <Notice tone="info">{message}</Notice>}
        {reset.isError && <Notice tone="bad">{errorText(reset.error)}</Notice>}
        {!params.get("email") && (
          <Field label="Email address">
            <Input type="email" autoComplete="email" value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} />
          </Field>
        )}
        <Field label="Code">
          <Input
            inputMode="numeric"
            autoComplete="one-time-code"
            value={code}
            onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 6))}
            className="num text-center text-[18px] tracking-[0.3em]"
            autoFocus
          />
        </Field>
        <Field label="New password" error={pwError} hint="At least 8 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.">
          <Input
            type="password"
            autoComplete="new-password"
            value={password}
            onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
          />
        </Field>
        <Button
          type="submit"
          variant="primary"
          size="lg"
          loading={reset.isPending}
          disabled={code.length < 6 || !password}
        >
          Set the new password
        </Button>
      </form>
    </AuthFrame>
  );
}

function ProfileForm() {
  const me = useMe();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  const p = me.profile;
  const options = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["profile-options"],
    queryFn: () => api.get<ProfileOptions>("/profile/options"),
    staleTime: Infinity,
  });
  const clean = (v: string | null | undefined) => (v && v !== "Unknown" ? v : "");
  const [occupation, setOccupation] = useState(clean(p?.current_occupation));
  const [field, setField] = useState(clean(p?.specialization));
  const [city, setCity] = useState(clean(p?.city));
  const [age, setAge] = useState(clean(p?.age_bracket));
  const save = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      api.post<{ message: string }>("/profile/complete", {
        current_occupation: occupation,
        specialization: field,
        age_bracket: age || null,
        city: city.trim() || "Unknown",
        phone: null,
        how_did_you_hear: p?.how_did_you_hear ?? "Unknown",
      }),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      toast({ tone: "good", text: r.message });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["me"] });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["recommendations"] });
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
  const o = options.data;
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <Field label="What you do now">
        <Select
          value={occupation}
          onChange={(e) => setOccupation(e.target.value)}
          options={[
            { value: "", label: "Choose one" },
            ...(o?.occupations ?? []).map((v) => ({ value: v, label: OCCUPATION_LABEL[v] ?? v })),
          ]}
        />
      </Field>
      <Field label="Your field">
        <Select
          value={field}
          onChange={(e) => setField(e.target.value)}
          options={[
            { value: "", label: "Choose one" },
            ...(o?.specializations ?? []).map((v) => ({ value: v, label: v })),
          ]}
        />
      </Field>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <Field label="Age" optional>
          <Select
            value={age}
            onChange={(e) => setAge(e.target.value)}
            options={[
              { value: "", label: "Rather not say" },
              ...(o?.age_brackets ?? []).map((v) => ({ value: v, label: v })),
            ]}
          />
        </Field>
        <Field label="City" optional>
          <Input value={city} onChange={(e) => setCity(e.target.value)} maxLength={60} />
        </Field>
      </div>
      <div>
        <Button
          variant="primary"
          loading={save.isPending}
          disabled={!occupation || !field}
          onClick={() => save.mutate()}
        >
          Save the profile
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Preferences() {
  const me = useMe();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  const p = me.profile;
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState(p?.phone ?? "");
  const update = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (body: Record<string, unknown>) => api.put<{ message: string }>("/profile/preferences", body),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      toast({ tone: "good", text: r.message });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["me"] });
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
      <Switch
        checked={p?.do_not_email !== "Yes"}
        onChange={(v) => update.mutate({ do_not_email: !v })}
        disabled={update.isPending}
        label="Emails about courses"
        description="Course news, reminders and offers. Account emails (codes, receipts) are always sent."
      />
      <Switch
        checked={p?.do_not_call !== "Yes"}
        onChange={(v) => update.mutate({ do_not_call: !v })}
        disabled={update.isPending}
        label="Calls from a counsellor"
        description="Only when you have given a phone number."
      />
      <Switch
        checked={Boolean(p?.whatsapp_opt_in)}
        onChange={(v) => update.mutate({ whatsapp_opt_in: v })}
        disabled={update.isPending || !p?.phone}
        label="WhatsApp messages"
        description={p?.phone ? "Short messages about the courses you looked at." : "Add a phone number first."}
      />
      <form
        className="flex items-end gap-2"
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          update.mutate({ phone: phone.trim() });
        }}
      >
        <Field label="Phone" className="flex-1">
          <Input
            type="tel"
            autoComplete="tel"
            value={phone}
            onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="+91 98765 43210"
            maxLength={20}
          />
        </Field>
        <Button type="submit" disabled={phone.trim() === (p?.phone ?? "")}>
          Save
        </Button>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

function PasswordForm() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState("");
  const [next, setNext] = useState("");
  const change = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      api.post<{ message: string; token: string }>("/auth/change-password", {
        current_password: current,
        new_password: next,
      }),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      // a new password signs out every other session; this one goes on with the new token
      setToken(r.token);
      toast({ tone: "good", text: r.message });
      setCurrent("");
      setNext("");
    },
  });
  const problem = next ? passwordProblem(next) : null;
  return (
    <form
      className="flex flex-col gap-4"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (current && !passwordProblem(next)) change.mutate();
      }}
    >
      {change.isError && <Notice tone="bad">{errorText(change.error)}</Notice>}
      <Field label="Current password">
        <Input
          type="password"
          autoComplete="current-password"
          value={current}
          onChange={(e) => setCurrent(e.target.value)}
        />
      </Field>
      <Field label="New password" error={problem} hint="At least 8 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.">
        <Input type="password" autoComplete="new-password" value={next} onChange={(e) => setNext(e.target.value)} />
      </Field>
      <div>
        <Button type="submit" loading={change.isPending} disabled={!current || !next || Boolean(problem)}>
          Change the password
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

interface Insights {
  lead_score: number;
  tier: string;
  probability: number;
  factors: { factor: string; detail: string; impact: string; points: number }[];
}

function YourData() {
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  const insights = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["insights"],
    queryFn: () => api.get<Insights>("/me/insights"),
    enabled: show,
  });
  return (
    <div>
      <p className="text-[14.5px] text-ink-2">
        While you are signed in we record the pages you open, how long you stay, and what you add to your cart or
        wishlist. From that, a model works out how interested you seem, which decides the suggestions and follow-ups you
        get.
      </p>
      {!show ? (
        <Button className="mt-4" onClick={() => setShow(true)}>
          Show what the model sees now
        </Button>
      ) : insights.isPending ? (
        <p className="mt-4 text-[14px] text-muted">Working it out</p>
      ) : insights.isError ? (
        <p className="mt-4 text-[14px] text-muted">{errorText(insights.error)}</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-4 rounded-md border border-line bg-surface p-4">
          <p className="text-[14.5px] text-ink">
            Interest score <span className="num font-semibold">{Math.round(insights.data.lead_score)}</span> out of 100.
          </p>
          <ul className="mt-2 flex flex-col gap-1 text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">
            {insights.data.factors.slice(0, 6).map((f) => (
              <li key={f.factor} className="flex gap-3">
                <span className="flex-1">
                  {f.factor} <span className="text-muted">({f.detail})</span>
                </span>
                <span className="num">{f.impact}</span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function DeleteAccount() {
  const signOutHome = useSignOutHome();

  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState("");
  const remove = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.del("/me"),

      </p>

        Delete my account
      </Button>
      <Dialog
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        size="sm"
        title="Delete your account?"
        description="Everything about you is removed from X Education. Type DELETE to confirm."
        footer={
          <>
            <Button onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Keep my account</Button>
            <Button
              variant="danger"
              loading={remove.isPending}
              disabled={confirm !== "DELETE"}
              onClick={() => remove.mutate()}

        <Field label="Confirmation">
          <Input value={confirm} onChange={(e) => setConfirm(e.target.value)} autoComplete="off" />
        </Field>
      </Dialog>
    </>
  );
}

import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { errorText } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Button, Field, Input, Notice } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Link, Navigate, useLocation, useNavigate } from "react-router";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import { useSession } from "../app/session";
import { AuthFrame } from "../components/AuthFrame";
import { EMAIL_RE, passwordProblem } from "../lib/password";

export default function Signup() {
  const { me } = useSession();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const from = (location.state as { from?: string } | null)?.from;
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [tried, setTried] = useState(false);
  const signup = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      api.post<{ message: string }>("/auth/signup", { name: name.trim(), email: email.trim(), password }),
    onSuccess: (r) =>
      navigate(`/verify?email=${encodeURIComponent(email.trim().toLowerCase())}`, {
        state: { message: r.message, from },
      }),
  });
  if (me) return <Navigate to="/my-learning" replace />;

  const nameError = tried && !name.trim() ? "Enter your name." : null;
  const emailError = tried && !EMAIL_RE.test(email.trim()) ? "Enter an email address like name@example.com." : null;
  const pwError = tried ? passwordProblem(password) : null;
  const submit = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setTried(true);
    if (name.trim() && EMAIL_RE.test(email.trim()) && !passwordProblem(password)) signup.mutate();
  };

  return (
    <AuthFrame
      title="Create your free account"
      description="Save courses, ask questions, book a call with a counsellor, and enrol when you are ready."
      footer={
        <>
          Already have an account?{" "}
          <Link to="/login" state={{ from }} className="font-medium text-brand-ink hover:underline">
            Sign in
          </Link>
        </>
      }
    >
      <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4" noValidate>
        {signup.isError && <Notice tone="bad">{errorText(signup.error)}</Notice>}
        <Field label="Your name" error={nameError}>
          <Input autoComplete="name" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} maxLength={80} autoFocus />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Email address" error={emailError} hint="We send a 6-digit code to check it is yours.">
          <Input
            type="email"
            autoComplete="email"
            value={email}
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            maxLength={120}
          />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Password" error={pwError} hint="At least 8 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.">
          <Input
            type="password"
            autoComplete="new-password"
            value={password}
            onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
            maxLength={128}
          />
        </Field>
        <Button type="submit" variant="primary" size="lg" loading={signup.isPending}>
          Create the account
        </Button>
        <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">
          By creating an account you agree that we record the pages you visit while signed in, to suggest courses. You
          can delete the account and everything about you at any time. See{" "}
          <Link to="/privacy" className="text-brand-ink hover:underline">
            Privacy
          </Link>
          .
        </p>
      </form>
    </AuthFrame>
  );
}

import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { errorText } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Button, buttonClass, Notice } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { Link, useSearchParams } from "react-router";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import { AuthFrame } from "../components/AuthFrame";

/** The one-click unsubscribe link from every marketing email (/unsubscribe?t=<token>). */
export default function Unsubscribe() {
  const [params] = useSearchParams();
  const token = params.get("t") ?? "";
  const unsubscribe = useMutation({ mutationFn: () => api.post<{ message: string }>("/email/unsubscribe", { token }) });
  if (!token) {
    return (
      <AuthFrame
        title="Unsubscribe"
        description="This page needs the link from one of our emails. You can also switch emails off in your settings."
      >
        <Link to="/settings" className={buttonClass("primary", "lg")}>
          Open my settings
        </Link>
      </AuthFrame>
    );
  }
  return (
    <AuthFrame
      title={unsubscribe.isSuccess ? "No more emails about courses" : "Stop emails about courses?"}
      description="You will still get account emails such as sign-in codes and receipts."
    >
      {unsubscribe.isSuccess ? (
        <Notice tone="good">{unsubscribe.data.message}</Notice>
      ) : (
        <>
          {unsubscribe.isError && (
            <Notice tone="bad" className="mb-4">
              {errorText(unsubscribe.error)}
            </Notice>
          )}
          <Button variant="primary" size="lg" loading={unsubscribe.isPending} onClick={() => unsubscribe.mutate()}>
            Unsubscribe
          </Button>
        </>
      )}
    </AuthFrame>
  );
}

import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { errorText } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Button, Field, Input, Notice, useToast } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Link, useLocation, useNavigate, useSearchParams } from "react-router";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import type { SignInResponse } from "../api/types";
import { useSession } from "../app/session";
import { AuthFrame } from "../components/AuthFrame";

export default function Verify() {
  const { adopt } = useSession();
  const toast = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const [params] = useSearchParams();
  const state = location.state as { message?: string; from?: string } | null;
  const [email, setEmail] = useState(params.get("email") ?? "");
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const verify = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.post<SignInResponse>("/auth/verify-otp", { email: email.trim(), otp: code.trim() }),
    onSuccess: async (r) => {
      await adopt(r);
      toast({ tone: "good", text: r.message ?? "Email verified." });
      navigate(r.profile_complete ? (state?.from ?? "/my-learning") : "/welcome", {
        replace: true,
        state: { from: state?.from },
      });
    },
  });
  const resend = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.post<{ message: string }>("/auth/resend-otp", { email: email.trim() }),
    onSuccess: (r) => toast({ tone: "info", text: r.message }),
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
  const submit = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (email.trim() && code.trim().length >= 4) verify.mutate();
  };
  return (
    <AuthFrame
      title="Check your email"
      description={
        email ? `Enter the 6-digit code we sent to ${email}.` : "Enter your email address and the 6-digit code we sent."
      }
      footer={
        <>
          No code after a minute? Look in the spam folder, or{" "}
          <button
            type="button"
            className="font-medium text-brand-ink hover:underline disabled:opacity-50"
            disabled={!email || resend.isPending}
            onClick={() => resend.mutate()}
          >
            send a new code
          </button>
          . Wrong address?{" "}
          <Link to="/signup" className="font-medium text-brand-ink hover:underline">
            Start again
          </Link>
          .
        </>
      }
    >
      <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4" noValidate>
        {state?.message && !verify.isError && <Notice tone="info">{state.message}</Notice>}
        {verify.isError && <Notice tone="bad">{errorText(verify.error)}</Notice>}
        {!params.get("email") && (
          <Field label="Email address">
            <Input type="email" autoComplete="email" value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} />
          </Field>
        )}
        <Field label="Code">
          <Input
            inputMode="numeric"
            autoComplete="one-time-code"
            value={code}
            onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 6))}
            className="num h-12 text-center text-[22px] tracking-[0.4em]"
            autoFocus
          />
        </Field>
        <Button
          type="submit"
          variant="primary"
          size="lg"
          loading={verify.isPending}
          disabled={code.length < 6 || !email}
        >
          Verify and continue
        </Button>
      </form>
    </AuthFrame>
  );
}

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { errorText } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Button, Field, Input, Notice, Select, useToast } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from "react-router";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import { useMe } from "../app/session";
import { AuthFrame } from "../components/AuthFrame";
import { OCCUPATION_LABEL, type ProfileOptions as Options } from "../lib/profile";

export default function Welcome() {
  const me = useMe();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const from = (location.state as { from?: string } | null)?.from;

    queryKey: ["profile-options"],

    staleTime: Infinity,
  });

    p?.current_occupation && p.current_occupation !== "Unknown" ? p.current_occupation : "",
  );
  const [field, setField] = useState(p?.specialization && p.specialization !== "Unknown" ? p.specialization : "");
  const [age, setAge] = useState(p?.age_bracket && p.age_bracket !== "Unknown" ? p.age_bracket : "");
  const [city, setCity] = useState(p?.city && p.city !== "Unknown" ? p.city : "");
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState(p?.phone ?? "");
  const [heard, setHeard] = useState(p?.how_did_you_hear && p.how_did_you_hear !== "Unknown" ? p.how_did_you_hear : "");
  const [tried, setTried] = useState(false);
  const save = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      api.post<{ message: string }>("/profile/complete", {
        current_occupation: occupation,
        specialization: field,
        age_bracket: age || null,
        city: city.trim() || "Unknown",
        phone: phone.trim() || null,
        how_did_you_hear: heard || "Unknown",
      }),
    onSuccess: async (r) => {
      toast({ tone: "good", text: r.message });
      await qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["me"] });
      navigate(from ?? "/my-learning", { replace: true });
    },
  });
  const submit = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setTried(true);
    if (occupation && field) save.mutate();
  };
  const o = options.data;
  return (
    <AuthFrame
      title={`Welcome, ${me.user.name.split(" ")[0]}`}
      description="Two questions and your suggestions fit you better. The rest is optional."
    >
      <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4" noValidate>
        {save.isError && <Notice tone="bad">{errorText(save.error)}</Notice>}
        <Field label="What do you do now?" error={tried && !occupation ? "Choose one." : null}>
          <Select
            value={occupation}
            onChange={(e) => setOccupation(e.target.value)}
            options={[
              { value: "", label: "Choose one" },
              ...(o?.occupations ?? []).map((v) => ({ value: v, label: OCCUPATION_LABEL[v] ?? v })),
            ]}
          />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Which field are you in, or want to be in?" error={tried && !field ? "Choose one." : null}>
          <Select
            value={field}

            options={[

            value={heard}

            options={[

import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { date, errorText } from "@xedu/shared/lib";
import { Button, buttonClass, Spinner, useToast } from "@xedu/shared/ui";
import { Heart } from "lucide-react";
import { Link, useNavigate } from "react-router";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import { useCart, useCourses, useWishlist } from "../api/queries";
import { CourseRow } from "../components/course";
import { usePageView } from "../lib/hooks";

export default function Wishlist() {
  usePageView();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const toast = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const wishlist = useWishlist();
  const cart = useCart();
  const courses = useCourses();
  const bySlug = new Map((courses.data ?? []).map((c) => [c.slug, c]));
  const remove = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (slug: string) => api.del<{ message: string }>(`/wishlist/${slug}`),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      toast({ tone: "info", text: r.message });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["wishlist"] });
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
  const toCart = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (slug: string) => api.post("/cart", { course_slug: slug }),
    onSuccess: () => {
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["cart"] });
      navigate("/cart");
    },
    onError: (e) => toast({ tone: "bad", text: errorText(e) }),
  });
  const items = wishlist.data ?? [];
  const inCart = new Set((cart.data ?? []).map((c) => c.course_slug));

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-[900px] px-5 pb-10 pt-12 sm:px-8">
      <h1 className="text-[34px] font-semibold leading-tight text-ink">Saved for later</h1>
      {wishlist.isPending ? (
        <Spinner className="mt-8" />
      ) : items.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="mt-8 rounded-md border border-dashed border-line-strong px-5 py-10 text-center">
          <Heart aria-hidden className="mx-auto size-6 text-muted" />
          <p className="mt-2 text-[16px] text-ink">Nothing saved yet. Save a course from its page to compare later.</p>
          <Link to="/courses" className={buttonClass("primary", "md", "mt-4")}>
            Find a course
          </Link>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ul className="mt-8 divide-y divide-line border-y border-line">
          {items.map((w) => {
            const c = bySlug.get(w.course_slug);
            return (
              <li key={w.course_slug} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 py-2">
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-80">
                  {c ? <CourseRow course={c} note={`Saved ${date(w.added_at)}`} className="-mx-3" /> : w.course_title}
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  {inCart.has(w.course_slug) ? (
                    <Link to="/cart" className={buttonClass("secondary", "sm")}>
                      In your cart
                    </Link>
                  ) : (
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="primary"
                      loading={toCart.isPending && toCart.variables === w.course_slug}
                      onClick={() => toCart.mutate(w.course_slug)}
                    >
                      Enrol
                    </Button>
                  )}
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    variant="ghost"
                    loading={remove.isPending && remove.variables === w.course_slug}
                    onClick={() => remove.mutate(w.course_slug)}
                  >
                    Remove
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

# Research

The experiments behind the paper. They import the backend's own code (`backend/app`), so what they measure is what
the CRM runs; studies that need whole simulated histories make each one in a temporary copy of the project, so your
own database and models are never touched.

```
ml/
  run_experiments.py      runs E1 to E9 and writes ml/results (fixed seeds)
  real_leads.py           loads the real X Education leads with only the columns a new lead has
  requirements.txt        matplotlib for the figures, on top of the backend's packages
  data/                   the two real public datasets (see data/README.md)
  experiments/            one script per study, plus _project.py (temporary project copies)
    published/            four public lead-scoring solutions, re-run exactly as their authors wrote them
  results/                the reports (.md), their numbers (.json) and figures/
```

Run from the project folder with the backend's Python after the first start (which trains the starting models):

```bash
pip install -r ml/requirements.txt
python ml/run_experiments.py            # E1 to E9, about 4 hours (E8 makes 11 simulated histories)
python ml/run_experiments.py quick      # without the slow studies (E2b, E6, E8, E8b), under an hour
python ml/run_experiments.py E9         # one experiment
```

What each experiment asks, its result and how it compares: [docs/RESEARCH.md](../docs/RESEARCH.md). The methods in
plain words: [docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md](../docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md).

FILE: c:\Users\krish\Desktop\xeducation-crm-v7.1.0\xeducation-crm\ml\real_leads.py

"""
real_leads.py — the public X Education lead data (ml/data/Leads.csv, 9,240 real leads), used ONLY
to test our modelling method on real data. The CRM's own lead model is trained on simulated
leads that carry every signal the website records (backend/app/ml/training/lead.py); the real file has no
video, pricing, cart or checkout columns, so a model trained only on it could not react to them.

Leakage: the real file also has columns the sales team fills in AFTER contacting a lead (Tags,
Lead Quality, Lead Profile, Last Activity, Asymmetrique scores ...). With them a model scores
AUC ~0.98, but a new lead never has them. They are never read here; backend/tests/test_no_leakage.py
fails if one is ever used.
"""

import os

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import FunctionTransformer, OneHotEncoder, StandardScaler

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
REAL_DATA = os.path.join(HERE, "data", "Leads.csv")

# The only inputs: all are known when a lead signs up, and the website records them too.
REAL_COLUMNS = [
    "LeadOrigin",
    "LeadSource",
    "DoNotEmail",
    "DoNotCall",
    "TotalVisits",
    "TotalTimeOnWebsite",
    "PageViewsPerVisit",
    "CurrentOccupation",
    "Specialization",
]
REAL_CATEGORICAL = ["LeadOrigin", "LeadSource", "CurrentOccupation", "Specialization"]

# Written by sales after contact (or IDs): never used as inputs.
LEAKY_COLUMNS = [
    "Tags",
    "Lead Quality",
    "Lead Profile",
    "Last Activity",
    "Last Notable Activity",
    "Asymmetrique Activity Index",
    "Asymmetrique Profile Index",
    "Asymmetrique Activity Score",
    "Asymmetrique Profile Score",
    "Prospect ID",
    "Lead Number",
]

# Kaggle "Lead Source" values -> the website's vocabulary (app.ml.features.LEAD_SOURCES)
SOURCE_MAP = {
    "Google": "Google",
    "google": "Google",
    "Pay per Click Ads": "Google",
    "Direct Traffic": "Direct Traffic",
    "Click2call": "Direct Traffic",
    "Olark Chat": "Olark Chat",
    "Live Chat": "Olark Chat",
    "Organic Search": "Organic Search",
    "bing": "Organic Search",
    "Reference": "Reference",
    "Referral Sites": "Reference",
    "Welingak Website": "Reference",
    "Facebook": "Social Media",
    "Social Media": "Social Media",
    "youtubechannel": "YouTube",
    "NC_EDM": "Email Campaign",
}
SPEC_MAP = {"Select": None, "E-COMMERCE": "E-Commerce", "E-Business": "E-Commerce"}


def load_real_leads(path=REAL_DATA):
    """The real X Education leads as the website's raw features. Returns (rows, y)."""
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        raise SystemExit(f"Real lead data not found: {path} (see ml/data/README.md)")
    d = pd.read_csv(path)
    visits = d["TotalVisits"].fillna(d["TotalVisits"].median())
    pages = d["Page Views Per Visit"].fillna(d["Page Views Per Visit"].median())
    occ = d["What is your current occupation"].where(d["What is your current occupation"].notna(), None)
    spec = d["Specialization"].map(lambda v: SPEC_MAP.get(v, v) if isinstance(v, str) else None)
    raw = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "LeadOrigin": d["Lead Origin"],
            "LeadSource": d["Lead Source"].map(
                lambda v: SOURCE_MAP.get(v, "Direct Traffic") if isinstance(v, str) else "Direct Traffic"
            ),
            "DoNotEmail": (d["Do Not Email"] == "Yes").astype(int),
            "DoNotCall": (d["Do Not Call"] == "Yes").astype(int),
            "TotalVisits": visits.clip(lower=1),
            "TotalTimeOnWebsite": d["Total Time Spent on Website"].fillna(0),
            "PageViewsPerVisit": pages,
            "CurrentOccupation": occ,
            "Specialization": spec,
        }
    )
    return raw.to_dict("records"), d["Converted"].astype(int).to_numpy()


def build_real_preprocessor():
    """One-hot categories, log-scaled counts, consent flags — for the 9 real columns."""
    return ColumnTransformer(
        [
            ("cat", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore", sparse_output=False), REAL_CATEGORICAL),
            (
                "skew",
                Pipeline(
                    [
                        ("log", FunctionTransformer(np.log1p, feature_names_out="one-to-one")),
                        ("scale", StandardScaler()),
                    ]
                ),
                ["TotalVisits", "TotalTimeOnWebsite", "PageViewsPerVisit"],
            ),
            ("flags", "passthrough", ["DoNotEmail", "DoNotCall"]),
        ]
    )

FILE: c:\Users\krish\Desktop\xeducation-crm-v7.1.0\xeducation-crm\ml\run_experiments.py
==========================================================================================

"""
Re-runs every experiment behind the paper's numbers and writes ml/results/*.md and *.json (fixed seeds).

Run from the project folder with the backend's Python, after the first start (it trains the starting models):
    backend/.venv/Scripts/python ml/run_experiments.py          Windows    (about 4 hours; "quick" under an hour)
    backend/.venv/bin/python ml/run_experiments.py              macOS, Linux
    ... ml/run_experiments.py quick                             skips the slow robustness and history studies
    ... ml/run_experiments.py E7                                one experiment (E1, E1b, E2, E2b, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7, E8, E8b, E9)

  E1   model_benchmark.py      the lead-scoring method on REAL data: boosting vs logistic, random forest, neural
                               networks on the 9,240 real X Education leads, no leaked columns
  E1b  published_benchmark.py  against four public solutions re-run exactly (same rows, same inputs) and published
                               papers on the same file; DeLong and McNemar tests, 30 new splits
  E2   hillstrom_uplift.py     next-best-action on a real randomized email experiment (64,000 customers)
  E2b  nba_robustness.py       next-best-action when the assumptions about the world are wrong (simulation)
  E3   learning_loop.py        does naive retraining fool itself, and does ours avoid it? (real data)
  E4   ab_engine_check.py      are the A/B statistics trustworthy? (simulated tests with known truth)
  E5   paths_check.py          do the what-if paths predict what learners do next? (on the CRM's own history)
  E6   lead_age_check.py       learned lead aging against hand-set decay rules (simulated histories)
  E7   capacity_check.py       capacity-aware next-best-action: a priced call slot against first come, first served
  E8   anchored_check.py       each step's effect from the CRM's own experiment (v7.1) inside the product: the ways
                               to retrain the lead score, judged on learners nobody contacted or trained on, across
                               control-group and random-step settings (11 simulated histories, about 3 hours)
  E8b  exploration_check.py    what the random learning steps cost, and what next-best-action loses without them
                               (closed loop, 12 months, 14 worlds of E2b, 5 runs each, about 45 minutes)
  E9   money_check.py          the money features against known truth: a priced monthly discount budget against
                               first come first served and the cart-recovery rule, the coupon guard, the pipeline
                               in rupees (money order against score order), and the planner's estimates

The next-best-action policy comparison (profit per 1,000 leads) is written when the models are trained
(python -m app.cli train uplift). The six-history report (ml/results/history_runs.md) is made by
ml/experiments/history_seeds.py (about an hour).
"""

import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
EXP = os.path.join(HERE, "experiments")
STEPS = [
    ("E1", "lead scoring on real data", "model_benchmark.py", False),
    ("E1b", "against published solutions", "published_benchmark.py", False),
    ("E2", "next-best-action on real data", "hillstrom_uplift.py", False),
    ("E2b", "next-best-action robustness", "nba_robustness.py", True),
    ("E3", "learning loop on real data", "learning_loop.py", False),
    ("E4", "A/B engine", "ab_engine_check.py", False),
    ("E5", "what-if paths", "paths_check.py", False),
    ("E6", "learned lead aging", "lead_age_check.py", True),
    ("E7", "capacity-aware next-best-action", "capacity_check.py", False),
    ("E8", "the anchored update in the product", "anchored_check.py", True),
    ("E8b", "the cost of random learning steps", "exploration_check.py", True),
    ("E9", "the money features", "money_check.py", False),
]


def main() -> int:
    args = [a for a in sys.argv[1:]]
    quick = "quick" in args
    only = {a.upper() for a in args if a.lower() != "quick"}
    os.environ.setdefault("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "1")
    failed = []
    for key, title, script, slow in STEPS:
        if (only and key.upper() not in only) or (quick and slow and not only):
            continue
        print(f"\n==== {key} {title} ({script}) ====", flush=True)
        t0 = time.time()
        code = subprocess.call([sys.executable, os.path.join(EXP, script)], cwd=os.path.dirname(HERE))
        print(f"---- {'done' if code == 0 else f'FAILED (exit {code})'} in {time.time() - t0:.0f} s", flush=True)
        if code:
            failed.append(key)
    print("\nResults: ml/results/*.md" + (f"\nFailed: {', '.join(failed)}" if failed else ""))
    return 1 if failed else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# The two real datasets

| File | What it is | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `Leads.csv` | **X Education Lead Scoring dataset** (Kaggle): 9,240 real leads of an online-education company, 37 columns; `Converted` = became a customer (38.5%). | Testing the lead-scoring method on real data without leakage: E1 (`ml/experiments/model_benchmark.py`, only the 9 columns known before any contact), E1b (`ml/experiments/published_benchmark.py`, four public solutions re-run exactly on their own rows and inputs and compared with ours) and `backend/tests/test_no_leakage.py`. It does not train the CRM's own model: it has none of the website signals (video, pricing page, cart, checkout) the CRM scores on. |
| `hillstrom.csv` | **Kevin Hillstrom, MineThatData E-Mail Analytics and Data Mining Challenge (2008)**: 64,000 customers randomly assigned to a men's email, a women's email or no email (one third each); outcomes `visit`, `conversion` and `spend` in the next two weeks. The standard public benchmark for uplift modelling. | E2 (`ml/experiments/hillstrom_uplift.py`) and E3 (`ml/experiments/learning_loop.py`). |

Columns of `Leads.csv` that sales fills in after contacting a lead (Tags, Lead Quality, Lead Profile, Last Activity,
Last Notable Activity, the Asymmetrique scores) leak the outcome and are never used by our model;
`backend/tests/test_no_leakage.py` fails if one is. E1b uses them only where it re-runs other people's published
solutions (which used them), to show what they are worth.

Both are public datasets, kept here so every result in `ml/results/` can be reproduced with
`python ml/run_experiments.py`. If this repository is made public, check the licence terms on the original download
pages first.

Simulated data is made by code, never stored here: `backend/app/simulation/population.py` simulates the 60,000 leads
the starting lead model is trained on and the randomised campaign that gives next-best-action its starting knowledge
(`python -m app.cli train all`); `backend/app/simulation/history.py` makes the six-month starting history of simulated
learners (`python -m app.cli history create`), each of them marked as simulated in the CRM.
